As often as the last of them passes him, the first of them will be brought back to him, until Allah pronounces His Judgment among mankind during a day whose extent will be fifty thousand years that you count, and he sees whether his path is to take him to Paradise or to Hell
9.hi: Abu Hurairah kehte hain ke Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne farmaya: "Agar khazane (sone-chandi) ka koi maalik uska haqq ada na kare, to Allah usay Qayamat ke din Jahannam ki aag mein garam karega, aur uski karwat, peshani aur peeth isse daagi jayegi yahan tak ke Allah insaano ke darmiyan faisla kare, us din jiski lambai tumhare hisaab se pachaas hazar saal ke barabar hogi, aur woh dekhega ke uska raasta Jannat ki taraf hai ya Jahannam ki taraf. Agar bakriyon ka koi maalik unpar zakat ada na kare, to woh Qayamat ke din sabse mazboot aur bhaari tadaad mein zahir hongi, aur unke liye ek narm reti wala maidan bichhaya jayega; woh usay apne seengon se maarengi aur apne khuron se kuchlengi; unmein koi bhi mudi hui seeng wala ya bina seeng ka nahi hoga. Jab bhi unmein se aakhri wapis aayegi, to pehli usse dobara laai jayegi, yahan tak ke Allah insaano ke darmiyan faisla kare, us din jiski lambai tumhare hisaab se pachaas hazar saal ke barabar hogi, aur woh dekhega ke uska raasta Jannat ki taraf hai ya Jahannam ki taraf. Agar unton ka koi maalik unka haqq ada na kare, to woh Qayamat ke din sabse mazboot aur bhaari tadaad mein zahir honge, aur unke liye ek narm reti wala maidan bichhaya jayega; woh usay apne seengon se maarenge aur apne khuron se kuchlenge; unmein koi bhi mudi hui seeng wala ya bina seeng ka nahi hoga. Jab bhi unmein se aakhri wapis aayega, to pehla usse dobara laaya jayega, yahan tak ke Allah insaano ke darmiyan faisla kare, us din jiski lambai tumhare hisaab se pachaas hazar saal ke barabar hogi, aur woh dekhega ke uska raasta Jannat ki taraf hai ya Jahannam ki taraf."

9.ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ مُسَافِرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي فُدَيْكٍ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَحْوَهُ ‏.‏ قَالَ فِي قِصَّةِ الإِبِلِ بَعْدَ قَوْلِهِ ‏"‏ لاَ يُؤَدِّي حَقَّهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَمِنْ حَقِّهَا حَلْبُهَا يَوْمَ وِرْدِهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
9.en: The above mentioned tradition has also been transmitted by Abu Hurairah through a different chain of narrators in a similar manner from the Prophet (SAWS). This version adds after the words “does not pay what is due on them” in the description of the camels the words “ One thing which is due being to milk them when they come down to drink water.”
9.hi: Upar zikr ki gayi riwayat Abu Hurairah se ek doosri sanad se bhi isi tarah, Nabi (ﷺ) ke hawale se, marwi hai. Is riwayat mein unton ke bayan mein "unka haqq ada na kare" ke baad izafa hai: "Ek haqq yeh hai ke jab woh paani peene aayen to unhein doodh nikaal kar diya jaye."

9.ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي عُمَرَ الْغُدَانِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَحْوَ هَذِهِ الْقِصَّةِ فَقَالَ لَهُ - يَعْنِي لأَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ - فَمَا حَقُّ الإِبِلِ قَالَ تُعْطِي الْكَرِيمَةَ وَتَمْنَحُ الْغَزِيرَةَ وَتُفْقِرُ الظَّهْرَ وَتُطْرِقُ الْفَحْلَ وَتَسْقِي اللَّبَنَ ‏.‏
9.en: Narrated Abu Hurayrah: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as saying something similar to this tradition. He (the narrator) said to AbuHurayrah: What is due on camels? He replied: That you should give the best of your camels (in the path of Allah), that you lend a milch she-camel, you lend your mount for riding, that you lend the stallion for covering, and that you give the milk (to the people) for drinking
9.hi: Abu Hurairah bayan karte hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ko isi jaisi ek baat kehte suna. Ravi ne Abu Hurairah se poocha: "Unton ka haqq kya hai?" Unhone jawab diya: "Ke tum apne behtareen unt (Allah ki raah mein) do, ke tum doodh dene wali unti udhaar do, ke tum apni sawari udhaar do sawari ke liye, ke tum nar unt (jodne ke liye) udhaar do, aur ke tum doodh (logon ko) peene ke liye do."

9.ar: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ خَلَفٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ سَمِعْتُ عُبَيْدَ بْنَ عُمَيْرٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَجُلٌ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مَا حَقُّ الإِبِلِ فَذَكَرَ نَحْوَهُ زَادَ ‏ "‏ وَإِعَارَةُ دَلْوِهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
9.en: The aforesaid tradition has also been transmitted by ‘Ubaid bin ‘ Umair through a different chain of narrators. This version goes:A man asked: Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), what is due on camels? He replied in a similar way. This version adds "and to lend its udders.”
9.hi: Upar zikr ki gayi riwayat Ubaid bin Umair se ek doosri sanad se bhi marwi hai. Is riwayat mein hai: Ek shakhs ne poocha: "Ya Rasoolallah, unton ka haqq kya hai?" Aap ne isi tarah jawab diya. Is riwayat mein izafa hai: "aur uske thanon (doodh dene ki jagahon) ko udhaar dena."

9.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ يَحْيَى الْحَرَّانِيُّ، حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى بْنِ حَبَّانَ، عَنْ عَمِّهِ، وَاسِعِ بْنِ حَبَّانَ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَمَرَ مِنْ كُلِّ جَادِّ عَشَرَةِ أَوْسُقٍ مِنَ التَّمْرِ بِقِنْوٍ يُعَلَّقُ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ لِلْمَسَاكِينِ ‏.‏
9.en: Jabir bin ‘Abdallah said The bProphet (SWAS) commanded that he who plucks ten wasqs of dates from date palms should hang a bunch of dates in the mosque for the poor
9.hi: Jabir bin Abdullah kehte hain: Nabi (ﷺ) ne hukm diya ke jo khajoor ke daraakhton se das wasq (khajoor) todta hai, usay masjid mein gharibon ke liye khajoor ka ek guccha latka dena chahiye.

9.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْخُزَاعِيُّ، وَمُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الأَشْهَبِ، عَنْ أَبِي نَضْرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، قَالَ بَيْنَمَا نَحْنُ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي سَفَرٍ إِذْ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ عَلَى نَاقَةٍ لَهُ فَجَعَلَ يَصْرِفُهَا يَمِينًا وَشِمَالاً فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنْ كَانَ عِنْدَهُ فَضْلُ ظَهْرٍ فَلْيَعُدْ بِهِ عَلَى مَنْ لاَ ظَهْرَ لَهُ وَمَنْ كَانَ عِنْدَهُ فَضْلُ زَادٍ فَلْيَعُدْ بِهِ عَلَى مَنْ لاَ زَادَ لَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ حَتَّى ظَنَنَّا أَنَّهُ لاَ حَقَّ لأَحَدٍ مِنَّا فِي الْفَضْلِ ‏.‏
9.en: Abu Sa’id al-Khudri said While we were traveling along with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) a man came to him on his she camel, and began to drive her right and left. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said he who has a spare riding beast should give it to him who has no riding beast; and he who has surplus equipment should give it to who has no equipment. We thought that none of us had a right in surplus property
9.hi: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri kehte hain: Jab hum Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ke saath safar kar rahe the, to ek shakhs apni unti par sawar hokar Aap ke paas aaya aur usay daayen-bayen hankne laga. Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne farmaya: "Jiske paas fazil (izafi) sawari hai, usay us shakhs ko dedena chahiye jiske paas sawari nahi hai; aur jiske paas izafi saaz-o-saamaan hai, usay us shakhs ko dedena chahiye jiske paas saaz-o-saamaan nahi hai." Humein laga ke humme se kisi ka izafi maal par koi haqq nahi hai.

9.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَعْلَى الْمُحَارِبِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا غَيْلاَنُ، عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ إِيَاسٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ لَمَّا نَزَلَتْ هَذِهِ الآيَةُ ‏{‏ وَالَّذِينَ يَكْنِزُونَ الذَّهَبَ وَالْفِضَّةَ ‏}‏ قَالَ كَبُرَ ذَلِكَ عَلَى الْمُسْلِمِينَ فَقَالَ عُمَرُ - رضى الله عنه أَنَا أُفَرِّجُ عَنْكُمْ ‏.‏ فَانْطَلَقَ فَقَالَ يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ إِنَّهُ كَبُرَ عَلَى أَصْحَابِكَ هَذِهِ الآيَةُ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَمْ يَفْرِضِ الزَّكَاةَ إِلاَّ لِيُطَيِّبَ مَا بَقِيَ مِنْ أَمْوَالِكُمْ وَإِنَّمَا فَرَضَ الْمَوَارِيثَ لِتَكُونَ لِمَنْ بَعْدَكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَكَبَّرَ عُمَرُ ثُمَّ قَالَ لَهُ ‏"‏ أَلاَ أُخْبِرُكَ بِخَيْرِ مَا يَكْنِزُ الْمَرْءُ الْمَرْأَةُ الصَّالِحَةُ إِذَا نَظَرَ إِلَيْهَا سَرَّتْهُ وَإِذَا أَمَرَهَا أَطَاعَتْهُ وَإِذَا غَابَ عَنْهَا حَفِظَتْهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
9.en: Narrated Abdullah ibn Abbas: When this verse was revealed: "And those who hoard gold and silver," the Muslims were grieved about it. Umar said: I shall dispel your care. He, therefore, went and said: Prophet of Allah, your Companions were grieved by this verse. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Allah has made zakat obligatory simply to purify your remaining property, and He made inheritances obligatory that they might come to those who survive you. Umar then said: Allah is most great. He then said to him: Let me inform you about the best a man hoards; it is a virtuous woman who pleases him when he looks at her, obeys him when he gives her a command, and guards his interests when he is away from her
9.hi: Abdullah bin Abbas bayan karte hain: Jab yeh ayat nazil hui: "Aur jo log sona aur chandi jama karte hain..." (Surah at-Tawbah, 9:34), to Musalmano ko is baat se pareshani hui. Umar ne kaha: "Main tumhari fikr door karunga." Chunanche woh gaye aur kaha: "Ae Allah ke Nabi, aapke sahaba is ayat se pareshan hain." Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne farmaya: "Allah ne zakat sirf isliye farz ki hai ke woh tumhari baaqi milkiyat ko pak kar de, aur Usne wirasat isliye farz ki hai ke woh un logon tak pahunche jo tumhare baad zinda rahenge." Umar ne phir kaha: "Allahu Akbar." Phir Aap ne unse farmaya: "Kya main tumhein bataon ke aadmi kis behtareen cheez ko jama karta hai? Yeh ek neksirisht aurat hai jo usay dekhkar khush karti hai, uski itaat karti hai jab woh usay kuch hukm de, aur uski gair-maujoodgi mein uske huqooq ki hifazat karti hai."

9.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ، حَدَّثَنَا مُصْعَبُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ شُرَحْبِيلَ، حَدَّثَنِي يَعْلَى بْنُ أَبِي يَحْيَى، عَنْ فَاطِمَةَ بِنْتِ حُسَيْنٍ، عَنْ حُسَيْنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لِلسَّائِلِ حَقٌّ وَإِنْ جَاءَ عَلَى فَرَسٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
9.en: Narrated Ali ibn Abu Talib: The Prophet (ﷺ) said: A beggar has the right though he may be riding (a horse)
9.hi: Ali bin Abi Talib bayan karte hain ke Nabi (ﷺ) ne farmaya: "Bheekh maangne wale ka haqq hai, chahe woh (ghode par) sawar hi kyun na ho."

9.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ آدَمَ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، عَنْ شَيْخٍ، قَالَ رَأَيْتُ سُفْيَانَ عِنْدَهُ عَنْ فَاطِمَةَ بِنْتِ حُسَيْنٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهَا، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
9.en: The above mentioned tradition has also been transmitted by 'Ali through a different chain of narrators in a similar manner from the Prophet(ﷺ)
9.hi: Upar zikr ki gayi riwayat Ali se ek doosri sanad se bhi isi tarah, Nabi (ﷺ) ke hawale se, marwi hai.

9.ar: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ بُجَيْدٍ، عَنْ جَدَّتِهِ أُمِّ بُجَيْدٍ، وَكَانَتْ، مِمَّنْ بَايَعَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ لَهُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْكَ إِنَّ الْمِسْكِينَ لَيَقُومُ عَلَى بَابِي فَمَا أَجِدُ لَهُ شَيْئًا أُعْطِيهِ إِيَّاهُ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِنْ لَمْ تَجِدِي لَهُ شَيْئًا تُعْطِينَهُ إِيَّاهُ إِلاَّ ظِلْفًا مُحْرَقًا فَادْفَعِيهِ إِلَيْهِ فِي يَدِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
9.en: Narrated Umm Bujayd: She took the oath of allegiance to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and said to him: Messenger of Allah, a poor man stands at my door, but I find nothing to give him. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to her: If you do not find anything to give him, put something in his hand, even though it should be a burnt hoof
9.hi: Umm Bujaid bayan karti hain: Unhone Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) se bay'at ki aur Aap se kaha: "Ya Rasoolallah, ek gareeb aadmi mere darwaze par khada hota hai, lekin mujhe usay dene ke liye kuch nahi milta." Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne unse farmaya: "Agar tumhein usay dene ke liye kuch na mile, to uske haath mein kuch rakh do, chahe woh jala hua khur (janwar ka khur) hi kyun na ho."

9.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ أَبِي شُعَيْبٍ الْحَرَّانِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَسْمَاءَ، قَالَتْ قَدِمَتْ عَلَىَّ أُمِّي رَاغِبَةً فِي عَهْدِ قُرَيْشٍ وَهِيَ رَاغِمَةٌ مُشْرِكَةٌ فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ أُمِّي قَدِمَتْ عَلَىَّ وَهِيَ رَاغِمَةٌ مُشْرِكَةٌ أَفَأَصِلُهَا قَالَ ‏ "‏ نَعَمْ فَصِلِي أُمَّكِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
9.en: Asma‘ said My mother came to me seeking some act of kindness from me during the treaty of the Quraish (at Hudaibiyyah). While she hated Islam and she was a polytheist. I said Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), my mother has come to me while she hates Islam and she is a disbeliever. May I do an act of kindness to her? He replied Yes, do an act of kindness to her
9.hi: Asma kehti hain: Meri maa mujhse kisi ehsaan ki umeed se milne aayi Quraish ke sulahnama (Hudaybiyyah) ke daur mein. Woh Islam se nafrat karti thi aur mushrika thi. Maine kaha: "Ya Rasoolallah, meri maa mujhse milne aayi hain jabke woh Islam se nafrat karti hain aur kafira hain. Kya main unke saath ehsaan karoon?" Aap ne jawab diya: "Haan, unke saath ehsaan karo."

9.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا كَهْمَسٌ، عَنْ سَيَّارِ بْنِ مَنْظُورٍ، - رَجُلٍ مِنْ بَنِي فَزَارَةَ - عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ امْرَأَةٍ، يُقَالُ لَهَا بُهَيْسَةُ عَنْ أَبِيهَا، قَالَتِ اسْتَأْذَنَ أَبِي النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَدَخَلَ بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ قَمِيصِهِ فَجَعَلَ يُقَبِّلُ وَيَلْتَزِمُ ثُمَّ قَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مَا الشَّىْءُ الَّذِي لاَ يَحِلُّ مَنْعُهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ الْمَاءُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ مَا الشَّىْءُ الَّذِي لاَ يَحِلُّ مَنْعُهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ الْمِلْحُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مَا الشَّىْءُ الَّذِي لاَ يَحِلُّ مَنْعُهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَنْ تَفْعَلَ الْخَيْرَ خَيْرٌ لَكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
9.en: Buhaysah reported on the authority of his father:My father sought permission from the Prophet (ﷺ). (When permission was granted and he came near him) he lifted his shirt, and began to kiss him and embrace him (out of love for him). He asked: Messenger of Allah, what is the thing which it is unlawful to refuse? He replied: Water. He again asked: Prophet of Allah, what is the thing which it is unlawful to refuse? He replied: Salt. He again asked: Prophet of Allah, what is the thing which it is unlawful to refuse? He said: To do good is better for you
9.hi: Buhaysah apne walid ke hawale se bayan karte hain: Mere walid ne Nabi (ﷺ) se ijazat maangi. (Jab ijazat mil gayi aur woh Aap ke qareeb aaye,) unhone Aap ki qamees uthai aur Aap ko chumne aur gale lagane lage (muhabbat ki wajah se). Unhone poocha: "Ya Rasoolallah, woh kaunsi cheez hai jise inkaar karna haraam hai?" Aap ne jawab diya: "Paani." Unhone phir poocha: "Ya Allah ke Nabi, woh kaunsi cheez hai jise inkaar karna haraam hai?" Aap ne jawab diya: "Namak." Unhone phir poocha: "Ya Allah ke Nabi, woh kaunsi cheez hai jise inkaar karna haraam hai?" Aap ne farmaya: "Neki karna tumhare liye behtar hai."

9.ar: حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ آدَمَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ بَكْرٍ السَّهْمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا مُبَارَكُ بْنُ فَضَالَةَ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ الْبُنَانِيِّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ هَلْ مِنْكُمْ أَحَدٌ أَطْعَمَ الْيَوْمَ مِسْكِينًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ رضى الله عنه - دَخَلْتُ الْمَسْجِدَ فَإِذَا أَنَا بِسَائِلٍ يَسْأَلُ فَوَجَدْتُ كِسْرَةَ خُبْزٍ فِي يَدِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ فَأَخَذْتُهَا مِنْهُ فَدَفَعْتُهَا إِلَيْهِ ‏.‏
9.en: ‘Abd al-Rahman bin Abu Bakr (may Allah be pleased with him) said The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) asked Is there anyone of you who provided food to a poor man today? Abu Bakr said I entered the mosque where a beggar was begging ; I found a piece of bread in the hand of ‘Abdal-Rahman which I took and gave it to him
9.hi: Abdur Rahman bin Abu Bakr bayan karte hain: Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne poocha: "Kya tum mein se kisi ne aaj kisi gareeb ko khana khilaya hai?" Abu Bakr ne kaha: "Main masjid mein dakhil hua jahan ek bheekh maangne wala tha; maine Abdur Rahman ke haath mein roti ka ek tukda paaya, jo maine liya aur usay de diya."

9.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْعَبَّاسِ الْقِلَّوْرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ الْحَضْرَمِيُّ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ مُعَاذٍ التَّيْمِيِّ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُنْكَدِرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لاَ يُسْأَلُ بِوَجْهِ اللَّهِ إِلاَّ الْجَنَّةُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
9.en: Narrated Jabir ibn Abdullah: The Prophet (ﷺ) said: Nothing but Paradise must be begged for Allah's sake
9.hi: Jabir bin Abdullah bayan karte hain ke Nabi (ﷺ) ne farmaya: "Sirf Jannat ke siwa kuch bhi Allah ki khaatir maanga jana nahi chahiye."

9.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنِ اسْتَعَاذَ بِاللَّهِ فَأَعِيذُوهُ وَمَنْ سَأَلَ بِاللَّهِ فَأَعْطُوهُ وَمَنْ دَعَاكُمْ فَأَجِيبُوهُ وَمَنْ صَنَعَ إِلَيْكُمْ مَعْرُوفًا فَكَافِئُوهُ فَإِنْ لَمْ تَجِدُوا مَا تُكَافِئُونَهُ فَادْعُوا لَهُ حَتَّى تَرَوْا أَنَّكُمْ قَدْ كَافَأْتُمُوهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
9.en: Narrated Abdullah ibn Umar: The Prophet (ﷺ) said: If anyone seeks protection in Allah's name, grant him protection; if anyone begs in Allah's name, give him something; if anyone gives you an invitation, accept it; and if anyone does you a kindness, recompense him; but if you have not the means to do so, pray for him until you feel that you have compensated him
9.hi: Abdullah bin Umar bayan karte hain ke Nabi (ﷺ) ne farmaya: "Agar koi Allah ke naam par panah maange, to usay panah do; agar koi Allah ke naam par maange, to usay kuch do; agar koi tumhein dawat de, to usay qubool karo; aur agar koi tumhare saath ehsaan kare, to usay iska badla do; lekin agar tumhare paas iska koi zariya na ho, to uske liye dua karo jab tak tumhein lage ke tumne usay uska badla de diya hai."

9.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ عَاصِمِ بْنِ عُمَرَ بْنِ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ مَحْمُودِ بْنِ لَبِيدٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الأَنْصَارِيِّ، قَالَ كُنَّا عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذْ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ بِمِثْلِ بَيْضَةٍ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَصَبْتُ هَذِهِ مِنْ مَعْدِنٍ فَخُذْهَا فَهِيَ صَدَقَةٌ مَا أَمْلِكُ غَيْرَهَا ‏.‏ فَأَعْرَضَ عَنْهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثُمَّ أَتَاهُ مِنْ قِبَلِ رُكْنِهِ الأَيْمَنِ فَقَالَ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ فَأَعْرَضَ عَنْهُ ثُمَّ أَتَاهُ مِنْ قِبَلِ رُكْنِهِ الأَيْسَرِ فَأَعْرَضَ عَنْهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثُمَّ أَتَاهُ مِنْ خَلْفِهِ فَأَخَذَهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَحَذَفَهُ بِهَا فَلَوْ أَصَابَتْهُ لأَوْجَعَتْهُ أَوْ لَعَقَرَتْهُ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ يَأْتِي أَحَدُكُمْ بِمَا يَمْلِكُ فَيَقُولُ هَذِهِ صَدَقَةٌ ثُمَّ يَقْعُدُ يَسْتَكِفُّ النَّاسَ خَيْرُ الصَّدَقَةِ مَا كَانَ عَنْ ظَهْرِ غِنًى ‏"‏ ‏.‏
9.en: Narrated Jabir ibn Abdullah Al-Ansari: While we were sitting with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) a man brought him some gold equal in weight to an egg, and said: Messenger of Allah, I have got this from a mine; take it; it is sadaqah. I have no more than this. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) turned his attention from him. Then he came to him from his right side and repeated the same words. But he (the Prophet) turned his attention from him. He then came to him from his left side and repeated the same words. But he (again) turned his attention from him. He then came to him from behind. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) took it and threw it away. Had it hit him, it would have hurt him or wounded him. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: One of you brings all that he possesses and says: This is sadaqah. Then he sits down and spreads his hand before the people. The best sadaqah is that which leaves a competence
9.hi: Jabir bin Abdullah al-Ansari bayan karte hain: Jab hum Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ke saath baithe the, ek shakhs Aap ke paas ande jitna sona lekar aaya aur kaha: "Ya Rasoolallah, mujhe yeh khan (mine) se mila hai; ise le lijiye, yeh sadqa hai. Mere paas isse zyada kuch nahi." Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne apna dhyan usse hata liya. Phir woh Aap ke daayen taraf se aaya aur wahi baat dohrai. Lekin Aap ne apna dhyan phir usse hata liya. Phir woh Aap ke bayen taraf se aaya aur wahi baat dohrai. Lekin Aap ne (phir) apna dhyan usse hata liya. Phir woh Aap ke peechhe se aaya. Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne usay le liya aur usay phenk diya. Agar woh usse takra jata, to usay chot lag jati ya woh zakhmi ho jata. Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne farmaya: "Tum mein se koi apna sab kuch le aata hai aur kehta hai: 'Yeh sadqa hai.' Phir woh baith jata hai aur logon ke saamne apna haath phaila deta hai. Behtareen sadqa woh hai jo (dene wale ke liye bhi) kaafi hisse ke saath choda jaye."

9.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ إِدْرِيسَ، عَنِ ابْنِ إِسْحَاقَ، بِإِسْنَادِهِ وَمَعْنَاهُ زَادَ ‏ "‏ خُذْ عَنَّا مَالَكَ لاَ حَاجَةَ لَنَا بِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
9.en: The above mentioned tradition has also been transmitted by Ibn Ishaq through a different chain of narrators to the same effect. This version adds "have your property with you from us. We have no need of it
9.hi: Upar zikr ki gayi riwayat Ibn Ishaq ke zariye ek doosri sanad se bhi isi mazmoon ke saath marwi hai. Is riwayat mein izafa hai: "Apna maal apne paas rakho, humein iski zaroorat nahi."

9.ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَجْلاَنَ، عَنْ عِيَاضِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، سَمِعَ أَبَا سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيَّ، يَقُولُ دَخَلَ رَجُلٌ الْمَسْجِدَ فَأَمَرَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم النَّاسَ أَنْ يَطْرَحُوا ثِيَابًا فَطَرَحُوا فَأَمَرَ لَهُ مِنْهَا بِثَوْبَيْنِ ثُمَّ حَثَّ عَلَى الصَّدَقَةِ فَجَاءَ فَطَرَحَ أَحَدَ الثَّوْبَيْنِ فَصَاحَ بِهِ وَقَالَ ‏ "‏ خُذْ ثَوْبَكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
9.en: Narrated Abu Sa'id al-Khudri: A man entered the mosque. The Prophet (ﷺ) commanded the people to throw their clothes as sadaqah. Thereupon they threw their clothes (as sadaqah). He then asked him to take two clothes from them. He reprimanded him and said: Take your clothe
9.hi: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri bayan karte hain: Ek shakhs masjid mein dakhil hua. Nabi (ﷺ) ne logon ko hukm diya ke apne kapde sadqe mein phenk dein. Isi par unhone apne kapde phenke (sadqe mein). Phir Aap ne usse do kapde lene ko kaha. Aap ne usse sakhti se kaha: "Apna kapda le lo."

9.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِنَّ خَيْرَ الصَّدَقَةِ مَا تَرَكَ غِنًى أَوْ تُصُدِّقَ بِهِ عَنْ ظَهْرِ غِنًى وَابْدَأْ بِمَنْ تَعُولُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
9.en: Abu Hurairah reported the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as saying The best sadaqah is that which leaves a competence ; and begin with those for whom you are responsible
9.hi: Abu Hurairah bayan karte hain ke Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne farmaya: "Behtareen sadqa woh hai jo (dene wale ke liye bhi) kaafi hisse ke saath choda jaye; aur unse (kharcha) shuru karo jinke tum zimmedaar ho."

9.ar: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَيَزِيدُ بْنُ خَالِدِ بْنِ مَوْهَبٍ الرَّمْلِيُّ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ جَعْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَىُّ الصَّدَقَةِ أَفْضَلُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ جُهْدُ الْمُقِلِّ وَابْدَأْ بِمَنْ تَعُولُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
9.en: Abu Hurairah reported I asked Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), What kind of sadaqah is most excellent? He replied What a man with little property can afford to give; and begin with those for whom you are responsible
9.hi: Abu Hurairah bayan karte hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) se poocha: "Kaunsa sadqa sabse behtareen hai?" Aap ne jawab diya: "Woh jo kam maal wala shakhs de sakta hai; aur unse (kharcha) shuru karo jinke tum zimmedaar ho."

9.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ، وَعُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، - وَهَذَا حَدِيثُهُ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا الْفَضْلُ بْنُ دُكَيْنٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ، - رضى الله عنه - يَقُولُ أَمَرَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمًا أَنْ نَتَصَدَّقَ فَوَافَقَ ذَلِكَ مَالاً عِنْدِي فَقُلْتُ الْيَوْمَ أَسْبِقُ أَبَا بَكْرٍ إِنْ سَبَقْتُهُ يَوْمًا فَجِئْتُ بِنِصْفِ مَالِي فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَا أَبْقَيْتَ لأَهْلِكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَأَتَى أَبُو بَكْرٍ - رضى الله عنه - بِكُلِّ مَا عِنْدَهُ فَقَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَا أَبْقَيْتَ لأَهْلِكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبْقَيْتُ لَهُمُ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ لاَ أُسَابِقُكَ إِلَى شَىْءٍ أَبَدًا ‏.‏
9.en: Narrated Umar ibn al-Khattab: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) commanded us one day to give sadaqah. At that time I had some property. I said: Today I shall surpass AbuBakr if I surpass him any day. I, therefore, brought half my property. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) asked: What did you leave for your family? I replied: The same amount. AbuBakr brought all that he had with him. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) asked him: What did you leave for your family? He replied: I left Allah and His Apostle for them. I said: I shall never compete you in anything
9.hi: Umar bin al-Khattab bayan karte hain: Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne humein ek din sadqa dene ka hukm diya. Us waqt mere paas kuch maal tha. Maine socha: "Agar kabhi main Abu Bakr se aage nikal sakta hoon, to aaj hi nikalunga." Isliye main apna aadha maal le aaya. Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne poocha: "Tumne apne pariwar ke liye kya chhoda?" Maine jawab diya: "Utni hi miqdar." Abu Bakr apna sab kuch le aaye jo unke paas tha. Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne unse poocha: "Aapne apne pariwar ke liye kya chhoda?" Unhone jawab diya: "Maine unke liye Allah aur Uske Rasool ko chhoda." Maine kaha: "Main kabhi bhi kisi cheez mein aapse muqabla nahi karunga."

9.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا هَمَّامٌ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ، أَنَّ سَعْدًا، أَتَى النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ أَىُّ الصَّدَقَةِ أَعْجَبُ إِلَيْكَ قَالَ ‏ "‏ الْمَاءُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
9.en: Sa’id reported Sa’d came to the Prophet (SWAS) and asked him Which sadaqah do you like most? He replied Water
9.hi: Sa'id kehte hain: Sa'd Nabi (ﷺ) ke paas aaye aur poocha: "Aapko kaunsa sadqa sabse zyada pasand hai?" Aap ne jawab diya: "Paani."

9.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحِيمِ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَرْعَرَةَ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، وَالْحَسَنِ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ عُبَادَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَحْوَهُ ‏.‏
9.en: The above mentioned tradition has also been narrated by Sa’d bin ‘Ubadah from the Prophet (ﷺ) in the same manner
9.hi: Upar zikr ki gayi riwayat Sa'd bin Ubadah ke zariye Nabi (ﷺ) se isi tarah bayan ki gayi hai.

9.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ رَجُلٍ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ عُبَادَةَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ أُمَّ سَعْدٍ مَاتَتْ فَأَىُّ الصَّدَقَةِ أَفْضَلُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ الْمَاءُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَحَفَرَ بِئْرًا وَقَالَ هَذِهِ لأُمِّ سَعْدٍ ‏.‏
9.en: Narrated Sa'd ibn Ubadah: Sa'd asked: Messenger of Allah, Umm Sa'd has died; what form of sadaqah is best? He replied: Water (is best). He dug a well and said: It is for Umm Sa'd
9.hi: Sa'd bin Ubadah bayan karte hain: Sa'd ne poocha: "Ya Rasoolallah, Umm Sa'd (meri maa) ka inteqal ho gaya hai; kaunsi qism ka sadqa sabse behtareen hai?" Aap ne jawab diya: "Paani (sabse behtareen hai)." Unhone ek kuwan khudwaya aur kaha: "Yeh Umm Sa'd ke liye hai."

9.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ إِشْكَابَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَدْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو خَالِدٍ، - الَّذِي كَانَ يَنْزِلُ فِي بَنِي دَالاَنَ - عَنْ نُبَيْحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ أَيُّمَا مُسْلِمٍ كَسَا مُسْلِمًا ثَوْبًا عَلَى عُرْىٍ كَسَاهُ اللَّهُ مِنْ خُضْرِ الْجَنَّةِ وَأَيُّمَا مُسْلِمٍ أَطْعَمَ مُسْلِمًا عَلَى جُوعٍ أَطْعَمَهُ اللَّهُ مِنْ ثِمَارِ الْجَنَّةِ وَأَيُّمَا مُسْلِمٍ سَقَى مُسْلِمًا عَلَى ظَمَإٍ سَقَاهُ اللَّهُ مِنَ الرَّحِيقِ الْمَخْتُومِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
9.en: Narrated Abu Sa'id (al-Khudri): The Prophet (ﷺ) said: If any Muslim clothes a Muslim when he is naked, Allah will clothe him with some green garments of Paradise; if any Muslim feeds a Muslim when he is hungry, Allah will feed him with some of the fruits of Paradise; and if any Muslim gives a Muslim drink when he is thirsty, Allah will give him some of the pure wine which is sealed to drink
9.hi: Abu Sa'id (al-Khudri) bayan karte hain ke Nabi (ﷺ) ne farmaya: "Agar koi Musalman kisi Musalman ko kapda pehnaye jab woh nangaa ho, to Allah usay Jannat ke kuch hare kapde pehnayega; agar koi Musalman kisi Musalman ko khana khilaye jab woh bhookha ho, to Allah usay Jannat ke kuch phalon mein se khilayega; aur agar koi Musalman kisi Musalman ko pani pilaye jab woh pyaasa ho, to Allah usay us mohar-band khaalis sharaab mein se pilayega jo peene ke liye taiyar ki gayi hai."

9.ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُوسَى، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا عِيسَى، - وَهَذَا حَدِيثُ مُسَدَّدٍ وَهُوَ أَتَمُّ - عَنِ الأَوْزَاعِيِّ، عَنْ حَسَّانَ بْنِ عَطِيَّةَ، عَنْ أَبِي كَبْشَةَ السَّلُولِيِّ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَمْرٍو، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ أَرْبَعُونَ خَصْلَةً أَعْلاَهُنَّ مَنِيحَةُ الْعَنْزِ مَا يَعْمَلُ رَجُلٌ بِخَصْلَةٍ مِنْهَا رَجَاءَ ثَوَابِهَا وَتَصْدِيقَ مَوْعُودِهَا إِلاَّ أَدْخَلَهُ اللَّهُ بِهَا الْجَنَّةَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو دَاوُدَ فِي حَدِيثِ مُسَدَّدٍ قَالَ حَسَّانُ فَعَدَدْنَا مَا دُونَ مَنِيحَةِ الْعَنْزِ مِنْ رَدِّ السَّلاَمِ وَتَشْمِيتِ الْعَاطِسِ وَإِمَاطَةِ الأَذَى عَنِ الطَّرِيقِ وَنَحْوِهِ فَمَا اسْتَطَعْنَا أَنْ نَبْلُغَ خَمْسَ عَشْرَةَ خَصْلَةً ‏.‏
9.en: Narrated Abdullah ibn Amr ibn al-'As: The Prophet (ﷺ) said: There are forty characteristics; the highest of them is to give a goat on loan (for benefiting from its milk). If any man carries out any of those characteristics with the hope of getting a reward and testifying to the promise for it, Allah will admit him to Paradise for it. Abu Dawud said: In the version of Musaddad, Hassan said: So we counted other characteristics than lending the goat: to return the greeting, to respond to sneezing, and remove things which cause annoyance to the people from their path, and similar other things. We could not reach fifteen characteristics
9.hi: Abdullah bin Amr bin al-'As bayan karte hain ke Nabi (ﷺ) ne farmaya: "Chalis khasiyaten (achhi khusoosiyaten) hain; unme sabse bulund yeh hai ke koi bakri udhaar de (uske doodh se faida uthane ke liye). Agar koi shakhs sawaab paane ki ummeed aur iske wade ki tasdeeq karte hue in khasiyaton mein se koi ek bhi apnaye, to Allah isi wajah se usay Jannat mein dakhil karega." Abu Dawud kehte hain: Musaddad ki riwayat mein Hassan kehte hain: Chunanche humne bakri udhaar dene ke alawa aur khasiyaten ginin: salaam ka jawab dena, chheenk ka jawab dena, aur logon ke raste se takleef-deh cheezein hatana, aur aisi hi doosri baaten. Hum pandra tak nahi pahunch sake.

9.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ، - الْمَعْنَى - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ بُرَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِنَّ الْخَازِنَ الأَمِينَ - الَّذِي يُعْطِي مَا أُمِرَ بِهِ كَامِلاً مُوَفَّرًا طَيِّبَةً بِهِ نَفْسُهُ حَتَّى يَدْفَعَهُ إِلَى الَّذِي أُمِرَ لَهُ بِهِ - أَحَدُ الْمُتَصَدِّقَيْنِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
9.en: Abu Musa reported The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as saying The faithful trustee who gives what he is commanded completely and in full with a good will, and delivers it to the one whom he was told to give it, is one of the two who gives sadaqah
9.hi: Abu Musa kehte hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ko yeh farmate suna: "Ek imaandaar zaakhirah-daar jo usay poori tarah aur mukammal, achhi niyat ke saath, jo hukm diya gaya hai woh ada karta hai, aur usay us shakhs tak pahunchata hai jise dene ka hukm diya gaya tha, woh sadqa dene walon mein se ek shumar hota hai."

9.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ شَقِيقٍ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، - رضى الله عنها - قَالَتْ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِذَا أَنْفَقَتِ الْمَرْأَةُ مِنْ بَيْتِ زَوْجِهَا غَيْرَ مُفْسِدَةٍ كَانَ لَهَا أَجْرُ مَا أَنْفَقَتْ وَلِزَوْجِهَا أَجْرُ مَا اكْتَسَبَ وَلِخَازِنِهِ مِثْلُ ذَلِكَ لاَ يَنْقُصُ بَعْضُهُمْ أَجْرَ بَعْضٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
9.en: A’ishah reported The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as saying When a woman gives (some of the property) from her husband’s house, not wasting it, she will have her reward for what she has spent, and her husband will have his for what he earned. The said applies to a trustee. In no respect does the one diminish the reward of the other
9.hi: Ayesha kehti hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ko yeh farmate suna: "Jab koi aurat apne shohar ke ghar se (kuch maal) barbaad kiye bagair deti hai, to usay apne kharch ka sawaab milta hai, aur uske shohar ko uski kamai ka sawaab milta hai. Yehi baat zaakhirah-daar par bhi lagu hoti hai. Kisi bhi soorat mein ek doosre ke sawaab mein kami nahi karta."

9.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَوَّارٍ الْمِصْرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ السَّلاَمِ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ، عَنْ زِيَادِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنْ سَعْدٍ، قَالَ لَمَّا بَايَعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم النِّسَاءَ قَامَتِ امْرَأَةٌ جَلِيلَةٌ كَأَنَّهَا مِنْ نِسَاءِ مُضَرَ فَقَالَتْ يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ إِنَّا كَلٌّ عَلَى آبَائِنَا وَأَبْنَائِنَا - قَالَ أَبُو دَاوُدَ وَأُرَى فِيهِ وَأَزْوَاجِنَا - فَمَا يَحِلُّ لَنَا مِنْ أَمْوَالِهِمْ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ الرَّطْبُ تَأْكُلْنَهُ وَتُهْدِينَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو دَاوُدَ الرَّطْبُ الْخُبْزُ وَالْبَقْلُ وَالرُّطَبُ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو دَاوُدَ وَكَذَا رَوَاهُ الثَّوْرِيُّ عَنْ يُونُسَ ‏.‏
9.en: Sa’d said When the Messenger of Allah (SWAS) took the oath of allegiance from woman, a woman of high rank, who seemed to be one of the women of Mudar, rose and said Prophet of Allah (SWAS), we are dependant on our parents, our sons. (Abu Dawud said I think (this version) has the word “ and our husbands”. ) So what part of their property can be spent lawfully? He said Fresh food which you eat and give as a present. Abu Dawud said The Arabic word ratb means bread, vegetables and fresh dates. Abu Dawud said Al-Thawri transmitted from Yunus in a similar manner
9.hi: Sa'd kehte hain: Jab Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) auraton se bay'at le rahe the, to ek uche darje ki aurat, jo Mudar qabile ki maloom hoti thi, khadi hui aur kaha: "Allah ke Nabi, hum apne walidain aur apne beton par munhasir hain." (Abu Dawud kehte hain: Mera khayal hai isme "aur humare shohar" ka lafz bhi hai.) "To phir unka kaunsa maal hum jaiz taur par kharch kar sakti hain?" Aap ne farmaya: "Taaza khana jo tum khaao aur tohfe mein do." Abu Dawud kehte hain: Arabi lafz "ratb" ka matlab hai roti, sabziyan aur taaza khajoor. Abu Dawud kehte hain: Al-Thawri ne yeh riwayat Yunus se isi tarah bayan ki hai.

9.ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ هَمَّامِ بْنِ مُنَبِّهٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِذَا أَنْفَقَتِ الْمَرْأَةُ مِنْ كَسْبِ زَوْجِهَا مِنْ غَيْرِ أَمْرِهِ فَلَهَا نِصْفُ أَجْرِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
9.en: Abu Hurairah reported The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as saying When a woman gives something her husband has earned without being commanded by him to do so, she has half his reward
9.hi: Abu Hurairah bayan karte hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ko yeh farmate suna: "Jab koi aurat apne shohar ki kamai mein se, uske hukm ke bagair, kuch deti hai, to usay uska aadha ajr milta hai."

9.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَوَّارٍ الْمِصْرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَةُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، فِي الْمَرْأَةِ تَصَدَّقُ مِنْ بَيْتِ زَوْجِهَا قَالَ لاَ إِلاَّ مِنْ قُوتِهَا وَالأَجْرُ بَيْنَهُمَا وَلاَ يَحِلُّ لَهَا أَنْ تَصَدَّقَ مِنْ مَالِ زَوْجِهَا إِلاَّ بِإِذْنِهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو دَاوُدَ هَذَا يُضَعِّفُ حَدِيثَ هَمَّامٍ ‏.‏
9.en: ‘Ata said Abu Hurairah was asked Whether a woman could give sadaqah from the house (property) of her husband. He replied `No’. She can give it from her maintenance. The reward will be divided between them. It is not lawful for her to give sadaqah from her husband’s property without his permission. Abu Dawud said This version weakens the version narrated by Hammam (bin Munabbih)
9.hi: Ata kehte hain: Abu Hurairah se poocha gaya ke kya ek aurat apne shohar ke ghar (ki maal) se sadqa de sakti hai. Unhone jawab diya: "Nahi." Woh apne kharche mein se de sakti hai. Sawaab dono ke darmiyan taqseem hoga. Uske liye apne shohar ke maal se uski ijazat ke bagair sadqa dena jaiz nahi. Abu Dawud kehte hain: Yeh riwayat Hammam (bin Munabbih) ki riwayat ko kamzor karti hai.

9.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ لَمَّا نَزَلَتْ ‏{‏ لَنْ تَنَالُوا الْبِرَّ حَتَّى تُنْفِقُوا مِمَّا تُحِبُّونَ ‏}‏ قَالَ أَبُو طَلْحَةَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَرَى رَبَّنَا يَسْأَلُنَا مِنْ أَمْوَالِنَا فَإِنِّي أُشْهِدُكَ أَنِّي قَدْ جَعَلْتُ أَرْضِي بِأَرِيحَاءَ لَهُ فَقَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ اجْعَلْهَا فِي قَرَابَتِكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَسَمَهَا بَيْنَ حَسَّانَ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ وَأُبَىِّ بْنِ كَعْبٍ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو دَاوُدَ بَلَغَنِي عَنِ الأَنْصَارِيِّ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ أَبُو طَلْحَةَ زَيْدُ بْنُ سَهْلِ بْنِ الأَسْوَدِ بْنِ حَرَامِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ زَيْدِ مَنَاةَ بْنِ عَدِيِّ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ مَالِكِ بْنِ النَّجَّارِ وَحَسَّانُ بْنُ ثَابِتِ بْنِ الْمُنْذِرِ بْنِ حَرَامٍ يَجْتَمِعَانِ إِلَى حَرَامٍ وَهُوَ الأَبُ الثَّالِثُ وَأُبَىُّ بْنُ كَعْبِ بْنِ قَيْسِ بْنِ عَتِيكِ بْنِ زَيْدِ بْنِ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ مَالِكِ بْنِ النَّجَّارِ فَعَمْرٌو يَجْمَعُ حَسَّانَ وَأَبَا طَلْحَةَ وَأُبَيًّا ‏.‏ قَالَ الأَنْصَارِيُّ بَيْنَ أُبَىٍّ وَأَبِي طَلْحَةَ سِتَّةُ آبَاءٍ ‏.‏
9.en: Anas said When the verse “You will never attain righteousness until you give freely of what you love" came down, Abu Talhah said Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), I think our Lord asks us for our property. I call you as witness that I dedicate my land at Ariha ‘to Him’. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to him Divide it among your nearest relatives. So he divided it among Hassan bin Thabit and Ubayy bin Ka’b. Abu Dawud said I have been gold by an Ansari Muhammad bin ‘Abdallah that the name of Abu Talhah is Zaid bin Sahal bin al-Aswad bin Haram bin ‘Amar bin Zaid bin Manat bin ‘Adi bin ‘Amr bin Malik bin al-Najjar; and Hassan bin Tabit is son of al-Mundhir in al-Haram. Thus both of them (Abu Talhah and Hassan) have their common link in Haram who is the third great grandfather. Ubbay bin Ka’b is son of Qais bin ‘Atik bin Zaid bin Mu’awiyah bin ‘Amr bin Malik bin al-Najjar. Thus the common tie between Hassan, Abu Talhah and Ubbay is ‘Amr (bin Malik). The Ansari said between Ubbay and Abi Talhah there are six great grandfathers
9.hi: Anas kehte hain: Jab yeh ayat nazil hui "Tum kabhi neki ko nahi paoge jab tak tum apni pasandeeda cheezein (Allah ki raah mein) na do" (Surah Aal-e-Imran, 3:92), to Abu Talhah ne kaha: "Ya Rasoolallah, mera khayal hai hamara Rab humse humara maal maang raha hai. Main aapko gawah banata hoon ke main apni zameen 'Ariha' mein Uske liye waqf karta hoon." Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne unse farmaya: "Isay apne sabse qareebi rishtedaron mein taqseem karo." Chunanche unhone isay Hassan bin Thabit aur Ubay bin Ka'b ke darmiyan taqseem kar diya. Abu Dawud kehte hain: Mujhe ek Ansari, Muhammad bin Abdullah, ne bataya ke Abu Talhah ka naam Zaid bin Sahl bin al-Aswad bin Haram bin Amr bin Zaid bin Manat bin Adi bin Amr bin Malik bin al-Najjar hai; aur Hassan bin Thabit, al-Mundhir bin al-Haram ke bete hain. Isliye dono (Abu Talhah aur Hassan) ka mushtarka silsila Haram mein milta hai, jo teesra dada hai. Ubay bin Ka'b, Qais bin Atik bin Zaid bin Mu'awiyah bin Amr bin Malik bin al-Najjar ke bete hain. Isliye Hassan, Abu Talhah aur Ubay ke darmiyan mushtarka rishta Amr (bin Malik) hai. Ansari ne kaha: Ubay aur Abu Talhah ke darmiyan chhe dade hain.

9.ar: حَدَّثَنَا هَنَّادُ بْنُ السَّرِيِّ، عَنْ عَبْدَةَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ بُكَيْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الأَشَجِّ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنْ مَيْمُونَةَ، زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَتْ كَانَتْ لِي جَارِيَةٌ فَأَعْتَقْتُهَا فَدَخَلَ عَلَىَّ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَخْبَرْتُهُ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ آجَرَكِ اللَّهُ أَمَا إِنَّكِ لَوْ كُنْتِ أَعْطَيْتِهَا أَخْوَالَكِ كَانَ أَعْظَمَ لأَجْرِكِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
9.en: Maimunah, wife of the Probhet (ﷺ) said :I had a slave girl and I set her free. When the Prophet (ﷺ) entered upon me, I informed him (of this). He said : May Allah give reward for it; if you had given her to your maternal uncles, it would have increased your reward
9.hi: Maimunah, Nabi (ﷺ) ki zaujah, kehti hain: Mere paas ek laundi thi aur maine usay azaad kar diya. Jab Nabi (ﷺ) mere paas aaye, to maine unhein iski khabar di. Aap ne farmaya: "Allah tumhein iska sawaab de; agar tumne isay apne mamu-zaad bhaiyon ko diya hota, to tumhara sawaab aur zyada hota."

9.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَجْلاَنَ، عَنِ الْمَقْبُرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ أَمَرَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِالصَّدَقَةِ فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ عِنْدِي دِينَارٌ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ تَصَدَّقْ بِهِ عَلَى نَفْسِكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ عِنْدِي آخَرُ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ تَصَدَّقْ بِهِ عَلَى وَلَدِكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ عِنْدِي آخَرُ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ تَصَدَّقْ بِهِ عَلَى زَوْجَتِكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ أَوْ قَالَ ‏"‏ زَوْجِكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ عِنْدِي آخَرُ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ تَصَدَّقْ بِهِ عَلَى خَادِمِكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ عِنْدِي آخَرُ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَنْتَ أَبْصَرُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
9.en: Narrated Abu Hurayrah: The Prophet (ﷺ) commanded to give sadaqah. A man said: Messenger of Allah, I have a dinar. He said: Spend it on yourself. He again said: I have another. He said: Spend it on your children. He again said: I have another. He said: Spend it on your wife. He again said: I have another. He said: Spend it on your servant. He finally said: I have another. He replied: You know best (what to do with it)
9.hi: Abu Hurairah bayan karte hain: Nabi (ﷺ) ne sadqa dene ka hukm diya. Ek shakhs ne kaha: "Ya Rasoolallah, mere paas ek dinar hai." Aap ne farmaya: "Isay apne liye kharch karo." Usne phir kaha: "Mere paas ek aur hai." Aap ne farmaya: "Isay apni aulad par kharch karo." Usne phir kaha: "Mere paas ek aur hai." Aap ne farmaya: "Isay apni biwi par kharch karo." Usne phir kaha: "Mere paas ek aur hai." Aap ne farmaya: "Isay apne khadim par kharch karo." Aakhirkar usne kaha: "Mere paas ek aur hai." Aap ne jawab diya: "Tum khud behtar jaante ho (isay kahan kharch karna hai)."

9.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ وَهْبِ بْنِ جَابِرٍ الْخَيْوَانِيِّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ كَفَى بِالْمَرْءِ إِثْمًا أَنْ يُضَيِّعَ مَنْ يَقُوتُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
9.en: Abd Allah bin ‘Amr reported the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as saying :It is sufficient sin for a man that he neglects him whom he maintains
9.hi: Abdullah bin Amr bayan karte hain ke Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne farmaya: "Kisi shakhs ke liye itna hi gunah kaafi hai ke woh us shakhs ko nazar-andaz kare jise woh paalta hai."

9.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ، وَيَعْقُوبُ بْنُ كَعْبٍ، - وَهَذَا حَدِيثُهُ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنْ سَرَّهُ أَنْ يُبْسَطَ لَهُ فِي رِزْقِهِ وَيُنْسَأَ لَهُ فِي أَثَرِهِ فَلْيَصِلْ رَحِمَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
9.en: Anas reported the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as saying :Anyone who is pleased that his sustenance is expanded and his age extended should do kindness to his near relatives
9.hi: Anas bayan karte hain ke Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne farmaya: "Jo koi chahta hai ke uski rozi barhe aur uski umar lambi ho, usay apne qareebi rishtedaron ke saath achha suluk karna chahiye."

9.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ قَالَ اللَّهُ أَنَا الرَّحْمَنُ وَهِيَ الرَّحِمُ شَقَقْتُ لَهَا اسْمًا مِنَ اسْمِي مَنْ وَصَلَهَا وَصَلْتُهُ وَمَنْ قَطَعَهَا بَتَتُّهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
9.en: Narrated AbdurRahman ibn Awf: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say: Allah the Exalted has said: I am Compassionate, and this has been derived from mercy. I have derived its name from My name. If anyone joins it, I shall join him, and if anyone cuts it off, I shall cut him off
9.hi: Abdur Rahman bin Awf bayan karte hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ko yeh farmate suna: "Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya hai: 'Main Rahman hoon, aur yeh (silah-rahmi ka lafz) rehmat se nikala gaya hai. Maine iska naam apne naam se nikala hai. Jo isay jodta hai, main usay jodunga, aur jo isay katta hai, main usay katunga.'"

9.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُتَوَكِّلِ الْعَسْقَلاَنِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ، أَنَّ الرَّدَّادَ اللَّيْثِيَّ، أَخْبَرَهُ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمَعْنَاهُ ‏.‏
9.en: The above mentioned tradition has also been narrated by `Abd al-Rahman bin ‘Awf from the Messenger of Allah (SWAS) through a different chain of narrators to the same effect
9.hi: Upar zikr ki gayi riwayat Abdur Rahman bin Awf se, Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ke hawale se, isi tarah ek doosri sanad se bhi marwi hai.

9.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ مُطْعِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، يَبْلُغُ بِهِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ يَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ قَاطِعُ رَحِمٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
9.en: Jubair bin Mut’im reported on the authority of his father:The Prophet(ﷺ) said: Anyone who cuts off relationship from his nearest relatives will not enter Paradise
9.hi: Jubair bin Mut'im apne walid ke hawale se riwayat karte hain: Nabi (ﷺ) ne farmaya: "Jo koi apne sabse qareebi rishtedaron se rishta katta hai, woh Jannat mein dakhil nahi hoga."

9.ar: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ كَثِيرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، وَالْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، وَفِطْرٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، - قَالَ سُفْيَانُ وَلَمْ يَرْفَعْهُ سُلَيْمَانُ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَرَفَعَهُ فِطْرٌ وَالْحَسَنُ - قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لَيْسَ الْوَاصِلُ بِالْمُكَافِئِ وَلَكِنَّ الْوَاصِلَ هُوَ الَّذِي إِذَا قُطِعَتْ رَحِمُهُ وَصَلَهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
9.en: Abd Allah bin `Amr said :(Sufyan said : The version of the narrator Sulaiman does not go back to The Prophet (SAWS). Fitr and al-Hasan reported from him ) : The Messenger of Allah (SAWS) said : One who compensates is not a man who unites relationship : but the man who unites relationship is the one who joins it when the relationship is cut off
9.hi: Abdullah bin Amr kehte hain (Sufyan kehte hain: Ravi Sulaiman ki riwayat Nabi (ﷺ) tak nahi pahunchti; Fitr aur al-Hasan ne bhi unse riwayat ki): Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne farmaya: "Jo badla deta hai woh silah-rahmi (rishta jodne) wala nahi hai; balke rishta jodne wala woh hai jo rishta katne par bhi usay jodta hai."

9.ar: حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مُرَّةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، قَالَ خَطَبَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ إِيَّاكُمْ وَالشُّحَّ فَإِنَّمَا هَلَكَ مَنْ كَانَ قَبْلَكُمْ بِالشُّحِّ أَمَرَهُمْ بِالْبُخْلِ فَبَخَلُوا وَأَمَرَهُمْ بِالْقَطِيعَةِ فَقَطَعُوا وَأَمَرَهُمْ بِالْفُجُورِ فَفَجَرُوا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
9.en: Narrated Abdullah ibn Amr ibn al-'As: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) preached and said: Abstain from avarice, for those who had been before you were annihilated due to avarice. It (avarice) commanded them to show niggardliness; it commanded them to cut off their relationship with their nearest relatives, so they cut off. It commanded them to show profligacy, so they showed it
9.hi: Abdullah bin Amr bin al-'As bayan karte hain: Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne khutba diya aur farmaya: "Lalach se bacho, kyunki tumse pehle ke log lalach ki wajah se tabaah ho gaye. Isne unhein kanjoosi ka hukm diya, unhone kanjoosi ki; isne unhein apne sabse qareebi rishtedaron se rishta todne ka hukm diya, unhone rishta toda; isne unhein badkaari ka hukm diya, unhone badkaari ki."

9.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَيُّوبُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ، حَدَّثَتْنِي أَسْمَاءُ بِنْتُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، قَالَتْ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مَا لِي شَىْءٌ إِلاَّ مَا أَدْخَلَ عَلَىَّ الزُّبَيْرُ بَيْتَهُ أَفَأُعْطِي مِنْهُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ أَعْطِي وَلاَ تُوكِي فَيُوكِيَ عَلَيْكِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
9.en: Asma, daughter of Abu Bakr, said :I said : Messenger of Allah(SAWS), I have nothing of my own except what al-Zubair (her husband) brings to me in his house: should I spend out of it? He said : Give and do not hoard so your sustenance will be hoarded
9.hi: Asma, Abu Bakr ki beti, kehti hain: Maine kaha: "Ya Rasoolallah, mere paas apna kuch nahi hai siwaye us cheez ke jo al-Zubair (mera shohar) apne ghar mein laata hai: kya main usme se kharch kar sakti hoon?" Aap ne farmaya: "Do aur jama karke mat rakho, warna tumhari rozi bhi rok li jayegi."

9.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَيُّوبُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّهَا ذَكَرَتْ عِدَّةً مِنْ مَسَاكِينَ - قَالَ أَبُو دَاوُدَ وَقَالَ غَيْرُهُ أَوْ عِدَّةً مِنْ صَدَقَةٍ - فَقَالَ لَهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ أَعْطِي وَلاَ تُحْصِي فَيُحْصِيَ عَلَيْكِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
9.en: Abu Mulaykah reported:Aisha counted a number of indigents. AbuDawud said: The other version has: She counted a number of sadaqahs. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Give and do not calculate, so calculation will be made against you
9.hi: Abu Mulaikah bayan karte hain: Ayesha ne kai gharibon ki ginti ki. (Abu Dawud kehte hain: Doosri riwayat mein hai: Unhone kai sadqon ki ginti ki.) Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne farmaya: "Do aur hisaab mat lagao, warna tumhare khilaf bhi hisaab lagaya jayega."

10.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ سَلَمَةَ بْنِ كُهَيْلٍ، عَنْ سُوَيْدِ بْنِ غَفَلَةَ، قَالَ غَزَوْتُ مَعَ زَيْدِ بْنِ صُوحَانَ وَسَلْمَانَ بْنِ رَبِيعَةَ فَوَجَدْتُ سَوْطًا فَقَالاَ لِي اطْرَحْهُ ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ لاَ وَلَكِنْ إِنْ وَجَدْتُ صَاحِبَهُ وَإِلاَّ اسْتَمْتَعْتُ بِهِ فَحَجَجْتُ فَمَرَرْتُ عَلَى الْمَدِينَةِ فَسَأَلْتُ أُبَىَّ بْنَ كَعْبٍ فَقَالَ وَجَدْتُ صُرَّةً فِيهَا مِائَةُ دِينَارٍ فَأَتَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ عَرِّفْهَا حَوْلاً ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَعَرَّفْتُهَا حَوْلاً ثُمَّ أَتَيْتُهُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ عَرِّفْهَا حَوْلاً ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَعَرَّفْتُهَا حَوْلاً ثُمَّ أَتَيْتُهُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ عَرِّفْهَا حَوْلاً ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَعَرَّفْتُهَا حَوْلاً ثُمَّ أَتَيْتُهُ فَقُلْتُ لَمْ أَجِدْ مَنْ يَعْرِفُهَا ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ احْفَظْ عَدَدَهَا وَوِكَاءَهَا وَوِعَاءَهَا فَإِنْ جَاءَ صَاحِبُهَا وَإِلاَّ فَاسْتَمْتِعْ بِهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ وَلاَ أَدْرِي أَثَلاَثًا قَالَ ‏"‏ عَرِّفْهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ أَوْ مَرَّةً وَاحِدَةً ‏.‏
10.en: Suwayd ibn Ghaflah said:I fought along with Zayd ibn Suhan and Sulayman ibn Rabi'ah. I found a whip. They said to me: Throw it away. I said: No; if I find its owner (I shall give it to him); if not, I shall use it. Then I performed hajj; and when I reached Medina, I asked Ubayy ibn Ka'b. He said: I found a purse which contained one hundred dinars; so I came to the Prophet (ﷺ). He said to me: Make the matter known for a year. I made it known for a year and then came to him. He then said to me: Make the matter known for a year. So I made it known for a year. I then (again) came to him. He said to me: Make the matter known for a year. Then I came to him and said: I did not find anyone who realises it. He said: Remember, its number, its container and its tie. If its owner comes, (give it to him), otherwise use it yourself. He (the narrator Shu'bah) said: I do not know whether he said the word "make the matter known" three times or once
10.hi: Suwaid bin Ghaflah kehte hain: Main Zaid bin Suhan aur Sulaiman bin Rabi'ah ke saath (jung mein) shareek hua. Mujhe ek chaabuk mila. Unhone mujhse kaha: "Isay phenk do." Maine kaha: "Nahi; agar mujhe iska maalik mile (to main isay usay de dunga), warna main isay khud istemal karunga." Phir maine hajj kiya, aur jab main Madinah pahuncha, to maine Ubay bin Ka'b se poocha. Unhone kaha: Mujhe ek thaila mila jismein sau dinar the; isliye main Nabi (ﷺ) ke paas gaya. Aap ne mujhse farmaya: "Ek saal tak iska elaan karo." Maine ek saal tak elaan kiya aur phir Aap ke paas aaya. Aap ne mujhse phir farmaya: "Ek saal tak iska elaan karo." Isliye maine ek saal aur elaan kiya. Phir main (dobara) Aap ke paas aaya. Aap ne mujhse farmaya: "Ek saal tak iska elaan karo." Phir main Aap ke paas aaya aur kaha: "Mujhe koi nahi mila jo iski shanakht karta ho." Aap ne farmaya: "Yaad rakho iski tadaad, iski thaili, aur iski bandhan ki dori. Agar iska maalik aa jaye, (to usay de do), warna khud istemal karo." (Ravi Shu'bah kehte hain): Mujhe nahi maloom ke unhone "elaan karo" ka lafz teen martaba kaha ya ek baar.

10.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، بِمَعْنَاهُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ عَرِّفْهَا حَوْلاً ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ ثَلاَثَ مِرَارٍ قَالَ فَلاَ أَدْرِي قَالَ لَهُ ذَلِكَ فِي سَنَةٍ أَوْ فِي ثَلاَثِ سِنِينَ ‏.‏
10.en: The aforesaid tradition has also been transmitted by Shu’bah through a different chain of narrators to the same effect. The version goes :He said : Make it known for a year. He said this three times. He said: I do not know whether he said “for a year” or “for three years”
10.hi: Upar zikr ki gayi riwayat Shu'bah ke zariye ek doosri sanad se bhi isi tarah bayan ki gayi hai. Is riwayat mein hai: Aap ne farmaya: "Ek saal tak elaan karo." Aap ne yeh teen martaba kaha. (Ravi kehte hain): Mujhe nahi maloom ke Aap ne "ek saal" kaha ya "teen saal."

10.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، حَدَّثَنَا سَلَمَةُ بْنُ كُهَيْلٍ، بِإِسْنَادِهِ وَمَعْنَاهُ قَالَ فِي التَّعْرِيفِ قَالَ عَامَيْنِ أَوْ ثَلاَثَةً ‏.‏ وَقَالَ ‏"‏ اعْرِفْ عَدَدَهَا وَوِعَاءَهَا وَوِكَاءَهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ زَادَ ‏"‏ فَإِنْ جَاءَ صَاحِبُهَا فَعَرَفَ عَدَدَهَا وَوِكَاءَهَا فَادْفَعْهَا إِلَيْهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو دَاوُدَ لَيْسَ يَقُولُ هَذِهِ الْكَلِمَةَ إِلاَّ حَمَّادٌ فِي هَذَا الْحَدِيثِ يَعْنِي ‏"‏ فَعَرَفَ عَدَدَهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
10.en: The above mentioned tradition has also been transmitted by Salamah. Bin Kuhail through a different chain to the same effect. The version has ; about making the matter known he said ; “ two years or three.” He said :Remember its number, its container and its string. The version adds : If its owner comes, and tells its number and its string, then give it to him. Abu Dawud said : None of the narrators said this word in this tradition except Hammad ; That is, “ If he tells its number.”
10.hi: Upar zikr ki gayi riwayat Salamah bin Kuhail ke zariye ek doosri sanad se bhi isi tarah bayan ki gayi hai. Is riwayat mein elaan ke baare mein hai: Aap ne kaha: "Do saal ya teen." Aap ne kaha: "Yaad rakho iski tadaad, iski thaili, aur iski dori." Is riwayat mein izafa hai: "Agar iska maalik aa jaye aur iski tadaad aur dori bataye, to usay de do." Abu Dawud kehte hain: Is riwayat mein Hammad ke siwa kisi bhi ravi ne yeh lafz nahi kaha, yani "agar woh iski tadaad bataye."

10.ar: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ جَعْفَرَ، عَنْ رَبِيعَةَ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ، مَوْلَى الْمُنْبَعِثِ عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ الْجُهَنِيِّ، أَنَّ رَجُلاً، سَأَلَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ اللُّقَطَةِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ عَرِّفْهَا سَنَةً ثُمَّ اعْرِفْ وِكَاءَهَا وَعِفَاصَهَا ثُمَّ اسْتَنْفِقْ بِهَا فَإِنْ جَاءَ رَبُّهَا فَأَدِّهَا إِلَيْهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ فَضَالَّةُ الْغَنَمِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ خُذْهَا فَإِنَّمَا هِيَ لَكَ أَوْ لأَخِيكَ أَوْ لِلذِّئْبِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ فَضَالَّةُ الإِبِلِ فَغَضِبَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَتَّى احْمَرَّتْ وَجْنَتَاهُ - أَوِ احْمَرَّ وَجْهُهُ - وَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَا لَكَ وَلَهَا مَعَهَا حِذَاؤُهَا وَسِقَاؤُهَا حَتَّى يَأْتِيَهَا رَبُّهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
10.en: Zaid bin Khalid al-Juhani said :A man asked the Messenger of Allah (SWAS) about a find. He said: Make the matter known for a year, then note its string and its container and then use it for your purpose. Then if its owner comes, give it to him. He asked : Messenger of Allah, what about a stray sheep? He replied: Take it; that is for you, or for your brother, or for the wolf. He again asked: Messenger of Allah, What about stray camels? The Messenger of Allah (SWAS) became angry so much so that his cheeks became red or ( the narrator is doubtful) his face became red. He replied: What have you to do with them? They have with them their feet and their stomachs (for drink) till their master comes to him
10.hi: Zaid bin Khalid al-Juhani kehte hain: Ek shakhs ne Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) se gum-shuda cheez (jo mil jaye) ke baare mein poocha. Aap ne farmaya: "Ek saal tak iska elaan karo, phir iski dori aur thaili yaad rakho, aur phir isay apne maqsad ke liye istemal karo. Phir agar iska maalik aa jaye, to usay de do." Usne poocha: "Ya Rasoolallah, gum-shuda bakri ka kya hukm hai?" Aap ne jawab diya: "Isay le lo; yeh tumhare liye hai, ya tumhare bhai ke liye, ya bhediye ke liye." Usne phir poocha: "Ya Rasoolallah, gum-shuda unton ka kya hukm hai?" Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) itne naraz hue ke Aap ke gaal (ya, ravi ko shak hai, Aap ka poora chehra) laal ho gaye. Aap ne jawab diya: "Tumhein unse kya lena-dena? Unke apne paon aur apna pait (paani peene ke liye) hain, yahan tak ke unka maalik unhein mil jaye."

10.ar: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ السَّرْحِ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي مَالِكٌ، بِإِسْنَادِهِ وَمَعْنَاهُ زَادَ ‏"‏ سِقَاؤُهَا تَرِدُ الْمَاءَ وَتَأْكُلُ الشَّجَرَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَقُلْ ‏"‏ خُذْهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فِي ضَالَّةِ الشَّاءِ وَقَالَ فِي اللُّقَطَةِ ‏"‏ عَرِّفْهَا سَنَةً فَإِنْ جَاءَ صَاحِبُهَا وَإِلاَّ فَشَأْنَكَ بِهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرِ ‏"‏ اسْتَنْفِقْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو دَاوُدَ رَوَاهُ الثَّوْرِيُّ وَسُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ بِلاَلٍ وَحَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ رَبِيعَةَ مِثْلَهُ لَمْ يَقُولُوا ‏"‏ خُذْهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
10.en: The above mentioned tradition has also been transmitted by Malik through a different chain of narrators to the same effect. This version adds:They have their stomachs: They can go down to water and eat trees. He did not say about the stray sheep: take it. About a find he said : Make it known for a year; if it’s owner comes, (give it to him), otherwise use it yourself. This version has not the word : “ spend it”. Abu Dawud said : This tradition has been narrated by al-Thawri, Sulaiman bin Bilal, and Hammad bin Salamah on the authority of Rabi ‘ ah in a similar manner. They did not mention the word “take it”
10.hi: Upar zikr ki gayi riwayat Malik ke zariye ek doosri sanad se bhi isi tarah bayan ki gayi hai. Is riwayat mein izafa hai: Unke apne pait hain: Woh paani peene ja sakte hain aur daraakht kha sakte hain. Aap ne gum-shuda bakri ke baare mein nahi kaha: isay le lo. Gum-shuda cheez ke baare mein Aap ne farmaya: Ek saal tak iska elaan karo; agar iska maalik aa jaye, (to usay de do), warna khud istemal karo. Is riwayat mein "isay kharch karo" ka lafz nahi hai. Abu Dawud kehte hain: Yeh riwayat al-Thawri, Sulaiman bin Bilal, aur Hammad bin Salamah ne bhi Rabi'ah ke hawale se isi tarah bayan ki hai. Unhone "isay le lo" ka lafz zikr nahi kiya.

10.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، وَهَارُونُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، - الْمَعْنَى - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي فُدَيْكٍ، عَنِ الضَّحَّاكِ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عُثْمَانَ - عَنْ سَالِمِ أَبِي النَّضْرِ، عَنْ بُسْرِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ الْجُهَنِيِّ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم سُئِلَ عَنِ اللُّقَطَةِ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ عَرِّفْهَا سَنَةً فَإِنْ جَاءَ بَاغِيهَا فَأَدِّهَا إِلَيْهِ وَإِلاَّ فَاعْرِفْ عِفَاصَهَا وَوِكَاءَهَا ثُمَّ كُلْهَا فَإِنْ جَاءَ بَاغِيهَا فَأَدِّهَا إِلَيْهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
10.en: Narrated Zayd ibn Khalid al-Juhani: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was asked about a find. He said: Make it known for a year. If its seeker comes, deliver it to him, otherwise note its container and its string. Then use it; if its seeker comes, deliver it to him
10.hi: Zaid bin Khalid al-Juhani bayan karte hain: Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) se gum-shuda cheez ke baare mein poocha gaya. Aap ne farmaya: "Ek saal tak iska elaan karo. Agar iska talaash karne wala aa jaye, to usay de do, warna iski thaili aur dori yaad rakho. Phir isay istemal karo; agar iska talaash karne wala aa jaye, to usay de do."

10.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ حَفْصٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، حَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ طَهْمَانَ، عَنْ عَبَّادِ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، يَزِيدَ مَوْلَى الْمُنْبَعِثِ عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ الْجُهَنِيِّ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ سُئِلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَذَكَرَ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ رَبِيعَةَ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَسُئِلَ عَنِ اللُّقَطَةِ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ تُعَرِّفُهَا حَوْلاً فَإِنْ جَاءَ صَاحِبُهَا دَفَعْتَهَا إِلَيْهِ وَإِلاَّ عَرَفْتَ وِكَاءَهَا وَعِفَاصَهَا ثُمَّ أَفِضْهَا فِي مَالِكَ فَإِنْ جَاءَ صَاحِبُهَا فَادْفَعْهَا إِلَيْهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
10.en: The aforesaid tradition has also been transmitted by Zaid bin Khalid al-Juhani through a different chain of narrators. This version has:The Messenger of Allah (SWAS) was asked about a find. He replied : Make the matter known for a year; if its owner comes, give it to him, otherwise note its string and its container and have it along with your property. If its owner comes, deliver it to him
10.hi: Upar zikr ki gayi riwayat Zaid bin Khalid al-Juhani se ek doosri sanad se bhi bayan ki gayi hai. Is riwayat mein hai: Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) se gum-shuda cheez ke baare mein poocha gaya. Aap ne jawab diya: "Ek saal tak iska elaan karo; agar iska maalik aa jaye, to usay de do, warna iski dori aur thaili yaad rakho aur isay apne maal ke saath rakho. Agar iska maalik aa jaye, to usay de do."

10.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، وَرَبِيعَةَ، بِإِسْنَادِ قُتَيْبَةَ وَمَعْنَاهُ وَزَادَ فِيهِ ‏"‏ فَإِنْ جَاءَ بَاغِيهَا فَعَرَفَ عِفَاصَهَا وَعَدَدَهَا فَادْفَعْهَا إِلَيْهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ حَمَّادٌ أَيْضًا عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ شُعَيْبٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ جَدِّهِ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو دَاوُدَ وَهَذِهِ الزِّيَادَةُ الَّتِي زَادَ حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ فِي حَدِيثِ سَلَمَةَ بْنِ كُهَيْلٍ وَيَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ وَعُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ وَرَبِيعَةَ ‏"‏ إِنْ جَاءَ صَاحِبُهَا فَعَرَفَ عِفَاصَهَا وَوِكَاءَهَا فَادْفَعْهَا إِلَيْهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ لَيْسَتْ بِمَحْفُوظَةٍ ‏"‏ فَعَرَفَ عِفَاصَهَا وَوِكَاءَهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَحَدِيثُ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ سُوَيْدٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَيْضًا قَالَ ‏"‏ عَرِّفْهَا سَنَةً ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَحَدِيثُ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ أَيْضًا عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ عَرِّفْهَا سَنَةً ‏"‏ ‏.‏
10.en: The above mentioned tradition has also been transmitted by Yahya bin Sa’id and Rabi’ah through the chain of narrators mentioned by Qutaibah to the same effect. This version adds; if its seeker comes, and recognizes its container and its number, then give it to him. Hammad also narrated it from `Ubaid Allah bin `Umar from `Amr bin Shu’aib, from his father, from his grandfather, from the Prophet (SWAS) something similar. Abu Dawud said :This addition made by Hammad bin Salamah bin Kuhail, Yahya bin Sa’id, `Ubaid Allah bin `Umar and Rabi’ah; “if its owner comes and recognizes its container, and its string,” is not guarded. The version narrated by Uqbah bin Suwaid on the authority of his father from the Prophet (SWAS) has also the words : “make it known for a year”. The version of `Umar bin al-Khattab has also been transmitted from the Prophet (SWAS). This version has : “Make it known for a year”
10.hi: Upar zikr ki gayi riwayat Yahya bin Sa'id aur Rabi'ah ke zariye, Qutaybah ki zikr ki hui sanad se, bhi isi tarah bayan ki gayi hai. Is riwayat mein izafa hai: agar iska talaash karne wala aa jaye aur iski thaili aur tadaad ko pehchane, to usay de do. Hammad ne bhi isay Ubaid Allah bin Umar se, Amr bin Shu'aib se, unke walid se, unke dada se, Nabi (ﷺ) se, isi jaisi riwayat ki hai. Abu Dawud kehte hain: Yeh izafa jo Hammad bin Salamah bin Kuhail, Yahya bin Sa'id, Ubaid Allah bin Umar aur Rabi'ah ne kiya hai, "agar iska maalik aa jaye aur iski thaili aur dori ko pehchane," mahfooz nahi hai. Uqbah bin Suwaid ki riwayat, jo unke walid se, Nabi (ﷺ) se hai, mein bhi "ek saal tak iska elaan karo" ke alfaaz hain. Umar bin al-Khattab ki riwayat bhi Nabi (ﷺ) se marwi hai. Is riwayat mein hai: "Ek saal tak iska elaan karo."

10.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ يَعْنِي الطَّحَّانَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ، - الْمَعْنَى - عَنْ خَالِدٍ الْحَذَّاءِ، عَنْ أَبِي الْعَلاَءِ، عَنْ مُطَرِّفٍ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ - عَنْ عِيَاضِ بْنِ حِمَارٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنْ وَجَدَ لُقَطَةً فَلْيُشْهِدْ ذَا عَدْلٍ - أَوْ ذَوَىْ عَدْلٍ - وَلاَ يَكْتُمْ وَلاَ يُغَيِّبْ فَإِنْ وَجَدَ صَاحِبَهَا فَلْيَرُدَّهَا عَلَيْهِ وَإِلاَّ فَهُوَ مَالُ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ يُؤْتِيهِ مَنْ يَشَاءُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
10.en: Narrated Iyad ibn Himar: The Prophet (ﷺ) said: He who finds something should call one or two trusty persons as witnesses and not conceal it or cover it up; then if he finds its owner he should return it to him, otherwise it is Allah's property which He gives to whom He will
10.hi: Iyad bin Himar bayan karte hain ke Nabi (ﷺ) ne farmaya: "Jo koi kuch paaye, usay ek ya do bharosemand logon ko gawah banana chahiye, aur isay chhupana ya dhaankna nahi chahiye; phir agar usay iska maalik mil jaye, to usay wapis karna chahiye, warna yeh Allah ki milkiyat hai jise Woh jise chahe deta hai."

10.ar: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَجْلاَنَ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ شُعَيْبٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْعَاصِ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ سُئِلَ عَنِ الثَّمَرِ الْمُعَلَّقِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَنْ أَصَابَ بِفِيهِ مِنْ ذِي حَاجَةٍ غَيْرَ مُتَّخِذٍ خُبْنَةً فَلاَ شَىْءَ عَلَيْهِ وَمَنْ خَرَجَ بِشَىْءٍ مِنْهُ فَعَلَيْهِ غَرَامَةُ مِثْلَيْهِ وَالْعُقُوبَةُ وَمَنْ سَرَقَ مِنْهُ شَيْئًا بَعْدَ أَنْ يُئْوِيَهُ الْجَرِينُ فَبَلَغَ ثَمَنَ الْمِجَنِّ فَعَلَيْهِ الْقَطْعُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَذَكَرَ فِي ضَالَّةِ الإِبِلِ وَالْغَنَمِ كَمَا ذَكَرَهُ غَيْرُهُ قَالَ وَسُئِلَ عَنِ اللُّقَطَةِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَا كَانَ مِنْهَا فِي طَرِيقِ الْمِيتَاءِ أَوِ الْقَرْيَةِ الْجَامِعَةِ فَعَرِّفْهَا سَنَةً فَإِنْ جَاءَ طَالِبُهَا فَادْفَعْهَا إِلَيْهِ وَإِنْ لَمْ يَأْتِ فَهِيَ لَكَ وَمَا كَانَ فِي الْخَرَابِ - يَعْنِي - فَفِيهَا وَفِي الرِّكَازِ الْخُمُسُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
10.en: Narrated Abdullah ibn Amr ibn al-'As: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was asked about the hanging fruit. He replied: If a needy person takes some and does not take a supply away in his garment, he is not to be blamed, but he who carries any of it away is to be find twice the value and punished, and he who steals any of it after it has been put in the place where dates are dried is to have his hand cut off if its value reaches the price of a shield. Regarding stray camels and sheep he mentioned the same as others have done. He said: He was asked about finds and replied: If it is in a frequented road and a large town, make the matter known for a year, and if its owner comes, give it to him, but if he does not, it belongs to you. If it is in a place which has been a waste from ancient time, or if it is a hidden treasure (belonging to the Islamic period), it is subject to the payment of the fifth
10.hi: Abdullah bin Amr bin al-'As bayan karte hain: Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) se latakte hue phal ke baare mein poocha gaya. Aap ne jawab diya: "Agar koi zaroormand shakhs kuch le aur apne kapde mein le jakar sto-kar na kare, to koi ilzaam nahi, lekin jo koi isse kuch le kar chala jaye, usay iski qeemat ka dogunа jurmana bharna chahiye aur saza di jani chahiye, aur jo koi isay uske sookhne wali jagah rakhne ke baad chura le, agar iski qeemat ek dhal ki qeemat tak pahunche, to uska haath kaata jayega." Gum-shuda unton aur bakriyon ke baare mein Aap ne wahi bataya jo doosron ne kaha hai. Aap se gum-shuda cheezon ke baare mein poocha gaya, aur Aap ne jawab diya: "Agar yeh kisi aabaad raste ya bade shehar mein ho, to ek saal tak iska elaan karo, aur agar iska maalik aa jaye, to usay de do, lekin agar woh nahi aata, to yeh tumhari milkiyat hai. Agar yeh kisi purane veerane mein hai, ya yeh koi (Islami daur se pehle ka) chhupa hua khazana hai, to ismein paanchwan hissa wajib hai."

10.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنِ الْوَلِيدِ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ كَثِيرٍ - حَدَّثَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ شُعَيْبٍ، بِإِسْنَادِهِ بِهَذَا قَالَ فِي ضَالَّةِ الشَّاءِ قَالَ ‏ "‏ فَاجْمَعْهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
10.en: The above mentioned tradition has also been transmitted by ‘Amr bin Shu’aib through a different chain of narrators. This version adds:regarding the stray sheep he said : “Take it”
10.hi: Upar zikr ki gayi riwayat Amr bin Shu'aib se ek doosri sanad se bhi bayan ki gayi hai. Is riwayat mein izafa hai: gum-shuda bakri ke baare mein Aap ne farmaya: "Isay le lo."

10.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الأَخْنَسِ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ شُعَيْبٍ، بِهَذَا بِإِسْنَادِهِ قَالَ فِي ضَالَّةِ الْغَنَمِ ‏"‏ لَكَ أَوْ لأَخِيكَ أَوْ لِلذِّئْبِ خُذْهَا قَطُّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ كَذَا قَالَ فِيهِ أَيُّوبُ وَيَعْقُوبُ بْنُ عَطَاءٍ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ شُعَيْبٍ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ فَخُذْهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
10.en: The aforesaid tradition has also been transmitted by ‘Amr bin Shu’aib through a different chain of narrators. This version has:He said about the stray sheep: You, your brother or the wolf may have them. Do take it. A similar version has been transmitted by Ayyub and Ya’qub bin `Ata from `Amr bin Shu’aid from the Propher (SWAS). He said : then take it
10.hi: Upar zikr ki gayi riwayat Amr bin Shu'aib se ek doosri sanad se bhi bayan ki gayi hai. Is riwayat mein hai: Aap ne gum-shuda bakri ke baare mein farmaya: Tum, tumhara bhai, ya bhediya isay le sakte hain. Isay le lo. Isi jaisi riwayat Ayyub aur Ya'qub bin Ata ne bhi Amr bin Shu'aib se, Nabi (ﷺ) ke hawale se bayan ki hai. Aap ne farmaya: phir isay le lo.

10.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْعَلاَءِ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ إِدْرِيسَ، عَنِ ابْنِ إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ شُعَيْبٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِهَذَا ‏.‏ قَالَ فِي ضَالَّةِ الشَّاءِ ‏ "‏ فَاجْمَعْهَا حَتَّى يَأْتِيَهَا بَاغِيهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
10.en: The above mentioned tradition has also been narrated by ‘Amr bin Shu’aib from his father, from his grandfather, from the Prophet (SWAS) to the same effect. This version has:regarding the stray sheep he said: Take it (and keep it with you) till its seeker comes to it
10.hi: Upar zikr ki gayi riwayat Amr bin Shu'aib ne bhi apne walid ke hawale se, unke dada se, Nabi (ﷺ) se isi tarah bayan ki hai. Is riwayat mein hai: gum-shuda bakri ke baare mein Aap ne farmaya: Isay le lo (aur apne paas rakho) jab tak iska talaash karne wala aa na jaye.

10.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ بُكَيْرِ بْنِ الأَشَجِّ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مِقْسَمٍ، حَدَّثَهُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، أَنَّ عَلِيَّ بْنَ أَبِي طَالِبٍ، وَجَدَ دِينَارًا فَأَتَى بِهِ فَاطِمَةَ فَسَأَلَتْ عَنْهُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ هُوَ رِزْقُ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَأَكَلَ مِنْهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَكَلَ عَلِيٌّ وَفَاطِمَةُ فَلَمَّا كَانَ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ أَتَتْهُ امْرَأَةٌ تَنْشُدُ الدِّينَارَ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ يَا عَلِيُّ أَدِّ الدِّينَارَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
10.en: Narrated Abu Sa'id al-Khudri: Ali ibn AbuTalib found a dinar and he took it to Fatimah. She asked the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) about it. He said: This is Allah's provision. Then the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) ate out of the food (bought with it), and Ali and Fatimah also ate out of that food. But afterwards a woman came crying out about the dinar. The Prophet (ﷺ) said: Pay the dinar, Ali
10.hi: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri bayan karte hain: Ali bin Abi Talib ko ek dinar mila aur woh isay Fatimah ke paas laaye. Unhone Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) se iske baare mein poocha. Aap ne farmaya: "Yeh Allah ki rozi hai." Phir Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne us khane (jo isse khareeda gaya) mein se khaaya, aur Ali aur Fatimah ne bhi usme se khaaya. Lekin baad mein ek aurat rote hue dinar ke baare mein aayi. Nabi (ﷺ) ne farmaya: "Dinar ada karo, Ali."

10.ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْهَيْثَمُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ الْجُهَنِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَوْسٍ، عَنْ بِلاَلِ بْنِ يَحْيَى الْعَبْسِيِّ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ، رضى الله عنه أَنَّهُ الْتَقَطَ دِينَارًا فَاشْتَرَى بِهِ دَقِيقًا فَعَرَفَهُ صَاحِبُ الدَّقِيقِ فَرَدَّ عَلَيْهِ الدِّينَارَ فَأَخَذَهُ عَلِيٌّ وَقَطَعَ مِنْهُ قِيرَاطَيْنِ فَاشْتَرَى بِهِ لَحْمًا ‏.‏
10.en: Narrated Ali ibn Abu Talib: Bilal ibn Yahya al-Absi said: Ali found a dinar and purchased some flour with it. The seller of the flour recognised him and returned the dinar to him. Ali took it, deducted two qirat (carat) from it, and purchased meat with it
10.hi: Ali bin Abi Talib bayan karte hain — Bilal bin Yahya al-Absi kehte hain: Ali ko ek dinar mila aur unhone usse kuch aata khareeda. Aata bechne wale ne unhein pehchan liya aur dinar unhein wapis kar diya. Ali ne isay le liya, isme se do qirat kaat liye, aur usse gosht khareeda.

10.ar: حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ مُسَافِرٍ التِّنِّيسِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي فُدَيْكٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ الزَّمْعِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ عَلِيَّ بْنَ أَبِي طَالِبٍ دَخَلَ عَلَى فَاطِمَةَ وَحَسَنٌ وَحُسَيْنٌ يَبْكِيَانِ فَقَالَ مَا يُبْكِيهِمَا قَالَتِ الْجُوعُ فَخَرَجَ عَلِيٌّ فَوَجَدَ دِينَارًا بِالسُّوقِ فَجَاءَ إِلَى فَاطِمَةَ فَأَخْبَرَهَا فَقَالَتِ اذْهَبْ إِلَى فُلاَنٍ الْيَهُودِيِّ فَخُذْ دَقِيقًا فَجَاءَ الْيَهُودِيَّ فَاشْتَرَى بِهِ دَقِيقًا فَقَالَ الْيَهُودِيُّ أَنْتَ خَتَنُ هَذَا الَّذِي يَزْعُمُ أَنَّهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ قَالَ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَخُذْ دِينَارَكَ وَلَكَ الدَّقِيقُ ‏.‏ فَخَرَجَ عَلِيٌّ حَتَّى جَاءَ فَاطِمَةَ فَأَخْبَرَهَا فَقَالَتِ اذْهَبْ إِلَى فُلاَنٍ الْجَزَّارِ فَخُذْ لَنَا بِدِرْهَمٍ لَحْمًا فَذَهَبَ فَرَهَنَ الدِّينَارَ بِدِرْهَمِ لَحْمٍ فَجَاءَ بِهِ فَعَجَنَتْ وَنَصَبَتْ وَخَبَزَتْ وَأَرْسَلَتْ إِلَى أَبِيهَا فَجَاءَهُمْ فَقَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَذْكُرُ لَكَ فَإِنْ رَأَيْتَهُ لَنَا حَلاَلاً أَكَلْنَاهُ وَأَكَلْتَ مَعَنَا مِنْ شَأْنِهِ كَذَا وَكَذَا ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ كُلُوا بِاسْمِ اللَّهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَأَكَلُوا فَبَيْنَمَا هُمْ مَكَانَهُمْ إِذَا غُلاَمٌ يَنْشُدُ اللَّهَ وَالإِسْلاَمَ الدِّينَارَ فَأَمَرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَدُعِيَ لَهُ فَسَأَلَهُ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ سَقَطَ مِنِّي فِي السُّوقِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ يَا عَلِيُّ اذْهَبْ إِلَى الْجَزَّارِ فَقُلْ لَهُ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ لَكَ أَرْسِلْ إِلَىَّ بِالدِّينَارِ وَدِرْهَمُكَ عَلَىَّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَأَرْسَلَ بِهِ فَدَفَعَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَيْهِ ‏.‏
10.en: Sahl bin Sa’d said :`Ali bin Abi Talib entered upon Fatimah while Hasan and Husain were crying. He asked: Why are they crying? She replied: Due to hunger. ‘Ali went out and found a dinar in the market. He then came to Fatima and told her about it. She said: Go to such and such a Jew and get some flour for us. He came to the Jew and purchased flour with it. He said : Are you the son-in-law of him who believes that he is the Messenger of Allah. He said : Yes. The Jew said : Have your dinar with you and you will get the flour. Ali then went out and came to Fatima. He told her about the matter. She then said: Go to such and such a butcher and get some meat for us for a dirham. Ali went out and pawned the dinar for a dirham with him and got the meat, and brought it (to her). She then kneaded the flour, put the utensil on fire and baked the bread. She sent for her father : (i.e. the Prophet (SWAS). He came to them. She said to him : Messenger of Allah, I tell you all the matter. If you think it is lawful for us, we shall eat it and you will eat with us. She said: The matter is such and such. He said: eat in the name of Allah. So they ate it. While they were (eating) at their place, a boy cried adguring in the name of Allah and Islam: He was searching the dinar. The Messenger of Allah (SWAS) commanded and he was called in. He asked him. The boy replied, I lost it somewhere in the market. The Prophet (SWAS) said : `Ali, go to the butcher and tell him that the Messenger of Allah (SWAS) has asked you : send the dinar to me and one dirham of yours will be due on me. The butcher returned it and the Messenger of Allah (SWAS) handed it to him (the boy)
10.hi: Sahl bin Sa'd kehte hain: Ali bin Abi Talib Fatimah ke paas dakhil huye jabke Hasan aur Husain ro rahe the. Unhone poocha: "Yeh kyun ro rahe hain?" Unhone jawab diya: "Bhook ki wajah se." Ali bahar gaye aur bazaar mein ek dinar paaya. Phir woh Fatimah ke paas aaye aur unhein iske baare mein bataya. Unhone kaha: "Falan-falan Yahudi ke paas jao aur humare liye kuch aata lao." Woh Yahudi ke paas gaye aur usse aata khareeda. Usne poocha: "Kya tum us shakhs ke damaad ho jo yeh imaan rakhta hai ke woh Allah ka Rasool hai?" Unhone jawab diya: "Haan." Yahudi ne kaha: "Apna dinar apne paas rakho aur aata le jao." Ali phir bahar gaye aur Fatimah ke paas aaye. Unhone unhein maamla bataya. Unhone kaha: "Falan-falan qassab ke paas jao aur humare liye ek dirham ke gosht lao." Ali bahar gaye aur uske paas dinar girvi rakh kar ek dirham liya aur gosht khareeda, aur usay laaye. Fatimah ne aata guundh liya, bartan aag par rakh diya, aur roti pakai. Unhone apne walid ko bulane bheja (yani Nabi ﷺ ko). Aap unke paas aaye. Unhone Aap se kaha: "Ya Rasoolallah, main aapko poora maamla bataati hoon. Agar aap isay hamare liye jaiz samajhte hain, to hum ise khayenge aur aap bhi humare saath khaein." Unhone kaha: Maamla itna hai. Aap ne farmaya: "Allah ke naam se khaao." Chunanche unhone isay khaaya. Jab woh apni jagah par (khaate hue) the, to ek larka Allah aur Islam ki qasam de kar chikhne laga: Woh dinar dhoond raha tha. Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne hukm diya aur usay bulaya gaya. Aap ne usse poocha. Larke ne jawab diya, "Maine isay bazaar mein kahin khoya hai." Nabi (ﷺ) ne farmaya: "Ali, qassab ke paas jao aur usay batao ke Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne tumse poocha hai: dinar mujhe bhej do aur tumhara ek dirham mujhpar wajib hoga." Qassab ne isay wapis kar diya aur Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne isay usse (larke ko) de diya.

10.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الدِّمَشْقِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ شُعَيْبٍ، عَنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ الْمَكِّيِّ، أَنَّهُ حَدَّثَهُ عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ رَخَّصَ لَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الْعَصَا وَالسَّوْطِ وَالْحَبْلِ وَأَشْبَاهِهِ يَلْتَقِطُهُ الرَّجُلُ يَنْتَفِعُ بِهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو دَاوُدَ رَوَاهُ النُّعْمَانُ بْنُ عَبْدِ السَّلاَمِ عَنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ بِإِسْنَادِهِ وَرَوَاهُ شَبَابَةُ عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ عَنْ جَابِرٍ قَالَ كَانُوا لَمْ يَذْكُرِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
10.en: Narrated Jabir ibn Abdullah: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) gave us licence to use (for our purpose) a stick, a rope, a whip and things of that type which a man picked up; he may benefit from them
10.hi: Jabir bin Abdullah bayan karte hain: Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne humein ijazat di ke hum ek lakdi, rassi, chaabuk, ya isi tarah ki koi cheez jo koi shakhs uthaye, istemal kar sakte hain; woh isse faida utha sakta hai.
