We have medicine for the wounded, we hand arrows (to the fighters), and supply drink made of wheat or barley. He said: Stand up. When Allah bestowed victory of Khaybar on him, he allotted shares to us from spoils that he allotted to the men. He (Hashraj ibn Ziyad) said: I said to her: Grandmother, what was that? She replied: Dates
15.hi: Hazrat Umm Ziyad bayaan karti hain: Hashraj bin Ziyad ne apni dadi ke hawale se riwayat ki ke woh Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ke saath Khaybar ki jung ke liye nikli. Woh khud samet chhe log thi. (Woh kehti hain:) Jab Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ko iski khabar mili, unhone humein bulwaaya. Hum unke paas aaye, aur unhein gusse mein paaya. Aapne poocha: Tum kiske saath nikli, aur kiski ijazat se nikli? Humne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, hum baal katne (spin karne) ke liye nikle hain, jiske zariye hum Allah ki raah mein madad dete hain. Humaare paas zakhmiyon ke liye dawa hai, hum teer (lada'oun ko) dete hain, aur hum gehun ya jau se banaa hua mashroob pahunchaate hain. Aapne farmaya: Khade ho jao. Jab Allah ne unhein Khaybar mein fatah di, aapne humein bhi hissa diya us ghaneemat mein se jo aapne mardon ko diya. Woh (Hashraj bin Ziyad) kehte hain: Maine unse poocha: Daadi, woh kya thi? Unhone jawaab diya: Khajoorein.

15.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ حَنْبَلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ الْمُفَضَّلِ - عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عُمَيْرٌ، مَوْلَى آبِي اللَّحْمِ قَالَ شَهِدْتُ خَيْبَرَ مَعَ سَادَتِي فَكَلَّمُوا فِيَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَمَرَ بِي فَقُلِّدْتُ سَيْفًا فَإِذَا أَنَا أَجُرُّهُ فَأُخْبِرَ أَنِّي مَمْلُوكٌ فَأَمَرَ لِي بِشَىْءٍ مِنْ خُرْثِيِّ الْمَتَاعِ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو دَاوُدَ مَعْنَاهُ أَنَّهُ لَمْ يُسْهِمْ لَهُ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو دَاوُدَ وَقَالَ أَبُو عُبَيْدٍ كَانَ حَرَّمَ اللَّحْمَ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ فَسُمِّيَ آبِي اللَّحْمِ ‏.‏
15.en: Narrated Umayr, client of AbulLahm: I was present at Khaybar along with my masters who spoke about me to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). He ordered about me, and a sword was girded on me and I was trailing it. He was then informed that I was a slave. He, therefore, ordered that I should be given some inferior goods. Abu Dawud said: This means that he (the Prophet) did not allot a portion of the spoils. Abu Dawud said: Abu 'Ubaid said: As he (the narrator Abi al-Lahm) made eating meat unlawful on himself, he was called Abi al-Lahm (one who hates meat)
15.hi: Hazrat Umayr, Abu al-Lahm ke azaad kiye hue ghulam, bayaan karte hain: Main Khaybar mein apne maalikon ke saath maujood tha jinhone Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) se mere baare mein baat ki. Aapne mere baare mein hukum diya, aur mujhpar ek talwaar baandhi gayi jise main ghaseeta hua tha. Fir aapko bataaya gaya ke main ek ghulam hoon. So aapne hukum diya ke mujhe kuch ghatiya saamaan diya jaaye. Abu Dawud kehte hain: Iska matlab yeh hai ke aapne (Nabi ﷺ ne) unhein ghaneemat mein hissa nahi diya. Abu Dawud kehte hain: Abu Ubayd kehte hain: Chunki unhone (raawi Abi al-Lahm ne) apne oopar gosht khaana haraam kar liya tha, unhein Abi al-Lahm (jo gosht se nafrat kare) kaha jaane laga.

15.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ كُنْتُ أَمِيحُ أَصْحَابِي الْمَاءَ يَوْمَ بَدْرٍ ‏.‏
15.en: Narrated Jabir ibn Abdullah: I supplied water to my companions on the day of Badr
15.hi: Hazrat Jabir bin Abdullah bayaan karte hain: Maine Badr ke din apne sathiyon ko paani pahunchaaya.

15.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، وَيَحْيَى بْنُ مَعِينٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنِ الْفُضَيْلِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نِيَارٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَ يَحْيَى أَنَّ رَجُلاً، مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ لَحِقَ بِالنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِيُقَاتِلَ مَعَهُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ ارْجِعْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ اتَّفَقَا فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّا لاَ نَسْتَعِينُ بِمُشْرِكٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
15.en: A’ishah said (this is the version of narrator Yahya). A man from the polytheists accompanied the Prophet (ﷺ) to fight along with him. He said “Go back. Both the narrators (Musaddad and Yahya) then agreed. The Prophet said “We do not want any help from a polytheist.”
15.hi: Aisha kehti hain (yeh raawi Yahya ka version hai): Mushrikeen mein se ek aadmi Nabi (ﷺ) ke saath unke saath ladne aaya. Aapne kaha: Wapas jao. Dono raawi (Musaddad aur Yahya) fir sahmat hote hain. Nabi (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Humein kisi mushrik ki madad nahi chaahiye.

15.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ حَنْبَلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَسْهَمَ لِرَجُلٍ وَلِفَرَسِهِ ثَلاَثَةَ أَسْهُمٍ سَهْمًا لَهُ وَسَهْمَيْنِ لِفَرَسِهِ ‏.‏
15.en: Ibn ‘Umar said “The Apostle of Allaah(ﷺ) allotted three portions for a man and his horse, one for him and two for his horse
15.hi: Ibn Umar kehte hain: Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne aadmi aur uske ghode ke liye teen hissa muqarrar kiye, ek unke liye aur do unke ghode ke liye.

15.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ حَنْبَلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، حَدَّثَنِي الْمَسْعُودِيُّ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو عَمْرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ أَتَيْنَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَرْبَعَةَ نَفَرٍ وَمَعَنَا فَرَسٌ فَأَعْطَى كُلَّ إِنْسَانٍ مِنَّا سَهْمًا وَأَعْطَى لِلْفَرَسِ سَهْمَيْنِ ‏.‏
15.en: Narrated AbuUmrah (al-Ansari?): We four persons, came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), and we (i.e. each one of us) had horses. He therefore, allotted one portion for each of us, and two portions for his horse
15.hi: Hazrat Abu Umrah (al-Ansari?) bayaan karte hain: Hum chaar log Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ke paas aaye, aur humme se har ek ke paas ghode the. Aapne humme se har ek ko ek hissa diya, aur unke ghode ko do hissa.

15.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أُمَيَّةُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْمَسْعُودِيُّ، عَنْ رَجُلٍ، مِنْ آلِ أَبِي عَمْرَةَ عَنْ أَبِي عَمْرَةَ، بِمَعْنَاهُ إِلاَّ أَنَّهُ قَالَ ثَلاَثَةَ نَفَرٍ ‏.‏ زَادَ فَكَانَ لِلْفَارِسِ ثَلاَثَةُ أَسْهُمٍ ‏.‏
15.en: The tradition mentioned above has also been transmitted by Abu ‘Umrah through a different chain of narrators to the same effect. But this version has “Three Persons” and added “To the horseman three portions.”
15.hi: Upar zikr ki gayi riwayat Abu Umrah se ek doosri sanad se bhi isi tarah riwayat ki gayi hai. Lekin iss version mein 'teen log' hai aur izaafa hai 'ghudsawaar ko teen hissa.'

15.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى، حَدَّثَنَا مُجَمِّعُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ مُجَمِّعِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ الأَنْصَارِيُّ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبِي يَعْقُوبَ بْنَ مُجَمِّعٍ، يَذْكُرُ عَنْ عَمِّهِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ الأَنْصَارِيِّ، عَنْ عَمِّهِ، مُجَمِّعِ بْنِ جَارِيَةَ الأَنْصَارِيِّ وَكَانَ أَحَدَ الْقُرَّاءِ الَّذِينَ قَرَءُوا الْقُرْآنَ قَالَ شَهِدْنَا الْحُدَيْبِيَةَ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلَمَّا انْصَرَفْنَا عَنْهَا إِذَا النَّاسُ يَهُزُّونَ الأَبَاعِرَ فَقَالَ بَعْضُ النَّاسِ لِبَعْضٍ مَا لِلنَّاسِ قَالُوا أُوحِيَ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ فَخَرَجْنَا مَعَ النَّاسِ نُوجِفُ فَوَجَدْنَا النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَاقِفًا عَلَى رَاحِلَتِهِ عِنْدَ كُرَاعِ الْغَمِيمِ فَلَمَّا اجْتَمَعَ عَلَيْهِ النَّاسُ قَرَأَ عَلَيْهِمْ ‏{‏ إِنَّا فَتَحْنَا لَكَ فَتْحًا مُبِينًا ‏}‏ فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَفَتْحٌ هُوَ قَالَ ‏"‏ نَعَمْ وَالَّذِي نَفْسُ مُحَمَّدٍ بِيَدِهِ إِنَّهُ لَفَتْحٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقُسِّمَتْ خَيْبَرُ عَلَى أَهْلِ الْحُدَيْبِيَةِ فَقَسَّمَهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى ثَمَانِيَةَ عَشَرَ سَهْمًا وَكَانَ الْجَيْشُ أَلْفًا وَخَمْسَمِائَةٍ فِيهِمْ ثَلاَثُمِائَةِ فَارِسٍ فَأَعْطَى الْفَارِسَ سَهْمَيْنِ وَأَعْطَى الرَّاجِلَ سَهْمًا ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو دَاوُدَ حَدِيثُ أَبِي مُعَاوِيَةَ أَصَحُّ وَالْعَمَلُ عَلَيْهِ وَأَرَى الْوَهَمَ فِي حَدِيثِ مُجَمِّعٍ أَنَّهُ قَالَ ثَلاَثُمِائَةِ فَارِسٍ وَكَانُوا مِائَتَىْ فَارِسٍ ‏.‏
15.en: Narrated Mujammi' ibn Jariyah al-Ansari: Mujammi' was one of the Qur'an-reciters (qaris), and he said: We were present with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) at al-Hudaybiyyah. When we returned, the people were driving their camels quickly. The people said to one another: What is the matter with them? They said: Revelation has come down to the Prophet (ﷺ). We also proceeded with the people, galloping (our camels). We found the Prophet (ﷺ) standing on his riding-animal at Kura' al-Ghamim. When the people gathered near him, he recited: "Verily We have granted thee a manifest victory. A man asked: Is this a victory, Messenger of Allah? He replied: Yes. By Him in Whose hands the soul of Muhammad is, this is a victory. Khaybar was divided among those who had been at al-Hudaybiyyah, and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) divided it into eighteen portions. The army consisted of one thousand five hundred men, of which three hundred were cavalry, and he gave two shares to a horseman and one to a foot-soldier. Abu Dawud said: Abu Mu'awiyah's tradition is sounder, and it is one which is followed. I think the error is in the tradition of Mujammi', because he said: "three hundred horsemen." when there were only two hundred
15.hi: Hazrat Mujammi' bin Jariyah al-Ansari bayaan karte hain: Mujammi' Quran ke qaari mein se the, aur unhone kaha: Hum Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ke saath al-Hudaybiyyah mein maujood the. Jab hum wapas laute, log apne oonton ko tezi se hankaa rahe the. Log ek-doosre se poochne lage: Unhein kya hua hai? Unhone kaha: Nabi (ﷺ) par wahi utri hai. Hum bhi logon ke saath aage badhe, apne oont daudaate hue. Humein Nabi (ﷺ) apni sawaari par Kura' al-Ghamim mein khade hue mile. Jab log unke aas-paas jama hue, aapne padha: "Beshak Humne tumhein khuli fatah di hai." Ek aadmi ne poocha: Kya yeh fatah hai, Allah ke Rasool? Aapne jawaab diya: Ji haan. Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein Muhammad ki jaan hai, yeh fatah hai. Khaybar unhi ke darmiyan taqseem kiya gaya jo al-Hudaybiyyah mein maujood the, aur Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne isse athaarah (18) hisson mein taqseem kiya. Lashkar mein pandrah sau aadmi the, jinmein teen sau ghudsawaar the, aur aapne ghudsawaar ko do hisse aur paidal shakhs ko ek hissa diya. Abu Dawud kehte hain: Abu Mu'awiyah ki riwayat zyada mazboot hai, aur usi par amal kiya jaata hai. Mera khayal hai Mujammi' ki riwayat mein galti hai, kyunki unhone kaha: 'teen sau ghudsawaar,' jabke woh sirf do sau the.

15.ar: حَدَّثَنَا وَهْبُ بْنُ بَقِيَّةَ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدٌ، عَنْ دَاوُدَ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَ بَدْرٍ ‏"‏ مَنْ فَعَلَ كَذَا وَكَذَا فَلَهُ مِنَ النَّفْلِ كَذَا وَكَذَا ‏"‏ قَالَ فَتَقَدَّمَ الْفِتْيَانُ وَلَزِمَ الْمَشْيَخَةُ الرَّايَاتِ فَلَمْ يَبْرَحُوهَا فَلَمَّا فَتَحَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ قَالَتِ الْمَشْيَخَةُ كُنَّا رِدْءًا لَكُمْ لَوِ انْهَزَمْتُمْ لَفِئْتُمْ إِلَيْنَا فَلاَ تَذْهَبُوا بِالْمَغْنَمِ وَنَبْقَى فَأَبَى الْفِتْيَانُ وَقَالُوا جَعَلَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَنَا فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ ‏{‏ يَسْأَلُونَكَ عَنِ الأَنْفَالِ قُلِ الأَنْفَالُ لِلَّهِ ‏}‏ إِلَى قَوْلِهِ ‏{‏ كَمَا أَخْرَجَكَ رَبُّكَ مِنْ بَيْتِكَ بِالْحَقِّ وَإِنَّ فَرِيقًا مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ لَكَارِهُونَ ‏}‏ يَقُولُ فَكَانَ ذَلِكَ خَيْرًا لَهُمْ فَكَذَلِكَ أَيْضًا فَأَطِيعُونِي فَإِنِّي أَعْلَمُ بِعَاقِبَةِ هَذَا مِنْكُمْ ‏.‏
15.en: Narrated Abdullah ibn Abbas: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said on the day of Badr: He who does such-and-such, will have such-and such. The young men came forward and the old men remained standing near the banners, and they did not move from there. When Allah bestowed victory on them, the old men said: We were support for you. If you had been defeated, you would have returned to us. Do not take this booty alone and we remain (deprived of it). The young men refused (to give), and said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) has given it to us. Then Allah sent down: "They ask thee concerning (things taken as) spoils of war, Say: (Such) spoils are at the disposal of Allah and the Apostle......Just as they Lord ordered thee out of thy house in truth, even though a party among the believers disliked it." This proved good for them. Similarly obey me. I know the consequence of this better than you
15.hi: Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas bayaan karte hain: Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne Badr ke din farmaya: Jo fulan-fulan kaam kare, use fulan-fulan milega. Jawaan aage badhe aur budhe jhandon ke qareeb khade rahe, aur woh wahan se hile nahi. Jab Allah ne unhein fatah di, budhe kehne lage: Hum tumhaare liye madad thi. Agar tumhein haar milti, tum humaare paas wapas aate. Isse tanha mat lo jabke hum mehroom rah jaayein. Jawaanon ne (dene se) inkaar kiya, aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne yeh humein diya hai. Fir Allah ne nazil kiya: "Woh aapse ghaneemat ke baare mein poochte hain. Kaho: Ghaneemat Allah aur Rasool ke ikhtiyaar mein hai...jaise tumhaare Rab ne tumhein tumhaare ghar se haq ke saath nikaala, jabke momino ka ek giroh isse na-pasand karta tha." Yeh unke liye achha saabit hua. Isi tarah, meri baat maano. Mujhe iska anjaam tumse behtar maloom hai.

15.ar: حَدَّثَنَا زِيَادُ بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا دَاوُدُ بْنُ أَبِي هِنْدٍ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ يَوْمَ بَدْرٍ ‏ "‏ مَنْ قَتَلَ قَتِيلاً فَلَهُ كَذَا وَكَذَا وَمَنْ أَسَرَ أَسِيرًا فَلَهُ كَذَا وَكَذَا ‏"‏ ثُمَّ سَاقَ نَحْوَهُ وَحَدِيثُ خَالِدٍ أَتَمُّ ‏.‏
15.en: Narrated Abdullah ibn Abbas: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said on the day of Badr: He who kills a man will get such-and-such, and he who captivates a man will get such-and-such. The narrator then transmitted the rest of the tradition in a similar manner. The tradition of Khalid is more perfect
15.hi: Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas bayaan karte hain: Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne Badr ke din farmaya: Jo koi kisi ko qatal kare, use fulan-fulan milega, aur jo koi kisi ko qaidi banaaye, use fulan-fulan milega. Fir raawi ne isi jaisi baaqi riwayat bayaan ki. Khalid ki riwayat zyada mukammal hai.

15.ar: حَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ بَكَّارِ بْنِ بِلاَلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ خَالِدِ بْنِ مَوْهَبٍ الْهَمْدَانِيُّ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ زَكَرِيَّا بْنِ أَبِي زَائِدَةَ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي دَاوُدُ، بِهَذَا الْحَدِيثِ بِإِسْنَادِهِ قَالَ فَقَسَّمَهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِالسَّوَاءِ ‏.‏ وَحَدِيثُ خَالِدٍ أَتَمُّ ‏.‏
15.en: The tradition mentioned above has been transmitted by Dawud with a different chain of narrators. He said “The Apostle of Allaah(ﷺ) apportioned it (spoils of war) equally. The tradition of Khalid is more perfect
15.hi: Upar zikr ki gayi riwayat Dawud ne ek doosri sanad se bhi riwayat ki hai. Unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne isse (ghaneemat ko) barabar taqseem kiya. Khalid ki riwayat zyada mukammal hai.

15.ar: حَدَّثَنِي هَنَّادُ بْنُ السَّرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ، عَنْ مُصْعَبِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ جِئْتُ إِلَى النَّبِي صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَ بَدْرٍ بِسَيْفٍ فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ قَدْ شَفَى صَدْرِي الْيَوْمَ مِنَ الْعَدُوِّ فَهَبْ لِي هَذَا السَّيْفَ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ هَذَا السَّيْفَ لَيْسَ لِي وَلاَ لَكَ ‏"‏ فَذَهَبْتُ وَأَنَا أَقُولُ يُعْطَاهُ الْيَوْمَ مَنْ لَمْ يُبْلِ بَلاَئِي ‏.‏ فَبَيْنَا أَنَا إِذْ جَاءَنِي الرَّسُولُ فَقَالَ أَجِبْ ‏.‏ فَظَنَنْتُ أَنَّهُ نَزَلَ فِيَّ شَىْءٌ بِكَلاَمِي فَجِئْتُ فَقَالَ لِي النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنَّكَ سَأَلْتَنِي هَذَا السَّيْفَ وَلَيْسَ هُوَ لِي وَلاَ لَكَ وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ قَدْ جَعَلَهُ لِي فَهُوَ لَكَ ثُمَّ قَرَأَ ‏{‏ يَسْأَلُونَكَ عَنِ الأَنْفَالِ قُلِ الأَنْفَالُ لِلَّهِ وَالرَّسُولِ ‏}‏ إِلَى آخِرِ الآيَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو دَاوُدَ قِرَاءَةُ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ يَسْأَلُونَكَ النَّفْلَ ‏.‏
15.en: Mus’ab bin Sa’d reported on the authority of his father (Sa’ad bin Abi Waqqas) “I brought a sword to the Prophet(ﷺ) on the day of the Badr and I said (to him) Apostle of Allaah(ﷺ) , Allaah has healed up my breast from the enemy today, so give me this sword. He said “This sword is neither mine nor yours. I then went away saying “today this will be given to a man who has not been put to trial like me. Meanwhile a messenger and came to me and said “Respond, I thought something was revealed about me owing to my speech. I came and the Prophet (ﷺ) said to me “You asked me for this sword, but this was neither mine nor yours. Now Allaah has given it to me, hence it is yours. He then recited “they ask thee concerning (things taken as) spoils of war. Say “(Such) spoils are at the disposal of Allaah and the Apostle. Abu Dawud said “According to the reading of the Qur’an of Ibn Mas’ud the verse goes. They ask thee concerning (things taken as ) spoils of war
15.hi: Hazrat Mus'ab bin Sa'd apne walid (Sa'd bin Abi Waqqas) ke hawale se bayaan karte hain: Main Badr ke din Nabi (ﷺ) ke paas ek talwaar laaya aur maine kaha (unse): Allah ke Rasool, Allah ne aaj mera seena dushman se shifa di, so mujhe yeh talwaar de dijiye. Aapne farmaya: Yeh talwaar na meri hai na tumhaari. Main chala gaya, kehte hue: Aaj yeh un shakhs ko di jaayegi jo mere jaisa aazmaaya na gaya ho. Isi waqt ek qaasid aaya aur mujhse kaha: Jawaab do. Maine socha shaayad mere kahne ki wajah se kuch nazil hua hai. Main aaya, aur Nabi (ﷺ) ne mujhse kaha: Tumne mujhse yeh talwaar maangi, lekin yeh na meri thi na tumhaari. Ab Allah ne mujhe yeh di hai, so yeh tumhaari hai. Fir aapne padha: "Woh aapse ghaneemat ke baare mein poochte hain. Kaho: Ghaneemat Allah aur Rasool ke ikhtiyaar mein hai." Abu Dawud kehte hain: Ibn Mas'ud ke Quran ki qiraat ke mutabiq, yeh aayat is tarah hai: 'Woh aapse ghaneemat ke baare mein poochte hain.'

15.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ بْنُ نَجْدَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الأَنْطَاكِيُّ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا مُبَشِّرٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَوْفٍ الطَّائِيُّ، أَنَّ الْحَكَمَ بْنَ نَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَهُمْ - الْمَعْنَى، - كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ شُعَيْبِ بْنِ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ بَعَثَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي جَيْشٍ قِبَلَ نَجْدٍ وَانْبَعَثَتْ سَرِيَّةٌ مِنَ الْجَيْشِ فَكَانَ سُهْمَانُ الْجَيْشِ اثْنَىْ عَشَرَ بَعِيرًا اثْنَىْ عَشَرَ بَعِيرًا وَنَفَّلَ أَهْلَ السَّرِيَّةِ بَعِيرًا بَعِيرًا فَكَانَتْ سُهْمَانُهُمْ ثَلاَثَةَ عَشَرَ ثَلاَثَةَ عَشَرَ ‏.‏
15.en: Narrated Abdullah ibn Umar: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) sent us along with an army towards Najd, and he sent a detachment of that army (to face the enemy). The whole army got twelve camels per head as their portion, but he gave the detachment one additional camel (apart from the division made to the army). Thus they got thirteen camels each (as a reward)
15.hi: Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar bayaan karte hain: Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne humein ek lashkar ke saath Najd ki taraf bheja, aur unhone us lashkar mein se ek giroh bheja (dushman ka saamna karne ke liye). Poore lashkar ko fi shakhs baarah oont ka hissa mila, lekin aapne giroh ko ek izaafi oont diya (lashkar ki taqseem ke ilaawa). Isse unhein har ek ko tera (13) oont mile (inaam ke tor par).

15.ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ عُتْبَةَ الدِّمَشْقِيُّ، قَالَ قَالَ الْوَلِيدُ - يَعْنِي ابْنَ مُسْلِمٍ - حَدَّثْتُ ابْنَ الْمُبَارَكِ، بِهَذَا الْحَدِيثِ قُلْتُ وَكَذَا حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي فَرْوَةَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، قَالَ لاَ تَعْدِلْ مَنْ سَمَّيْتَ بِمَالِكٍ هَكَذَا أَوْ نَحْوَهُ يَعْنِي مَالِكَ بْنَ أَنَسٍ ‏.‏
15.en: Al Walid bin Muslim said “I narrated this tradition (mentioned above) to Ibn Al Mubarak and said “And similarly it has been narrated by Ibn Abi Farwah to us on the authority of Nafi’(as narrated by Shu’aib). He (Ibn Al Mubarak) said “Those whom you have named cannot be equal to Malik i.e, Malik bin Anas
15.hi: Al-Walid bin Muslim kehte hain: Maine (upar zikr ki gayi) riwayat Ibn al-Mubarak ko sunayi aur kaha: Isi tarah yeh riwayat Ibn Abi Farwah ne bhi humme Nafi' se bataayi hai (jaisa Shu'aib ne riwayat kiya). Unhone (Ibn al-Mubarak ne) kaha: Jinka aapne naam liya woh Malik, yaani Malik bin Anas, ke barabar nahi ho sakte.

15.ar: حَدَّثَنَا هَنَّادٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَةُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ سُلَيْمَانَ الْكِلاَبِيَّ - عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ بَعَثَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم سَرِيَّةً إِلَى نَجْدٍ فَخَرَجْتُ مَعَهَا فَأَصَبْنَا نَعَمًا كَثِيرًا فَنَفَّلَنَا أَمِيرُنَا بَعِيرًا بَعِيرًا لِكُلِّ إِنْسَانٍ ثُمَّ قَدِمْنَا عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَسَّمَ بَيْنَنَا غَنِيمَتَنَا فَأَصَابَ كُلُّ رَجُلٍ مِنَّا اثْنَىْ عَشَرَ بَعِيرًا بَعْدَ الْخُمُسِ وَمَا حَاسَبَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِالَّذِي أَعْطَانَا صَاحِبُنَا وَلاَ عَابَ عَلَيْهِ بَعْدَ مَا صَنَعَ فَكَانَ لِكُلِّ رَجُلٍ مِنَّا ثَلاَثَةَ عَشَرَ بَعِيرًا بِنَفْلِهِ ‏.‏
15.en: Narrated Abdullah ibn Umar: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) sent a detachment to Najd. I went out along with them, and got abundant riches. Our commander gave each of us a camel as a reward. We then came upon the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and he divided the spoils of war among us. Each of us received twelve camels after taking a fifth of it. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) did not take account of our companion (i.e. the commander of the army), nor did he blame him for what he had done. Thus each man of us had received thirteen camels with the reward he gave
15.hi: Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar bayaan karte hain: Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne Najd ki taraf ek giroh bheja. Main unke saath nikla, aur mujhe bahut jaidad mili. Humaare sardaar ne humme se har ek ko ek oont inaam mein diya. Fir hum Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ke paas aaye aur unhone humaare beech ghaneemat taqseem ki. Humme se har ek ko khums (paanchwan hissa) nikaalne ke baad baarah oont mile. Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne humaare saathi (yaani, lashkar ke sardaar) se koi hisaab nahi liya, na hi jo unhone kiya uske liye unhein malaamat ki. Isse humme har aadmi ko tera oont mile jo unhone diya tha.

15.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ الْقَعْنَبِيُّ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ، وَيَزِيدُ بْنُ خَالِدِ بْنِ مَوْهَبٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، - الْمَعْنَى - عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَعَثَ سَرِيَّةً فِيهَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ قِبَلَ نَجْدٍ فَغَنِمُوا إِبِلاً كَثِيرَةً فَكَانَتْ سُهْمَانُهُمُ اثْنَىْ عَشَرَ بَعِيرًا وَنُفِّلُوا بَعِيرًا بَعِيرًا ‏.‏ زَادَ ابْنُ مَوْهَبٍ فَلَمْ يُغَيِّرْهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
15.en: Nafi’ reported on the authority of ‘Abd Allaah bin ‘Umar “The Apostle of Allaah(ﷺ) sent a detachment towards Najd. ‘Abd Allaah bin ‘Umar also accompanied it. They gained a large number of Camels as a booty. Their portion was twelve Camels each and they were rewarded (in addition) one Camel each. The version of Ibn Mawhab added “The Apostle of Allaah(ﷺ) did not change it”
15.hi: Nafi' Abdullah bin Umar ke hawale se bataate hain: Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne Najd ki taraf ek giroh bheja. Abdullah bin Umar bhi unke saath the. Unhein ghaneemat mein bahut se oont mile. Unka hissa fi shakhs baarah oont tha aur unhein (izaafa mein) ek oont fi shakhs inaam diya gaya. Ibn Mawhab ke version mein izaafa hai: Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne isse badla nahi.

15.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي نَافِعٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ بَعَثَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي سَرِيَّةٍ فَبَلَغَتْ سُهْمَانُنَا اثْنَىْ عَشَرَ بَعِيرًا وَنَفَّلَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَعِيرًا بَعِيرًا ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو دَاوُدَ رَوَاهُ بُرْدُ بْنُ سِنَانٍ عَنْ نَافِعٍ مِثْلَ حَدِيثِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ وَرَوَاهُ أَيُّوبُ عَنْ نَافِعٍ مِثْلَهُ إِلاَّ أَنَّهُ قَالَ وَنُفِّلْنَا بَعِيرًا بَعِيرًا ‏.‏ لَمْ يَذْكُرِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
15.en: ‘Abd Allaah (bin ‘Umar) said “The Apostle of Allaah(ﷺ) sent us along with a detachment. The share of each was twelve Camels. The Apostle of Allaah(ﷺ) gave each one of us a Camel as a reward. Abu Dawud said “Burd bin Sinan narrated a similar tradition from Nafi’ as narrated by ‘Ubaid Allaah. Ayyub also narrated from Nafi’ a similar tradition, but his version goes “We were rewarded one Camel each. He did not mention the Prophet (ﷺ)
15.hi: Abdullah (bin Umar) kehte hain: Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne humein ek giroh ke saath bheja. Humme se har ek ka hissa baarah oont tha. Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne humme se har ek ko inaam mein ek oont diya. Abu Dawud kehte hain: Burd bin Sinan ne bhi Nafi' se isi jaisi riwayat ki jaisa Ubaydullah ne kiya. Ayyub ne bhi Nafi' se isi jaisi riwayat ki, lekin unke version mein hai: 'Humme har ek ko inaam mein ek oont diya gaya.' Unhone Nabi (ﷺ) ka zikr nahi kiya.

15.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ شُعَيْبِ بْنِ اللَّيْثِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ جَدِّي، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ أَبِي يَعْقُوبَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي حُجَيْنٌ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ عُقَيْلٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَدْ كَانَ يُنَفِّلُ بَعْضَ مَنْ يَبْعَثُ مِنَ السَّرَايَا لأَنْفُسِهِمْ خَاصَّةً النَّفْلَ سِوَى قَسْمِ عَامَّةِ الْجَيْشِ وَالْخُمُسُ فِي ذَلِكَ وَاجِبٌ كُلُّهُ ‏.‏
15.en: Narrated Abdullah ibn Umar: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to give to some of the detachments he sent out (something extra) for themselves in particular apart from the division made to the whole army. The fifth is necessary in all that
15.hi: Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar bayaan karte hain: Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) kuch giroohon ko bhejte waqt unhein khaas taur par (kuch izaafi) dete, poore lashkar ki taqseem ke ilaawa. Khums (paanchwan hissa) iss sabme laazim hai.

15.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حُيَىٌّ، عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْحُبُلِيِّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَرَجَ يَوْمَ بَدْرٍ فِي ثَلاَثِمِائَةٍ وَخَمْسَةَ عَشَرَ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّهُمْ حُفَاةٌ فَاحْمِلْهُمُ اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّهُمْ عُرَاةٌ فَاكْسُهُمُ اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّهُمْ جِيَاعٌ فَأَشْبِعْهُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَفَتَحَ اللَّهُ لَهُ يَوْمَ بَدْرٍ فَانْقَلَبُوا حِينَ انْقَلَبُوا وَمَا مِنْهُمْ رَجُلٌ إِلاَّ وَقَدْ رَجَعَ بِجَمَلٍ أَوْ جَمَلَيْنِ وَاكْتَسَوْا وَشَبِعُوا ‏.‏
15.en: Narrated Abdullah ibn Umar: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) went out on the day of Badr along with three hundred and fifteen (men). The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: O Allah, they are on foot, provide mount for them; O Allah , they are naked, clothe them; O Allah, they are hungry, provide food for them. Allah then bestowed victory on them. They returned when they were clothed. There was no man of them but he returned with one or two camels; they were clothed and ate to their fill
15.hi: Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar bayaan karte hain: Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) Badr ke din teen sau pandrah (315) aadmiyon ke saath nikle. Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Ae Allah, woh paidal hain, unhein sawaari de; Ae Allah, woh nange hain, unhein kapde de; Ae Allah, woh bhookhe hain, unhein khaana de. Allah ne unhein fatah di. Woh kapdon mein wapas aaye. Unmein koi bhi aisa na tha jo ek ya do oont lekar wapas na aaya ho; woh kapdon mein the aur seer khaate the.

15.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ بْنِ جَابِرٍ الشَّامِيِّ، عَنْ مَكْحُولٍ، عَنْ زِيَادِ بْنِ جَارِيَةَ التَّمِيمِيِّ، عَنْ حَبِيبِ بْنِ مَسْلَمَةَ الْفِهْرِيِّ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُنَفِّلُ الثُّلُثَ بَعْدَ الْخُمُسِ ‏.‏
15.en: Narrated Habib ibn Maslamah al-Fihri: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) would give a third of the spoils after he would keep off the fifth
15.hi: Hazrat Habib bin Maslamah al-Fihri bayaan karte hain: Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) khums (paanchwan hissa) nikaalne ke baad ghaneemat ka tihai (inaam ke tor par) dete.

15.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ بْنِ مَيْسَرَةَ الْجُشَمِيُّ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ صَالِحٍ، عَنِ الْعَلاَءِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ مَكْحُولٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ جَارِيَةَ، عَنْ حَبِيبِ بْنِ مَسْلَمَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يُنَفِّلُ الرُّبُعَ بَعْدَ الْخُمُسِ وَالثُّلُثَ بَعْدَ الْخُمُسِ إِذَا قَفَلَ ‏.‏
15.en: Narrated Habib ibn Maslamah: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to give a quarter of the booty as reward after the fifty had been kept off, and a third after the fifth had been kept off when he returned
15.hi: Hazrat Habib bin Maslamah bayaan karte hain: Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) khums nikaalne ke baad chauthai (inaam ke tor par) dete, aur wapas aate waqt tihai dete, khums nikaalne ke baad.

15.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ بَشِيرِ بْنِ ذَكْوَانَ، وَمَحْمُودُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ الدِّمَشْقِيَّانِ، - الْمَعْنَى - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مَرْوَانُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَمْزَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا وَهْبٍ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ مَكْحُولاً، يَقُولُ كُنْتُ عَبْدًا بِمِصْرَ لاِمْرَأَةٍ مِنْ بَنِي هُذَيْلٍ فَأَعْتَقَتْنِي فَمَا خَرَجْتُ مِنْ مِصْرَ وَبِهَا عِلْمٌ إِلاَّ حَوَيْتُ عَلَيْهِ فِيمَا أُرَى ثُمَّ أَتَيْتُ الْحِجَازَ فَمَا خَرَجْتُ مِنْهَا وَبِهَا عِلْمٌ إِلاَّ حَوَيْتُ عَلَيْهِ فِيمَا أُرَى ثُمَّ أَتَيْتُ الْعِرَاقَ فَمَا خَرَجْتُ مِنْهَا وَبِهَا عِلْمٌ إِلاَّ حَوَيْتُ عَلَيْهِ فِيمَا أُرَى ثُمَّ أَتَيْتُ الشَّامَ فَغَرْبَلْتُهَا كُلُّ ذَلِكَ أَسْأَلُ عَنِ النَّفْلِ فَلَمْ أَجِدْ أَحَدًا يُخْبِرُنِي فِيهِ بِشَىْءٍ حَتَّى أَتَيْتُ شَيْخًا يُقَالُ لَهُ زِيَادُ بْنُ جَارِيَةَ التَّمِيمِيُّ فَقُلْتُ لَهُ هَلْ سَمِعْتَ فِي النَّفْلِ شَيْئًا قَالَ نَعَمْ سَمِعْتُ حَبِيبَ بْنَ مَسْلَمَةَ الْفِهْرِيَّ يَقُولُ شَهِدْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَفَّلَ الرُّبُعَ فِي الْبَدْأَةِ وَالثُّلُثَ فِي الرَّجْعَةِ ‏.‏
15.en: Narrated Habib ibn Maslamah al-Fihri: Makhul said: I was the slave of a woman of Banu Hudhayl; afterwards she emancipated me. I did not leave Egypt until I had acquired all the knowledge that seemed to me to exist there. I then came to al-Hijaz and I did not leave it until I had acquired all the knowledge that seemed to be available. Then I came to al-Iraq, and I did not leave it until I had acquired all the knowledge that seemed to be available. I then came to Syria, and besieged it. I asked everyone about giving rewards from the booty. I did not find anyone who could tell me anything about it. I then met an old man called Ziyad ibn Jariyah at-Tamimi. I asked him: Have you heard anything about giving rewards from the booty? He replied: Yes. I heard Maslamah al-Fihri say: I was present with the Prophet (ﷺ). He gave a quarter of the spoils on the outward journey and a third on the return journey
15.hi: Hazrat Habib bin Maslamah al-Fihri bayaan karte hain: Makhul kehte hain: Main Banu Hudhail ki ek aurat ka ghulam tha; baad mein unhone mujhe azaad kar diya. Maine Misr chhoda nahi jab tak maine wahan jitna ilm mumkin tha haasil na kar liya. Fir main al-Hijaz gaya aur maine isse tab tak nahi chhoda jab tak maine jitna ilm wahan uplabdh tha haasil nahi kar liya. Fir main al-Iraq aaya, aur maine isse tab tak nahi chhoda jab tak maine jitna ilm uplabdh tha haasil nahi kar liya. Fir main Sham aaya, aur isse gher liya. Maine har kisi se ghaneemat mein se inaam dene ke baare mein poocha. Mujhe koi nahi mila jo mujhe iske baare mein kuch bataa sake. Fir main ek budhe aadmi se mila jise Ziyad bin Jariyah al-Tamimi kaha jaata tha. Maine unse poocha: Kya aapne ghaneemat mein se inaam dene ke baare mein kuch suna hai? Unhone jawaab diya: Ji haan. Maine Maslamah al-Fihri ko kehte suna: Main Nabi (ﷺ) ke saath maujood tha. Aapne jaate waqt chauthai (inaam ke tor par) di aur wapas aate waqt tihai.

15.ar: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، عَنِ ابْنِ إِسْحَاقَ، - هُوَ مُحَمَّدٌ - بِبَعْضِ هَذَا ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ بْنِ مَيْسَرَةَ، حَدَّثَنِي هُشَيْمٌ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ شُعَيْبٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ الْمُسْلِمُونَ تَتَكَافَأُ دِمَاؤُهُمْ يَسْعَى بِذِمَّتِهِمْ أَدْنَاهُمْ وَيُجِيرُ عَلَيْهِمْ أَقْصَاهُمْ وَهُمْ يَدٌ عَلَى مَنْ سِوَاهُمْ يَرُدُّ مُشِدُّهُمْ عَلَى مُضْعِفِهِمْ وَمُتَسَرِّعُهُمْ عَلَى قَاعِدِهِمْ لاَ يُقْتَلُ مُؤْمِنٌ بِكَافِرٍ وَلاَ ذُو عَهْدٍ فِي عَهْدِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرِ ابْنُ إِسْحَاقَ الْقَوَدَ وَالتَّكَافُؤَ ‏.‏
15.en: Narrated Abdullah ibn Amr ibn al-'As: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Muslims are equal in respect of blood. The lowest of them is entitled to give protection on behalf of them, and the one residing far away may give protection on behalf of them. They are like one hand over against all those who are outside the community. Those who have quick mounts should return to those who have slow mounts, and those who got out along with a detachment (should return) to those who are stationed. A believer shall not be killed for an unbeliever, nor a confederate within the term of confederation with him. Ibn Ishaq did not mention retaliation and equality in respect of blood
15.hi: Hazrat Abdullah bin Amr bin al-As bayaan karte hain ke Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Musalman khoon ke maamle mein barabar hain. Unmein sabse chhota bhi unki taraf se panah de sakta hai, aur door reh raha shakhs bhi unki taraf se panah de sakta hai. Woh baaki sabke muqaable ek haath ki tarah hain. Jinke paas tezi se chalne wali sawaariyaan hon unhein un logon ke paas wapas jaana chaahiye jinke paas dhimi sawaariyaan hain, aur jo giroh ke saath nikle unhein un logon ke paas wapas jaana chaahiye jo (padaao par) ruke hue hain. Koi momin kaafir ke badle qatal nahi kiya jaayega, na koi mutthhaidi (ally) us muddat mein jab tak muahida jaari hai. Ibn Ishaq ne khoon mein qisaas aur barabari ka zikr nahi kiya.

15.ar: حَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا هَاشِمُ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ، حَدَّثَنَا عِكْرِمَةُ، حَدَّثَنِي إِيَاسُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ أَغَارَ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ عَلَى إِبِلِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَتَلَ رَاعِيَهَا وَخَرَجَ يَطْرُدُهَا هُوَ وَأُنَاسٌ مَعَهُ فِي خَيْلٍ فَجَعَلْتُ وَجْهِي قِبَلَ الْمَدِينَةِ ثُمَّ نَادَيْتُ ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ يَا صَبَاحَاهُ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ اتَّبَعْتُ الْقَوْمَ فَجَعَلْتُ أَرْمِي وَأَعْقِرُهُمْ فَإِذَا رَجَعَ إِلَىَّ فَارِسٌ جَلَسْتُ فِي أَصْلِ شَجَرَةٍ حَتَّى مَا خَلَقَ اللَّهُ شَيْئًا مِنْ ظَهْرِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلاَّ جَعَلْتُهُ وَرَاءَ ظَهْرِي وَحَتَّى أَلْقَوْا أَكْثَرَ مِنْ ثَلاَثِينَ رُمْحًا وَثَلاَثِينَ بُرْدَةً يَسْتَخِفُّونَ مِنْهَا ثُمَّ أَتَاهُمْ عُيَيْنَةُ مَدَدًا فَقَالَ لِيَقُمْ إِلَيْهِ نَفَرٌ مِنْكُمْ ‏.‏ فَقَامَ إِلَىَّ أَرْبَعَةٌ مِنْهُمْ فَصَعِدُوا الْجَبَلَ فَلَمَّا أَسْمَعْتُهُمْ قُلْتُ أَتَعْرِفُونِي قَالُوا وَمَنْ أَنْتَ قُلْتُ أَنَا ابْنُ الأَكْوَعِ وَالَّذِي كَرَّمَ وَجْهَ مُحَمَّدٍ صلى الله عليه وسلم لاَ يَطْلُبُنِي رَجُلٌ مِنْكُمْ فَيُدْرِكُنِي وَلاَ أَطْلُبُهُ فَيَفُوتُنِي ‏.‏ فَمَا بَرِحْتُ حَتَّى نَظَرْتُ إِلَى فَوَارِسِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَتَخَلَّلُونَ الشَّجَرَ أَوَّلُهُمُ الأَخْرَمُ الأَسَدِيُّ فَيَلْحَقُ بِعَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ وَيَعْطِفُ عَلَيْهِ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ فَاخْتَلَفَا طَعْنَتَيْنِ فَعَقَرَ الأَخْرَمُ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ وَطَعَنَهُ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ فَقَتَلَهُ فَتَحَوَّلَ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ عَلَى فَرَسِ الأَخْرَمِ فَيَلْحَقُ أَبُو قَتَادَةَ بِعَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ فَاخْتَلَفَا طَعْنَتَيْنِ فَعَقَرَ بِأَبِي قَتَادَةَ وَقَتَلَهُ أَبُو قَتَادَةَ فَتَحَوَّلَ أَبُو قَتَادَةَ عَلَى فَرَسِ الأَخْرَمِ ثُمَّ جِئْتُ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُوَ عَلَى الْمَاءِ الَّذِي جَلَّيْتُهُمْ عَنْهُ ذُو قَرَدٍ فَإِذَا نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي خَمْسِمِائَةٍ فَأَعْطَانِي سَهْمَ الْفَارِسِ وَالرَّاجِلِ ‏.‏
15.en: Salamah (bin Al ‘Akwa) said “Abd Al rahman bin ‘Uyainah raided the Camels of the Apostle of Allaah(ﷺ) and killed their herdsman. He and some people who were with him on horses proceeded on driving them away. I turned my face towards Madeenah and shouted three times. A morning raid, I then went after the people shooting arrows at them and hamstringing them (their beasts). When a horseman returned to me, I sat in the foot of a tree till there was no riding beast of the Prophet (ﷺ) created by Allaah which I had not kept behind my back. They threw away more than thirty lance and thirty cloaks to lighten themselves. Then ‘Uyainah came to them with reinforcement and said “A few of you should go to him. Four of them stood and came to me. They ascended a mountain. Then they came near me till they could hear my voice. I told them “Do you know me?” They said “Who are you? I replied “I am Ibn Al ‘Akwa. By Him Who honored the face of Muhammad (ﷺ) if any man of you pursues he cannot catch me and if I pursue him, I will not miss him. This went on with me till I saw the horsemen of the Apostle of Allaah(ﷺ) coming through the trees. Al Akhram Al Asadi was at their head. He then joined ‘Abd Al Rahman bin ‘Uyainah and ‘Abd Al Rahman turned over him. They attacked each other with lances. Al Akhram hamstrung ‘Abd Al Rahman’s horse and ‘Abd Al Rahman pierced a lance in his body and killed him. ‘Abd al Rahman then returned on the horse of Al Akhram. I then came to the Apostle of Allaah(ﷺ) who was present at the same water from where I drove them away and which is known as Dhu Qarad. The Prophet (ﷺ) was among five hundred people. He then gave me two portions a horseman’s and a footman’s
15.hi: Salamah (bin al-Akwa') kehte hain: Abdur Rahman bin Uyaynah ne Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ke oonton par chhaapa maara aur unke charwaahe ko qatal kar diya. Woh aur unke saath kuch log ghodon par unhein hankaate hue nikale. Maine apna chehra Madina ki taraf kiya aur teen martaba chillaaya: Subah ka chhaapa! Fir main un logon ke peechhe gaya, unpar teer chalaate hue aur unke jaanwaron ki peedh kaat te hue. Jab koi ghudsawaar mere paas wapas aata, main ek darakht ki jad mein baith jaata yahan tak ke Allah ki banaayi hui koi bhi Nabi (ﷺ) ki sawaari na thi jise maine wapas na le liya ho. Unhone apne aap ko halka karne ke liye tees se zyada bhaale aur tees chaadar phenke. Fir Uyaynah madad ke saath unke paas aaye aur kaha: Tum mein se thode unke paas jao. Chaar log khade hue aur mere paas aaye. Woh ek pahaad par chadhe. Fir woh mere qareeb aaye yahan tak ke woh meri awaaz sun sakte the. Maine unhein kaha: Kya tum mujhe pehchaante ho? Unhone kaha: Tum kaun ho? Maine jawaab diya: Main Ibn al-Akwa' hoon. Us Zaat ki qasam jisne Muhammad (ﷺ) ke chehre ki izzat ki, agar tum mein se koi mera peechha kare, woh mujhe pakad nahi sakta, aur agar main unka peechha karun, main unhein nahi chhodunga. Yeh silsila tab tak chalta raha jab tak maine Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ke ghudsawaaron ko darakhton mein se aate dekha. Al-Akhram al-Asadi unke aage the. Fir woh Abdur Rahman bin Uyaynah se mile, aur Abdur Rahman unpar palat gaye. Unhone ek-doosre par bhaale se hamla kiya. Al-Akhram ne Abdur Rahman ke ghode ki peedh kaat di aur Abdur Rahman ne apna bhaala unke jism mein ghusa diya aur unhein qatal kar diya. Fir Abdur Rahman al-Akhram ke ghode par wapas laut aaye. Fir main Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ke paas aaya jo usi paani ke paas maujood the jahan se maine unhein hankaaya tha aur jise Dhu Qarad kaha jaata hai. Nabi (ﷺ) paanch sau logon ke saath the. Aapne mujhe do hisse diye, ek ghudsawaar ka aur ek paidal shakhs ka.

15.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو صَالِحٍ، مَحْبُوبُ بْنُ مُوسَى أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ الْفَزَارِيُّ، عَنْ عَاصِمِ بْنِ كُلَيْبٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الْجُوَيْرِيَةِ الْجَرْمِيِّ، قَالَ أَصَبْتُ بِأَرْضِ الرُّومِ جَرَّةً حَمْرَاءَ فِيهَا دَنَانِيرُ فِي إِمْرَةِ مُعَاوِيَةَ وَعَلَيْنَا رَجُلٌ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ بَنِي سُلَيْمٍ يُقَالُ لَهُ مَعْنُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ فَأَتَيْتُهُ بِهَا فَقَسَمَهَا بَيْنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ وَأَعْطَانِي مِنْهَا مِثْلَ مَا أَعْطَى رَجُلاً مِنْهُمْ ثُمَّ قَالَ لَوْلاَ أَنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ لاَ نَفْلَ إِلاَّ بَعْدَ الْخُمُسِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ لأَعْطَيْتُكَ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ أَخَذَ يَعْرِضُ عَلَىَّ مِنْ نَصِيبِهِ فَأَبَيْتُ ‏.‏
15.en: Narrated Ma'an ibn Yazid: AbulJuwayriyyah al-Jarmi said: I found a red pitcher containing dinars in Byzantine territory during the reign of Mu'awiyah. A man from the Companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) belonging to Banu Sulaym was our ruler. He was called Ma'an ibn Yazid. I brought it to him. He apportioned it among the Muslims. He gave me the same portion which he gave to one of them. He then said: Had I not heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say: There is no reward except after taking the fifth (from the booty), I would have given you (the reward). He then presented his own share to me, but I refused
15.hi: Hazrat Ma'an bin Yazid bayaan karte hain: Abu al-Juwayriyyah al-Jarmi kehte hain: Maine Byzantine (Rome) ilaake mein ek laal ghada paaya jisme dinar the, Mu'awiyah ke daur mein. Nabi (ﷺ) ke sahaba mein se ek aadmi, Banu Sulaym se, humaara hukmaraan tha. Unhein Ma'an bin Yazid kaha jaata tha. Main unhein yeh laaya. Unhone isse Musalmanon mein taqseem kiya. Unhone mujhe wahi hissa diya jo unmein se ek ko diya. Fir unhone kaha: Agar maine Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ko yeh kehte na suna hota, 'Koi inaam nahi jab tak khums (paanchwan hissa) na nikaala jaaye (ghaneemat se),' to main tumhein (inaam) deta. Fir unhone apna hissa mujhe pesh kiya, lekin maine inkaar kiya.

15.ar: حَدَّثَنَا هَنَّادٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ الْمُبَارَكِ، عَنْ أَبِي عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ عَاصِمِ بْنِ كُلَيْبٍ، بِإِسْنَادِهِ وَمَعْنَاهُ ‏.‏
15.en: The tradition mentioned above has also been transmitted by ‘Asim bin Kulaib through a different chain of narrators to the same effect
15.hi: Upar zikr ki gayi riwayat Asim bin Kulaib se ek doosri sanad se bhi isi tarah riwayat ki gayi hai.

15.ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ عُتْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا سَلاَّمٍ الأَسْوَدَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَمْرَو بْنَ عَبَسَةَ، قَالَ صَلَّى بِنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَى بَعِيرٍ مِنَ الْمَغْنَمِ فَلَمَّا سَلَّمَ أَخَذَ وَبَرَةً مِنْ جَنْبِ الْبَعِيرِ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏ "‏ وَلاَ يَحِلُّ لِي مِنْ غَنَائِمِكُمْ مِثْلُ هَذَا إِلاَّ الْخُمُسَ وَالْخُمُسُ مَرْدُودٌ فِيكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
15.en: Narrated Amr ibn Abasah: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) led us in prayer facing a camel which had been taken in booty, and when he had given the salutation, he took a hair from the camel's side and said: I have no right as much as this of your booty, but only to the fifth. and the fifth is returned to you
15.hi: Hazrat Amr bin Abasah bayaan karte hain: Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne humein ek oont ke saamne namaz padhaayi jo ghaneemat mein liya gaya tha, aur jab aapne salaam pheri, aapne oont ke pehlu se ek baal liya aur farmaya: Mujhe tumhaari ghaneemat mein isse zyada koi haq nahi, sirf khums ke ilaawa, aur khums bhi tumhein wapas kiya jaata hai.

15.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ الْقَعْنَبِيُّ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ الْغَادِرَ يُنْصَبُ لَهُ لِوَاءٌ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ فَيُقَالُ هَذِهِ غَدْرَةُ فُلاَنِ بْنِ فُلاَنٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
15.en: Ibn ‘Umar reported the Apostle of Allaah(ﷺ) as saying “A banner will be hoisted for a treacherous man on the Day of Judgment, it will then be announced. This is a treachery of so and so, son of so and so
15.hi: Ibn Umar bayaan karte hain ke Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Ek dhoke wale aadmi ke liye Qayamat ke din ek jhanda lagaaya jaayega, fir elaan kiya jaayega: Yeh fulan bin fulan ka dhoka hai.

15.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الصَّبَّاحِ الْبَزَّازُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِنَّمَا الإِمَامُ جُنَّةٌ يُقَاتَلُ بِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
15.en: Abu Hurarirah reported the Apostle of Allaah(ﷺ) as saying “A Muslim ruler is shield by which a battle is fought.”
15.hi: Abu Hurairah kehte hain ke Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Musalman hukmaraan ek dhaal hai jismein jung ladi jaati hai.

15.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرٌو، عَنْ بُكَيْرِ بْنِ الأَشَجِّ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي رَافِعٍ، أَنَّ أَبَا رَافِعٍ، أَخْبَرَهُ قَالَ بَعَثَتْنِي قُرَيْشٌ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلَمَّا رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أُلْقِيَ فِي قَلْبِيَ الإِسْلاَمُ فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي وَاللَّهِ لاَ أَرْجِعُ إِلَيْهِمْ أَبَدًا فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِنِّي لاَ أَخِيسُ بِالْعَهْدِ وَلاَ أَحْبِسُ الْبُرُدَ وَلَكِنِ ارْجِعْ فَإِنْ كَانَ فِي نَفْسِكَ الَّذِي فِي نَفْسِكَ الآنَ فَارْجِعْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَذَهَبْتُ ثُمَّ أَتَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَسْلَمْتُ ‏.‏ قَالَ بُكَيْرٌ وَأَخْبَرَنِي أَنَّ أَبَا رَافِعٍ كَانَ قِبْطِيًّا ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو دَاوُدَ هَذَا كَانَ فِي ذَلِكَ الزَّمَانِ فَأَمَّا الْيَوْمَ فَلاَ يَصْلُحُ ‏.‏
15.en: Narrated AbuRafi': The Quraysh sent me to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), and when I saw the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), Islam was cast into my heart, so I said: Messenger of Allah, I swear by Allah, I shall never return to them. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) replied: I do not break a covenant or imprison messengers, but return, and if you feel the same as you do just now, come back. So I went away, and then came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and accepted Islam. The narrator Bukair said: He informed me that Abu Rafi' was a Copt. Abu Dawud said: This was valid in those days, but today it is not valid
15.hi: Hazrat Abu Rafi' bayaan karte hain: Quraysh ne mujhe Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ke paas bheja, aur jab maine Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ko dekha, Islam mere dil mein daal diya gaya, so maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool, Allah ki qasam, main unke paas kabhi wapas nahi jaunga. Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne jawaab diya: Main koi muahida nahi todta ya qaasidon ko qaid nahi karta, lekin wapas jao, aur agar tumhein waisa hi mehsoos ho jaisa abhi mehsoos hua, wapas aa jaana. So main gaya, fir Nabi (ﷺ) ke paas aaya aur Islam qabool kiya. Raawi Bukair kehte hain: Unhone mujhe bataaya ke Abu Rafi' ek Copt the. Abu Dawud kehte hain: Yeh us zamane mein jaayez tha, lekin aaj yeh jaayez nahi.

15.ar: حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ عُمَرَ النَّمَرِيُّ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي الْفَيْضِ، عَنْ سُلَيْمِ بْنِ عَامِرٍ، - رَجُلٍ مِنْ حِمْيَرَ - قَالَ كَانَ بَيْنَ مُعَاوِيَةَ وَبَيْنَ الرُّومِ عَهْدٌ وَكَانَ يَسِيرُ نَحْوَ بِلاَدِهِمْ حَتَّى إِذَا انْقَضَى الْعَهْدُ غَزَاهُمْ فَجَاءَ رَجُلٌ عَلَى فَرَسٍ أَوْ بِرْذَوْنٍ وَهُوَ يَقُولُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ وَفَاءٌ لاَ غَدْرٌ فَنَظَرُوا فَإِذَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَبَسَةَ فَأَرْسَلَ إِلَيْهِ مُعَاوِيَةُ فَسَأَلَهُ فَقَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ مَنْ كَانَ بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ قَوْمٍ عَهْدٌ فَلاَ يَشُدُّ عُقْدَةً وَلاَ يَحُلُّهَا حَتَّى يَنْقَضِيَ أَمَدُهَا أَوْ يَنْبِذَ إِلَيْهِمْ عَلَى سَوَاءٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَرَجَعَ مُعَاوِيَةُ ‏.‏
15.en: Narrated Amr ibn Abasah: Sulaym ibn Amir, a man of Himyar, said: There was a covenant between Mu'awiyah and the Byzantines, and he was going towards their country, and when the covenant came to an end, he attacked them. A man came on a horse, or a packhorse saying, Allah is Most Great, Allah is Most Great; let there be faithfulness and not treachery. And when they looked they found that he was Amr ibn Abasah. Mu'awiyah sent for him and questioned him (about that). He said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say: When one has covenant with people he must not strengthen or loosen it till its term comes to an end or he brings it to an end in agreement with them (to make both the parties equal). So Mu'awiyah returned
15.hi: Hazrat Amr bin Abasah bayaan karte hain: Sulaym bin Amir, Himyar ka ek aadmi, kehte hain: Mu'awiyah aur Byzantines ke darmiyan ek muahida tha, aur woh unke ilaake ki taraf jaa rahe the, aur jab muahida khatam ho gaya, unhone unpar hamla kiya. Ek aadmi ghode ya sawaari ke jaanwar par aaya, kehte hue, Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar; wafadaari ho, dhoka nahi. Aur jab unhone dekha, unhein maloom hua ke woh Amr bin Abasah the. Mu'awiyah ne unhein bulaaya aur (iske baare mein) poocha. Unhone kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ko farmaate suna: Jab kisi ke logon ke saath muahida ho, use isse na mazboot karna chaahiye na dheela karna chaahiye jab tak yeh muddat khatam na ho ya woh unke saath sahmati se isse khatam na kare (dono paksh barabar ho). So Mu'awiyah wapas mud gaye.

15.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ عُيَيْنَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنْ قَتَلَ مُعَاهِدًا فِي غَيْرِ كُنْهِهِ حَرَّمَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ الْجَنَّةَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
15.en: Narrated AbuBakrah: The Prophet (ﷺ) said: If anyone kills a man whom he grants protection prematurely, Allah will forbid him to enter Paradise
15.hi: Hazrat Abu Bakrah bayaan karte hain: Nabi (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Agar koi kisi aadmi ko qatal kare jise usne pehle panah di ho, Allah unhein Jannat mein dakhil hone se mana karega.

15.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو الرَّازِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا سَلَمَةُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ الْفَضْلِ - عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ، قَالَ كَانَ مُسَيْلِمَةُ كَتَبَ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ قَالَ وَقَدْ حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ شَيْخٍ مِنْ أَشْجَعَ يُقَالُ لَهُ سَعْدُ بْنُ طَارِقٍ عَنْ سَلَمَةَ بْنِ نُعَيْمِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ الأَشْجَعِيِّ عَنْ أَبِيهِ نُعَيْمٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ لَهُمَا حِينَ قَرَآ كِتَابَ مُسَيْلِمَةَ ‏"‏ مَا تَقُولاَنِ أَنْتُمَا ‏"‏ قَالاَ نَقُولُ كَمَا قَالَ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَمَا وَاللَّهِ لَوْلاَ أَنَّ الرُّسُلَ لاَ تُقْتَلُ لَضَرَبْتُ أَعْنَاقَكُمَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
15.en: Narrated Nu'aym ibn Mas'ud: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say when they (messengers sent by Musaylimah) read the letter of Musaylimah: What do you believe yourselves? They said: We believe as he believes. He said: I swear by Allah that were it not that messengers are not killed, I would cut off your heads
15.hi: Hazrat Nu'aym bin Mas'ud bayaan karte hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ko yeh kehte suna jab woh (Musaylimah ke bheje hue qaasid) Musaylimah ka khat padh rahe the: Tum khud kya maante ho? Unhone kaha: Hum wahi maante hain jo woh maante hain. Aapne farmaya: Allah ki qasam, agar yeh na hota ke qaasid qatal nahi kiye jaate, to main tumhaare sar kaat deta.

15.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ حَارِثَةَ بْنِ مُضَرِّبٍ، أَنَّهُ أَتَى عَبْدَ اللَّهِ فَقَالَ مَا بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ أَحَدٍ مِنَ الْعَرَبِ حِنَةٌ وَإِنِّي مَرَرْتُ بِمَسْجِدٍ لِبَنِي حَنِيفَةَ فَإِذَا هُمْ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِمُسَيْلِمَةَ ‏.‏ فَأَرْسَلَ إِلَيْهِمْ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ فَجِيءَ بِهِمْ فَاسْتَتَابَهُمْ غَيْرَ ابْنِ النَّوَّاحَةِ قَالَ لَهُ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ لَوْلاَ أَنَّكَ رَسُولٌ لَضَرَبْتُ عُنُقَكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَأَنْتَ الْيَوْمَ لَسْتَ بِرَسُولٍ فَأَمَرَ قَرَظَةَ بْنَ كَعْبٍ فَضَرَبَ عُنُقَهُ فِي السُّوقِ ثُمَّ قَالَ مَنْ أَرَادَ أَنْ يَنْظُرَ إِلَى ابْنِ النَّوَّاحَةِ قَتِيلاً بِالسُّوقِ ‏.‏
15.en: Narrated Abdullah ibn Mas'ud: Harithah ibn Mudarrib said that he came to Abdullah ibn Mas'ud and said (to him): There is no enmity between me and any of the Arabs. I passed a mosque of Banu Hanifah. They (the people) believed in Musaylimah. Abdullah (ibn Mas'ud) sent for them. They were brought, and he asked them to repent, except Ibn an-Nawwahah. He said to him: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say: Were it not that you were not a messenger, I would behead you. But today you are not a messenger. He then ordered Qarazah ibn Ka'b (to kill him). He beheaded him in the market. Anyone who wants to see Ibn an-Nawwahah slain in the market (he may see him)
15.hi: Hazrat Abdullah bin Mas'ud bayaan karte hain: Harithah bin Mudarrib kehte hain ke woh Abdullah bin Mas'ud ke paas aaye aur (unse) kaha: Mere aur kisi bhi Arab ke darmiyan koi dushmani nahi. Main Banu Hanifah ki ek masjid se guzra. Unhone (logon ne) Musaylimah par imaan rakha. Abdullah (bin Mas'ud) ne unhein bulwaaya. Unhein laaya gaya, aur unhone unhein tauba karne ko kaha, siwaye Ibn an-Nawwahah ke. Unhone unse kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ko yeh kehte suna: Agar yeh na hota ke tum qaasid nahi ho, to main tumhein sar kalam kar deta. Lekin aaj tum qaasid nahi ho. Fir unhone Qarazah bin Ka'b ko hukum diya (unhein qatal karne ke liye). Unhone unhein bazaar mein sar kalam kiya. Jo koi Ibn an-Nawwahah ko bazaar mein qatal hote dekhna chahe (dekh sakta hai).

15.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عِيَاضُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ مَخْرَمَةَ بْنِ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ كُرَيْبٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَتْنِي أُمُّ هَانِئٍ بِنْتُ أَبِي طَالِبٍ، أَنَّهَا أَجَارَتْ رَجُلاً مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ يَوْمَ الْفَتْحِ فَأَتَتِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَذَكَرَتْ لَهُ ذَلِكَ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ قَدْ أَجَرْنَا مَنْ أَجَرْتِ وَأَمَّنَّا مَنْ أَمَّنْتِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
15.en: Ibn ‘Abbas said “Umm Hani daughter of Abu Talib told me that in the year of the conquest she gave protection to a man from the polytheists. She came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and mentioned it to him. He said “We have given security to those to whom you have given it.”
15.hi: Ibn Abbas kehte hain: Umm Hani, Abu Talib ki beti, ne mujhse bataaya ke fatah ke saal unhone mushrikeen mein se ek aadmi ko panah di. Woh Nabi (ﷺ) ke paas gayi aur yeh baat unhein bataayi. Aapne farmaya: Humne unhein panah di jinhein tumne panah di.

15.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ إِنْ كَانَتِ الْمَرْأَةُ لَتُجِيرُ عَلَى الْمُؤْمِنِينَ فَيَجُوزُ ‏.‏
15.en: Narrated Aisha, Ummul Mu'minin: A woman would give security from the believers and it would be allowed
15.hi: Hazrat Aisha, Ummul-Momineen (رضی اللہ عنہا), bayaan karti hain: Koi bhi aurat momino mein se kisi ko panah de sakti thi aur yeh maani jaati thi.

15.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُبَيْدٍ، أَنَّ مُحَمَّدَ بْنَ ثَوْرٍ، حَدَّثَهُمْ عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنِ الْمِسْوَرِ بْنِ مَخْرَمَةَ، قَالَ خَرَجَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم زَمَنَ الْحُدَيْبِيَةِ فِي بِضْعَ عَشَرَةَ مِائَةٍ مِنْ أَصْحَابِهِ حَتَّى إِذَا كَانُوا بِذِي الْحُلَيْفَةِ قَلَّدَ الْهَدْىَ وَأَشْعَرَهُ وَأَحْرَمَ بِالْعُمْرَةِ ‏.‏ وَسَاقَ الْحَدِيثَ قَالَ وَسَارَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَتَّى إِذَا كَانَ بِالثَّنِيَّةِ الَّتِي يُهْبَطُ عَلَيْهِمْ مِنْهَا بَرَكَتْ بِهِ رَاحِلَتُهُ فَقَالَ النَّاسُ حَلْ حَلْ خَلأَتِ الْقَصْوَاءُ ‏.‏ مَرَّتَيْنِ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَا خَلأَتْ وَمَا ذَلِكَ لَهَا بِخُلُقٍ وَلَكِنْ حَبَسَهَا حَابِسُ الْفِيلِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ لاَ يَسْأَلُونِي الْيَوْمَ خُطَّةً يُعَظِّمُونَ بِهَا حُرُمَاتِ اللَّهِ إِلاَّ أَعْطَيْتُهُمْ إِيَّاهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ زَجَرَهَا فَوَثَبَتْ فَعَدَلَ عَنْهُمْ حَتَّى نَزَلَ بِأَقْصَى الْحُدَيْبِيَةِ عَلَى ثَمَدٍ قَلِيلِ الْمَاءِ فَجَاءَهُ بُدَيْلُ بْنُ وَرْقَاءَ الْخُزَاعِيُّ ثُمَّ أَتَاهُ - يَعْنِي عُرْوَةَ بْنَ مَسْعُودٍ - فَجَعَلَ يُكَلِّمُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَكُلَّمَا كَلَّمَهُ أَخَذَ بِلِحْيَتِهِ وَالْمُغِيرَةُ بْنُ شُعْبَةَ قَائِمٌ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَمَعَهُ السَّيْفُ وَعَلَيْهِ الْمِغْفَرُ فَضَرَبَ يَدَهُ بِنَعْلِ السَّيْفِ وَقَالَ أَخِّرْ يَدَكَ عَنْ لِحْيَتِهِ ‏.‏ فَرَفَعَ عُرْوَةُ رَأْسَهُ فَقَالَ مَنْ هَذَا قَالُوا الْمُغِيرَةُ بْنُ شُعْبَةَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَىْ غُدَرُ أَوَلَسْتُ أَسْعَى فِي غَدْرَتِكَ وَكَانَ الْمُغِيرَةُ صَحِبَ قَوْمًا فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ فَقَتَلَهُمْ وَأَخَذَ أَمْوَالَهُمْ ثُمَّ جَاءَ فَأَسْلَمَ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَمَّا الإِسْلاَمُ فَقَدْ قَبِلْنَا وَأَمَّا الْمَالُ فَإِنَّهُ مَالُ غَدْرٍ لاَ حَاجَةَ لَنَا فِيهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ الْحَدِيثَ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ اكْتُبْ هَذَا مَا قَاضَى عَلَيْهِ مُحَمَّدٌ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَقَصَّ الْخَبَرَ فَقَالَ سُهَيْلٌ وَعَلَى أَنَّهُ لاَ يَأْتِيكَ مِنَّا رَجُلٌ وَإِنْ كَانَ عَلَى دِينِكَ إِلاَّ رَدَدْتَهُ إِلَيْنَا ‏.‏ فَلَمَّا فَرَغَ مِنْ قَضِيَّةِ الْكِتَابِ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لأَصْحَابِهِ ‏"‏ قُومُوا فَانْحَرُوا ثُمَّ احْلِقُوا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ جَاءَ نِسْوَةٌ مُؤْمِنَاتٌ مُهَاجِرَاتٌ الآيَةَ فَنَهَاهُمُ اللَّهُ أَنْ يَرُدُّوهُنَّ وَأَمَرَهُمْ أَنْ يَرُدُّوا الصَّدَاقَ ثُمَّ رَجَعَ إِلَى الْمَدِينَةِ فَجَاءَهُ أَبُو بَصِيرٍ رَجُلٌ مِنْ قُرَيْشٍ - يَعْنِي فَأَرْسَلُوا فِي طَلَبِهِ - فَدَفَعَهُ إِلَى الرَّجُلَيْنِ فَخَرَجَا بِهِ حَتَّى إِذَا بَلَغَا ذَا الْحُلَيْفَةِ نَزَلُوا يَأْكُلُونَ مِنْ تَمْرٍ لَهُمْ فَقَالَ أَبُو بَصِيرٍ لأَحَدِ الرَّجُلَيْنِ وَاللَّهِ إِنِّي لأَرَى سَيْفَكَ هَذَا يَا فُلاَنُ جَيِّدًا ‏.‏ فَاسْتَلَّهُ الآخَرُ فَقَالَ أَجَلْ قَدْ جَرَّبْتُ بِهِ فَقَالَ أَبُو بَصِيرٍ أَرِنِي أَنْظُرْ إِلَيْهِ فَأَمْكَنَهُ مِنْهُ فَضَرَبَهُ حَتَّى بَرَدَ وَفَرَّ الآخَرُ حَتَّى أَتَى الْمَدِينَةَ فَدَخَلَ الْمَسْجِدَ يَعْدُو فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لَقَدْ رَأَى هَذَا ذُعْرًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ قَدْ قُتِلَ وَاللَّهِ صَاحِبِي وَإِنِّي لَمَقْتُولٌ فَجَاءَ أَبُو بَصِيرٍ فَقَالَ قَدْ أَوْفَى اللَّهُ ذِمَّتَكَ فَقَدْ رَدَدْتَنِي إِلَيْهِمْ ثُمَّ نَجَّانِي اللَّهُ مِنْهُمْ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ وَيْلَ أُمِّهِ مِسْعَرَ حَرْبٍ لَوْ كَانَ لَهُ أَحَدٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَلَمَّا سَمِعَ ذَلِكَ عَرَفَ أَنَّهُ سَيَرُدُّهُ إِلَيْهِمْ فَخَرَجَ حَتَّى أَتَى سِيفَ الْبَحْرِ وَيَنْفَلِتُ أَبُو جَنْدَلٍ فَلَحِقَ بِأَبِي بَصِيرٍ حَتَّى اجْتَمَعَتْ مِنْهُمْ عِصَابَةٌ ‏.‏
15.en: Al Miswar bin Makhramah said :The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came out in the year of al-Hudaibbiyyah with over ten hundreds of Companions and when he came to Dhu al Hulaifah. He garlanded and marked the sacrificial animals, and entered the sacred state of Umrah. He then went on with the tradition. The Prophet moved on and when he came to the mountain, pass by which one descends (to Mecca) to them, his riding-beast knelt down, and the people said twice: Go on, go on, al-Qaswa has become jaded. The Prophet (May peace be upon him) said: She has not become jaded and that is not a characteristic of hers, but He Who restrained the elephant has restrained her. He then said: By Him in Whose hand my soul is, they will not ask any me good thing by which they honor which God has made sacred without my giving them it. He then urged her and she leaped up and he turned aside from them, and stopped at the farthest side of al-Hudaibiyyah at a pool with little water. Meanwhile Budail bin Warqa al-Khuza’I came, and ‘Urwah bin Mas’ud joined him. He began to speak to the Prophet (ﷺ). Whenever he spoke to the Prophet (ﷺ), he caught his beard. Al Mughriah bin Shu’bah was standing beside the Prophet (ﷺ).He had a sword with him, wearing a helmet. He (Al Mughriah) struck his (‘Urwah’s) hand with the lower end of his sheath, and said: Keep away your hand from his beard. ‘Urwah then raised his hand and asked: Who is this? They replied: Al-Mughirah bin Shu’bah. He said: O treacherous one! Did I not use my offices in your treachery? In pre-Islamic days Al-Mughirah bin Shu’bah accompanied some people and murdered them, and took their property. He then came (to the Prophet) and embraced Islam. The Prophet (ﷺ) said: As for Islam we accepted it, but as to the property, as it has been taken by treachery, we have no need of it. He went on with the tradition the Prophet (ﷺ) said: Write down: This is what Muhammad, the Messenger of Allah, has decided. He then narrated the tradition. Suhail then said: And that a man will not come to you from us, even if he follows your religion, without you sending him back to us. When he finished drawing up the document, the Prophet (ﷺ) said to his Companions: Get up and sacrifice and then shave. Thereafter some believing women who were immigrants came. (Allah sent down: O yea who believe, when believing women come to you as emigrants). Allah most high forbade them to send them back, but ordered them to restore the dower. He then returned to Medina. Abu Basir a man from the Quraish (who was a Muslim), came to him. And they sent (two men) to look for him; so he handed him over to the two men. They took him away, and when they reached Dhu Al Hulaifah and alighted to eat some dates which they had, Abu Basir said to one of the men : I swear by Allah so-and-so, that I think this sword of yours is a fine one; the other drew the sword and said : Yes I have tried it. Abu Basir said: Let me look at it. He let him have it and he struck him till he died, whereupon the other fled and came to Medina, and running entered the mosque. The Prophet ( may peace be upon him) said: This man has seen something frightful. He said: I swear by Allah that my Companion has been killed, and im as good as dead. Abu Basir then arrived and said: Allah has fulfilled your covenant. You returned me to them, but Allah saved me from them. The Prophet (ﷺ) said: Woe to his mother, stirrer up of war! Would that he had someone (i.e. some kinsfolk). When he heard that he knew that he would send him back to them, so he went out and came to the seashore. Abu Jandal escaped and joined Abu Basir till a band of them collected
15.hi: Al-Miswar bin Makhramah kehte hain: Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) al-Hudaybiyyah ke saal apne dus sau se zyada sahaba ke saath nikle aur jab woh Dhu al-Hulaifah pahunche, aapne qurbani ke jaanwaron ko haar aur nishaan pehnaaye, aur Umrah ke ihraam mein dakhil hue. Fir woh riwayat aage bataate hain. Nabi (ﷺ) aage badhe aur jab aap us pahaad tak pahunche jahan se log neeche (Makka ki taraf) utarte hain, aapki sawaari baith gayi, aur log do martaba kehne lage: Chalo, chalo, al-Qaswa thak gayi hai. Nabi (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Woh nahi thaki hai aur yeh uski aadat nahi, lekin jisne haathi ko roka usne isse roka hai. Fir aapne farmaya: Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, woh mujhse koi bhi achhi baat jisse woh Allah ki muqarrar ki hui cheezon ki izzat karein na maangenge magar main unhein woh dunga. Fir aapne isse ubhaara aur woh khadi ho gayi, aur aap unse alag hokar al-Hudaybiyyah ke sabse door hisse mein ek chhota jal-samidhaan wale talab par ruke. Isi waqt Budail bin Warqa al-Khuza'i aaye, aur Urwah bin Mas'ud unke saath judee. Woh Nabi (ﷺ) se baat karne lage. Jab bhi woh Nabi (ﷺ) se baat karte, woh unki daadhi pakadte the. Al-Mughirah bin Shu'bah Nabi (ﷺ) ke paas khade the. Unke paas talwaar thi, woh ek khud (helmet) pehne hue the. Unhone (Al-Mughirah ne) unka (Urwah ka) haath apne miyaan ke neeche wale hisse se maara, aur kaha: Apna haath unki daadhi se door rakho. Urwah ne fir apna haath uthaaya aur poocha: Yeh kaun hai? Unhone jawaab diya: Al-Mughirah bin Shu'bah. Unhone kaha: Ae dhokebaaz! Kya maine tumhaare dhoke mein tumhaari madad nahi ki thi? Jahiliyat ke zamane mein al-Mughirah bin Shu'bah kuch logon ke saath gaye aur unhein qatal kiya, aur unki jaidad li. Fir woh (Nabi ke paas) aaye aur Islam qabool kiya. Nabi (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Jahan tak Islam ka taalluq hai, humne isse qabool kiya, lekin jahan tak jaidad ka taalluq hai, chunki isse dhoke se liya gaya hai, humein iski koi zaroorat nahi. Woh riwayat aage bataate hain. Nabi (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Likho: Yeh woh hai jo Muhammad, Allah ke Rasool, ne tay kiya hai. Fir unhone riwayat bayaan ki. Suhail ne fir kaha: Aur yeh ke koi aadmi humaari taraf se aap tak nahi aayega, chahe woh aapke deen ki pairvi kare, jise aap wapas na bhej dein. Jab unhone dastavez likhna khatam kiya, Nabi (ﷺ) ne apne sahaba se kaha: Uthho aur qurbani karo, fir sar mundwaao. Iske baad kuch momin auraten jo Muhajir thi aayin. (Allah ne nazil kiya: Ae imaan waalo, jab momin auraten tumhaare paas hijrat karke aayein.) Allah, Azeem, ne unhein wapas bhejne se mana kiya, lekin mahar wapas karne ka hukum diya. Fir aap Madina wapas gaye. Quraysh mein se ek Musalman aadmi, Abu Basir, unke paas aaye. Aur unhone (Quraysh ne) unhein dhoondne (do log) bheje; so aapne unhein un do aadmiyon ke supurd kar diya. Woh unhein le gaye, aur jab woh Dhu al-Hulaifah pahunche aur kuch khajoor khaane ke liye ruke jo unke paas thi, Abu Basir ne unmein se ek se kaha: Allah ki qasam, fulan, mujhe lagta hai tumhaari yeh talwaar bahut achhi hai; doosre ne talwaar nikaali aur kaha: Ji haan, maine isse aazmaaya hai. Abu Basir ne kaha: Mujhe isse dekhne do. Usne unhein de di, aur unhone unhein maara yahan tak ke woh mar gaye, isper doosra aadmi bhaag kar Madina aaya, aur daudte hue masjid mein dakhil hua. Nabi (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Iss aadmi ne kuch khaufnaak dekha hai. Unhone kaha: Allah ki qasam, mera saathi qatal ho gaya, aur main bhi marne wala hoon. Fir Abu Basir pahunche aur kaha: Allah ne aapka muahida poora kiya. Aapne mujhe unhein wapas kiya, lekin Allah ne mujhe unse bachaaya. Nabi (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Uski maa ke liye afsos, jung ki aag jagaane wala! Kaash uske saath koi (rishtedaar) hote. Jab unhone yeh suna, unhein maloom hua ke aap unhein wapas bhej denge, so woh nikal gaye aur samundar ke kinaare aaye. Abu Jandal bhi bhaag kar Abu Basir se juda ho gaye yahan tak ke unka ek giroh jama ho gaya.

15.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ إِدْرِيسَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ إِسْحَاقَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنِ الْمِسْوَرِ بْنِ مَخْرَمَةَ، وَمَرْوَانَ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ، أَنَّهُمُ اصْطَلَحُوا عَلَى وَضْعِ الْحَرْبِ عَشْرَ سِنِينَ يَأْمَنُ فِيهِنَّ النَّاسُ وَعَلَى أَنَّ بَيْنَنَا عَيْبَةً مَكْفُوفَةً وَأَنَّهُ لاَ إِسْلاَلَ وَلاَ إِغْلاَلَ ‏.‏
15.en: Al Miswar bin Makhramah and Marwan bin Al Hakam said “They agreed to abandon war for ten years during which the people which have security on the basis that there should be sincerity between them and that there should be not theft or treachery
15.hi: Al-Miswar bin Makhramah aur Marwan bin al-Hakam kehte hain: Unhone das saal ke liye jung chhodne par sahmati zaahir ki, jismein log surakshit rahenge aur unke darmiyan sachhaayi hogi, koi chori ya dhoka na hoga.

15.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ النُّفَيْلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَوْزَاعِيُّ، عَنْ حَسَّانَ بْنِ عَطِيَّةَ، قَالَ مَالَ مَكْحُولٌ وَابْنُ أَبِي زَكَرِيَّاءَ إِلَى خَالِدِ بْنِ مَعْدَانَ وَمِلْتُ مَعَهُمَا فَحَدَّثَنَا عَنْ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ نُفَيْرٍ، قَالَ قَالَ جُبَيْرٌ انْطَلِقْ بِنَا إِلَى ذِي مِخْبَرٍ - رَجُلٌ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم - فَأَتَيْنَاهُ فَسَأَلَهُ جُبَيْرٌ عَنِ الْهُدْنَةِ فَقَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ سَتُصَالِحُونَ الرُّومَ صُلْحًا آمِنًا وَتَغْزُونَ أَنْتُمْ وَهُمْ عَدُوًّا مِنْ وَرَائِكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
15.en: Narrated Dhu Mikhbar: Hassan ibn Atiyyah said: Makhul and Ibn Zakariyya went to Khalid ibn Ma'dan, and I also went along with them. He reported a tradition on the authority of Jubayr ibn Nufayr. He said: Go with us to Dhu Mikhbar, a man from the Companions of the Prophet (ﷺ). We came to him and Jubayr asked him about peace. He said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say: You will make a secure peace with the Byzantines, then you and they will fight an enemy behind you
15.hi: Hazrat Dhu Mikhbar bayaan karte hain: Hassan bin Atiyyah kehte hain: Makhul aur Ibn Zakariyya Khalid bin Ma'dan ke paas gaye, aur main bhi unke saath gaya. Unhone Jubayr bin Nufayr ke hawale se ek riwayat sunaayi. Unhone kaha: Humaare saath Dhu Mikhbar ke paas jao, jo Nabi (ﷺ) ke sahaba mein se ek aadmi hain. Hum unke paas gaye aur Jubayr ne unse sulah ke baare mein poocha. Unhone kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ko farmaate suna: Tum Byzantines ke saath ek surakshit sulah karoge, fir tum aur woh dono milkar apne peeche wale dushman se ladoge.

15.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَنْ لِكَعْبِ بْنِ الأَشْرَفِ فَإِنَّهُ قَدْ آذَى اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَامَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ فَقَالَ أَنَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَتُحِبُّ أَنْ أَقْتُلَهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ نَعَمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَأْذَنْ لِي أَنْ أَقُولَ شَيْئًا ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ نَعَمْ قُلْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَأَتَاهُ فَقَالَ إِنَّ هَذَا الرَّجُلَ قَدْ سَأَلَنَا الصَّدَقَةَ وَقَدْ عَنَّانَا قَالَ وَأَيْضًا لَتَمَلُّنَّهُ ‏.‏ قَالَ اتَّبَعْنَاهُ فَنَحْنُ نَكْرَهُ أَنْ نَدَعَهُ حَتَّى نَنْظُرَ إِلَى أَىِّ شَىْءٍ يَصِيرُ أَمْرُهُ وَقَدْ أَرَدْنَا أَنْ تُسْلِفَنَا وَسْقًا أَوْ وَسْقَيْنِ ‏.‏ قَالَ كَعْبٌ أَىَّ شَىْءٍ تَرْهَنُونِي قَالَ وَمَا تُرِيدُ مِنَّا قَالَ نِسَاءَكُمْ قَالُوا سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ أَنْتَ أَجْمَلُ الْعَرَبِ نَرْهَنُكَ نِسَاءَنَا فَيَكُونُ ذَلِكَ عَارًا عَلَيْنَا ‏.‏ قَالَ فَتَرْهَنُونِي أَوْلاَدَكُمْ ‏.‏ قَالُوا سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ يُسَبُّ ابْنُ أَحَدِنَا فَيُقَالُ رُهِنْتَ بِوَسْقٍ أَوْ وَسْقَيْنِ ‏.‏ قَالُوا نَرْهَنُكَ اللأْمَةَ يُرِيدُ السِّلاَحَ قَالَ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ فَلَمَّا أَتَاهُ نَادَاهُ فَخَرَجَ إِلَيْهِ وَهُوَ مُتَطَيِّبٌ يَنْضَخُ رَأْسُهُ فَلَمَّا أَنْ جَلَسَ إِلَيْهِ وَقَدْ كَانَ جَاءَ مَعَهُ بِنَفَرٍ ثَلاَثَةٍ أَوْ أَرْبَعَةٍ فَذَكَرُوا لَهُ قَالَ عِنْدِي فُلاَنَةُ وَهِيَ أَعْطَرُ نِسَاءِ النَّاسِ ‏.‏ قَالَ تَأْذَنُ لِي فَأَشُمُّ قَالَ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ فَأَدْخَلَ يَدَهُ فِي رَأْسِهِ فَشَمَّهُ قَالَ أَعُودُ قَالَ نَعَمْ فَأَدْخَلَ يَدَهُ فِي رَأْسِهِ فَلَمَّا اسْتَمْكَنَ مِنْهُ قَالَ دُونَكُمْ ‏.‏ فَضَرَبُوهُ حَتَّى قَتَلُوهُ ‏.‏
15.en: Jabir reported:The Messenger of Allah ( may peace be upon him) said : Who will pursue Ka’b bin Al-Ashraf, for he has caused trouble to Allah and His Apostle? Muhammad bin Maslamah stood up and said: I (shall do), Messenger of Allah. Do you want that I should kill him? He said: Yes. He said: So permit me to say something (against you). He said: Yes say. He then came to him (Ka’b b. al-Ashraf) and said to him: This man has asked us for sadaqah (alms) and has put us into trouble. He (Ka’b) said: You will be more grieved. He (Muhammad bin Maslamah) said: We have followed him and we do not like to forsake him until we see what will be the consequences of his matter. We wished if you could lend us one or two wasqs. Ka’b said: What will you mortgage with me? He asked: what do you want from us? He replied : your Women. They said: Glory be to Allah: You are the most beautiful of the Arabs. If we mortgage our women with you, that will be a disgrace for us. He said “The mortgage your children.” They said “Glory be to Allaah, a son of us may abuse saying “You were mortgaged for one or two wasqs.” They said “We shall mortgage or coat of mail with you. By this he meant arms”. He said “Yes, when he came to him, he called him and he came out while he used perfume and his head was spreading fragrance. When he at with him and he came there accompanied by three or four persons who mentioned his perfume. He said “I have such and such woman with me. She is most fragrant of the women among the people. He (Muhammad bin Maslamah) asked “Do you permit me so that I may smell? He said “Yes. He then entered his hand through his hair and smell it.” He said “May I repeat?” He said “Yes. He again entered his hand through his hair. When he got his complete control, he said “Take him. So he struck him until they killed him.”
15.hi: Jabir bayaan karte hain: Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Ka'b bin al-Ashraf ka peechha kaun karega, kyunki usne Allah aur uske Rasool ko takleef pahunchaayi hai? Muhammad bin Maslamah khade hue aur kaha: Main karunga, Allah ke Rasool. Kya aap chahte hain ke main unhein qatal karun? Aapne kaha: Ji haan. Unhone kaha: To mujhe (aapke khilaaf) kuch kehne ki ijazat dein. Aapne kaha: Ji haan, kaho. Fir woh unke (Ka'b bin al-Ashraf ke) paas gaye aur kaha: Iss aadmi ne humse sadqa maanga hai aur humein museebat mein daal diya hai. Unhone (Ka'b ne) kaha: Tum aur zyada pareshaan hoge. Unhone (Muhammad bin Maslamah ne) kaha: Humne unki pairvi ki hai aur hum unhein tab tak chhodna nahi chaahte jab tak hum na dekhein unke maamle ka anjaam kya hoga. Humaari khwaahish hai ke aap humein ek ya do wasq udhaar dein. Ka'b ne kaha: Tum mujhse kya girvi rakhoge? Unhone poocha: Aap humse kya chaahte hain? Unhone jawaab diya: Tumhaari auraten. Unhone kaha: Subhaan-Allah, tum Arabon mein sabse khoobsurat ho. Agar hum apni auratein aapke paas girvi rakhein, yeh humaari be-izzati hogi. Unhone kaha: To apne bacchon ko girvi rakho. Unhone kaha: Subhaan-Allah, humaara koi beta yeh sunkar taane maar sakta hai ke tumhein ek ya do wasq ke liye girvi rakha gaya tha. Unhone kaha: Hum aapke paas apni zirah girvi rakhenge. Isse unka matlab tha hathiyaar. Unhone kaha: Theek hai. Jab woh unke paas gaye, unhone unhein bulwaaya aur woh baahar aaye khushbu lagaaye hue, aur unke sar se khushbu phailwaay wali thi. Jab woh unke saath baithe, jab woh teen ya chaar logon ke saath aaye jinhone unki khushbu ka zikr kiya. Unhone kaha: Mere paas fulan-fulan aurat hai. Woh logon mein sabse khushbu wali hai. Unhone (Muhammad bin Maslamah ne) poocha: Kya aap mujhe ijazat dete hain ke main soongh sakoon? Unhone jawaab diya: Ji haan. Fir unhone apna haath unke baalon mein daala aur soongh liya. Unhone poocha: Kya main dobara kar sakta hoon? Unhone jawaab diya: Ji haan. Woh dobara apna haath unke baalon mein daale. Jab unhone unpar poora qaboo paa liya, unhone kaha: Unhein pakdo. So unhone unhein maara yahan tak ke unhein qatal kar diya.

15.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حُزَابَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ مَنْصُورٍ - حَدَّثَنَا أَسْبَاطُ الْهَمْدَانِيُّ، عَنِ السُّدِّيِّ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ الإِيمَانُ قَيَّدَ الْفَتْكَ لاَ يَفْتِكُ مُؤْمِنٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
15.en: Narrated AbuHurayrah: The Prophet (ﷺ) said: Faith prevented assassination. A believer should not assassinate
15.hi: Hazrat Abu Hurairah bayaan karte hain: Nabi (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Imaan ne dhoke se qatal karne se roka. Momin ko dhoke se qatal nahi karna chaahiye.

15.ar: حَدَّثَنِي الْقَعْنَبِيُّ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ إِذَا قَفَلَ مِنْ غَزْوٍ أَوْ حَجٍّ أَوْ عُمْرَةٍ يُكَبِّرُ عَلَى كُلِّ شَرَفٍ مِنَ الأَرْضِ ثَلاَثَ تَكْبِيرَاتٍ وَيَقُولُ ‏ "‏ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ آيِبُونَ تَائِبُونَ عَابِدُونَ سَاجِدُونَ لِرَبِّنَا حَامِدُونَ صَدَقَ اللَّهُ وَعْدَهُ وَنَصَرَ عَبْدَهُ وَهَزَمَ الأَحْزَابَ وَحْدَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
15.en: ‘Abd Allah bin ‘Umar said “When the Apostle of Allaah(ﷺ) returned from an expedition, Hajj or ‘Umrah on every rising piece of ground he would say three times “Allaah is Most Great” and he would say “There is no god bt Allaah alone who has no partner, to Whom the dominion belongs, to Whom praise is due, and Who is Omnipotent, serving, prostrating ourselves before our Lord and expressing praise. Allaah alone has kept his word, helped His servant and routed the confederate
15.hi: Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar bayaan karte hain: Jab Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) kisi muhim, Hajj, ya Umrah se wapas aate, har oonchi zameen par aap teen martaba 'Allahu Akbar' kehte aur kehte: Koi ma'bood nahi Allah ke siwa, akela, uska koi shareek nahi, uski hukumat hai, uski hamd hai, aur woh har cheez par qaadir hai, wapas aate hue, tauba karte hue, apne Rab ki ibaadat karte aur sajda karte hue, aur hamd karte hue. Allah ne akela apna wa'da poora kiya, apne banda ki madad ki, aur giroh-band dushmanon ko akela haraaya.

15.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ الْمَرْوَزِيُّ، حَدَّثَنِي عَلِيُّ بْنُ حُسَيْنٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ النَّحْوِيِّ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ ‏{‏ لاَ يَسْتَأْذِنُكَ الَّذِينَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ ‏}‏ الآيَةَ نَسَخَتْهَا الَّتِي فِي النُّورِ ‏{‏ إِنَّمَا الْمُؤْمِنُونَ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا بِاللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ ‏}‏ إِلَى قَوْلِهِ ‏{‏ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ ‏}‏ ‏.‏
15.en: Ibn ‘Abbas said “The verse “Those who believe in Allaah and the Last Day ask thee for no exemption from fighting with their goods and persons” was abrogated by the verse “Only those are believers who believe in Allaah and His Apostle....For Allaah is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.”
15.hi: Ibn Abbas kehte hain: Yeh aayat "Woh log jo Allah aur Aakhirat ke din par imaan rakhte hain, aapse apne maal aur jaan se jihaad na karne ki ijazat nahi maangte" isse mansookh kar di gayi thi is aayat se: "Sirf woh momin hain jo Allah aur uske Rasool par imaan rakhte hain...beshak Allah bahut bakhshne wala, bahut meherbaan hai."

15.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو تَوْبَةَ الرَّبِيعُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عِيسَى، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، عَنْ قَيْسٍ، عَنْ جَرِيرٍ، قَالَ قَالَ لِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ أَلاَ تُرِيحُنِي مِنْ ذِي الْخَلَصَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَأَتَاهَا فَحَرَّقَهَا ثُمَّ بَعَثَ رَجُلاً مِنْ أَحْمَسَ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُبَشِّرُهُ يُكْنَى أَبَا أَرْطَاةَ ‏.‏
15.en: Jarir (bin ‘Abd Allaah) said “The Apostle of Allaah(ﷺ) said to me “Why do you not give me rest from Dhu Al Khulasah? He went there and burned it. He then sent a man from Ahmas to the Prophet (ﷺ) to give him good tidings. His surname was Artah
15.hi: Jarir (bin Abdullah) kehte hain: Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne mujhse farmaya: Kya tum mujhe Dhu al-Khalasah se aaraam nahi doge? Woh wahan gaye aur usse jala diya. Fir unhone Ahmas ke ek aadmi ko Nabi (ﷺ) ke paas khush-khabri dene bheja. Unka takhallus Artah tha.

15.ar: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ السَّرْحِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ كَعْبِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ كَعْبٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ كَعْبَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا قَدِمَ مِنْ سَفَرٍ بَدَأَ بِالْمَسْجِدِ فَرَكَعَ فِيهِ رَكْعَتَيْنِ ثُمَّ جَلَسَ لِلنَّاسِ ‏.‏ وَقَصَّ ابْنُ السَّرْحِ الْحَدِيثَ قَالَ وَنَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْمُسْلِمِينَ عَنْ كَلاَمِنَا أَيُّهَا الثَّلاَثَةُ حَتَّى إِذَا طَالَ عَلَىَّ تَسَوَّرْتُ جِدَارَ حَائِطِ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ وَهُوَ ابْنُ عَمِّي فَسَلَّمْتُ عَلَيْهِ فَوَاللَّهِ مَا رَدَّ عَلَىَّ السَّلاَمَ ثُمَّ صَلَّيْتُ الصُّبْحَ صَبَاحَ خَمْسِينَ لَيْلَةً عَلَى ظَهْرِ بَيْتٍ مِنْ بُيُوتِنَا فَسَمِعْتُ صَارِخًا يَا كَعْبُ بْنَ مَالِكٍ أَبْشِرْ ‏.‏ فَلَمَّا جَاءَنِي الَّذِي سَمِعْتُ صَوْتَهُ يُبَشِّرُنِي نَزَعْتُ لَهُ ثَوْبَىَّ فَكَسَوْتُهُمَا إِيَّاهُ فَانْطَلَقْتُ حَتَّى إِذَا دَخَلْتُ الْمَسْجِدَ فَإِذَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم جَالِسٌ فَقَامَ إِلَىَّ طَلْحَةُ بْنُ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ يُهَرْوِلُ حَتَّى صَافَحَنِي وَهَنَّأَنِي ‏.‏
15.en: Ka’ab bin Malik said “When the Prophet(ﷺ) arrived from a journey, he first went to a mosque where he prayed two rak’ahs after which he sat in it and gave audience to the people. The narrator Ibn Al Sarh then narrated the rest of the tradition. He said “The Apostle of Allaah(ﷺ) forbade the Muslims to speak to any three of us. When considerable time had passed on me, I ascended the wall of Abu Qatadah who was my cousin. I saluted him, but, I swear by Allaah he did not return my salutation. I then offered the dawn prayer on the fiftieth day on the roof of one of our houses. I then hear d a crier say “Ka’ab bin Mailk, have good news”. When the man whose voice I heard came to me giving me good news, I took off my garments and clothed him. I went on till I entered the mosque. The Apostle of Allaah(ﷺ) was sitting there. Talhah bin ‘Ubaid Allaah stood up and hastened to me till he shook hands with me and greeted me
15.hi: Ka'b bin Malik kehte hain: Jab Nabi (ﷺ) kisi safar se pahunchte, aap pehle masjid jaate jahan aap do rakat namaz padhte, iske baad aap wahan baithte aur logon ko darshan dete. Raawi Ibn al-Sarh ne fir baaqi riwayat bayaan ki. Unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne Musalmanon ko humme se teen logon se baat karne se mana kiya. Jab mujhpar kaafi waqt guzar gaya, main Abu Qatadah ki deewaar par chadha jo mera chachaazaad bhai the. Maine unhein salaam kiya, lekin, Allah ki qasam, unhone mera salaam nahi lauta. Fir maine Fajr ki namaz pachaasvein din humaare ek ghar ki chhat par padhi. Fir maine ek pukaarne wale ki awaaz suni jo keh raha tha: Ka'b bin Malik, khush ho jao. Jab woh aadmi jiski awaaz maine suni khush-khabri lekar mere paas aaya, maine apne kapde utaar diye aur unhein pehna diye. Main aage badha yahan tak ke main masjid mein dakhil hua. Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) wahan baithe the. Talhah bin Ubaydullah khade hue aur meri taraf jaldi aaye yahan tak ke unhone mujhse haath milaaya aur mujhe mubarak baad di.
