23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُبَيْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، قَالَ كَتَبَ إِلَىَّ يَعْلَى بْنُ حَكِيمٍ أَنِّي سَمِعْتُ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنَ يَسَارٍ، بِمَعْنَى إِسْنَادِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ وَحَدِيثِهِ ‏.‏
23.en: Ayyub said:Ya'la b. Hakim wrote to me: I heard Sulaiman b. Yasar narrating the tradition to the same effect as narrated by 'Ubaid Allah and through the same chain
23.hi: Ayyub kehte hain: Ya'la bin Hakim ne mujhe likha: Maine Sulaiman bin Yasar ko isi jaisi riwayat bayaan karte suna jaisa Ubaydullah ne aur usi sanad ke zariye riwayat ki.

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ ذَرٍّ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ رَافِعِ بْنِ خَدِيجٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ جَاءَنَا أَبُو رَافِعٍ مِنْ عِنْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ نَهَانَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ أَمْرٍ كَانَ يَرْفَقُ بِنَا وَطَاعَةُ اللَّهِ وَطَاعَةُ رَسُولِهِ أَرْفَقُ بِنَا نَهَانَا أَنْ يَزْرَعَ أَحَدُنَا إِلاَّ أَرْضًا يَمْلِكُ رَقَبَتَهَا أَوْ مَنِيحَةً يَمْنَحُهَا رَجُلٌ ‏.‏
23.en: Narrated Rafi' ibn Khadij: AbuRafi' came to us from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) forbade us from a work which benefited us; but obedience to Allah and His Apostle (ﷺ) is more beneficial to us. He forbade that one of us cultivates land except the one which he owns or the land which a man lends him (to cultivate)
23.hi: Hazrat Rafi' bin Khadij bayaan karte hain: Abu Rafi' Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ki taraf se humaare paas aaye aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne humein ek aise kaam se mana kiya jo humein faida deta tha; lekin Allah aur uske Rasool (ﷺ) ki itaa'at humaare liye zyada faidemand hai. Aapne mana kiya ke hum mein se koi zameen kheti kare siwaye us zameen ke jiske woh maalik hon ya jo zameen koi aadmi unhein (kheti ke liye) udhaar de.

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، أَنَّ أُسَيْدَ بْنَ ظُهَيْرٍ، قَالَ جَاءَنَا رَافِعُ بْنُ خَدِيجٍ فَقَالَ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ يَنْهَاكُمْ عَنْ أَمْرٍ، كَانَ لَكُمْ نَافِعًا وَطَاعَةُ اللَّهِ وَطَاعَةُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْفَعُ لَكُمْ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَنْهَاكُمْ عَنِ الْحَقْلِ وَقَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنِ اسْتَغْنَى عَنْ أَرْضِهِ فَلْيَمْنَحْهَا أَخَاهُ أَوْ لِيَدَعْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو دَاوُدَ وَهَكَذَا رَوَاهُ شُعْبَةُ وَمُفَضَّلُ بْنُ مُهَلْهَلٍ عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ ‏.‏ قَالَ شُعْبَةُ أُسَيْدُ ابْنُ أَخِي رَافِعِ بْنِ خَدِيجٍ ‏.‏
23.en: Narrated Usaid b. Zuhair: Rafi' b. Khadij came to us and said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) forbids you from a work which is beneficial to you ; and obedience to Allah and His Prophet (ﷺ) is more beneficial to you. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) forbids you from renting land for share of its produce and he said: If anyone if not in need of his land he should lend it to his brother or leave it. Abu Dawud said: Shu'bah and Mufaddal b. Muhalhal have narrated it from Mansur in similar way. Shu'bah said (in his version): Usaid, nephew of Rafi' b, Khadij
23.hi: Hazrat Usaid bin Zuhair bayaan karte hain: Rafi' bin Khadij humaare paas aaye aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) tumhein ek aise kaam se mana karte hain jo tumhaare liye faidemand hai; aur Allah aur unke Nabi (ﷺ) ki itaa'at tumhaare liye zyada faidemand hai. Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) tumhein zameen ko iski paidaawar ke hisse ke liye kiraye par dene se mana karte hain aur unhone kaha: Agar kisi ko apni zameen ki zaroorat na ho, to use apne bhai ko udhaar deni chaahiye ya use chhod deni chaahiye. Abu Dawud kehte hain: Shu'bah aur Mufaddal bin Muhalhal ne bhi isi tarah Mansur se riwayat ki hai. Shu'bah ne (apne version mein) kaha: Usaid, Rafi' bin Khadij ke bhatije.

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ الْخَطْمِيُّ، قَالَ بَعَثَنِي عَمِّي أَنَا وَغُلاَمًا، لَهُ إِلَى سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ قَالَ فَقُلْنَا لَهُ شَىْءٌ بَلَغَنَا عَنْكَ فِي الْمُزَارَعَةِ ‏.‏ قَالَ كَانَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ لاَ يَرَى بِهَا بَأْسًا حَتَّى بَلَغَهُ عَنْ رَافِعِ بْنِ خَدِيجٍ حَدِيثٌ فَأَتَاهُ فَأَخْبَرَهُ رَافِعٌ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَتَى بَنِي حَارِثَةَ فَرَأَى زَرْعًا فِي أَرْضِ ظُهَيْرٍ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَا أَحْسَنَ زَرْعَ ظُهَيْرٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا لَيْسَ لِظُهَيْرٍ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَلَيْسَ أَرْضُ ظُهَيْرٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا بَلَى وَلَكِنَّهُ زَرْعُ فُلاَنٍ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَخُذُوا زَرْعَكُمْ وَرُدُّوا عَلَيْهِ النَّفَقَةَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ رَافِعٌ فَأَخَذْنَا زَرْعَنَا وَرَدَدْنَا إِلَيْهِ النَّفَقَةَ ‏.‏ قَالَ سَعِيدٌ أَفْقِرْ أَخَاكَ أَوْ أَكْرِهِ بِالدَّرَاهِمِ ‏.‏
23.en: AbuJa'far al-Khatmi said:My uncle sent me and his slave to Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab. We said to him, there is something which has reached us about sharecropping. He replied: Ibn Umar did not see any harm in it until a tradition reached him from Rafi' ibn Khadij. He then came to him and Rafi' told him that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came to Banu Harithah and saw crop in the land of Zuhayr. He said: What an excellent crop of Zuhayr is! They said: It does not belong to Zuhayr. He asked: Is this not the land of Zuhayr? They said: Yes, but the crop belongs to so-and-so. He said: Take your crop and give him the wages. Rafi' said: We took our crop and gave him the wages. Sa'id (ibn al-Musayyab) said: Lend your brother or employ him for dirhams
23.hi: Hazrat Abu Ja'far al-Khatmi bayaan karte hain: Mere chacha ne mujhe aur apne ghulam ko Sa'id bin al-Musayyab ke paas bheja. Humne unse kaha: Humme sharecropping ke baare mein kuch khabar pahunchi hai. Unhone jawaab diya: Ibn Umar ko isme koi harj nazar nahi aaya jab tak unhein Rafi' bin Khadij se ek riwayat nahi mili. Fir woh unke paas aaye aur Rafi' ne unhein bataaya ke Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) Banu Harithah ke paas aaye aur Zuhayr ki zameen mein fasal dekhi. Aapne kaha: Zuhayr ki fasal kitni khoob hai! Unhone (logon ne) kaha: Yeh Zuhayr ki nahi hai. Aapne poocha: Kya yeh Zuhayr ki zameen nahi hai? Unhone kaha: Ji haan, lekin fasal fulan ki hai. Aapne kaha: Apni fasal lo aur unhein mazdoori do. Rafi' ne kaha: Humne apni fasal li aur unhein mazdoori di. Sa'id (bin al-Musayyab) ne kaha: Apne bhai ko (zameen) udhaar do ya use dirham ke liye rakh lo.

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الأَحْوَصِ، حَدَّثَنَا طَارِقُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ رَافِعِ بْنِ خَدِيجٍ، قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الْمُحَاقَلَةِ وَالْمُزَابَنَةِ وَقَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّمَا يَزْرَعُ ثَلاَثَةٌ رَجُلٌ لَهُ أَرْضٌ فَهُوَ يَزْرَعُهَا وَرَجُلٌ مُنِحَ أَرْضًا فَهُوَ يَزْرَعُ مَا مُنِحَ وَرَجُلٌ اسْتَكْرَى أَرْضًا بِذَهَبٍ أَوْ فِضَّةٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
23.en: Narrated Rafi' ibn Khadij: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) forbade muhaqalah and muzabanah. Those who cultivate land are three: a man who has (his own) land and he tills it: a man who has been lent land and he tills the one lent to him; a man who employs another man to till land against gold (dinars) or silver (dirhams)
23.hi: Hazrat Rafi' bin Khadij bayaan karte hain: Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne muhaqalah aur muzabanah se mana kiya. Zameen par kheti karne wale teen tarah ke hote hain: ek aadmi jiske paas (apni) zameen hai aur woh isper kheti karta hai; ek aadmi jise zameen udhaar di gayi hai aur woh isper kheti karta hai jo usse udhaar mili hai; aur ek aadmi jo doosre aadmi ko zameen par kheti karne ke liye sona (dinar) ya chandi (dirham) ke liye rakhta hai.

23.ar: قَالَ أَبُو دَاوُدَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى سَعِيدِ بْنِ يَعْقُوبَ الطَّالْقَانِيِّ قُلْتُ لَهُ حَدَّثَكُمُ ابْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ أَبِي شُجَاعٍ، حَدَّثَنِي عُثْمَانُ بْنُ سَهْلِ بْنِ رَافِعِ بْنِ خَدِيجٍ، قَالَ إِنِّي لَيَتِيمٌ فِي حِجْرِ رَافِعِ بْنِ خَدِيجٍ وَحَجَجْتُ مَعَهُ فَجَاءَهُ أَخِي عِمْرَانُ بْنُ سَهْلٍ فَقَالَ أَكْرَيْنَا أَرْضَنَا فُلاَنَةَ بِمِائَتَىْ دِرْهَمٍ فَقَالَ دَعْهُ فَإِنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنْ كِرَاءِ الأَرْضِ ‏.‏
23.en: Abu Dawud said:I read out (this tradition) to Sa'id b. Ya'qub al-Taliqini, and I said to him: Ibn al-Mubarak transmitted (this tradition) to you from Sa'id Abi Shuja' who said: 'Uthman b. Sahl b. Rafi' b. Khadij narrated it to me saying: I was an orphan being nourished under the guardianship of Rafi' b. Khadij and I performed Hajj with him. My brother 'Imran b. Sahl then came to me and said: We rented out land to so-and-so for two hundred dirhams. He said: Leave it, for the Prophet (ﷺ) forbade renting land
23.hi: Abu Dawud kehte hain: Maine (yeh riwayat) Sa'id bin Ya'qub al-Taliqini ko padh kar sunaayi, aur maine unse kaha: Ibn al-Mubarak ne (yeh riwayat) aapko Sa'id Abi Shuja' se bataayi jinhone kaha: Uthman bin Sahl bin Rafi' bin Khadij ne mujhe yeh riwayat ki, kehte hue: Main ek yateem tha jise Rafi' bin Khadij ki sarparasti mein paala gaya, aur maine unke saath Hajj kiya. Mera bhai Imran bin Sahl fir mere paas aaya aur kaha: Humne fulan ko do sau dirham mein zameen kiraye par di. Unhone kaha: Isse chhod do, kyunki Nabi (ﷺ) ne zameen kiraye par dene se mana kiya.

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا الْفَضْلُ بْنُ دُكَيْنٍ، حَدَّثَنَا بُكَيْرٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عَامِرٍ - عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نُعْمٍ، حَدَّثَنِي رَافِعُ بْنُ خَدِيجٍ، أَنَّهُ زَرَعَ أَرْضًا فَمَرَّ بِهِ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُوَ يَسْقِيهَا فَسَأَلَهُ ‏"‏ لِمَنِ الزَّرْعُ وَلِمَنِ الأَرْضُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ زَرْعِي بِبَذْرِي وَعَمَلِي لِيَ الشَّطْرُ وَلِبَنِي فُلاَنٍ الشَّطْرُ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَرْبَيْتُمَا فَرُدَّ الأَرْضَ عَلَى أَهْلِهَا وَخُذْ نَفَقَتَكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
23.en: Narrated Rafi' ibn Khadij: Rafi' had cultivated a land. The Prophet (ﷺ) passed him when he was watering it. So he asked him: To whom does the crop belong, and to whom does the land belong? He replied: The crop is mine for my seed and labour. The half (of the crop) is mine and the half for so-and-so. He said: You conducted usurious transaction. Return the land to its owner and take your wages and cost
23.hi: Hazrat Rafi' bin Khadij bayaan karte hain: Rafi' ne ek zameen mein kheti ki thi. Nabi (ﷺ) unke paas se guzre jab woh isse paani de rahe the. So aapne poocha: Fasal kiski hai, aur zameen kiski hai? Unhone jawaab diya: Fasal meri hai apne beej aur mehnat ke liye. Aadha (fasal ka) mera hai aur aadha fulan ka. Aapne kaha: Tumne sood ka mu'aamla kiya. Zameen uske maalik ko wapas do aur apni mazdoori aur laagat le lo.

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، عَنْ رَافِعِ بْنِ خَدِيجٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنْ زَرَعَ فِي أَرْضِ قَوْمٍ بِغَيْرِ إِذْنِهِمْ فَلَيْسَ لَهُ مِنَ الزَّرْعِ شَىْءٌ وَلَهُ نَفَقَتُهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
23.en: Narrated Rafi' ibn Khadij: The Prophet (ﷺ) said: If anyone sows in other people's land without their permission, he has no right to any of the crop, but he may have what it cost him
23.hi: Hazrat Rafi' bin Khadij bayaan karte hain: Nabi (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Agar koi doosre logon ki zameen mein unki ijazat ke bagair beej boye, unhein fasal mein koi haq nahi, lekin unhein woh mil sakta hai jo isme unhein kharcha hua.

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ حَنْبَلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، أَنَّ حَمَّادًا، وَعَبْدَ الْوَارِثِ، حَدَّثَاهُمْ كُلُّهُمْ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، - قَالَ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، وَسَعِيدِ بْنِ مِينَاءَ، ثُمَّ اتَّفَقُوا - عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الْمُحَاقَلَةِ وَالْمُزَابَنَةِ وَالْمُخَابَرَةِ وَالْمُعَاوَمَةِ - قَالَ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ وَقَالَ أَحَدُهُمَا وَالْمُعَاوَمَةِ وَقَالَ الآخَرُ بَيْعِ السِّنِينَ ثُمَّ اتَّفَقُوا - وَعَنِ الثُّنْيَا وَرَخَّصَ فِي الْعَرَايَا ‏.‏
23.en: Narrated Jabir b. 'Abd Allah :The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) forbade muhaqalah, muzabanah, mukhabarah, and mu'awanah. One of the two narrators from Hammad said the word mu'awamah, and other said: "selling many years ahead". The agreed version then goes: and thunya, but gave license for 'araya
23.hi: Hazrat Jabir bin Abdullah bayaan karte hain: Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne muhaqalah, muzabanah, mukhabarah, aur mu'awanah se mana kiya. Hammad se do raawiyoun mein se ek ne lafz 'mu'awamah' kaha, aur doosre ne kaha: 'Kai saal aage bechna.' Fir sahmat version kehta hai: aur thunya, lekin araya ki ijazat di.

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَفْصٍ، عُمَرُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ السَّيَّارِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا عَبَّادُ بْنُ الْعَوَّامِ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ بْنِ حُسَيْنٍ، عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الْمُزَابَنَةِ وَالْمُحَاقَلَةِ وَعَنِ الثُّنْيَا إِلاَّ أَنْ يُعْلَمَ ‏.‏
23.en: Narrated Jabir b. 'Abd Allah :The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) forbade muzabanah, muhaqalah and thunya except it is known
23.hi: Hazrat Jabir bin Abdullah bayaan karte hain: Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne muzabanah, muhaqalah, aur thunya se mana kiya siwaye iske ke yeh maaruf ho.

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ مَعِينٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ رَجَاءٍ، - يَعْنِي الْمَكِّيَّ - قَالَ ابْنُ خُثَيْمٍ حَدَّثَنِي عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ مَنْ لَمْ يَذَرِ الْمُخَابَرَةَ فَلْيَأْذَنْ بِحَرْبٍ مِنَ اللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
23.en: Narrated Jabir b. 'Abd Allah :I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say: If any of you does not leave mukhabarah, he should take notice of war from Allah and His Apostle (ﷺ)
23.hi: Hazrat Jabir bin Abdullah bayaan karte hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ko yeh kehte suna: Agar tum mein se koi mukhabarah nahi chhodta, use Allah aur uske Rasool (ﷺ) ki taraf se jung ka notice le lena chaahiye.

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ بُرْقَانَ، عَنْ ثَابِتِ بْنِ الْحَجَّاجِ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ، قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الْمُخَابَرَةِ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ وَمَا الْمُخَابَرَةُ قَالَ أَنْ تَأْخُذَ الأَرْضَ بِنِصْفٍ أَوْ ثُلُثٍ أَوْ رُبُعٍ ‏.‏
23.en: Narrated Zaid b. Thabit:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) forbade mukhabarah. I asked: What is mukhabarah ? He replied: That you have the land (for cultivation) for half, a third, or a quarter (of the produce)
23.hi: Hazrat Zaid bin Thabit bayaan karte hain: Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne mukhabarah se mana kiya. Maine poocha: Mukhabarah kya hai? Unhone jawaab diya: Ke tum zameen (kheti ke liye) aadha, tihai, ya chauthai (paidaawar) ke liye rakho.

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ حَنْبَلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَامَلَ أَهْلَ خَيْبَرَ بِشَطْرِ مَا يَخْرُجُ مِنْ ثَمَرٍ أَوْ زَرْعٍ ‏.‏
23.en: Narrated Ibn 'Umar:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) made an agreement with the people of Khaibar to work and cultivate in return for half of the fruits or produce
23.hi: Hazrat Ibn Umar bayaan karte hain: Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne Khaybar walon se ek muahida kiya ke woh phalon ya paidaawar ke aadhe hisse ke ewaz mein kaam aur kheti karein.

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنِ اللَّيْثِ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ غَنَجٍ - عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم دَفَعَ إِلَى يَهُودِ خَيْبَرَ نَخْلَ خَيْبَرَ وَأَرْضَهَا عَلَى أَنْ يَعْتَمِلُوهَا مِنْ أَمْوَالِهِمْ وَأَنَّ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم شَطْرَ ثَمَرَتِهَا ‏.‏
23.en: Narrated Ibn 'Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) handed over the Jews of Khaibar the palm trees and the land of Khaibar on condition that they should employ what belonged to them in working on them, and that he should have half of the fruits
23.hi: Hazrat Ibn Umar bayaan karte hain: Nabi (ﷺ) ne Khaybar ke Yahoodiyon ko khajoor ke darakht aur Khaybar ki zameen is shart par sonpi ke woh unpar kaam karenge apne (saadhan) istemaal karke, aur ke unhein aadhe phal milenge.

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ الرَّقِّيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ بُرْقَانَ، عَنْ مَيْمُونِ بْنِ مِهْرَانَ، عَنْ مِقْسَمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ افْتَتَحَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَيْبَرَ وَاشْتَرَطَ أَنَّ لَهُ الأَرْضَ وَكُلَّ صَفْرَاءَ وَبَيْضَاءَ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَهْلُ خَيْبَرَ نَحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِالأَرْضِ مِنْكُمْ فَأَعْطِنَاهَا عَلَى أَنَّ لَكُمْ نِصْفَ الثَّمَرَةِ وَلَنَا نِصْفٌ ‏.‏ فَزَعَمَ أَنَّهُ أَعْطَاهُمْ عَلَى ذَلِكَ فَلَمَّا كَانَ حِينَ يُصْرَمُ النَّخْلُ بَعَثَ إِلَيْهِمْ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ رَوَاحَةَ فَحَزَرَ عَلَيْهِمُ النَّخْلَ وَهُوَ الَّذِي يُسَمِّيهِ أَهْلُ الْمَدِينَةِ الْخَرْصَ فَقَالَ فِي ذِهْ كَذَا وَكَذَا قَالُوا أَكْثَرْتَ عَلَيْنَا يَا ابْنَ رَوَاحَةَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ فَأَنَا أَلِي حَزْرَ النَّخْلِ وَأُعْطِيكُمْ نِصْفَ الَّذِي قُلْتُ ‏.‏ قَالُوا هَذَا الْحَقُّ وَبِهِ تَقُومُ السَّمَاءُ وَالأَرْضُ قَدْ رَضِينَا أَنْ نَأْخُذَهُ بِالَّذِي قُلْتَ ‏.‏
23.en: Narrated Ibn 'Abbas:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) conquered Khaibar, and stipulated that all the land, gold and silver would belong to him. The people of Khaibar said: we know the land more than you ; so give it to us on condition that you should have half of the produce and we would have the half. He then gave it to them on that condition. When the time of picking the fruits of the palm-trees came, he sent 'Abd Allah b. Rawahah to them, and he assessed the among of the fruits of the palm-trees. This is what the people of Medina call khars (assessment). He used to say: In these palm-trees there is such-and-such amount (of produce). They would say: You assessed more to us, Ibn Rawahah (than the real amount). He would say: I first take the responsibility of assessing the fruits of the palm-trees and give you half of (the amount) I said. They would say: This is true, and on this (equity) stand the heavens and the earth. We agreed that we should take (the amount which) you said
23.hi: Hazrat Ibn Abbas bayaan karte hain: Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne Khaybar fatah kiya, aur shart lagayi ke saari zameen, sona, aur chandi unki hogi. Khaybar walon ne kaha: Hum zameen tumse zyada jaante hain; so isse humein iss shart par do ke aapko paidaawar ka aadha milega aur humme aadha. Fir aapne isse unhein isi shart par diya. Jab khajoor todne ka waqt aaya, aapne Abdullah bin Rawahah ko unke paas bheja, aur unhone khajoor ke phalon ki miqdaar ka andaaza lagaya. Yehi hai jise Madina walon ke log 'khars' (andaaza) kehte hain. Woh kaha karte the: Un khajoor ke darakhton mein itni-itni miqdaar (paidaawar) hai. Woh (Yahoodi) kehte: Aapne humaare liye zyada andaaza lagaya, Ibn Rawahah (asal miqdaar se). Woh jawaab dete: Main pehle khajoor ke phalon ki miqdaar lagaane ki zimmedaari lunga aur tumhein iska aadha dunga jo maine kaha. Woh kehte: Yeh sach hai, aur isi (insaaf) par aasmaan aur zameen qaayam hain. Humne mana kiya ke hum wahi miqdaar lenge jo tumne kahi.

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَهْلٍ الرَّمْلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا زَيْدُ بْنُ أَبِي الزَّرْقَاءِ، عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ بُرْقَانَ، بِإِسْنَادِهِ وَمَعْنَاهُ قَالَ فَحَزَرَ وَقَالَ عِنْدَ قَوْلِهِ وَكُلَّ صَفْرَاءَ وَبَيْضَاءَ يَعْنِي الذَّهَبَ وَالْفِضَّةَ لَهُ ‏.‏
23.en: The tradition mentioned above has also been narrated by Ja'far b. Burqan through his chain and to the same effect. This version has:He said: He assessed, and after the words of kull safara' wa baida', he said: that is, gold and silver will belong to him
23.hi: Upar zikr ki gayi riwayat Ja'far bin Burqan se bhi unki sanad ke zariye isi tarah riwayat ki gayi hai. Iss version mein hai: Unhone kaha: Unhone andaaza lagaya, aur 'kull safara wa baida' ke alfaaz ke baad, unhone kaha: yaani, sona aur chandi unki hogi.

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ الأَنْبَارِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا كَثِيرٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ هِشَامٍ - عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ بُرْقَانَ، حَدَّثَنَا مَيْمُونٌ، عَنْ مِقْسَمٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم حِينَ افْتَتَحَ خَيْبَرَ فَذَكَرَ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ زَيْدٍ قَالَ فَحَزَرَ النَّخْلَ وَقَالَ فَأَنَا أَلِي جُذَاذَ النَّخْلِ وَأُعْطِيكُمْ نِصْفَ الَّذِي قُلْتُ ‏.‏
23.en: Narrated Miqsam:When the Prophet (ﷺ) conquered Khaibar. He then narrated it like the tradition of Zaid (b. Abu al-Zarqa'). This version has: He then assessed the produce of the palm-trees and said: I take the job of picking the fruit myself, and I shall give you half of (the amount) I said
23.hi: Hazrat Miqsam bayaan karte hain: Jab Nabi (ﷺ) ne Khaybar fatah kiya. Fir unhone isse Zaid (bin Abu al-Zarqa) ki riwayat jaisa riwayat kiya. Iss version mein hai: Fir unhone khajoor ke phalon ki paidaawar ka andaaza lagaya aur kaha: Main khud phal todne ka kaam lunga, aur main tumhein aadha dunga jo maine kaha.

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ مَعِينٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، قَالَ أُخْبِرْتُ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، - رضى الله عنها - قَالَتْ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَبْعَثُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ رَوَاحَةَ فَيَخْرُصُ النَّخْلَ حِينَ يَطِيبُ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُؤْكَلَ مِنْهُ ثُمَّ يُخَيِّرُ يَهُودَ يَأْخُذُونَهُ بِذَلِكَ الْخَرْصِ أَوْ يَدْفَعُونَهُ إِلَيْهِمْ بِذَلِكَ الْخَرْصِ لِكَىْ تُحْصَى الزَّكَاةُ قَبْلَ أَنْ تُؤْكَلَ الثِّمَارُ وَتُفَرَّقَ ‏.‏
23.en: Narrated Aisha, Ummul Mu'minin: The Prophet (ﷺ) used to send Abdullah ibn Rawahah (to Khaybar), and he would assess the amount of dates when they began to ripen before they were eaten (by the Jews). He would then give choice to the Jews that they have them (on their possession) by that assessment or could assign to them (Muslims) by that assignment, so that the (amount of) zakat could be calculated before the fruit became eatable and distributed (among the people)
23.hi: Hazrat Aisha, Ummul-Momineen, bayaan karti hain: Nabi (ﷺ) Abdullah bin Rawahah ko (Khaybar) bhejte the, aur woh khajoor ki miqdaar ka andaaza lagaate jab woh pakna shuru hote isse pehle unhein (Yahoodiyon ko) khaaya jaaye. Fir woh Yahoodiyon ko chuni denge ke woh unhein (apni milkiyat mein) us andaaze par rakhein ya (Musalmanon ko) us andaaze par sonpein, taake zakat ka hisaab phal ke khaane ke laayak aur taqseem hone se pehle lagaya jaa sake.

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي خَلَفٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَابِقٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ طَهْمَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ أَفَاءَ اللَّهُ عَلَى رَسُولِهِ خَيْبَرَ فَأَقَرَّهُمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَمَا كَانُوا وَجَعَلَهَا بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَهُمْ فَبَعَثَ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ رَوَاحَةَ فَخَرَصَهَا عَلَيْهِمْ ‏.‏
23.en: Narrated Jabir ibn Abdullah: When Allah bestowed Khaybar on His Prophet (ﷺ) as fay' (as a result of conquest without fighting), the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) allowed (them) to remain there as they were before, and apportioned it between him and them. He then sent Abdullah ibn Rawahah who assessed (the amount of dates) upon them
23.hi: Hazrat Jabir bin Abdullah bayaan karte hain: Jab Allah ne apne Nabi (ﷺ) ko Khaybar fai' (bagair jung ke fatah) ke tor par diya, Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne unhein wahin rehne diya jaise woh pehle the, aur isse unke aur unke darmiyan taqseem kiya. Fir aapne Abdullah bin Rawahah ko bheja jinhone unpar (khajoor ki miqdaar ka) andaaza lagaaya.

23.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ حَنْبَلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَكْرٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، يَقُولُ خَرَصَهَا ابْنُ رَوَاحَةَ أَرْبَعِينَ أَلْفَ وَسْقٍ وَزَعَمَ أَنَّ الْيَهُودَ لَمَّا خَيَّرَهُمُ ابْنُ رَوَاحَةَ أَخَذُوا الثَّمَرَ وَعَلَيْهِمْ عِشْرُونَ أَلْفَ وَسْقٍ ‏.‏
23.en: Narrated Jabir ibn Abdullah: Ibn Rawahah assessed them (the amount of dates) at forty thousand wasqs, and when Ibn Rawahah gave them option, the Jews took the fruits in their possession and twenty thousand wasqs of dates were due from them
23.hi: Hazrat Jabir bin Abdullah bayaan karte hain: Ibn Rawahah ne unpar (khajoor ki miqdaar) chalees hazaar wasq ka andaaza lagaaya, aur jab Ibn Rawahah ne unhein chunaao diya, Yahoodiyon ne phal apne qabze mein le liye aur unpar bees hazaar wasq khajoor baqaya thi.

24.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، وَحُمَيْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرُّؤَاسِيُّ، عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ بْنِ زِيَادٍ، عَنْ عُبَادَةَ بْنِ نُسَىٍّ، عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ بْنِ ثَعْلَبَةَ، عَنْ عُبَادَةَ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ، قَالَ عَلَّمْتُ نَاسًا مِنْ أَهْلِ الصُّفَّةِ الْكِتَابَ وَالْقُرْآنَ فَأَهْدَى إِلَىَّ رَجُلٌ مِنْهُمْ قَوْسًا فَقُلْتُ لَيْسَتْ بِمَالٍ وَأَرْمِي عَنْهَا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ لآتِيَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلأَسْأَلَنَّهُ فَأَتَيْتُهُ فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ رَجُلٌ أَهْدَى إِلَىَّ قَوْسًا مِمَّنْ كُنْتُ أُعَلِّمُهُ الْكِتَابَ وَالْقُرْآنَ وَلَيْسَتْ بِمَالٍ وَأَرْمِي عَنْهَا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنْ كُنْتَ تُحِبُّ أَنْ تُطَوَّقَ طَوْقًا مِنْ نَارٍ فَاقْبَلْهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
24.en: Narrated Ubaydah ibn as-Samit: I taught some persons of the people of Suffah writing and the Qur'an. A man of them presented to me a bow. I said: It cannot be reckoned property; may I shoot with it in Allah's path? I must come to the Apostle of of Allah (ﷺ) and ask him (about it). So I came to him and said : Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), one of those whom I have been teaching writing and the Qur'an has presented me a bow, and as it cannot be reckoned property, may I shoot with it in Allah's path? He said: If you want to have a necklace of fire on you, accept it
24.hi: Hazrat Ubaydah bin as-Samit bayaan karte hain: Maine Suffah ke kuch logon ko likhna aur Quran sikhaya. Unmein se ek aadmi ne mujhe ek dhanush tohfe mein diya. Maine kaha: Isse jaidad nahi mana jaa sakta; kya main isse Allah ki raah mein teer-andaazi ke liye istemaal karun? Mujhe Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ke paas jaana hoga aur unse (iske baare mein) poochna hoga. So main unke paas gaya aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, jinhein main likhna aur Quran sikhaa raha tha unmein se ek ne mujhe ek dhanush tohfe mein diya hai, aur chunki isse jaidad nahi maana jaa sakta, kya main isse Allah ki raah mein teer-andaazi ke liye istemaal kar sakta hoon? Aapne kaha: Agar tumhein apni gardan mein aag ka haar chaahiye, isse qabool karo.

24.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عُثْمَانَ، وَكَثِيرُ بْنُ عُبَيْدٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا بَقِيَّةُ، حَدَّثَنِي بِشْرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، قَالَ عَمْرٌو حَدَّثَنِي عُبَادَةُ بْنُ نُسَىٍّ، عَنْ جُنَادَةَ بْنِ أَبِي أُمَيَّةَ، عَنْ عُبَادَةَ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ، نَحْوَ هَذَا الْخَبَرِ - وَالأَوَّلُ أَتَمُّ - فَقُلْتُ مَا تَرَى فِيهَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ جَمْرَةٌ بَيْنَ كَتِفَيْكَ تَقَلَّدْتَهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ أَوْ ‏"‏ تَعَلَّقْتَهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
24.en: A similar tradition has also been transmitted by 'Ubadah b. al-Samit through a different chain of narrators, but the former tradition is more perfect. This version has:I said: What do you think about it, Messenger of Allah? He said: A live coal between your shoulders which you have put around your neck or hanged it
24.hi: Isi jaisi riwayat Ubadah bin as-Samit se ek doosri sanad se bhi riwayat ki gayi hai, lekin pehli riwayat zyada mukammal hai. Iss version mein hai: Maine kaha: Aapko iske baare mein kya khayal hai, Allah ke Rasool? Aapne kaha: Ek jalta hua koyla tumhaare kandhon ke beech jo tumne apni gardan mein daala hai ya jise tumne latkaya hai.

24.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي بِشْرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الْمُتَوَكِّلِ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، أَنَّ رَهْطًا، مِنْ أَصْحَابِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم انْطَلَقُوا فِي سَفْرَةٍ سَافَرُوهَا فَنَزَلُوا بِحَىٍّ مِنْ أَحْيَاءِ الْعَرَبِ فَاسْتَضَافُوهُمْ فَأَبَوْا أَنْ يُضَيِّفُوهُمْ - قَالَ - فَلُدِغَ سَيِّدُ ذَلِكَ الْحَىِّ فَشَفَوْا لَهُ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ لاَ يَنْفَعُهُ شَىْءٌ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ لَوْ أَتَيْتُمْ هَؤُلاَءِ الرَّهْطَ الَّذِينَ نَزَلُوا بِكُمْ لَعَلَّ أَنْ يَكُونَ عِنْدَ بَعْضِهِمْ شَىْءٌ يَنْفَعُ صَاحِبَكُمْ فَقَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ إِنَّ سَيِّدَنَا لُدِغَ فَشَفَيْنَا لَهُ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ فَلاَ يَنْفَعُهُ شَىْءٌ فَهَلْ عِنْدَ أَحَدٍ مِنْكُمْ شَىْءٌ يَشْفِي صَاحِبَنَا يَعْنِي رُقْيَةً ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الْقَوْمِ إِنِّي لأَرْقِي وَلَكِنِ اسْتَضَفْنَاكُمْ فَأَبَيْتُمْ أَنْ تُضَيِّفُونَا مَا أَنَا بِرَاقٍ حَتَّى تَجْعَلُوا لِي جُعْلاً ‏.‏ فَجَعَلُوا لَهُ قَطِيعًا مِنَ الشَّاءِ فَأَتَاهُ فَقَرَأَ عَلَيْهِ بِأُمِّ الْكِتَابِ وَيَتْفُلُ حَتَّى بَرِئَ كَأَنَّمَا أُنْشِطَ مِنْ عِقَالٍ فَأَوْفَاهُمْ جُعْلَهُمُ الَّذِي صَالَحُوهُ عَلَيْهِ ‏.‏ فَقَالُوا اقْتَسِمُوا فَقَالَ الَّذِي رَقَى لاَ تَفْعَلُوا حَتَّى نَأْتِيَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَنَسْتَأْمِرَهُ ‏.‏ فَغَدَوْا عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَذَكَرُوا لَهُ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مِنْ أَيْنَ عَلِمْتُمْ أَنَّهَا رُقْيَةٌ أَحْسَنْتُمْ وَاضْرِبُوا لِي مَعَكُمْ بِسَهْمٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
24.en: Narrated Abu Sa’id Al Khudri :Some of the Companions of Prophet (ﷺ) went on a journey. They encamped with a clan of the Arabs and sought hospitality from them, but they refused to provide them with any hospitality. The chief of the clan was stung by a scorpion or bitten by a snake. They gave him all sorts of treatment, but nothing gave him relied. One of them said: Would that you had gone to those people who encamped with you ; some of them might have something which could give you relief to your companion. (So they went and) one of them said: Our chief has been stung by a scorpion or bitten by a snake. We administered all sorts of medicine but nothing gave him relief. Has any of you anything, i.e. charm, which gives healing to our companion. One of those people said: I shall apply charm; we sought hospitality from you, but you refused to entertain us. I am not going to apply charm until you give me some wages. So they offered them a number of sheep. He then came to and recited Faithat-al-Kitab and spat until he was cured as if he were set free from a bond. Thereafter they made payment of the wages as agreed by them. They said: Apportion (the wages). The man who applied the charm said: Do not do until we come to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and consult him. So they came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) next morning and mentioned it to him. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: From where did you learn that it was a charm ? You have done right. Give me a share along with you
24.hi: Hazrat Abu Sa'eed al-Khudri bayaan karte hain: Nabi (ﷺ) ke kuch sahaba ek safar par gaye. Unhone Arab ke ek qabeele ke saath padaao daala aur unse mehmaan-nawaazi maangi, lekin unhone koi bhi mehmaan-nawaazi dene se inkaar kiya. Qabeele ke sardaar ko bichhu ne kaata ya saanp ne kaata. Unhone har tarah ka ilaaj kiya, lekin unhein koi aaraam na mila. Unmein se ek ne kaha: Kaash tum un logon ke paas jaate jo tumhaare saath padaao daale hain; unmein se kisi ke paas kuch ho sakta hai jo tumhaare saathi ko aaraam de sake. (So woh gaye aur) unmein se ek ne kaha: Humaare sardaar ko bichhu ne kaata hai ya saanp ne kaata hai. Humne har tarah ki dawa di lekin unhein koi aaraam na mila. Kya tum mein se kisi ke paas kuch hai, yaani, koi jhaad-phoonk, jo humaare saathi ko theek kar de? Un logon mein se ek ne kaha: Main jhaad-phoonk karunga; humne tumse mehmaan-nawaazi maangi thi, lekin tumne humaari mehmaan-nawaazi karne se inkaar kiya. Main tab tak jhaad-phoonk nahi karunga jab tak tum mujhe kuch mazdoori na do. So unhone unhein kuch bakriyaan pesh kin. Fir woh (unke paas) aaye aur Fatihat-al-Kitab padhi aur thooke (jhaad-phoonk karte hue) yahan tak ke woh theek ho gaye, jaise woh kisi bandhan se azaad ho gaye ho. Fir unhone jitni mazdoori tay hui thi woh ada ki. Unhone (mehmaan-nawaazi na dene walon ne) kaha: Ise (mazdoori ko) taqseem karo. Jhaad-phoonk karne wale aadmi ne kaha: Aisa mat karo jab tak hum Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ke paas na jaayein aur unse mashwara na lein. So woh agli subah Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ke paas aaye aur unhein yeh bataaya. Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne poocha: Tumhein kaise pata chala ke yeh ek jhaad-phoonk tha? Tumne sahi kiya. Mujhe bhi tumhaare saath ek hissa do.

24.ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، أَخْبَرَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ حَسَّانَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِيرِينَ، عَنْ أَخِيهِ، مَعْبَدِ بْنِ سِيرِينَ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِهَذَا الْحَدِيثِ ‏.‏
24.en: This tradition has also been transmitted by Abu Sa'id al-Khudri form the Prophet (ﷺ)
24.hi: Isi jaisi riwayat Abu Sa'eed al-Khudri se, Nabi (ﷺ) se bhi riwayat ki gayi hai.

24.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي السَّفَرِ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنْ خَارِجَةَ بْنِ الصَّلْتِ، عَنْ عَمِّهِ، أَنَّهُ مَرَّ بِقَوْمٍ فَأَتَوْهُ فَقَالُوا إِنَّكَ جِئْتَ مِنْ عِنْدِ هَذَا الرَّجُلِ بِخَيْرٍ فَارْقِ لَنَا هَذَا الرَّجُلَ ‏.‏ فَأَتَوْهُ بِرَجُلٍ مَعْتُوهٍ فِي الْقُيُودِ فَرَقَاهُ بِأُمِّ الْقُرْآنِ ثَلاَثَةَ أَيَّامٍ غُدْوَةً وَعَشِيَّةً كُلَّمَا خَتَمَهَا جَمَعَ بُزَاقَهُ ثُمَّ تَفَلَ فَكَأَنَّمَا أُنْشِطَ مِنْ عِقَالٍ فَأَعْطُوهُ شَيْئًا فَأَتَى النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَذَكَرَهُ لَهُ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ كُلْ فَلَعَمْرِي لَمَنْ أَكَلَ بِرُقْيَةٍ بَاطِلٍ لَقَدْ أَكَلْتَ بِرُقْيَةٍ حَقٍّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
24.en: Kharijah b. al-Salt quoted his paternal uncle as saying that he passed by a clan (of the Arab) who came to him and said:You have brought what is good from this man. Then they brought a lunatic in chains. He recited Surat al-Fatihah over him three days, morning and evening. When he finished, he collected his saliva and then spat it out, (he felt relief) as if he were set free from a bond. They gave him something (as wages). He then came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and mentioned it to him. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Accept it, for by my life, some accept it for a worthless charm, but you have done so far a genuine one
24.hi: Kharijah bin al-Salt apne chacha ke hawale se bataate hain ke woh ek qabeele (Arab ke) ke paas se guzre jo unke paas aaye aur kaha: Tum iss aadmi se kuch achha lekar aaye ho. Fir woh ek paagal aadmi ko zanjeer mein baandhkar laaye. Unhone unpar teen din, subah aur shaam, Surah al-Fatihah padhi. Jab unhone khatam kiya, unhone apni lar (thook) ikattha ki aur fir usse thook diya, (aisa mehsoos hua) jaise woh kisi bandhan se azaad ho gaye ho. Unhone unhein kuch diya (mazdoori ke tor par). Fir woh Nabi (ﷺ) ke paas aaye aur unhein yeh bataaya. Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne kaha: Isse qabool karo, kyunki, meri jaan ki qasam, kuch log ise bekaar jhaad-phoonk ke liye qabool karte hain, lekin tumne isse ek sahi jhaad-phoonk ke liye kiya hai.

24.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبَانُ، عَنْ يَحْيَى، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ قَارِظٍ - عَنِ السَّائِبِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، عَنْ رَافِعِ بْنِ خَدِيجٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ كَسْبُ الْحَجَّامِ خَبِيثٌ وَثَمَنُ الْكَلْبِ خَبِيثٌ وَمَهْرُ الْبَغِيِّ خَبِيثٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
24.en: Narrated Rafi' ibn Khadij: The Prophet (ﷺ) said: The earnings of a cupper are impure, the price paid for a dog is impure, and the hire paid to a prostitute is impure
24.hi: Hazrat Rafi' bin Khadij bayaan karte hain: Nabi (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Hijaama karne wale ki kamaai napaak hai, kutte ke liye di gayi qeemat napaak hai, aur ek badkaar aurat ko di gayi mazdoori napaak hai.

24.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ الْقَعْنَبِيُّ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ مُحَيِّصَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّهُ اسْتَأْذَنَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي إِجَارَةِ الْحَجَّامِ فَنَهَاهُ عَنْهَا فَلَمْ يَزَلْ يَسْأَلُهُ وَيَسْتَأْذِنُهُ حَتَّى أَمَرَهُ أَنِ اعْلِفْهُ نَاضِحَكَ وَرَقِيقَكَ ‏.‏
24.en: Narrated Muhayyisah ibn Ka'b: Muhayyisah asked permission of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) regarding hire of the cupper, but he forbade him. He kept on asking his permission, and at last he said to him: Feed your watering camel with it and feed your slave with it
24.hi: Hazrat Muhayyisah bin Ka'b bayaan karte hain: Muhayyisah ne Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) se hijaama karne wale ki mazdoori ke baare mein ijazat maangi, lekin unhone unhein mana kiya. Woh baar-baar ijazat maangte rahe, aur aakhir mein aapne unse kaha: Isse apni paani laane wali oont ko khilaao aur apne ghulam ko khilaao.

24.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ احْتَجَمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَعْطَى الْحَجَّامَ أَجْرَهُ وَلَوْ عَلِمَهُ خَبِيثًا لَمْ يُعْطِهِ ‏.‏
24.en: Narrated Ibn 'Abbas:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) got him self cupped and gave the cupper his wages. Had he considered it impure, he would not have given it (wage) to him
24.hi: Hazrat Ibn Abbas bayaan karte hain: Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne khud hijaama karwaaya aur hijaama karne wale ko unki mazdoori di. Agar aap isse napaak samajhte, aap unhein (mazdoori) na dete.

24.ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْقَعْنَبِيُّ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ الطَّوِيلِ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ حَجَمَ أَبُو طَيْبَةَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَمَرَ لَهُ بِصَاعٍ مِنْ تَمْرٍ وَأَمَرَ أَهْلَهُ أَنْ يُخَفِّفُوا عَنْهُ مِنْ خَرَاجِهِ ‏.‏
24.en: Narrated Anas b. Malik :That Abu Tibah cupped the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and he ordered that a sa' of dates be given to him, also ordering his people to remit some of his dues
24.hi: Hazrat Anas bin Malik bayaan karte hain: Abu Tibah ne Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ka hijaama kiya, aur aapne hukum diya ke unhein ek sa' khajoor di jaaye, aur unke maalikon ko hukum diya ke woh unse kuch qarz maaf kar dein.

24.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ جُحَادَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا حَازِمٍ، سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ كَسْبِ الإِمَاءِ ‏.‏
24.en: Narrated Abu Hurairah:That the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) forbade earnings of slave-girls
24.hi: Hazrat Abu Hurairah bayaan karte hain: Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne laundiyon ki kamaai se mana kiya.

24.ar: حَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا هَاشِمُ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ، حَدَّثَنَا عِكْرِمَةُ، حَدَّثَنِي طَارِقُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْقُرَشِيُّ، قَالَ جَاءَ رَافِعُ بْنُ رِفَاعَةَ إِلَى مَجْلِسِ الأَنْصَارِ فَقَالَ لَقَدْ نَهَانَا نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْيَوْمَ فَذَكَرَ أَشْيَاءَ وَنَهَانَا عَنْ كَسْبِ الأَمَةِ إِلاَّ مَا عَمِلَتْ بِيَدِهَا ‏.‏ وَقَالَ هَكَذَا بِأَصَابِعِهِ نَحْوَ الْخَبْزِ وَالْغَزْلِ وَالنَّفْشِ ‏.‏
24.en: Narrated Tariq ibn AbdurRahman al-Qarash: Rafi' ibn Rifa'ah came to a meeting of the Ansar and said: The Prophet of Allah (ﷺ) forbade us (from some things) today, and he mentioned some things. He forbade the earning of a slave-girl except what she earned with her hand. He indicated (some things) with his fingers such as baking, spinning, and ginning
24.hi: Hazrat Tariq bin Abdur Rahman al-Qarash bayaan karte hain: Rafi' bin Rifa'ah Ansar ki ek majlis mein aaye aur kaha: Nabi (ﷺ) ne aaj humein (kuch cheezon se) mana kiya, aur unhone kuch cheezon ka zikr kiya. Aapne laundi ki kamaai se mana kiya siwaye us cheez ke jo usne apne haath se kamaai. Aapne apni ungliyon se (kuch cheezon ki taraf) ishara kiya jaise roti pakana, sut kaatna, aur ruii saaf karna.

24.ar: حَدَّثَنِي أَحْمَدُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي فُدَيْكٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ هُرَيْرٍ - عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ، رَافِعٍ - هُوَ ابْنُ خَدِيجٍ - قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ كَسْبِ الأَمَةِ حَتَّى يُعْلَمَ مِنْ أَيْنَ هُوَ ‏.‏
24.en: Narrated Rafi' b. Khadij:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) forbade earnings of a slave-girl unless it is known from where it came
24.hi: Hazrat Rafi' bin Khadij bayaan karte hain: Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne laundi ki kamaai se mana kiya jab tak yeh maaloom na ho ke yeh kahan se aayi.

24.ar: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِي مَسْعُودٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ نَهَى عَنْ ثَمَنِ الْكَلْبِ وَمَهْرِ الْبَغِيِّ وَحُلْوَانِ الْكَاهِنِ ‏.‏
24.en: Narrated AbuMas'ud: The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade the price paid for a dog, the hire paid to a prostitute, and the gift given to a soothsayer
24.hi: Hazrat Abu Mas'ud bayaan karte hain: Nabi (ﷺ) ne kutte ke liye di gayi qeemat, badkaar aurat ko di gayi mazdoori, aur jyotishi ko diya gaya tohfa se mana kiya.

24.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدُ بْنُ مُسَرْهَدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ عَسْبِ الْفَحْلِ ‏.‏
24.en: Narrated Abdullah ibn Umar: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) forbade (taking hire for) a stallion's covering
24.hi: Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar bayaan karte hain: Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne (nar jaanwar ki) sansargen ki mazdoori lene se mana kiya.

24.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ، عَنِ الْعَلاَءِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِي مَاجِدَةَ، قَالَ قَطَعْتُ مِنْ أُذُنِ غُلاَمٍ - أَوْ قُطِعَ مِنْ أُذُنِي - فَقَدِمَ عَلَيْنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ حَاجًّا فَاجْتَمَعْنَا إِلَيْهِ فَرَفَعَنَا إِلَى عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ فَقَالَ عُمَرُ إِنَّ هَذَا قَدْ بَلَغَ الْقِصَاصَ ادْعُوا لِي حَجَّامًا لِيَقْتَصَّ مِنْهُ فَلَمَّا دُعِيَ الْحَجَّامُ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ إِنِّي وَهَبْتُ لِخَالَتِي غُلاَمًا وَأَنَا أَرْجُو أَنْ يُبَارَكَ لَهَا فِيهِ فَقُلْتُ لَهَا لاَ تُسَلِّمِيهِ حَجَّامًا وَلاَ صَائِغًا وَلاَ قَصَّابًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو دَاوُدَ رَوَى عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى عَنِ ابْنِ إِسْحَاقَ قَالَ ابْنُ مَاجِدَةَ رَجُلٌ مِنْ بَنِي سَهْمٍ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ ‏.‏
24.en: AbuMajidah said:I cut the ear of a boy, or he cut my ear (the narrator is doubtful). AbuBakr then came to us to perform hajj and we got together with him. But he referred us to Umar ibn al-Khattab. Umar (ibn al-Khattab) said: This reached the extent of retaliation. Call a cupper to me so that he may retaliate. When the cupper was called, he (Umar) said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say: I gave a boy to my maternal aunt, and I hope that she will be blessed in respect of him. I said to her: Do not entrust him to a supper, nor to a goldsmith, nor to a butcher. Abu Dawud said: This tradition has also been transmitted by 'Abd al-A'la from Ibn Ishaq who said: Abu Majidah is a man of Banu Sahm narrating from 'Umar b. al-Khattab
24.hi: Abu Majidah kehte hain: Maine ek ladke ka kaan kaata, ya usne mera kaan kaata (raawi ko shak hai). Abu Bakr fir Hajj karne humaare paas aaye aur hum unse mile. Lekin unhone humein Umar bin Khattab ke paas bheja. Umar (bin Khattab) ne kaha: Yeh badla lene ki hadd tak pahunch gaya hai. Mere liye ek hijaama karne wale ko bulaao taake woh badla le sake. Jab hijaama karne wale ko bulaaya gaya, unhone (Umar ne) kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ko yeh kehte suna: Maine ek ladka apni khaala ko diya, aur mujhe ummeed hai ke unhein iske zariye barkat milegi. Maine unse kaha: Ise kisi hijaama karne wale ke, na kisi sunaar ke, na kisi qassab ke supurd mat karo. Abu Dawud kehte hain: Yeh riwayat Abd al-A'la ne bhi Ibn Ishaq se riwayat ki hai jinhone kaha: Abu Majidah Banu Sahm ka ek aadmi hai jo Umar bin Khattab se riwayat karta hai.

24.ar: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ بْنُ مُوسَى، حَدَّثَنَا سَلَمَةُ بْنُ الْفَضْلِ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ إِسْحَاقَ، عَنِ الْعَلاَءِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْحُرَقِيُّ، عَنِ ابْنِ مَاجِدَةَ السَّهْمِيِّ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَحْوَهُ ‏.‏
24.en: A similar tradition has also been transmitted by Abu Majidah al-Sahmi from 'Umar b. al-Khattab through a different chain of narrators
24.hi: Isi jaisi riwayat Abu Majidah al-Sahmi se, Umar bin Khattab se, ek doosri sanad se bhi riwayat ki gayi hai.

24.ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْفَضْلُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ، حَدَّثَنَا الْعَلاَءُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْحُرَقِيُّ، عَنِ ابْنِ مَاجِدَةَ السَّهْمِيِّ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ، - رضى الله عنه - عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
24.en: Abu Majidah quoted 'Umar b. al-Khattab as saying:I heard the Prophet (ﷺ) say ... narrating the tradition to the same effect
24.hi: Abu Majidah, Umar bin Khattab ke hawale se, kehte hain: Maine Nabi (ﷺ) ko yeh kehte suna... aur unhone baaqi riwayat bayaan ki.

24.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ حَنْبَلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنْ بَاعَ عَبْدًا وَلَهُ مَالٌ فَمَالُهُ لِلْبَائِعِ إِلاَّ أَنْ يَشْتَرِطَهُ الْمُبْتَاعُ وَمَنْ بَاعَ نَخْلاً مُؤَبَّرًا فَالثَّمَرَةُ لِلْبَائِعِ إِلاَّ أَنْ يَشْتَرِطَ الْمُبْتَاعُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
24.en: Narrated Ibn 'Umar:The Prophet (ﷺ) as saying: If anyone buys a slave who possesses property. his property belongs to the seller unless buyer makes a provision and if anyone buys palm-trees after they have been fecundated, the fruit belongs to the seller unless the buyer make a provision
24.hi: Hazrat Ibn Umar bayaan karte hain: Nabi (ﷺ) ne kaha: Agar koi ghulam khareede jiske paas jaidad ho, uski jaidad bechne wale ki hoti hai jab tak khareedne wala ek shart na lagaaye, aur agar koi khajoor ke darakht unke barwaar hone ke baad khareede, phal bechne wale ka hota hai jab tak khareedne wala ek shart na lagaaye.

24.ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْقَعْنَبِيُّ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ عُمَرَ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِقِصَّةِ الْعَبْدِ وَعَنْ نَافِعٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِقِصَّةِ النَّخْلِ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو دَاوُدَ وَاخْتَلَفَ الزُّهْرِيُّ وَنَافِعٌ فِي أَرْبَعَةِ أَحَادِيثَ هَذَا أَحَدُهَا ‏.‏
24.en: This tradition has also been narrated by 'Umar from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) through a different chain of narrators. It mentions only the sale of the slave. It has also been transmitted by Nafi' on the authority of Ibn 'Umar from the Prophet (ﷺ) indicating only the sale of palm-trees. Abu Dawud said:Al-Zuhri and Nafi' differed among themselves in four traditions. This is one of them
24.hi: Isi jaisi riwayat Umar se, Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) se, ek doosri sanad se bhi riwayat ki gayi hai. Isme sirf ghulam bechne ka zikr hai. Yeh Nafi' ne bhi Ibn Umar se, Nabi (ﷺ) se, sirf khajoor ke darakhton ka zikr karte hue riwayat ki hai. Abu Dawud kehte hain: Al-Zuhri aur Nafi' char riwaayaton mein aapas mein ikhtilaaf rakhte hain. Yeh unmein se ek hai.

24.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، حَدَّثَنِي سَلَمَةُ بْنُ كُهَيْلٍ، حَدَّثَنِي مَنْ، سَمِعَ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنْ بَاعَ عَبْدًا وَلَهُ مَالٌ فَمَالُهُ لِلْبَائِعِ إِلاَّ أَنْ يَشْتَرِطَ الْمُبْتَاعُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
24.en: Narrated Jabir ibn Abdullah: The Prophet (ﷺ) said: If anyone buys a slave who possesses property, his property belongs to the seller unless the buyer makes a proviso
24.hi: Hazrat Jabir bin Abdullah bayaan karte hain: Nabi (ﷺ) ne kaha: Agar koi ghulam khareede jiske paas jaidad ho, uski jaidad bechne wale ki hoti hai jab tak khareedne wala ek shart na lagaaye.

24.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ الْقَعْنَبِيُّ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ يَبِعْ بَعْضُكُمْ عَلَى بَيْعِ بَعْضٍ وَلاَ تَلَقَّوُا السِّلَعَ حَتَّى يُهْبَطَ بِهَا الأَسْوَاقَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
24.en: Narrated 'Abdullah bin 'Umar:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as saying: None of you must buy in opposition to one another ; and do not go out to meet the merchandise, (but one must wait) till it is brought down to the market
24.hi: Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar bayaan karte hain: Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne yeh kehte suna: Tum mein se koi ek-doosre ke muqaable khareedaari na kare; aur baahar jaakar saamaan se mat milo, (balke) intezaar karo jab tak yeh bazaar mein laaya jaaye.

24.ar: حَدَّثَنَا الرَّبِيعُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ أَبُو تَوْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عَمْرٍو الرَّقِّيَّ - عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنِ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنْ تَلَقِّي الْجَلَبِ فَإِنْ تَلَقَّاهُ مُتَلَقٍّ مُشْتَرٍ فَاشْتَرَاهُ فَصَاحِبُ السِّلْعَةِ بِالْخِيَارِ إِذَا وَرَدَتِ السُّوقَ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو عَلِيٍّ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا دَاوُدَ يَقُولُ قَالَ سُفْيَانُ لاَ يَبِعْ بَعْضُكُمْ عَلَى بَيْعِ بَعْضٍ أَنْ يَقُولَ إِنَّ عِنْدِي خَيْرًا مِنْهُ بِعَشْرَةٍ ‏.‏
24.en: Abu Hurairah said:Do not go our to meet what is being brought (to market for sale). If anyone does so and buys some of it, the owner of merchandise has a choice (of canceling the deal) when it comes to the market. Abu 'Ali said: I heard Abu Dawud say: Sufyan said: none of you must buy in opposition to one another ; that is he says: I have a better one for ten (dirhams)
24.hi: Abu Hurairah kehte hain: Baahar jaakar us cheez se mat milo jise (bazaar mein bechne ke liye) laaya jaa raha hai. Agar koi aisa kare aur usme se kuch khareede, saamaan ke maalik ke paas chunaao ka haq hai (sauda radd karne ka) jab yeh bazaar mein pahunche. Abu Ali kehte hain: Maine Abu Dawud ko kehte suna: Sufyan ne kaha: Tum mein se koi ek-doosre ke muqaable khareedaari na kare; yaani, woh kehte hain: Mere paas isse behtar hai das (dirham) mein.

24.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَمْرِو بْنِ السَّرْحِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لاَ تَنَاجَشُوا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
24.en: Narrated Abu Hurairah:The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade to bid against one another
24.hi: Hazrat Abu Hurairah bayaan karte hain: Nabi (ﷺ) ne ek-doosre ke muqaable bhaav badhaakar bolane se mana kiya.

24.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُبَيْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ ثَوْرٍ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ طَاوُسٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ يَبِيعَ حَاضِرٌ لِبَادٍ ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ مَا يَبِيعُ حَاضِرٌ لِبَادٍ قَالَ لاَ يَكُونُ لَهُ سِمْسَارًا ‏.‏
24.en: Narrated Ibn 'Abbas:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) forbade a townsman to sell for a man from the desert. I asked: What do you mean by the selling of a townsman for a man from the desert ? He replied: He should not be a broker for him
24.hi: Hazrat Ibn Abbas bayaan karte hain: Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne ek shehri ko registaan wale ke liye bechne se mana kiya. Maine poocha: Shehri ka registaan wale ke liye bechne ka kya matlab hai? Unhone jawaab diya: Ke woh unke liye dalaal na bane.

24.ar: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، أَنَّ مُحَمَّدَ بْنَ الزِّبْرِقَانَ أَبَا هَمَّامٍ، حَدَّثَهُمْ - قَالَ زُهَيْرٌ وَكَانَ ثِقَةً - عَنْ يُونُسَ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ يَبِيعُ حَاضِرٌ لِبَادٍ وَإِنْ كَانَ أَخَاهُ أَوْ أَبَاهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو دَاوُدَ سَمِعْتُ حَفْصَ بْنَ عُمَرَ يَقُولُ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو هِلاَلٍ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ قَالَ كَانَ يُقَالُ لاَ يَبِيعُ حَاضِرٌ لِبَادٍ ‏.‏ وَهِيَ كَلِمَةٌ جَامِعَةٌ لاَ يَبِيعُ لَهُ شَيْئًا وَلاَ يَبْتَاعُ لَهُ شَيْئًا ‏.‏
24.en: Narrated Anas ibn Malik: The Prophet (ﷺ) said: A townsman must not sell for a man from the desert, even if he is his brother or father. Abu Dawud said: Anas b. Malik said: It was said: A townsman must not sell for a man from the desert. This phrase carries a broad meaning. It means that the (the townsman) must not sell anything for him or buy anything for him
24.hi: Hazrat Anas bin Malik bayaan karte hain: Nabi (ﷺ) ne kaha: Ek shehri ko registaan wale ke liye nahi bechna chaahiye, chahe woh unka bhai ya baap hi kyun na ho. Abu Dawud kehte hain: Anas bin Malik ne kaha: Kaha jaata tha: Ek shehri ko registaan wale ke liye nahi bechna chaahiye. Iss jumle ka matlab wasee hai. Iska matlab hai ke (shehri) unke liye kuch beche nahi ya unke liye kuch khareede nahi.

24.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ الْمَكِّيِّ، أَنَّ أَعْرَابِيًّا، حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّهُ، قَدِمَ بِحَلُوبَةٍ لَهُ عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَنَزَلَ عَلَى طَلْحَةَ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ فَقَالَ إِنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى أَنْ يَبِيعَ حَاضِرٌ لِبَادٍ وَلَكِنِ اذْهَبْ إِلَى السُّوقِ فَانْظُرْ مَنْ يُبَايِعُكَ فَشَاوِرْنِي حَتَّى آمُرَكَ أَوْ أَنْهَاكَ ‏.‏
24.en: Narrated Salim al-Makki: That a bedouin told him that he brought a milch she-camel in the time of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). He alighted with Talhah ibn Ubaydullah (and wanted to sell his milch animal to him). He said: The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade a townsman to sell for a man from the desert. But go to the market and see who buys from you. consult me thereafter, and then I shall ask you (to sell) or forbid you
24.hi: Hazrat Salim al-Makki bayaan karte hain: Ek Bedouin ne unhein bataaya ke woh Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ke zamane mein ek doodh wali oontni le kar aaya. Woh Talhah bin Ubaydullah ke paas utara (aur apna doodh wala jaanwar unhein bechna chaahta tha). Unhone kaha: Nabi (ﷺ) ne shehri ko registaan wale ke liye bechne se mana kiya. Lekin bazaar jao aur dekho tumse kaun khareedta hai. Fir mujhse mashwara lo, aur main tumhein hukum dunga ya rokunga.

24.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ النُّفَيْلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لاَ يَبِعْ حَاضِرٌ لِبَادٍ وَذَرُوا النَّاسَ يَرْزُقِ اللَّهُ بَعْضَهُمْ مِنْ بَعْضٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
24.en: Narrated Jabir: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as saying: A townsman must not sell for a man from the desert ; and leave people alone, Allah will give them provision from one another
24.hi: Hazrat Jabir bayaan karte hain: Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne yeh kehte suna: Ek shehri ko registaan wale ke liye nahi bechna chaahiye; aur logon ko akela chhod do, Allah unhein ek-doosre se rozi dega.

24.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ تَلَقَّوُا الرُّكْبَانَ لِلْبَيْعِ وَلاَ يَبِعْ بَعْضُكُمْ عَلَى بَيْعِ بَعْضٍ وَلاَ تُصَرُّوا الإِبِلَ وَالْغَنَمَ فَمَنِ ابْتَاعَهَا بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ فَهُوَ بِخَيْرِ النَّظَرَيْنِ بَعْدَ أَنْ يَحْلِبَهَا فَإِنْ رَضِيَهَا أَمْسَكَهَا وَإِنْ سَخِطَهَا رَدَّهَا وَصَاعًا مِنْ تَمْرٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
24.en: Narrated Abu Hurairah:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as saying: Do not go out to meet riders to conduct business with them ; none of you must buy in opposition to one another; and do not tie up the udders of camels and sheep, for he who buys them after that has been done has two courses open to him after milking them: he may keep them if he is pleased with them, or he may return them along with a sa' of dates is he is displeased with them
24.hi: Hazrat Abu Hurairah bayaan karte hain: Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne yeh kehte suna: Sawaaron se milne bahar mat jao unke saath vyaapaar karne ke liye; koi bhi ek-doosre ke muqaable khareedaari na kare; aur oont aur bakriyon ke thanon ko mat baandho, kyunki jo koi unhein aisa karne ke baad khareede use dooh lene ke baad do raaste khule hain: agar woh unse razi ho to woh unhein rakh sakta hai, ya agar woh na-raaz ho to woh unhein ek sa' khajoor ke saath wapas kar sakta hai.

24.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، وَهِشَامٍ، وَحَبِيبٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِيرِينَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنِ اشْتَرَى شَاةً مُصَرَّاةً فَهُوَ بِالْخِيَارِ ثَلاَثَةَ أَيَّامٍ إِنْ شَاءَ رَدَّهَا وَصَاعًا مِنْ طَعَامٍ لاَ سَمْرَاءَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
24.en: Narrated Abu Hurairah: The Prophet (ﷺ) as saying: If anyone buys sheep whose udders have been tied up, he has option for three days: he may return it if he desires with a sa' of any grain, not (necessarily) wheat
24.hi: Hazrat Abu Hurairah bayaan karte hain: Nabi (ﷺ) ne yeh kehte suna: Agar koi bakriyaan khareede jinke thane baandhe gaye hon, use teen din ka chunaao milta hai: woh isse wapas kar sakta hai agar woh chaahe kisi bhi anaaj ke ek sa' ke saath, jaruri nahi ke woh gehun ho.

24.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ التَّمِيمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا الْمَكِّيُّ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ - حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، حَدَّثَنِي زِيَادٌ، أَنَّ ثَابِتًا، مَوْلَى عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ، سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنِ اشْتَرَى غَنَمًا مُصَرَّاةً احْتَلَبَهَا فَإِنْ رَضِيَهَا أَمْسَكَهَا وَإِنْ سَخِطَهَا فَفِي حَلْبَتِهَا صَاعٌ مِنْ تَمْرٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
24.en: Narrated Abu Hurairah:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as saying: If anyone buys sheep or goat whose udders have been tied up and he milked it, he may keep it if he is pleased with it, or he may return it if he is displeased with it. There is one sa' of dates (which he must give to the seller) for milking it
24.hi: Hazrat Abu Hurairah bayaan karte hain: Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne yeh kehte suna: Agar koi bakri ya bakri khareede jiske thane baandhe gaye hon aur usne isse dooha, woh isse rakh sakta hai agar woh isse razi ho, ya isse wapas kar sakta hai agar woh na-raaz ho. Isse dooh lene ke liye ek sa' khajoor hai (jo use bechne wale ko dena chaahiye).

24.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كَامِلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ، حَدَّثَنَا صَدَقَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ جُمَيْعِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ التَّيْمِيِّ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنِ ابْتَاعَ مُحَفَّلَةً فَهُوَ بِالْخِيَارِ ثَلاَثَةَ أَيَّامٍ فَإِنْ رَدَّهَا رَدَّ مَعَهَا مِثْلَ أَوْ مِثْلَىْ لَبَنِهَا قَمْحًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
24.en: Narrated Abdullah ibn Umar: The Prophet (ﷺ) said: If anyone buys a sheep whose udders have been tied up, he has option for three days (for decision). If he returns it, he should return with it wheat equal to its milk or double of it
24.hi: Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar bayaan karte hain: Nabi (ﷺ) ne kaha: Agar koi bakri khareede jiske thane baandhe gaye hon, use teen din ka chunaao milta hai (faisle ke liye). Agar woh isse wapas kare, use iske doodh ke barabar ya double gehun wapas dena chaahiye.

24.ar: حَدَّثَنَا وَهْبُ بْنُ بَقِيَّةَ، أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدٌ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ يَحْيَى، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ عَطَاءٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرِ بْنِ أَبِي مَعْمَرٍ، أَحَدِ بَنِي عَدِيِّ بْنِ كَعْبٍ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لاَ يَحْتَكِرُ إِلاَّ خَاطِئٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ لِسَعِيدٍ فَإِنَّكَ تَحْتَكِرُ قَالَ وَمَعْمَرٌ كَانَ يَحْتَكِرُ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو دَاوُدَ وَسَأَلْتُ أَحْمَدَ مَا الْحُكْرَةُ قَالَ مَا فِيهِ عَيْشُ النَّاسِ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو دَاوُدَ قَالَ الأَوْزَاعِيُّ الْمُحْتَكِرُ مَنْ يَعْتَرِضُ السُّوقَ ‏.‏
24.en: Narrated Ma'mar b. Abi Ma'mar, one of the children of 'Adi b. Ka'b: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as saying: No one withholds goods till their price rises but a sinner. I said to Sa'id (b. al-Musayyab): You withhold goods till their price rises. He said: Ma'mar used to withhold goods till their price rose. Abu Dawud said: I asked Ahmad (b. Hanbal): What is hoarding (hukrah) ? He replied: That on which people live. Abu Dawud said: Al-Auza'i said: A muhtakir (one who hoards) is one who withholds supply of goods in the market
24.hi: Hazrat Ma'mar bin Abi Ma'mar, Adi bin Ka'b ke khaandaan mein se ek, bayaan karte hain: Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne yeh kehte suna: Koi bhi saamaan ko qeemat badhne ke intezaar mein nahi rokta siwaye ek gunaahgaar ke. Maine Sa'id (bin al-Musayyab) se kaha: Aap saamaan ko qeemat badhne tak rokte hain. Unhone kaha: Ma'mar bhi saamaan ko qeemat badhne tak roka karte the. Abu Dawud kehte hain: Maine Ahmad (bin Hanbal) se poocha: Zakhira karna (hukrah) kya hai? Unhone jawaab diya: Woh jispar log guzara karte hain. Abu Dawud kehte hain: Al-Awza'i ne kaha: Ek muhtakir (zakhira karne wala) woh hai jo bazaar mein saamaan ki suvidha rokta hai.

24.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى بْنِ فَيَّاضٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي ح، وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ الْفَيَّاضِ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، قَالَ لَيْسَ فِي التَّمْرِ حُكْرَةٌ ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى قَالَ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ فَقُلْنَا لَهُ لاَ تَقُلْ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو دَاوُدَ هَذَا الْحَدِيثُ عِنْدَنَا بَاطِلٌ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو دَاوُدَ كَانَ سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُسَيَّبِ يَحْتَكِرُ النَّوَى وَالْخَبَطَ وَالْبِزْرَ سَمِعْتُ أَحْمَدَ بْنَ يُونُسَ يَقُولُ سَأَلْتُ سُفْيَانَ عَنْ كَبْسِ الْقَتِّ فَقَالَ كَانُوا يَكْرَهُونَ الْحُكْرَةَ وَسَأَلْتُ أَبَا بَكْرِ بْنَ عَيَّاشٍ فَقَالَ اكْبِسْهُ ‏.‏
24.en: Qatadah said:Hoarding does not apply to dried dates. Ibn al-Muthanna said that he (Yahya b. Fayyad) reported on the authority of al-Hasan. We (Ibn al-Muthanna) said to him (Yahya): Do not say: "on the authority of al-Hasan." Abu Dawud said: This tradition according to us is false. Abu Dawud said: Sa'id b. al-Musayyab used to hoard kernel, fodder, and seeds. Abu Dawud said: I heard Ahmad b. Yunus say: I asked Sufyan about hoarding fodder. He replied: They (the people in the past) disapproved of hoarding. I asked Abu Bakr b. 'Ayyash (about it). He replied: Hoard it
24.hi: Hazrat Qatadah bayaan karte hain: Zakhira karna sookhi khajoor par laagu nahi hota. Ibn al-Muthanna kehte hain ke unhone (Yahya bin Fayyad) al-Hasan ke hawale se riwayat ki. Humne (Ibn al-Muthanna ne) unse (Yahya se) kaha: 'al-Hasan ke hawale se' mat kaho. Abu Dawud kehte hain: Yeh riwayat humaare nazdeek jhooti hai. Abu Dawud kehte hain: Sa'id bin al-Musayyab beej, chaara, aur bee ka zakhira karte the. Abu Dawud kehte hain: Maine Ahmad bin Yunus ko kehte suna: Maine Sufyan se chaare ka zakhira karne ke baare mein poocha. Unhone jawaab diya: Woh (pehle ke log) zakhira karne ko na-pasand karte the. Maine Abu Bakr bin Ayyash se (iske baare mein) poocha. Unhone jawaab diya: Isse zakhira karo.

24.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ حَنْبَلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعْتَمِرٌ، سَمِعْتُ مُحَمَّدَ بْنَ فَضَاءٍ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ تُكْسَرَ سِكَّةُ الْمُسْلِمِينَ الْجَائِزَةُ بَيْنَهُمْ إِلاَّ مِنْ بَأْسٍ ‏.‏
24.en: Narrated 'Alqamah b. 'Abdullah: On the authority of his father, who said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) forbade to break the coins of the Muslims current among them except for some defect
24.hi: Hazrat Alqamah bin Abdullah apne walid ke hawale se bayaan karte hain jinhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne Musalmanon ke chalte sikke todne se mana kiya siwaye kisi khaas maayoob ke.

24.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ الدِّمَشْقِيُّ، أَنَّ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنَ بِلاَلٍ، حَدَّثَهُمْ حَدَّثَنِي الْعَلاَءُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَجُلاً، جَاءَ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ سَعِّرْ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ بَلْ أَدْعُو ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ جَاءَهُ رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ سَعِّرْ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ بَلِ اللَّهُ يَخْفِضُ وَيَرْفَعُ وَإِنِّي لأَرْجُو أَنْ أَلْقَى اللَّهَ وَلَيْسَ لأَحَدٍ عِنْدِي مَظْلَمَةٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
24.en: Narrated AbuHurayrah: A man came and said: Messenger of Allah, fix prices. He said: (No), but I shall pray. Again the man came and said: Messenger of Allah, fix prices. He said: It is but Allah Who makes the prices low and high. I hope that when I meet Allah, none of you has any claim on me for doing wrong regarding blood or property
24.hi: Hazrat Abu Hurairah bayaan karte hain: Ek aadmi aaya aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, qeemat muqarrar karein. Aapne kaha: (Nahi), lekin main dua karunga. Aadmi fir aaya aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool, qeemat muqarrar karein. Aapne kaha: Sirf Allah hai jo qeemat kam aur zyada karta hai. Mujhe ummeed hai ke jab main Allah se milun, tum mein se kisi ka bhi mujhpar koi daawa na ho khoon ya jaidad ke bure amal ke liye.

24.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَفَّانُ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، أَخْبَرَنَا ثَابِتٌ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، وَقَتَادَةُ، وَحُمَيْدٌ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ قَالَ النَّاسُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ غَلاَ السِّعْرُ فَسَعِّرْ لَنَا ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ الْمُسَعِّرُ الْقَابِضُ الْبَاسِطُ الرَّازِقُ وَإِنِّي لأَرْجُو أَنْ أَلْقَى اللَّهَ وَلَيْسَ أَحَدٌ مِنْكُمْ يُطَالِبُنِي بِمَظْلَمَةٍ فِي دَمٍ وَلاَ مَالٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
24.en: Narrated Anas ibn Malik: The people said: Messenger of Allah , prices have shot up, so fix prices for us. Thereupon the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Allah is the one Who fixes prices, Who withholds, gives lavishly and provides, and I hope that when I meet Allah, none of you will have any claim on me for an injustice regarding blood or property
24.hi: Hazrat Anas bin Malik bayaan karte hain: Logon ne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, qeemten badh gayi hain, so humaare liye qeemten muqarrar karein. Isper Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne kaha: Allah hi hai jo qeemten muqarrar karta hai, jo rokta hai, khoob deta hai, aur muhaiya karta hai, aur mujhe ummeed hai ke jab main Allah se milun, tum mein se kisi ka bhi mujhpar koi daawa na ho khoon ya jaidad ke zulm ke liye.

24.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ حَنْبَلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ الْعَلاَءِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَرَّ بِرَجُلٍ يَبِيعُ طَعَامًا فَسَأَلَهُ ‏"‏ كَيْفَ تَبِيعُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَأَخْبَرَهُ فَأُوحِيَ إِلَيْهِ أَنْ أَدْخِلْ يَدَكَ فِيهِ فَأَدْخَلَ يَدَهُ فِيهِ فَإِذَا هُوَ مَبْلُولٌ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لَيْسَ مِنَّا مَنْ غَشَّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
24.en: Narrated Abu Hurairah:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) passed a man who was selling grain. He asked him: How are you selling? He informed him. Revelation them came down to him saying: "Put your hand into it." So he put his hand into it, and felt that it was damp. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) then said: "He who deceives has nothing to do with us
24.hi: Hazrat Abu Hurairah bayaan karte hain: Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ek aadmi ke paas se guzre jo anaaj bech raha tha. Aapne unse poocha: Tum kaise bech rahe ho? Unhone unhein bataaya. Isper unhein wahi mili ke: "Apna haath isme daalo." So unhone apna haath isme daala, aur mehsoos kiya ke yeh geela hai. Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne fir kaha: Jo dhoka de use humse koi taalluq nahi.

24.ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ الصَّبَّاحِ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ، عَنْ يَحْيَى، قَالَ كَانَ سُفْيَانُ يَكْرَهُ هَذَا التَّفْسِيرَ لَيْسَ مِنَّا لَيْسَ مِثْلَنَا ‏.‏
24.en: Yahya said:Sufyan disapproved of the interpretation of the phrase "has nothing to do with us" as "not like us
24.hi: Yahya kehte hain: Sufyan is baat ko na-pasand karte the ke 'humse koi taalluq nahi' ka matlab 'hamme jaisa nahi' liya jaaye.

24.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ الْمُتَبَايِعَانِ كُلُّ وَاحِدٍ مِنْهُمَا بِالْخِيَارِ عَلَى صَاحِبِهِ مَا لَمْ يَفْتَرِقَا إِلاَّ بَيْعَ الْخِيَارِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
24.en: Narrated 'Abdullah bin 'Umar:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as saying: Each one of the two parties in a business has an option (to annul it) against the other party so long as they have not separated, except in a conditional bargain
24.hi: Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar bayaan karte hain: Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne yeh kehte suna: Vyaapaar mein dono taraf walon ko chunaao ka haq hai (isse radd karne ka) jab tak woh alag na ho jaayein, siwaye shart wale sauda ke.

24.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمَعْنَاهُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ أَوْ يَقُولُ أَحَدُهُمَا لِصَاحِبِهِ اخْتَرْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
24.en: The tradition mentioned above has also been transmitted by Ibn 'Umar from the Prophet (ﷺ) to the same effect through a different chain of narrators. This version adds:"Or one of them tells the other: "Exercise the right
24.hi: Upar zikr ki gayi riwayat bhi Ibn Umar se, Nabi (ﷺ) se, isi tarah ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai. Iss version mein izaafa hai: 'Ya unmein se koi doosre se kahe: Apna haq istemaal karo.'

24.ar: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَجْلاَنَ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ شُعَيْبٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْعَاصِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ الْمُتَبَايِعَانِ بِالْخِيَارِ مَا لَمْ يَفْتَرِقَا إِلاَّ أَنْ تَكُونَ صَفْقَةَ خِيَارٍ وَلاَ يَحِلُّ لَهُ أَنْ يُفَارِقَ صَاحِبَهُ خَشْيَةَ أَنْ يَسْتَقِيلَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
24.en: Narrated Abdullah ibn Amr ibn al-'As: The Prophet (ﷺ) said: Both parties in a business transaction have a right to annul it so long as they have not separated unless it is a bargain with the option to annul is attached to it; and it is not permissible for one of them to separate from the other for fear that one may demand that the bargain be rescinded
24.hi: Hazrat Abdullah bin Amr bin al-As bayaan karte hain: Nabi (ﷺ) ne kaha: Vyaapaar mein dono taraf walon ko isse radd karne ka haq hai jab tak woh alag na ho jaayein siwaye is shart wale sauda ke jismein radd karne ka chunaao juda ho; aur ek ke liye jaayez nahi ke woh doosre se sirf isliye alag ho ke shaayad woh sauda radd karne ki maang kare.

24.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، عَنْ جَمِيلِ بْنِ مُرَّةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الْوَضِيءِ، قَالَ غَزَوْنَا غَزْوَةً لَنَا فَنَزَلْنَا مَنْزِلاً فَبَاعَ صَاحِبٌ لَنَا فَرَسًا بِغُلاَمٍ ثُمَّ أَقَامَا بَقِيَّةَ يَوْمِهِمَا وَلَيْلَتِهِمَا فَلَمَّا أَصْبَحَا مِنَ الْغَدِ حَضَرَ الرَّحِيلُ فَقَامَ إِلَى فَرَسِهِ يُسْرِجُهُ فَنَدِمَ فَأَتَى الرَّجُلَ وَأَخَذَهُ بِالْبَيْعِ فَأَبَى الرَّجُلُ أَنْ يَدْفَعَهُ إِلَيْهِ فَقَالَ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَكَ أَبُو بَرْزَةَ صَاحِبُ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَتَيَا أَبَا بَرْزَةَ فِي نَاحِيَةِ الْعَسْكَرِ فَقَالاَ لَهُ هَذِهِ الْقِصَّةَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَتَرْضَيَانِ أَنْ أَقْضِيَ بَيْنَكُمَا بِقَضَاءِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ الْبَيِّعَانِ بِالْخِيَارِ مَا لَمْ يَتَفَرَّقَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ هِشَامُ بْنُ حَسَّانَ حَدَّثَ جَمِيلٌ أَنَّهُ قَالَ مَا أُرَاكُمَا افْتَرَقْتُمَا ‏.‏
24.en: Narrated AbulWadi': We fought one of our battle, and encamped at a certain place. One of our companions sold a horse for a slave. After that they remained there for the rest of day and night. When the next morning came, they prepared themselves for departure. The buyer of the horse began to saddle it, but the seller was ashamed (of the transaction). He went to the man (buyer) and asked him to annul the transaction. The man refused to hand it over (the horse) to him. He said: AbuBarzah, the companion of the Prophet (ﷺ), is to decide between me and you. They went to AbuBarzah in the corner of the army. They related this story to him. He said: Do you agree that I make a decision between you on the basis of the decision of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)? The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Both parties in a business transaction have an option (right) to annul it so long as they have not separated. Hisham to Hassan said that Jamil said in his version: "I do not think that you separated
24.hi: Hazrat Abul-Wadi' bayaan karte hain: Hum apni ek jung mein lade, aur hum ek jagah padaao daale. Humaare ek saathi ne ek ghoda ek ghulam ke liye bech diya. Iske baad woh baaqi din aur raat wahin rahe. Jab agli subah aayi, woh nikalne ki taiyaari karne lage. Ghode ke khareedaar ne isse kaathi lagana shuru kiya, lekin bechne wale ko sharm mehsoos hui (mu'aamle par). Woh aadmi (khareedaar) ke paas gaye aur unse mu'aamla radd karne ko kaha. Aadmi ne (ghoda) unhein sonpne se inkaar kiya. Unhone kaha: Abu Barzah, Nabi (ﷺ) ke sahabi, humaare aur tumhaare darmiyan faisla karenge. Woh lashkar ke ek konay mein Abu Barzah ke paas gaye. Unhone unhein yeh kahaani bataayi. Unhone kaha: Kya tum raazi ho ke main tumhaare beech Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ke faisle ke aadhaar par faisla karun? Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne kaha: Vyaapaar mein dono taraf walon ko chunaao ka haq hai jab tak woh alag na ho jaayein. Hisham kehte hain Hassan se, ke Jamil ne apne version mein kaha: 'Mujhe nahi lagta tum alag hue ho.'

24.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ الْجَرْجَرَائِيُّ، قَالَ مَرْوَانُ الْفَزَارِيُّ أَخْبَرَنَا عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَيُّوبَ، قَالَ كَانَ أَبُو زُرْعَةَ إِذَا بَايَعَ رَجُلاً خَيَّرَهُ قَالَ ثُمَّ يَقُولُ خَيِّرْنِي وَيَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لاَ يَفْتَرِقَنَّ اثْنَانِ إِلاَّ عَنْ تَرَاضٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
24.en: Narrated Yahya b. Ayyub: When Abu Zur'ah made a business transaction with a man, he gave him the right of option. He then would tell him: Give me the right of option (to annul the bargain). He said: I heard AbuHurayrah say: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Two people must separate only by mutual consent
24.hi: Hazrat Yahya bin Ayyub bayaan karte hain: Jab Abu Zur'ah kisi aadmi ke saath vyaapaar karte, unhein chunaao ka haq dete. Fir woh unse kehte: Mujhe chunaao ka haq do (sauda radd karne ka). Unhone kaha: Maine Abu Hurairah ko yeh kehte suna: Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne kaha: Do log sirf aapas ki razaamandi se hi alag hone chaahiye.

24.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الْخَلِيلِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ حَكِيمِ بْنِ حِزَامٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ الْبَيِّعَانِ بِالْخِيَارِ مَا لَمْ يَفْتَرِقَا فَإِنْ صَدَقَا وَبَيَّنَا بُورِكَ لَهُمَا فِي بَيْعِهِمَا وَإِنْ كَتَمَا وَكَذَبَا مُحِقَتِ الْبَرَكَةُ مِنْ بَيْعِهِمَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو دَاوُدَ وَكَذَلِكَ رَوَاهُ سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي عَرُوبَةَ وَحَمَّادٌ وَأَمَّا هَمَّامٌ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ حَتَّى يَتَفَرَّقَا أَوْ يَخْتَارَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثَلاَثَ مِرَارٍ ‏.‏
24.en: Narrated Hakim b. Hizam: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) as saying: Both parties in a business transaction have a right of option (to annul it) so long as they are not separated ; and if they tell the truth and make everything clear, they will be blessed in their transaction, but it they conceal anything and lie, the blessing on their transaction will be blotted out. Abu Dawud said: A similar tradition has also been transmitted by Sa'id b. Abi 'Arubah and Hammad. As regards with Hammam, he said in his version: Until they separate or exercise the right of option (to annul the transaction), saying the words of option three times
24.hi: Hazrat Hakim bin Hizam bayaan karte hain: Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne yeh kehte suna: Vyaapaar mein dono taraf walon ko chunaao ka haq hai jab tak woh alag na ho jaayein; aur agar woh sach kahein aur sab kuch saaf saaf batayein, unhein apne vyaapaar mein barkat milegi, lekin agar woh kuch chhupaayein aur jhoot bolein, unke vyaapaar par barkat mit jaayegi. Abu Dawud kehte hain: Isi jaisi riwayat Sa'id bin Abi Arubah aur Hammad ne bhi riwayat ki hai. Jahan tak Hammam ka taalluq hai, unhone apne version mein kaha: Jab tak woh alag na ho jaayein ya chunaao ka haq istemaal na karein, chunaao ke alfaaz teen martaba kehte hue.

24.ar: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ مَعِينٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنْ أَقَالَ مُسْلِمًا أَقَالَهُ اللَّهُ عَثْرَتَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
24.en: Narrated AbuHurayrah: The Prophet (ﷺ) said: If anyone rescinds a sale with a Muslim, Allah will cancel his slip, on the Day of Resurrection
24.hi: Hazrat Abu Hurairah bayaan karte hain: Nabi (ﷺ) ne kaha: Agar koi kisi Musalman ke saath sauda radd kar de, Allah Qayamat ke din unki lagzish maaf kar dega.

24.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ زَكَرِيَّا، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنْ بَاعَ بَيْعَتَيْنِ فِي بَيْعَةٍ فَلَهُ أَوْكَسُهُمَا أَوِ الرِّبَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
24.en: Narrated AbuHurayrah: The Prophet (ﷺ) said: If anyone makes two transactions combined in one bargain, he should have the lesser of the two or it will involve usury
24.hi: Hazrat Abu Hurairah bayaan karte hain: Nabi (ﷺ) ne kaha: Agar koi do mu'aamlaat ek hi sauda mein mila de, use dono mein se choti hi lena chaahiye warna isme sood shaamil ho jaayega.

24.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ دَاوُدَ الْمَهْرِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي حَيْوَةُ بْنُ شُرَيْحٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ مُسَافِرٍ التِّنِّيسِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَحْيَى الْبُرُلُّسِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا حَيْوَةُ بْنُ شُرَيْحٍ، عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، - قَالَ سُلَيْمَانُ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْخُرَاسَانِيِّ، - أَنَّ عَطَاءً الْخُرَاسَانِيَّ، حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ نَافِعًا حَدَّثَهُ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ إِذَا تَبَايَعْتُمْ بِالْعِينَةِ وَأَخَذْتُمْ أَذْنَابَ الْبَقَرِ وَرَضِيتُمْ بِالزَّرْعِ وَتَرَكْتُمُ الْجِهَادَ سَلَّطَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْكُمْ ذُلاًّ لاَ يَنْزِعُهُ حَتَّى تَرْجِعُوا إِلَى دِينِكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو دَاوُدَ الإِخْبَارُ لِجَعْفَرٍ وَهَذَا لَفْظُهُ ‏.‏
24.en: Narrated Abdullah ibn Umar: I heard the Messenger of Allah, (ﷺ) say: When you enter into the inah transaction, hold the tails of oxen, are pleased with agriculture, and give up conducting jihad (struggle in the way of Allah). Allah will make disgrace prevail over you, and will not withdraw it until you return to your original religion
24.hi: Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar bayaan karte hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ko yeh kehte suna: Jab tum inah mu'aamle mein dakhil hote ho, bailon ki poonchhein pakadte ho, kheti se khush ho, aur jihaad (Allah ki raah mein koshish) chhod dete ho, Allah tumpar be-izzati chhaa dega, aur isse tab tak nahi hataayega jab tak tum apne asal deen ki taraf wapas na lauto.

24.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ النُّفَيْلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ كَثِيرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الْمِنْهَالِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ قَدِمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُمْ يُسْلِفُونَ فِي التَّمْرِ السَّنَةَ وَالسَّنَتَيْنِ وَالثَّلاَثَةَ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنْ أَسْلَفَ فِي تَمْرٍ فَلْيُسْلِفْ فِي كَيْلٍ مَعْلُومٍ وَوَزْنٍ مَعْلُومٍ إِلَى أَجَلٍ مَعْلُومٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
24.en: Narrated Ibn 'Abbas:When the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came to Medina, they were paying one, two and three years in advance for fruits, so he said: Those who pay in advance for anything, must do for a specified measure and weight with a specified time fixed
24.hi: Hazrat Ibn Abbas bayaan karte hain: Jab Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) Madina aaye, log phalon ke liye ek, do, aur teen saal pehle adaaigi kiya karte the, so aapne kaha: Jo bhi kisi cheez ke liye pehle adaaigi kare, use ek muqarrar naap aur wazan aur ek muqarrar muddat ke liye karna chaahiye.

24.ar: حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ كَثِيرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعْبَةُ، أَخْبَرَنِي مُحَمَّدٌ، أَوْ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُجَالِدٍ قَالَ اخْتَلَفَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ شَدَّادٍ وَأَبُو بُرْدَةَ فِي السَّلَفِ فَبَعَثُونِي إِلَى ابْنِ أَبِي أَوْفَى فَسَأَلْتُهُ فَقَالَ إِنْ كُنَّا نُسْلِفُ عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَبِي بَكْرٍ وَعُمَرَ فِي الْحِنْطَةِ وَالشَّعِيرِ وَالتَّمْرِ وَالزَّبِيبِ - زَادَ ابْنُ كَثِيرٍ - إِلَى قَوْمٍ مَا هُوَ عِنْدَهُمْ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ اتَّفَقَا وَسَأَلْتُ ابْنَ أَبْزَى فَقَالَ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ ‏.‏
24.en: Muhammad or 'Abd Allah b. Mujahid said:'Abd Allah b. Shaddad and Abu Burdah disputed over salaf (payment in advance). They sent me to Ibn Abi Awfa and I asked him (about it) and he replied: We used to pay in advance (salaf) during the time of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), Abu Bakr and 'Umar in wheat, barley, dates and raisins. Ibn Kathir added: "to those people who did not possess these things." The agreed version then goes: I then asked Ibn Abza who gave a similar reply
24.hi: Muhammad ya Abdullah bin Mujahid bayaan karte hain: Abdullah bin Shaddad aur Abu Burdah salaf (agrim adaaigi) ke baare mein jhagade. Unhone mujhe Ibn Abi Awfa ke paas bheja aur maine unse (iske baare mein) poocha, aur unhone jawaab diya: Hum Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ), Abu Bakr, aur Umar ke zamane mein gehun, jau, khajoor, aur kishmish ke liye salaf (pehle adaaigi) kiya karte the. Ibn Kathir ne izaafa kiya: 'Un logon ko jinke paas yeh cheezein na hoti thi.' Fir sahmat version kehta hai: Fir maine Ibn Abza se poocha jinhone isi jaisi jawaab diya.

24.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، وَابْنُ، مَهْدِيٍّ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي الْمُجَالِدِ، وَقَالَ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي الْمُجَالِدِ، بِهَذَا الْحَدِيثِ قَالَ عِنْدَ قَوْمٍ مَا هُوَ عِنْدَهُمْ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو دَاوُدَ الصَّوَابُ ابْنُ أَبِي الْمُجَالِدِ وَشُعْبَةُ أَخْطَأَ فِيهِ ‏.‏
