So the following verse of Surat al-Baqarah revealed; "They ask thee concerning wine and gambling. Say: In them is great sin...." Umar was then called and it was recited to him. He said: O Allah, give us a satisfactory explanation about wine. Then the following verse of Surat an-Nisa' was revealed: "O ye who believe! approach not prayers with a mind befogged...." Thereafter the herald of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) would call when the (congregational) prayer was performed: Beware, one who is drunk should not come to prayer. Umar was again called and it was recited to him). He said: O Allah, give us a satisfactory explanation about wine. This verse was revealed: "Will ye not then abstain?" Umar said: We abstained
27.hi: Hazrat Umar bin Khattab bayaan karte hain: Jab sharaab ki mumaanat abhi elaan hona baaqi thi, Umar ne kaha: Ae Allah, humein sharaab ke baare mein ek tasalli-bakhsh wazaahat de. So Surah al-Baqarah ki yeh aayat nazil hui: "Woh aapse sharaab aur juay ke baare mein poochte hain. Kaho: Inmein bada gunah hai..." Umar ko fir bulwaaya gaya aur yeh unhein padh kar sunaayi gayi. Unhone kaha: Ae Allah, humein sharaab ke baare mein ek tasalli-bakhsh wazaahat de. Fir Surah an-Nisa ki yeh aayat nazil hui: "Ae imaan waalo! Namaz ke qareeb na jao jab tumhaara dimaag dhundhla ho..." Iske baad, Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ke elaan karne wale (jama'at ki) namaz ke waqt yeh pukaarte: Khabardaar, jo nasha mein ho use namaz mein nahi aana chaahiye. Umar ko dobara bulwaaya gaya (aur yeh unhein padh kar sunaayi gayi). Unhone kaha: Ae Allah, humein sharaab ke baare mein ek tasalli-bakhsh wazaahat de. Yeh aayat nazil hui: "Kya tum fir bhi na rukoge?" Umar ne kaha: Hum ruk gaye.

27.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَطَاءُ بْنُ السَّائِبِ، عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ السُّلَمِيِّ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ، عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ أَنَّ رَجُلاً، مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ دَعَاهُ وَعَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ عَوْفٍ فَسَقَاهُمَا قَبْلَ أَنْ تُحَرَّمَ الْخَمْرُ فَأَمَّهُمْ عَلِيٌّ فِي الْمَغْرِبِ فَقَرَأَ ‏{‏ قُلْ يَا أَيُّهَا الْكَافِرُونَ ‏}‏ فَخَلَطَ فِيهَا فَنَزَلَتْ ‏{‏ لاَ تَقْرَبُوا الصَّلاَةَ وَأَنْتُمْ سُكَارَى حَتَّى تَعْلَمُوا مَا تَقُولُونَ ‏}‏ ‏.‏
27.en: Narrated Ali ibn AbuTalib: A man of the Ansar called him and AbdurRahman ibn Awf and supplied them wine before it was prohibited. Ali then led them in the evening prayer, and he recited; "Say: O ye who reject faith." He was confused in it. Then the following verse came down: "O ye who believe! approach not prayers with a mind befogged until you can understand all that ye say
27.hi: Hazrat Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) bayaan karte hain: Ansar ke ek aadmi ne unhein aur Abdur Rahman bin Awf ko bulwaaya aur unhein sharaab pilaayi isse pehle ke yeh haraam ho. Ali ne fir shaam ki namaz mein imamat ki, aur unhone padha: "Kaho: Ae imaan se inkaar karne walo." Woh isme bhram mein pad gaye. Fir yeh aayat nazil hui: "Ae imaan waalo! Namaz ke qareeb na jao jab tumhaara dimaag dhundhla ho jab tak tumhein maloom na ho tum kya keh rahe ho."

27.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ الْمَرْوَزِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ حُسَيْنٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ النَّحْوِيِّ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ ‏{‏ يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لاَ تَقْرَبُوا الصَّلاَةَ وَأَنْتُمْ سُكَارَى ‏}‏ وَ ‏{‏ يَسْأَلُونَكَ عَنِ الْخَمْرِ وَالْمَيْسِرِ قُلْ فِيهِمَا إِثْمٌ كَبِيرٌ وَمَنَافِعُ لِلنَّاسِ ‏}‏ نَسَخَتْهُمَا الَّتِي فِي الْمَائِدَةِ ‏{‏ إِنَّمَا الْخَمْرُ وَالْمَيْسِرُ وَالأَنْصَابُ ‏}‏ الآيَةَ ‏.‏
27.en: Ibn Abbas said:The Quranic verse :”O ye who believe ,approach not prayer with minds befogged until you can understand all they say,” and the verse: “They ask thee concerning wine and gambling. Say: In them is great sin and some profit for men ,” were repeated by the verse in Surat al-Ma’idah: ”O ye who believe, intoxicants and gambling,(dedication) stones
27.hi: Ibn Abbas kehte hain: Quraani aayat: "Ae imaan waalo, namaz ke qareeb na jao jab tumhaara dimaag dhundhla ho jab tak tumhein maloom na ho tum kya keh rahe ho," aur aayat: "Woh aapse sharaab aur juay ke baare mein poochte hain. Kaho: Inmein bada gunah hai aur logon ke liye kuch faida bhi," Surah al-Ma'idah ki aayat se badal di gayin: "Ae imaan waalo, nasha karne wali cheezein aur juaa, (nazar mein charhaaye gaye) patthar."

27.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ كُنْتُ سَاقِيَ الْقَوْمِ حَيْثُ حُرِّمَتِ الْخَمْرُ فِي مَنْزِلِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ وَمَا شَرَابُنَا يَوْمَئِذٍ إِلاَّ الْفَضِيخُ فَدَخَلَ عَلَيْنَا رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ إِنَّ الْخَمْرَ قَدْ حُرِّمَتْ وَنَادَى مُنَادِي رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقُلْنَا هَذَا مُنَادِي رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
27.en: Narrated Anas ibn Malik: I was serving wine to the people in the house of AbuTalhah when it was prohibited and that day our wine was made from unripe dates. A man entered upon us and said: The wine has been prohibited, and the herald of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) made an announcement. We then said: This is the herald of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)
27.hi: Hazrat Anas bin Malik bayaan karte hain: Main Abu Talhah ke ghar mein logon ko sharaab pila raha tha jab yeh haraam ki gayi, aur us din humaari sharaab kachchi khajoor se banaayi gayi thi. Ek aadmi humaare paas dakhil hua aur kaha: Sharaab haraam kar di gayi hai, aur Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ke elaan karne wale ne yeh elaan kiya. Humne fir kaha: Yeh Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ka elaan karne wala hai.

27.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعُ بْنُ الْجَرَّاحِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ أَبِي عَلْقَمَةَ، مَوْلاَهُمْ وَعَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْغَافِقِيِّ أَنَّهُمَا سَمِعَا ابْنَ عُمَرَ، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لَعَنَ اللَّهُ الْخَمْرَ وَشَارِبَهَا وَسَاقِيَهَا وَبَائِعَهَا وَمُبْتَاعَهَا وَعَاصِرَهَا وَمُعْتَصِرَهَا وَحَامِلَهَا وَالْمَحْمُولَةَ إِلَيْهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
27.en: Narrated Abdullah ibn Umar: The Prophet (ﷺ) said: Allah has cursed wine, its drinker, its server, its seller, its buyer, its presser, the one for whom it is pressed, the one who conveys it, and the one to whom it is conveyed
27.hi: Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar bayaan karte hain: Nabi (ﷺ) ne kaha: Allah ne sharaab par, uske peene wale par, uske parosne wale par, uske bechne wale par, uske khareedne wale par, uske nichodne wale par, jiske liye yeh nichodi jaaye uspar, jo isse le jaaye uspar, aur jise yeh pahunchaayi jaaye uspar laanat ki hai.

27.ar: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنِ السُّدِّيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي هُبَيْرَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ أَبَا طَلْحَةَ، سَأَلَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ أَيْتَامٍ وَرِثُوا خَمْرًا قَالَ ‏"‏ أَهْرِقْهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَفَلاَ أَجْعَلُهَا خَلاًّ قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
27.en: Anas b. Malik said :Abu Talhah asked the prophet (ﷺ) about the orphans who had inherited wine. He replied: Pour it out. He asked: May I not make vinegar of it ? He replied : No
27.hi: Anas bin Malik kehte hain: Abu Talhah ne Nabi (ﷺ) se un yateemon ke baare mein poocha jinhein sharaab virasat mein mili. Aapne jawaab diya: Isse bahaa do. Unhone poocha: Kya main isse sirka nahi bana sakta? Aapne jawaab diya: Nahi.

27.ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ آدَمَ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ مُهَاجِرٍ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنِ النُّعْمَانِ بْنِ بَشِيرٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِنَّ مِنَ الْعِنَبِ خَمْرًا وَإِنَّ مِنَ التَّمْرِ خَمْرًا وَإِنَّ مِنَ الْعَسَلِ خَمْرًا وَإِنَّ مِنَ الْبُرِّ خَمْرًا وَإِنَّ مِنَ الشَّعِيرِ خَمْرًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
27.en: Narrated An-Nu'man ibn Bashir: The Prophet (ﷺ) said: from grapes wine is made, from dried dates wine is made, from honey wine is made, from wheat wine is made, from barley wine is made
27.hi: Hazrat An-Nu'man bin Bashir bayaan karte hain: Nabi (ﷺ) ne kaha: Angoor se sharaab banaayi jaati hai, sookhi khajoor se sharaab banaayi jaati hai, shehad se sharaab banaayi jaati hai, gehun se sharaab banaayi jaati hai, jau se sharaab banaayi jaati hai.

27.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْوَاحِدِ أَبُو غَسَّانَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعْتَمِرٌ، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى الْفُضَيْلِ بْنِ مَيْسَرَةَ عَنْ أَبِي حَرِيزٍ، أَنَّ عَامِرًا، حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ النُّعْمَانَ بْنَ بَشِيرٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ الْخَمْرَ مِنَ الْعَصِيرِ وَالزَّبِيبِ وَالتَّمْرِ وَالْحِنْطَةِ وَالشَّعِيرِ وَالذُّرَةِ وَإِنِّي أَنْهَاكُمْ عَنْ كُلِّ مُسْكِرٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
27.en: Narrated An-Nu'man ibn Bashir: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say: Wine is made from grape-syrup, raisins, dried dates, wheat, barley, millet, and I forbid you from every intoxicant
27.hi: Hazrat An-Nu'man bin Bashir bayaan karte hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ko yeh kehte suna: Sharaab angoor ke sharbat, kishmish, sookhi khajoor, gehun, jau, aur bajra se banaayi jaati hai, aur main tumhein har nasha karne wali cheez se mana karta hoon.

27.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبَانُ، حَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى، عَنْ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ الْخَمْرُ مِنْ هَاتَيْنِ الشَّجَرَتَيْنِ النَّخْلَةِ وَالْعِنَبَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو دَاوُدَ اسْمُ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ الْغُبَرِيِّ يَزِيدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ غُفَيْلَةَ السَّحْمِيُّ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ أُذَيْنَةُ وَالصَّوَابُ غُفَيْلَةُ ‏.‏
27.en: Abu Hurairah b. Bashir reported the Apostel of Allah (ﷺ)as saying:Wine comes from these two trees, the date-palm and the grapes-vine. Abu Dawud said : The name of Abu KAthir al-Ubari is Yazid b. ‘Abd al-Rahman b. Ghufailat al-Sahmi. Some said: Uzainah. What is correct is Ghufailah
27.hi: Abu Hurairah bin Bashir ne Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ko yeh kehte hue riwayat ki: Sharaab in do darakhton se aati hai, khajoor ke darakht aur angoor ki bail se. Abu Dawud kehte hain: Abu Kathir al-Ubari ka naam Yazid bin Abdur Rahman bin Ghufailat al-Sahmi hai. Kuch ne kaha: Uzainah. Sahi jo hai woh Ghufailah hai.

27.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ دَاوُدَ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عِيسَى، - فِي آخَرِينَ - قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ زَيْدٍ - عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ كُلُّ مُسْكِرٍ خَمْرٌ وَكُلُّ مُسْكِرٍ حَرَامٌ وَمَنْ مَاتَ وَهُوَ يَشْرَبُ الْخَمْرَ يُدْمِنُهَا لَمْ يَشْرَبْهَا فِي الآخِرَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
27.en: Ibn ‘Umar reported the Apostel of Allah (ﷺ) as saying:Every intoxicant is forbidden. He who drinks wine in this world, and dies when he is addiction to it, will not drink it in the next
27.hi: Ibn Umar ne Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ko yeh kehte hue riwayat ki: Har nasha karne wali cheez haraam hai. Agar koi is duniya mein sharaab piye aur uska aadi ho kar mar jaaye, woh Aakhirat mein isse nahi peega.

27.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ النَّيْسَابُورِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ عُمَرَ الصَّنْعَانِيُّ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ النُّعْمَانَ، يَقُولُ عَنْ طَاوُسٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ كُلُّ مُخَمِّرٍ خَمْرٌ وَكُلُّ مُسْكِرٍ حَرَامٌ وَمَنْ شَرِبَ مُسْكِرًا بُخِسَتْ صَلاَتُهُ أَرْبَعِينَ صَبَاحًا فَإِنْ تَابَ تَابَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ فَإِنْ عَادَ الرَّابِعَةَ كَانَ حَقًّا عَلَى اللَّهِ أَنْ يَسْقِيَهُ مِنْ طِينَةِ الْخَبَالِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قِيلَ وَمَا طِينَةُ الْخَبَالِ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ صَدِيدُ أَهْلِ النَّارِ وَمَنْ سَقَاهُ صَغِيرًا لاَ يَعْرِفُ حَلاَلَهُ مِنْ حَرَامِهِ كَانَ حَقًّا عَلَى اللَّهِ أَنْ يَسْقِيَهُ مِنْ طِينَةِ الْخَبَالِ ‏"‏
27.en: Narrated Abdullah Ibn Abbas: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Every intoxicant is khamr (wine) and every intoxicant is forbidden. If anyone drinks wine, Allah will not accept prayer from him for forty days, but if he repents, Allah will accept his repentance. If he repeats it a fourth time, it is binding on Allah that He will give him tinat al-khabal to drink. He was asked: What is tinat al-khabal, Messenger of Allah? He replied: Discharge of wounds, flowing from the inhabitants of Hell. If anyone serves it to a minor who does not distinguish between the lawful and the unlawful, it is binding on Allah that He will give him to drink the discharge of wounds, flowing from the inhabitants of Hell
27.hi: Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas bayaan karte hain: Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne kaha: Har nasha karne wali cheez khamr (sharaab) hai aur har nasha karne wali cheez haraam hai. Agar koi sharaab piye, Allah unse chaalis din tak namaz qabool nahi karega, lekin agar woh tauba kare, Allah unki tauba qabool karega. Agar woh isse chauthi baar dohraaye, Allah par zaroori hai ke Woh unhein tinat al-khabal pilaaye. Unse poocha gaya: Tinat al-khabal kya hai, Allah ke Rasool? Aapne jawaab diya: Zakhmon ka nichod, Jahannam walon se bahne wala. Agar koi isse kisi naabaalig ko de jise jaayez aur naa-jaayez ka farq nahi maloom, Allah par zaroori hai ke Woh unhein Jahannam walon ke zakhmon ka nichod pilaaye.

27.ar: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ جَعْفَرٍ - عَنْ دَاوُدَ بْنِ بَكْرِ بْنِ أَبِي الْفُرَاتِ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَا أَسْكَرَ كَثِيرُهُ فَقَلِيلُهُ حَرَامٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
27.en: Narrated Jabir ibn Abdullah: The Prophet (ﷺ) said: If a large amount of anything causes intoxication, a small amount of it is prohibited
27.hi: Hazrat Jabir bin Abdullah bayaan karte hain: Nabi (ﷺ) ne kaha: Agar kisi cheez ki zyada miqdaar nasha karti hai, iski kam miqdaar bhi haraam hai.

27.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ الْقَعْنَبِيُّ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، - رضى الله عنها - قَالَتْ سُئِلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الْبِتْعِ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ كُلُّ شَرَابٍ أَسْكَرَ فَهُوَ حَرَامٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو دَاوُدَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى يَزِيدَ بْنِ عَبْدِ رَبِّهِ الْجُرْجُسِيِّ حَدَّثَكُمْ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ عَنِ الزُّبَيْدِيِّ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ بِهَذَا الْحَدِيثِ بِإِسْنَادِهِ زَادَ وَالْبِتْعُ نَبِيذُ الْعَسَلِ كَانَ أَهْلُ الْيَمَنِ يَشْرَبُونَهُ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو دَاوُدَ سَمِعْتُ أَحْمَدَ بْنَ حَنْبَلٍ يَقُولُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ مَا كَانَ أَثْبَتَهُ مَا كَانَ فِيهِمْ مِثْلُهُ يَعْنِي فِي أَهْلِ حِمْصَ يَعْنِي الْجُرْجُسِيَّ ‏.‏
27.en: ’A’ishah said :The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was asked about bit’. He replied: Every liquor which intoxicates is forbidden. Abu Dawud said: I read out this tradition to Yazid bin 'Abd Rabbihi al-Jurjisi. Muhammad bin Hard told you this tradition from al-Zabidi from al-Zuhri through his chain of narrators. This version added: Bit' is the nabidh from honey, which the people of the Yemen would drink. Abu Dawud said: I heard Ahmad bin Hanbal say: There is no god but Allah. there was none stronger in memory and like al-Jurjisi among the people of Hims
27.hi: Aisha kehti hain: Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) se bit' (shehad ki sharaab) ke baare mein poocha gaya. Aapne jawaab diya: Har nasha karne wala mashroob haraam hai. Abu Dawud kehte hain: Maine yeh riwayat Yazid bin Abd Rabbihi al-Jurjisi ko padh kar sunaayi. Muhammad bin Harb ne aapko yeh riwayat al-Zubaidi se, al-Zuhri se, unki sanad ke zariye bataayi. Iss version mein izaafa hai: Bit' shehad se banaaya jaane wala nabidh hai jo Yemen ke log piya karte the. Abu Dawud kehte hain: Maine Ahmad bin Hanbal ko kehte suna: Koi ma'bood nahi Allah ke siwa, Hims ke logon mein al-Jurjisi jaisa mazboot yaad-daast wala koi na tha.

27.ar: حَدَّثَنَا هَنَّادُ بْنُ السَّرِيِّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَةُ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ إِسْحَاقَ - عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ، عَنْ مَرْثَدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْيَزَنِيِّ، عَنْ دَيْلَمٍ الْحِمْيَرِيِّ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّا بِأَرْضٍ بَارِدَةٍ نُعَالِجُ فِيهَا عَمَلاً شَدِيدًا وَإِنَّا نَتَّخِذُ شَرَابًا مِنْ هَذَا الْقَمْحِ نَتَقَوَّى بِهِ عَلَى أَعْمَالِنَا وَعَلَى بَرْدِ بِلاَدِنَا ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ هَلْ يُسْكِرُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَاجْتَنِبُوهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ فَإِنَّ النَّاسَ غَيْرُ تَارِكِيهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَإِنْ لَمْ يَتْرُكُوهُ فَقَاتِلُوهُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
27.en: Narrated Daylam al-Himyari: I asked the Prophet (ﷺ) and said: Messenger of Allah! we live in a cold land in which we do heavy work and we make a liquor from wheat to get strength from if for our work and to stand the cold of our country. He asked: Is it intoxicating? I replied: Yes. He said: You must avoid it. I said: The people will not abandon it. He said: If they do not abandon it, fight with them
27.hi: Hazrat Daylam al-Himyari bayaan karte hain: Maine Nabi (ﷺ) se poocha aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool! Hum ek thandi zameen mein rehte hain jahan hum sakht kaam karte hain aur hum gehun se ek mashroob banaate hain taake apne kaam ke liye taaqat le sakein aur apne mulk ki thand jhel sakein. Aapne poocha: Kya yeh nasha karta hai? Maine jawaab diya: Ji haan. Aapne kaha: Tumhein isse bachna chaahiye. Maine kaha: Log isse chhodenge nahi. Aapne kaha: Agar woh isse na chhodein, unse jang karo.

27.ar: حَدَّثَنَا وَهْبُ بْنُ بَقِيَّةَ، عَنْ خَالِدٍ، عَنْ عَاصِمِ بْنِ كُلَيْبٍ، عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ شَرَابٍ مِنَ الْعَسَلِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ ذَاكَ الْبِتْعُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ وَيُنْتَبَذُ مِنَ الشَّعِيرِ وَالذُّرَةِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ ذَاكَ الْمِزْرُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَخْبِرْ قَوْمَكَ أَنَّ كُلَّ مُسْكِرٍ حَرَامٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
27.en: Abu Musa said :I asked the prophet (ﷺ) about wine made from honey. He said: That is bit. I said: And the one made from barley and millet ? He said :That is mizr. He then said: Tell your people that every intoxicant is prohibited
27.hi: Abu Musa kehte hain: Maine Nabi (ﷺ) se shehad se banaayi gayi sharaab ke baare mein poocha. Aapne kaha: Yeh bit' hai. Maine poocha: Aur jau aur bajra se banaayi gayi? Aapne jawaab diya: Yeh mizr hai. Fir aapne kaha: Apni qaum ko bataao ke har nasha karne wali cheez haraam hai.

27.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ، عَنِ الْوَلِيدِ بْنِ عَبْدَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، أَنَّ نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنِ الْخَمْرِ وَالْمَيْسِرِ وَالْكُوبَةِ وَالْغُبَيْرَاءِ وَقَالَ ‏ "‏ كُلُّ مُسْكِرٍ حَرَامٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو دَاوُدَ قَالَ ابْنُ سَلاَمٍ أَبُو عُبَيْدٍ الْغُبَيْرَاءُ السُّكُرْكَةُ تُعْمَلُ مِنَ الذُّرَةِ شَرَابٌ يَعْمَلُهُ الْحَبَشَةُ ‏.‏
27.en: Narrated Abdullah ibn Amr ibn al-'As: The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade wine (khamr), game of chance (maysir), drum (kubah), and wine made from millet (ghubayrah), saying: Every intoxicant is forbidden. Abu Dawud said: Ibn Sallam Abu 'Ubaid said: Ghubairah was an intoxicant liquor made from millet. This wine was made by the Abyssinians
27.hi: Hazrat Abdullah bin Amr bin al-As bayaan karte hain: Nabi (ﷺ) ne sharaab (khamr), juay (maysir), dhol (kubah), aur bajre se banaayi gayi sharaab (ghubayrah) se mana kiya, kehte hue: Har nasha karne wali cheez haraam hai. Abu Dawud kehte hain: Ibn Sallam Abu Ubaid kehte hain: Ghubairah bajre se banaayi gayi ek nasha karne wali sharaab thi. Yeh sharaab Habashi log banaate the.

27.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو شِهَابٍ عَبْدُ رَبِّهِ بْنُ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو الْفُقَيْمِيِّ، عَنِ الْحَكَمِ بْنِ عُتَيْبَةَ، عَنْ شَهْرِ بْنِ حَوْشَبٍ، عَنْ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ، قَالَتْ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ كُلِّ مُسْكِرٍ وَمُفَتِّرٍ ‏.‏
27.en: Narrated Umm Salamah, Ummul Mu'minin: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) forbade every intoxicant and everything which produces languidness
27.hi: Hazrat Umm Salamah, Ummul-Momineen, bayaan karti hain: Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne har nasha karne wali cheez se, aur har us cheez se mana kiya jo sustee paida kare.

27.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، وَمُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مَهْدِيٌّ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ مَيْمُونٍ - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عُثْمَانَ، - قَالَ مُوسَى هُوَ عَمْرُو بْنُ سَلْمٍ الأَنْصَارِيُّ - عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، رضى الله عنها قَالَتْ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ كُلُّ مُسْكِرٍ حَرَامٌ وَمَا أَسْكَرَ مِنْهُ الْفَرْقُ فَمِلْءُ الْكَفِّ مِنْهُ حَرَامٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
27.en: Narrated Aisha, Ummul Mu'minin: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say: Every intoxicant is forbidden; if a faraq of anything causes intoxication, a handful of it is forbidden
27.hi: Hazrat Aisha, Ummul-Momineen, bayaan karti hain: Maine Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ko yeh kehte suna: Har nasha karne wali cheez haraam hai; agar kisi cheez ka faraq (naap) nasha karta hai, iski ek mutthi bhi haraam hai.

27.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ حَنْبَلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا زَيْدُ بْنُ الْحُبَابِ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاوِيَةُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ، عَنْ حَاتِمِ بْنِ حُرَيْثٍ، عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ، قَالَ دَخَلَ عَلَيْنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ غَنْمٍ فَتَذَاكَرْنَا الطِّلاَءَ فَقَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو مَالِكٍ الأَشْعَرِيُّ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ لَيَشْرَبَنَّ نَاسٌ مِنْ أُمَّتِي الْخَمْرَ يُسَمُّونَهَا بِغَيْرِ اسْمِهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
27.en: Narrated AbdurRahman ibn Ghanam: Malik ibn AbuMaryam said: AbdurRahman ibn Ghanam entered upon us and we discussed tila' and he said: AbuMalik al-Ash'ari told me that he heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say: Some of my people will assuredly drink wine calling it by another name
27.hi: Hazrat Abdur Rahman bin Ghanam bayaan karte hain: Malik bin Abu Maryam kehte hain: Abdur Rahman bin Ghanam humaare paas dakhil hue aur humne tila' (angoor ki sharaab) ka zikr kiya, aur unhone kaha: Abu Malik al-Ash'ari ne mujhe bataaya ke unhone Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ko yeh kehte suna: Mere logon mein se kuch zaroor sharaab peengay, isse doosre naam se pukaarte hue.

27.ar: قَالَ أَبُو دَاوُدَ حَدَّثَنَا شَيْخٌ، مِنْ أَهْلِ وَاسِطٍ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مَنْصُورٍ الْحَارِثُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ سُفْيَانَ الثَّوْرِيَّ، وَسُئِلَ، عَنِ الدَّاذِيِّ، فَقَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لَيَشْرَبَنَّ نَاسٌ مِنْ أُمَّتِي الْخَمْرَ يُسَمُّونَهَا بِغَيْرِ اسْمِهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو دَاوُدَ وَقَالَ سُفْيَانُ الثَّوْرِيُّ الدَّاذِيُّ شَرَابُ الْفَاسِقِينَ ‏.‏
27.en: Abu Dawud said:An old man of the people of Wasit narrated from Abu Mansur al-Harith bin Mansur saying: I heard Sufyan Al-Thawri who was asked about al-dadhi. He said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Some of my people will assuredly drink wine calling it by another name
27.hi: Abu Dawud kehte hain: Wasit ke logon mein se ek boodhe aadmi ne Abu Mansur al-Harith bin Mansur se, kehte hue riwayat ki: Maine Sufyan al-Thawri ko dadhi ke baare mein poocha jaate suna. Unhone kaha: Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne kaha: Mere logon mein se kuch zaroor sharaab peengay, isse doosre naam se pukaarte hue.

27.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ بْنُ زِيَادٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مَنْصُورُ بْنُ حَيَّانَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، وَابْنِ، عَبَّاسٍ قَالاَ نَشْهَدُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنِ الدُّبَّاءِ وَالْحَنْتَمِ وَالْمُزَفَّتِ وَالنَّقِيرِ ‏.‏
27.en: Ibn ‘Umar and Ibn ‘Abbas said :We testify that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) forbade (the use of) gourds, green jars, receptacles smeared with pitch, and hollowed stumps of palm-trees
27.hi: Ibn Umar aur Ibn Abbas kehte hain: Hum gawaahi dete hain ke Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne (istemaal se) mana kiya: kaddu ke bartano, hari matke, tar se lipe hue bartano, aur khajoor ke darakht ke khoke bane hue bartano.

27.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، وَمُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، - الْمَعْنَى - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ يَعْلَى، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ حَكِيمٍ - عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ، يَقُولُ حَرَّمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَبِيذَ الْجَرِّ فَخَرَجْتُ فَزِعًا مِنْ قَوْلِهِ حَرَّمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَبِيذَ الْجَرِّ فَدَخَلْتُ عَلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ فَقُلْتُ أَمَا تَسْمَعُ مَا يَقُولُ ابْنُ عُمَرَ قَالَ وَمَا ذَاكَ قُلْتُ قَالَ حَرَّمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَبِيذَ الْجَرِّ ‏.‏ قَالَ صَدَقَ حَرَّمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَبِيذَ الْجَرِّ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ مَا الْجَرُّ قَالَ كُلُّ شَىْءٍ يُصْنَعُ مِنْ مَدَرٍ ‏.‏
27.en: Adb Allah bin 'Umar said:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) forbade the nabidh (date-wine) of jarr. I was alarmed by his statement: The Apostel of Allah (ﷺ) forbade the nabidh of jarr. I then entered upon Ibn ‘Abbas and asked him : Are you listening to what Ibn Umar says ? He asked : What is that ? I said : The Apostel of Allah (ﷺ) forbade the nabidh of jarr . He said :He spoke the truth. The Apostel of Allah (ﷺ) forbade the nabidh of jarr .I asked :what is jarr ? He replied : Anything made of clay
27.hi: Abdullah bin Umar kehte hain: Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne matki ke nabidh se mana kiya. Main unke bayaan se pareshaan hua: Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne matki ke nabidh se mana kiya. Main fir Ibn Abbas ke paas gaya aur poocha: Kya aap sun rahe hain jo Ibn Umar keh rahe hain? Unhone poocha: Woh kya hai? Maine kaha: Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne matki ke nabidh se mana kiya. Unhone kaha: Woh sach kehte hain. Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne matki ke nabidh se mana kiya. Maine poocha: Matki kya hai? Unhone jawaab diya: Mitti se banaayi gayi koi bhi cheez.

27.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُبَيْدٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبَّادُ بْنُ عَبَّادٍ، عَنْ أَبِي جَمْرَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ، يَقُولُ - وَقَالَ مُسَدَّدٌ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، وَهَذَا، حَدِيثُ سُلَيْمَانَ قَالَ - قَدِمَ وَفْدُ عَبْدِ الْقَيْسِ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّا هَذَا الْحَىَّ مِنْ رَبِيعَةَ قَدْ حَالَ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَكَ كُفَّارُ مُضَرَ وَلَسْنَا نَخْلُصُ إِلَيْكَ إِلاَّ فِي شَهْرٍ حَرَامٍ فَمُرْنَا بِشَىْءٍ نَأْخُذُ بِهِ وَنَدْعُو إِلَيْهِ مَنْ وَرَاءَنَا ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ آمُرُكُمْ بِأَرْبَعٍ وَأَنْهَاكُمْ عَنْ أَرْبَعٍ الإِيمَانُ بِاللَّهِ وَشَهَادَةُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَعَقَدَ بِيَدِهِ وَاحِدَةً ‏.‏ وَقَالَ مُسَدَّدٌ الإِيمَانُ بِاللَّهِ ثُمَّ فَسَّرَهَا لَهُمْ شَهَادَةَ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ ‏"‏ وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ وَإِقَامُ الصَّلاَةِ وَإِيتَاءُ الزَّكَاةِ وَأَنْ تُؤَدُّوا الْخُمُسَ مِمَّا غَنِمْتُمْ وَأَنْهَاكُمْ عَنِ الدُّبَّاءِ وَالْحَنْتَمِ وَالْمُزَفَّتِ وَالْمُقَيَّرِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ ابْنُ عُبَيْدٍ النَّقِيرِ مَكَانَ الْمُقَيَّرِ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ مُسَدَّدٌ وَالنَّقِيرِ وَالْمُقَيَّرِ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرِ الْمُزَفَّتِ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو دَاوُدَ أَبُو جَمْرَةَ نَصْرُ بْنُ عِمْرَانَ الضُّبَعِيُّ ‏.‏
27.en: Ibn 'Abbas said:The deputation of 'Abd al-Qais came to Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and said: This is the tribe of Rabi'ah, and the infidels of Mudar are between us and you. We are able to come to you only in the sacred month. So give a decisive command which we may follow ourselves and to which we call those at home behind us. He (the Prophet) said: I command you to observe four things, and forbade you four things: Belief in Allah. the testimony that there is no god but Allah, and he expresses one by folding his hand. Musadad's version has: Faith in Allah, and he explained to them: The testimony that there is no god but Allah and that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah, observance of prayer, payment of zakat, and your giving the filth of the booty. I forbid you the use of pumpkins, green jarrs, vessels smeared with pitch, and hollow stumps of palm-trees. Ibn 'Ubaid's version has word muqayyar (vessels smeared with pitch) instead of naqir (hollow stumps). Musaddad's version has naqir and muqayyar (pitch); he did not mention muzaffat (vessels smeared with pitch). Abu Dawud said: The name of Abu Jamrah is Nasr bin 'Imran al-Duba'i
27.hi: Ibn Abbas kehte hain: Abd al-Qais ka wafd Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ke paas aaya aur kaha: Yeh Rabi'ah qabeela hai, aur Mudar ke kaafir humaare aur aapke darmiyan hain. Hum sirf haram mahine mein aap tak pahunch sakte hain. So humein ek pukhta hukum dein jise hum khud apnaayein aur jise hum peechhe apne gharwalon ko bataayein. Aapne (Nabi ne) kaha: Main tumhein chaar cheezon ki paalna ka hukum deta hoon, aur tumhein chaar cheezon se mana karta hoon: Allah par imaan, gawaahi ke Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi, aur woh ek haath jodkar ishara karte hain. Musaddad ke version mein hai: Allah par imaan, aur unhone unhein wazeh kiya: gawaahi ke Allah ke siwa koi ma'bood nahi aur Muhammad Allah ke Rasool hain, namaz ki paalna, zakat ki adaaigi, aur tumhaara ghaneemat ka gandagi (khums) dena. Main tumhein kaddu, hari matki, tar se lipe hue bartano, aur khajoor ke darakht ke khoke bane hue bartano se mana karta hoon. Ibn Ubaid ke version mein 'muqayyar' (tar se lipe hue bartan) lafz hai 'naqir' (khoke bane hue) ke bajaaye. Musaddad ke version mein hai naqir aur muqayyar; unhone muzaffat (tar se lipe hue bartano) zikr nahi kiya. Abu Dawud kehte hain: Abu Jamrah ka naam Nasr bin Imran al-Duba'i hai.

27.ar: حَدَّثَنَا وَهْبُ بْنُ بَقِيَّةَ، عَنْ نُوحِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَوْنٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِيرِينَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ لِوَفْدِ عَبْدِ الْقَيْسِ ‏ "‏ أَنْهَاكُمْ عَنِ النَّقِيرِ وَالْمُقَيَّرِ وَالْحَنْتَمِ وَالدُّبَّاءِ وَالْمَزَادَةِ الْمَجْبُوبَةِ وَلَكِنِ اشْرَبْ فِي سِقَائِكَ وَأَوْكِهْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
27.en: Abu Hurairah said:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to the deputation of 'Abd al-Qais: I forbid you the use of hollow stumps, vessels smeared with pitch, green harrs, pumpkins, and a skin cut off at the top, but drink from your skin and tie it with string
27.hi: Abu Hurairah kehte hain: Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne Abd al-Qais ke wafd se kaha: Main tumhein khoke bane hue bartano, tar se lipe hue bartano, hari matki, kaddu, aur uper se kaate hue khaal se mana karta hoon, lekin apni khaal se piyo aur isse dhaagey se baandho.

27.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبَانُ، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، وَسَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، فِي قِصَّةِ وَفْدِ عَبْدِ الْقَيْسِ قَالُوا فِيمَ نَشْرَبُ يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ فَقَالَ نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ عَلَيْكُمْ بِأَسْقِيَةِ الأَدَمِ الَّتِي يُلاَثُ عَلَى أَفْوَاهِهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
27.en: In the story of the deputation of AbdulQays Ibn Abbas said:They (the people) asked: In which should we drink, Prophet of Allah? The Prophet (ﷺ) said: You should use those skin vessels that are tied at their mouths
27.hi: Abd al-Qais ke wafd ki kahaani mein, Ibn Abbas kehte hain: Unhone (logon ne) poocha: Hum kisme piyein, Allah ke Nabi? Nabi (ﷺ) ne kaha: Tumhein khaal ke bartan istemaal karne chaahiye jo unke munh par baandhe hue hon.

27.ar: حَدَّثَنَا وَهْبُ بْنُ بَقِيَّةَ، عَنْ خَالِدٍ، عَنْ عَوْفٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الْقَمُوصِ، زَيْدِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ حَدَّثَنِي رَجُلٌ، كَانَ مِنَ الْوَفْدِ الَّذِينَ وَفَدُوا إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ عَبْدِ الْقَيْسِ يَحْسِبُ عَوْفٌ أَنَّ اسْمَهُ قَيْسُ بْنُ النُّعْمَانِ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ تَشْرَبُوا فِي نَقِيرٍ وَلاَ مُزَفَّتٍ وَلاَ دُبَّاءٍ وَلاَ حَنْتَمٍ وَاشْرَبُوا فِي الْجِلْدِ الْمُوكَإِ عَلَيْهِ فَإِنِ اشْتَدَّ فَاكْسِرُوهُ بِالْمَاءِ فَإِنْ أَعْيَاكُمْ فَأَهْرِيقُوهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
27.en: A man of the deputation of 'Abd al-Qais who came to the Prophet (ﷺ) said - the narrator 'Awf thinks that his name was Qais bin al-Nu'man:The Prophet (ﷺ) said: Do not drink from hollowed stumps, vessel smeared with pitch, pumpkins, and green jars, but drink from a skin which is tied with string. If the drink ferments, lighten it by infusing water. If you are helpless, then pour it away
27.hi: Abd al-Qais ke wafd ka ek aadmi jo Nabi (ﷺ) ke paas aaye - raawi Awf ka khayal hai unka naam Qais bin al-Nu'man tha - bayaan karte hain: Nabi (ﷺ) ne kaha: Khoke bane hue, tar se lipe hue bartano, kaddu, aur hari matki se mat piyo, lekin us khaal se piyo jo dhaagey se baandhi ho. Agar mashroob mein khamir uthe, isse paani milaakar halka karo. Agar tum majboor ho jaao, isse bahaa do.

27.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أَحْمَدَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ بَذِيمَةَ، حَدَّثَنِي قَيْسُ بْنُ حَبْتَرٍ النَّهْشَلِيُّ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ وَفْدَ عَبْدِ الْقَيْسِ، قَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ فِيمَ نَشْرَبُ قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ تَشْرَبُوا فِي الدُّبَّاءِ وَلاَ فِي الْمُزَفَّتِ وَلاَ فِي النَّقِيرِ وَانْتَبِذُوا فِي الأَسْقِيَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ فَإِنِ اشْتَدَّ فِي الأَسْقِيَةِ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَصُبُّوا عَلَيْهِ الْمَاءَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَهُمْ فِي الثَّالِثَةِ أَوِ الرَّابِعَةِ ‏"‏ أَهْرِيقُوهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ حَرَّمَ عَلَىَّ أَوْ حُرِّمَ الْخَمْرُ وَالْمَيْسِرُ وَالْكُوبَةُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَكُلُّ مُسْكِرٍ حَرَامٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ سُفْيَانُ فَسَأَلْتُ عَلِيَّ بْنَ بَذِيمَةَ عَنِ الْكُوبَةِ قَالَ الطَّبْلُ ‏.‏
27.en: Ibn ‘Abbas said :The deputation of ‘Abd al-Qais asked (the prophet):From which(vessels)should we drink ? He (the prophet) replied: Do not drink from the pumpkins, vessels smeared with pitch, and hollow stumps , and steep dates in skins. They asked: Messenger of Allah, if it ferments? He replied: infuse water in it. They asked: Messenger of Allah...” (repeating the same words). He replied to them third or fourth time: Pour it away. He then said: Allah has forbidden me, or he said: He has forbidden me wine, game of chance and kubah(drums). He said: Every intoxicant is unlawful. Sufyan said: I asked ‘All b. Badhimah about kubah	. He replied: Drum
27.hi: Ibn Abbas kehte hain: Abd al-Qais ke wafd ne (Nabi se) poocha: Hum kisme piyein? Aapne (Nabi ne) jawaab diya: Kaddu, tar se lipe hue bartano, aur khoke bane hue bartano mein mat piyo, aur khajoor ko khaal mein bhigo do. Unhone poocha: Allah ke Rasool, agar isme khamir uthe? Aapne jawaab diya: Isme paani milaao. Unhone dobara poocha: Allah ke Rasool... (wahi alfaaz dohraate hue). Aapne teesri ya chauthi baar unhein jawaab diya: Isse bahaa do. Fir aapne kaha: Allah ne mujhe mana kiya hai, ya aapne kaha: Usne mujhe sharaab, juay, aur kubah (dhol) se mana kiya hai. Aapne kaha: Har nasha karne wali cheez haraam hai. Sufyan kehte hain: Maine Ali bin Badhimah se kubah ke baare mein poocha. Unhone jawaab diya: Dhol.

27.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ سُمَيْعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ عُمَيْرٍ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ، عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَالَ نَهَانَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الدُّبَّاءِ وَالْحَنْتَمِ وَالنَّقِيرِ وَالْجِعَةِ ‏.‏
27.en: Narrated Ali ibn AbuTalib: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) forbade us the use of pumpkins, green jars, hollow stumps and wine made from barley
27.hi: Hazrat Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) bayaan karte hain: Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne humein kaddu, hari matki, khoke bane hue bartano, aur jau se banaayi gayi sharaab se mana kiya.

27.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَرِّفُ بْنُ وَاصِلٍ، عَنْ مُحَارِبِ بْنِ دِثَارٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ بُرَيْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ نَهَيْتُكُمْ عَنْ ثَلاَثٍ وَأَنَا آمُرُكُمْ بِهِنَّ نَهَيْتُكُمْ عَنْ زِيَارَةِ الْقُبُورِ فَزُورُوهَا فَإِنَّ فِي زِيَارَتِهَا تَذْكِرَةً وَنَهَيْتُكُمْ عَنِ الأَشْرِبَةِ أَنْ تَشْرَبُوا إِلاَّ فِي ظُرُوفِ الأَدَمِ فَاشْرَبُوا فِي كُلِّ وِعَاءٍ غَيْرَ أَنْ لاَ تَشْرَبُوا مُسْكِرًا وَنَهَيْتُكُمْ عَنْ لُحُومِ الأَضَاحِي أَنْ تَأْكُلُوهَا بَعْدَ ثَلاَثٍ فَكُلُوا وَاسْتَمْتِعُوا بِهَا فِي أَسْفَارِكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
27.en: Narrated Buraydah ibn al-Hasib: The Prophet (ﷺ) said: I forbade you three things, and now I command (permit) you for them. I forbade you to visit graves, now you may visit them, for in visiting them there is admonition. I forbade you drinks except from skin vessels, but now you may drink from any kind of vessels, but do not drink an intoxicant. I forbade you to eat the meat of sacrificial animals after three days, but now you may eat and enjoy it during your journeys
27.hi: Hazrat Buraydah bin al-Hasib bayaan karte hain: Nabi (ﷺ) ne kaha: Maine tumhein teen cheezon se mana kiya tha, aur ab main tumhein iski ijazat deta hoon. Maine tumhein qabron par jaane se mana kiya, ab tum jaa sakte ho, kyunki inpar jaane se naseehat milti hai. Maine tumhein khaal ke bartano ke siwa kisi aur mashroob se mana kiya, lekin ab tum kisi bhi bartan se pi sakte ho, lekin nasha karne wali cheez mat piyo. Maine tumhein qurbani ke jaanwaron ka gosht teen din ke baad khaane se mana kiya, lekin ab tum apne safar mein isse khaa aur maza le sakte ho.

27.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، حَدَّثَنِي مَنْصُورٌ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ لَمَّا نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الأَوْعِيَةِ قَالَ قَالَتِ الأَنْصَارُ إِنَّهُ لاَ بُدَّ لَنَا ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏ "‏ فَلاَ إِذًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
27.en: Jabir b. ‘Abd Allah said:When the Messenger of Allah(ﷺ) forbade the use of(wine) vessels, Ansar said: They are inevitable for us. Thereupon he said: If so, then no
27.hi: Jabir bin Abdullah kehte hain: Jab Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne (sharaab ke) bartano se mana kiya, Ansar ne kaha: Yeh humaare liye laazmi hain. Isper aapne kaha: Agar aisa hai, to nahi.

27.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ، عَنْ زِيَادِ بْنِ فَيَّاضٍ، عَنْ أَبِي عِيَاضٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، قَالَ ذَكَرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الأَوْعِيَةَ الدُّبَّاءَ وَالْحَنْتَمَ وَالْمُزَفَّتَ وَالنَّقِيرَ فَقَالَ أَعْرَابِيٌّ إِنَّهُ لاَ ظُرُوفَ لَنَا ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ اشْرَبُوا مَا حَلَّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
27.en: ‘Abd Allah b.’ Amr said:The Prophet(ﷺ) mentioned the vessels: pumpkins, green jarrs, vessels smeared with pitch and hollow stumps. A desert Arab said: We have no vessels(except these). He said: Drink(from them) what is lawful
27.hi: Abdullah bin Amr kehte hain: Nabi (ﷺ) ne bartano ka zikr kiya: kaddu, hari matki, tar se lipe hue bartan, aur khoke bane hue bartan. Ek registaan wale Arab ne kaha: Humaare paas (inke siwa) koi bartan nahi. Aapne kaha: Pi lo (unme se) jo halal hai.

27.ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عَلِيٍّ - حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ آدَمَ، حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ، بِإِسْنَادِهِ قَالَ ‏ "‏ اجْتَنِبُوا مَا أَسْكَرَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
27.en: The tradition mentioned above has also been transmitted by Sharik through a different chain of narrators. This version has:Avoid that which produces intoxication
27.hi: Upar zikr ki gayi riwayat bhi Sharik se isi tarah ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai. Iss version mein hai: Us cheez se bacho jo nasha paida kare.

27.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ النُّفَيْلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ كَانَ يُنْبَذُ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي سِقَاءٍ فَإِذَا لَمْ يَجِدُوا سِقَاءً نُبِذَ لَهُ فِي تَوْرٍ مِنْ حِجَارَةٍ ‏.‏
27.en: Jabir b. ‘Abd Allah said:Dates were steeped for the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) in a skin, but when they could not find a skin, they were steeped for him in a small stone vessel
27.hi: Jabir bin Abdullah kehte hain: Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ke liye khajoorein ek khaal mein bhigo yi gayin, lekin jab unhein koi khaal na mili, unhein unke liye ek chhote patthar ke bartan mein bhigo diya gaya.

27.ar: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ أَبِي رَبَاحٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ نَهَى أَنْ يُنْتَبَذَ الزَّبِيبُ وَالتَّمْرُ جَمِيعًا وَنَهَى أَنْ يُنْتَبَذَ الْبُسْرُ وَالرُّطَبُ جَمِيعًا ‏.‏
27.en: Jabir b.’Abd Allah said:The Messenger of Allah(ﷺ) forbade mixing of raisins and dried dates: and unripe dates and fresh dates
27.hi: Jabir bin Abdullah kehte hain: Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne kishmish aur sookhi khajoor ko milaane se mana kiya, aur kachchi pakti khajoor aur taazi khajoor ko milaane se.

27.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو سَلَمَةَ، مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبَانُ، حَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّهُ نَهَى عَنْ خَلِيطِ الزَّبِيبِ، وَالتَّمْرِ، وَعَنْ خَلِيطِ الْبُسْرِ، وَالتَّمْرِ، وَعَنْ خَلِيطِ الزَّهْوِ، وَالرُّطَبِ، وَقَالَ، ‏ "‏ انْتَبِذُوا كُلَّ وَاحِدٍ عَلَى حِدَةٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِهَذَا الْحَدِيثِ ‏.‏
27.en: ‘Abd Allah b. Abi Qatadah said that his father Abu Qatadah forbade mixing raisins and dried dates, mixing unripe dates and fresh dates, and mixing dates beginning to take on colour and fresh dates. He said:Make nabidh (drink) from each separately. He (the narrator Yahya) said: Abu Salamah bin 'Abd al-Rahman narrated to me this tradition on the authority of Abu Qatadah from the Prophet (ﷺ)
27.hi: Abdullah bin Abi Qatadah bayaan karte hain ke unke walid Abu Qatadah ne kishmish aur sookhi khajoor ko milaane se, kachchi pakti khajoor aur taazi khajoor ko milaane se, aur rang badalte khajoor aur taazi khajoor ko milaane se mana kiya. Unhone kaha: Har ek se alag-alag nabidh (mashroob) banaao. Raawi Yahya kehte hain: Abu Salamah bin Abdur Rahman ne yeh riwayat mujhe Abu Qatadah ke hawale se, Nabi (ﷺ) se bataayi.

27.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَحَفْصُ بْنُ عُمَرَ النَّمَرِيُّ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنِ الْحَكَمِ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى، - عَنْ رَجُلٍ، - قَالَ حَفْصٌ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ نَهَى عَنِ الْبَلَحِ وَالتَّمْرِ وَالزَّبِيبِ وَالتَّمْرِ ‏.‏
27.en: Narrated A man: A man from among the Companions of the Prophet (ﷺ) said: The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade (mixing) unripe dates and dried dates, and (mixing) raisins and dried dates
27.hi: Ek aadmi bayaan karte hain: Nabi (ﷺ) ke sahaba mein se ek aadmi ne kaha: Nabi (ﷺ) ne kachchi pakti khajoor aur sookhi khajoor ko, aur kishmish aur sookhi khajoor ko milaane se mana kiya.

27.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ ثَابِتِ بْنِ عُمَارَةَ، حَدَّثَتْنِي رَيْطَةُ، عَنْ كَبْشَةَ بِنْتِ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ، قَالَتْ سَأَلْتُ أُمَّ سَلَمَةَ مَا كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَنْهَى عَنْهُ قَالَتْ كَانَ يَنْهَانَا أَنْ نَعْجُمَ النَّوَى طَبْخًا أَوْ نَخْلِطَ الزَّبِيبَ وَالتَّمْرَ ‏.‏
27.en: Narrated Umm Salamah, Ummul Mu'minin: Kabshah, daughter of AbuMaryam, asked Umm Salamah (Allah be pleased with her): What did the Prophet (ﷺ) prohibit? She replied: He forbade us to boil dates so much so that the kernels are spoiled, and to mix raisins and dried dates
27.hi: Hazrat Umm Salamah, Ummul-Momineen, bayaan karti hain: Kabshah, Abu Maryam ki beti, ne Umm Salamah se poocha: Nabi (ﷺ) ne kya mana kiya? Unhone jawaab diya: Aapne humein khajoor itni ubaalne se mana kiya ke unke beej kharab ho jaayein, aur kishmish aur sookhi khajoor ko milaane se.

27.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ دَاوُدَ، عَنْ مِسْعَرٍ، عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ امْرَأَةٍ، مِنْ بَنِي أَسَدٍ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، رضى الله عنها أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يُنْبَذُ لَهُ زَبِيبٌ فَيُلْقِي فِيهِ تَمْرًا وَتَمْرٌ فَيُلْقِي فِيهِ الزَّبِيبَ ‏.‏
27.en: Narrated Aisha, Ummul Mu'minin: Raisins were steeped for the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and then dried dates were infused in them, or dried dates were steeped and then raisins were infused in them
27.hi: Hazrat Aisha, Ummul-Momineen, bayaan karti hain: Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ke liye kishmish bhigo yi gayin aur fir sookhi khajoor unme daali gayin, ya sookhi khajoor bhigo yi gayin aur fir kishmish unme daali gayin.

27.ar: حَدَّثَنَا زَيَادُ بْنُ يَحْيَى الْحَسَّانِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَحْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَتَّابُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ الْحِمَّانِيُّ، حَدَّثَتْنِي صَفِيَّةُ بِنْتُ عَطِيَّةَ، قَالَتْ دَخَلْتُ مَعَ نِسْوَةٍ مِنْ عَبْدِ الْقَيْسِ عَلَى عَائِشَةَ فَسَأَلْنَاهَا عَنِ التَّمْرِ وَالزَّبِيبِ فَقَالَتْ كُنْتُ آخُذُ قَبْضَةً مِنْ تَمْرٍ وَقَبْضَةً مِنْ زَبِيبٍ فَأُلْقِيهِ فِي إِنَاءٍ فَأَمْرُسُهُ ثُمَّ أَسْقِيهِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
27.en: Narrated Aisha, Ummul Mu'minin: Safiyyah, daughter of Atiyyah, said: I entered upon Aisha with some women of AbdulQays, and asked her about mixing dried dates and raisins (for drink). She replied: I used to take a handful of dried dates and a handful or raisins and put them in a vessel, and then crush them (and soak in water). Then I would give it to the Prophet (ﷺ) to drink
27.hi: Hazrat Aisha, Ummul-Momineen, bayaan karti hain: Safiyyah bint Atiyyah kehti hain: Main Aisha ke paas kuch Abd al-Qais ki auraton ke saath dakhil hui, aur maine unse sookhi khajoor aur kishmish milane (mashroob ke liye) ke baare mein poocha. Unhone jawaab diya: Main sookhi khajoor ki ek mutthi aur kishmish ki ek mutthi leti aur unhein ek bartan mein daalti, fir unhein masal deti (aur paani mein bhigo deti). Fir main isse Nabi (ﷺ) ko peene ke liye deti.

27.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، وَعِكْرِمَةَ، أَنَّهُمَا كَانَا يَكْرَهَانِ الْبُسْرَ وَحْدَهُ وَيَأْخُذَانِ ذَلِكَ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ أَخْشَى أَنْ يَكُونَ الْمُزَّاءَ الَّذِي نُهِيَتْ عَنْهُ عَبْدُ الْقَيْسِ ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ لِقَتَادَةَ مَا الْمُزَّاءُ قَالَ النَّبِيذُ فِي الْحَنْتَمِ وَالْمُزَفَّتِ ‏.‏
27.en: Qatadah said on the authority of Jabir b. Zaid and ‘Ikrimah that they disapprove of drink made exclusively from unripe dates. This they reported on the authority of Ibn ‘Abbas said:I am afraid it may not be muzza from which(the people of) ‘Abd al-Qais were prohibited. I asked Qatadah : What is muzza’? He replied: Drink of dates made in a green jar and vessels smeared with pitch
27.hi: Qatadah, Jabir bin Zaid aur Ikrimah ke hawale se, kehte hain ke woh sirf kachchi pakti khajoor se banaaye gaye mashroob ko na-pasand karte the. Yeh unhone Ibn Abbas ke hawale se riwayat ki jinhone kaha: Mujhe dar hai ke yeh muzza na ho jisse Abd al-Qais ko mana kiya gaya. Maine Qatadah se poocha: Muzza kya hai? Unhone jawaab diya: Khajoor ka mashroob jo hari matki aur tar se lipe hue bartano mein banaaya jaaye.

27.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ضَمْرَةُ، عَنِ السَّيْبَانِيِّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الدَّيْلَمِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ أَتَيْنَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقُلْنَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَدْ عَلِمْتَ مَنْ نَحْنُ وَمِنْ أَيْنَ نَحْنُ فَإِلَى مَنْ نَحْنُ قَالَ ‏"‏ إِلَى اللَّهِ وَإِلَى رَسُولِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقُلْنَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ لَنَا أَعْنَابًا مَا نَصْنَعُ بِهَا قَالَ ‏"‏ زَبِّبُوهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قُلْنَا مَا نَصْنَعُ بِالزَّبِيبِ قَالَ ‏"‏ انْبِذُوهُ عَلَى غَدَائِكُمْ وَاشْرَبُوهُ عَلَى عَشَائِكُمْ وَانْبِذُوهُ عَلَى عَشَائِكُمْ وَاشْرَبُوهُ عَلَى غَدَائِكُمْ وَانْبِذُوهُ فِي الشِّنَانِ وَلاَ تَنْبِذُوهُ فِي الْقُلَلِ فَإِنَّهُ إِذَا تَأَخَّرَ عَنْ عَصْرِهِ صَارَ خَلاًّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
27.en: Narrated Ad-Daylami: We came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said to him: Messenger of Allah, you know who we are, from where we are and to whom we have come. He said: To Allah and His Apostle. We said: Messenger of Allah, we have grapes; what should we do with them? He said: Make them raisins. We then asked: What should we do with raisins? He replied: Steep them in the morning and drink in the evening, and steep them in the evening and drink in the morning. Steep them in skin vessels and do not steep them in earthen jar, for it it is delayed in pressing, it becomes vinegar
27.hi: Ad-Daylami kehte hain: Hum Nabi (ﷺ) ke paas aaye aur unse kaha: Allah ke Rasool, aap jaante hain hum kaun hain, hum kahan se hain, aur hum kiske paas aaye hain. Aapne kaha: Allah aur uske Rasool ke paas. Humne kaha: Allah ke Rasool, humaare paas angoor hain; hum inka kya karein? Aapne jawaab diya: Unhein kishmish banaao. Fir humne poocha: Hum kishmish ka kya karein? Aapne jawaab diya: Unhein subah bhigo do aur shaam ko piyo, aur unhein shaam bhigo do aur subah piyo. Unhein khaal ke bartano mein bhigo, matki mein nahi, kyunki agar isse nichodne mein deri ho, yeh sirka ban jaata hai.

27.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَجِيدِ الثَّقَفِيُّ، عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، عَنْ أُمِّهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، - رضى الله عنها - قَالَتْ كَانَ يُنْبَذُ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي سِقَاءٍ يُوكَأُ أَعْلاَهُ وَلَهُ عَزْلاَءُ يُنْبَذُ غُدْوَةً فَيَشْرَبُهُ عِشَاءً وَيُنْبَذُ عِشَاءً فَيَشْرَبُهُ غُدْوَةً ‏.‏
27.en: A’ishah said :Dates were steeped for the Apostel of Allah (ﷺ) in skin which was tied up at the top and had a mouth. What was steeped in the morning he would drink in the evening and what was steeped in the evening he would drink in the morning
27.hi: Aisha kehti hain: Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ke liye khajoorein ek khaal mein bhigo yi gayin jo oopar se baandhi gayi thi aur uska munh tha. Jo subah bhigo yi jaati, aap isse shaam ko peete, aur jo shaam ko bhigo yi jaati, aap isse subah peete.

27.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا الْمُعْتَمِرُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ شَبِيبَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ مُقَاتِلِ بْنِ حَيَّانَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَتْنِي عَمَّتِي، عَمْرَةُ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، رضى الله عنها أَنَّهَا كَانَتْ تَنْبِذُ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم غُدْوَةً فَإِذَا كَانَ مِنَ الْعَشِيِّ فَتَعَشَّى شَرِبَ عَلَى عَشَائِهِ وَإِنْ فَضَلَ شَىْءٌ صَبَبْتُهُ - أَوْ فَرَغْتُهُ - ثُمَّ تَنْبِذُ لَهُ بِاللَّيْلِ فَإِذَا أَصْبَحَ تَغَدَّى فَشَرِبَ عَلَى غَدَائِهِ قَالَتْ نَغْسِلُ السِّقَاءَ غُدْوَةً وَعَشِيَّةً فَقَالَ لَهَا أَبِي مَرَّتَيْنِ فِي يَوْمٍ قَالَتْ نَعَمْ ‏.‏
27.en: Narrated Aisha, Ummul Mu'minin: Amrah said on the authority of Aisha that she would steep dates for the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) in the morning. When the evening came, he took his dinner and drank it after his dinner. If anything remained, she poured it out. She then would steep for him at night. When the morning came, he took his morning meal and drank it after his morning meal. She said: The skin vessel was washed in the morning and in the evening. My father (Hayyan) said to her: Twice a day? She said: Yes
27.hi: Hazrat Aisha, Ummul-Momineen, bayaan karti hain: Amrah ne Aisha ke hawale se kaha ke woh Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ke liye khajoorein subah bhigo yi karti thi. Jab shaam hoti, aap apna khaana khaate aur apne khaane ke baad isse peete. Agar kuch baaqi rehta, woh isse phenk deti. Fir woh unke liye raat mein bhigo deti. Jab subah hoti, aap apna subah ka khaana khaate aur apne khaane ke baad isse peete. Unhone (Amrah ne) kaha: Khaal ka bartan subah aur shaam dono waqt dhoya jaata tha. Mere walid (Hayyan) ne unse poocha: Din mein do baar? Unhone jawaab diya: Ji haan.

27.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مَخْلَدُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي عُمَرَ، يَحْيَى الْبَهْرَانِيِّ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ كَانَ يُنْبَذُ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم الزَّبِيبُ فَيَشْرَبُهُ الْيَوْمَ وَالْغَدَ وَبَعْدَ الْغَدِ إِلَى مَسَاءِ الثَّالِثَةِ ثُمَّ يَأْمُرُ بِهِ فَيُسْقَى الْخَدَمَ أَوْ يُهَرَاقُ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو دَاوُدَ مَعْنَى يُسْقَى الْخَدَمَ يُبَادَرُ بِهِ الْفَسَادُ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو دَاوُدَ أَبُو عُمَرَ يَحْيَى بْنُ عُبَيْدٍ الْبَهْرَانِيُّ ‏.‏
27.en: Ibn abbas said :Raisins were steeped for the Prophet (ﷺ) and he would drink it in the morning and the night after, the following day and the night after. He then gave orders and it was given to servants to drinks or poured away. Abu Dawud said: That "it was given to servants to drink" means before it spoiled. Abu Dawud said: Abu 'Umar Yahya al-Bahrani
27.hi: Ibn Abbas kehte hain: Nabi (ﷺ) ke liye kishmish bhigo yi jaatin aur woh isse subah aur uske baad raat mein, agle din, aur uske baad raat mein peete. Fir aapne hukum diya aur yeh naukaron ko peene ke liye di jaati ya bahaa di jaati. Abu Dawud kehte hain: 'Naukaron ko di jaati' ka matlab hai kharaab hone se pehle. Abu Dawud kehte hain: Abu Umar Yahya al-Bahrani.

27.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ حَنْبَلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، قَالَ قَالَ ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ عُبَيْدَ بْنَ عُمَيْرٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَائِشَةَ، - رضى الله عنها - زَوْجَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم تُخْبِرُ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَمْكُثُ عِنْدَ زَيْنَبَ بِنْتِ جَحْشٍ فَيَشْرَبُ عِنْدَهَا عَسَلاً فَتَوَاصَيْتُ أَنَا وَحَفْصَةُ أَيَّتُنَا مَا دَخَلَ عَلَيْهَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلْتَقُلْ إِنِّي أَجِدُ مِنْكَ رِيحَ مَغَافِيرَ فَدَخَلَ عَلَى إِحْدَاهُنَّ فَقَالَتْ لَهُ ذَلِكَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ بَلْ شَرِبْتُ عَسَلاً عِنْدَ زَيْنَبَ بِنْتِ جَحْشٍ وَلَنْ أَعُودَ لَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَنَزَلَتْ ‏{‏ لِمَ تُحَرِّمُ مَا أَحَلَّ اللَّهُ لَكَ تَبْتَغِي ‏}‏ إِلَى ‏{‏ إِنْ تَتُوبَا إِلَى اللَّهِ ‏}‏ لِعَائِشَةَ وَحَفْصَةَ رضى الله عنهما ‏{‏ وَإِذْ أَسَرَّ النَّبِيُّ إِلَى بَعْضِ أَزْوَاجِهِ حَدِيثًا ‏}‏ لِقَوْلِهِ ‏"‏ بَلْ شَرِبْتُ عَسَلاً ‏"‏ ‏.‏
27.en: A’ishah said that the prophet (ﷺ) used to stay with Zainab, daughter of Jahsh, and drink honey. I and Hafsah counseled each other that if the Prophet (ﷺ) enters upon any of us, she must say :I find the smell of gum (maghafir) from you. He then entered upon one of them; she said that to him. Thereupon he said : No, I drank honey at (the house of) Zainab daughter of jahsh, and I will not do it again. Then the following verse came down :’’O Prophet !why holdest thou to be forbidden that which Allah has made lawful to thee ? ‘’Thou seekest. . . If you two turn in repentance to Allah ‘’ refers to Hafsah and A’ishah , and the verse: ‘’When the Prophet disclosed a matter in confidence to one of his consorts’’ refers to the statements of the Prophet (ﷺ) disclosed a matter in confidence to one of his consorts’’ refers to the statement of the Prophet (ﷺ) :No, I drank honey
27.hi: Aisha kehti hain ke Nabi (ﷺ) Zainab bint Jahsh ke paas thehra karte the aur shehad piya karte the. Main aur Hafsa ne aapas mein tay kiya ke agar Nabi (ﷺ) humme se kisi ke paas dakhil hon, unhein kehna chaahiye: Main aap se gum (maghafir) ki khushbu paati hoon. Fir aap unmein se ek ke paas dakhil hue; unhone yeh unse kaha. Isper aapne kaha: Nahi, maine Zainab bint Jahsh ke ghar shehad piya, aur main aisa dobara nahi karunga. Fir yeh aayat nazil hui: "Ae Nabi! Kyun aap us cheez ko haraam manaate hain jise Allah ne aapke liye halal kiya hai? Aap chahte hain...Agar tum dono Allah ki taraf tauba karo" (yeh) Hafsa aur Aisha ki taraf ishara karta hai, aur aayat: "Jab Nabi ne apni ek biwi ko chupke se koi baat bataayi" Nabi (ﷺ) ke us bayaan ki taraf ishara karta hai: 'Nahi, maine shehad piya.'

27.ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُحِبُّ الْحَلْوَاءَ وَالْعَسَلَ ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ بَعْضَ هَذَا الْخَبَرِ ‏.‏ وَكَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَشْتَدُّ عَلَيْهِ أَنْ تُوجَدَ مِنْهُ الرِّيحُ ‏.‏ وَفِي الْحَدِيثِ قَالَتْ سَوْدَةُ بَلْ أَكَلْتَ مَغَافِيرَ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏ "‏ بَلْ شَرِبْتُ عَسَلاً سَقَتْنِي حَفْصَةُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ جَرَسَتْ نَحْلُهُ الْعُرْفُطَ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو دَاوُدَ الْمَغَافِيرُ مُقْلَةٌ وَهِيَ صَمْغَةٌ ‏.‏ وَجَرَسَتْ رَعَتْ ‏.‏ وَالْعُرْفُطُ نَبْتٌ مِنْ نَبْتِ النَّحْلِ ‏.‏
27.en: ‘A’ishah said :The Messenger of Allah(ﷺ) liked sweet meats and honey. The narrator then mentioned a part of the tradition mentioned above. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) felt it hard on him to find smell from him. In this tradition saudah said: but you ate gum ? He said : No, I drank honey. Hafsah gave it to me to drank. I said : Its bees ate ‘urfut. Abu Dawud said: Maghafir is a gum ; jarasat means ate; ’urfut is a bees ‘ plant
27.hi: Aisha kehti hain: Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ko meethi cheezein aur shehad pasand tha. Raawi ne fir upar zikr ki gayi riwayat ka kuch hissa zikr kiya. Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ko sakht mehsoos hua ke unse (koi) khushbu mile. Iss riwayat mein Saudah ne kaha: Lekin aapne gum khaayi? Aapne kaha: Nahi, maine shehad piya. Hafsa ne mujhe isse peene ko diya. Maine kaha: Iski maakhiyon ne urfut khaaya. Abu Dawud kehte hain: Maghafir ek gum hai; jarasat ka matlab hai khaaya; urfut maakhi ka paudha hai.

27.ar: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا صَدَقَةُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا زَيْدُ بْنُ وَاقِدٍ، عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ حُسَيْنٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ عَلِمْتُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَصُومُ فَتَحَيَّنْتُ فِطْرَهُ بِنَبِيذٍ صَنَعْتُهُ فِي دُبَّاءٍ ثُمَّ أَتَيْتُهُ بِهِ فَإِذَا هُوَ يَنِشُّ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ اضْرِبْ بِهَذَا الْحَائِطَ فَإِنَّ هَذَا شَرَابُ مَنْ لاَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
27.en: Narrated AbuHurayrah: I knew that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to keep fast. I waited for the day when he did not fast to present him the drink (nabidh) which I made in a pumpkin. I then brought it to him while it fermented. He said: Throw it to this wall, for this is a drink of the one who does not believe in Allah and the Last Day
27.hi: Hazrat Abu Hurairah bayaan karte hain: Mujhe maloom tha ke Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) roza rakha karte the. Maine us din ka intezaar kiya jab unhone roza na rakha ho taake unhein woh mashroob (nabidh) pesh karun jo maine kaddu mein banaaya. Main isse unke paas laaya jabke isme khamir uth chuka tha. Aapne kaha: Isse iss deewaar par phenk do, kyunki yeh us shakhs ka mashroob hai jo Allah aur Aakhirat ke din par imaan nahi rakhta.

27.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى أَنْ يَشْرَبَ الرَّجُلُ قَائِمًا ‏.‏
27.en: Narrated Anas ibn Malik: The Prophet (ﷺ) forbade that a man should drink while standing
27.hi: Hazrat Anas bin Malik bayaan karte hain: Nabi (ﷺ) ne mana kiya ke aadmi khade hokar piye.

27.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ مِسْعَرِ بْنِ كِدَامٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ مَيْسَرَةَ، عَنِ النَّزَّالِ بْنِ سَبْرَةَ، أَنَّ عَلِيًّا، دَعَا بِمَاءٍ فَشَرِبَهُ وَهُوَ قَائِمٌ ثُمَّ قَالَ إِنَّ رِجَالاً يَكْرَهُ أَحَدُهُمْ أَنْ يَفْعَلَ هَذَا وَقَدْ رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَفْعَلُ مِثْلَ مَا رَأَيْتُمُونِي أَفْعَلُهُ ‏.‏
27.en: Nazzal b. Samurah said :‘Ali asked for water and he drank it while standing. He then said: some people disapprove of doing this (drinking while standing ), but I saw the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) doing as I have done
27.hi: Nazzal bin Samurah kehte hain: Ali ne paani maanga aur isse khade hokar piya. Fir unhone kaha: Kuch log isse (khade hokar peena) na-pasand karte hain, lekin maine Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ko waise hi karte dekha jaise maine kiya.

27.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا قَتَادَةُ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الشُّرْبِ مِنْ فِي السِّقَاءِ وَعَنْ رُكُوبِ الْجَلاَّلَةِ وَالْمُجَثَّمَةِ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو دَاوُدَ الْجَلاَّلَةُ الَّتِي تَأْكُلُ الْعَذِرَةَ ‏.‏
27.en: Ibn Abbas said:The apostle of allah (ﷺ) forbade drinking from the mouth of a water-skin, and riding the animal which feeds on filth and eating the animal which is killed in confinement. Abu Dawud said: Jallalah means an animal which eats filth and impurities
27.hi: Ibn Abbas kehte hain: Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne khaal ke bartan ke munh se peene se mana kiya, aur us jaanwar par sawaar hone se jo gandagi khaata hai aur uska gosht khaane se jise qaid mein maara jaata hai. Abu Dawud kehte hain: Jallalah ka matlab hai woh jaanwar jo gandagi aur naapaki khaata hai.

27.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ عُبَيْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنِ اخْتِنَاثِ الأَسْقِيَةِ ‏.‏
27.en: Abu Sa’id al-Khudri said :The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) prohibited drinking by inverting the heads of skin vessels
27.hi: Hazrat Abu Sa'eed al-Khudri bayaan karte hain: Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne khaal ke bartano ke sar ulte karke peene se mana kiya.

27.ar: حَدَّثَنَا نَصْرُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ، عَنْ عِيسَى بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، - رَجُلٍ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ - عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم دَعَا بِإِدَاوَةٍ يَوْمَ أُحُدٍ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ اخْنُثْ فَمَ الإِدَاوَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ شَرِبَ مِنْ فِيهَا ‏.‏
27.en: A man of the Ansar quoting from his father said that the Prophet (ﷺ) called for a skin-vessel on the day of the battle of Uhud. He then said:Invert the head of the vessel and he drank from its mouth
27.hi: Ansar ka ek aadmi apne walid ke hawale se bayaan karte hain ke Nabi (ﷺ) ne Uhud ki jung ke din ek khaal ka bartan mangwaaya. Fir aapne kaha: Bartan ka sar ulta karo, aur aapne iske munh se piya.

27.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي قُرَّةُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الشُّرْبِ مِنْ ثُلْمَةِ الْقَدَحِ وَأَنْ يُنْفَخَ فِي الشَّرَابِ ‏.‏
27.en: Abu sa’id al-Khudri said:The apostle of Allah (ﷺ) forbade drinking from the broken place (of a cup) and blowing into a drink
27.hi: Hazrat Abu Sa'eed al-Khudri bayaan karte hain: Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne toote hue hisse se peene se, aur mashroob mein saans phoonkne se mana kiya.

27.ar: حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنِ الْحَكَمِ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى، قَالَ كَانَ حُذَيْفَةُ بِالْمَدَائِنِ فَاسْتَسْقَى فَأَتَاهُ دِهْقَانٌ بِإِنَاءٍ مِنْ فِضَّةٍ فَرَمَاهُ بِهِ وَقَالَ إِنِّي لَمْ أَرْمِهِ بِهِ إِلاَّ أَنِّي قَدْ نَهَيْتُهُ فَلَمْ يَنْتَهِ وَإِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنِ الْحَرِيرِ وَالدِّيبَاجِ وَعَنِ الشُّرْبِ فِي آنِيَةِ الذَّهَبِ وَالْفِضَّةِ وَقَالَ ‏ "‏ هِيَ لَهُمْ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَلَكُمْ فِي الآخِرَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
27.en: Ibn Abi Laila said:Whan Hudhaifah was in al-Mada’in, he asked for water. A peasant brought him a silver vessel. He threw it away and said: I threw it away, for I prohibited (him) but he did not stop. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) forbade to wear silk or brocade, and to drink from gold and silver vessels. He said: Others have them in this world and you will have them in the next
27.hi: Ibn Abi Layla kehte hain: Jab Hudhaifah al-Mada'in mein the, unhone paani maanga. Ek kisaan unke liye chandi ka bartan laaya. Unhone isse phenk diya aur kaha: Maine isse phenk diya, kyunki maine (usse) mana kiya lekin usne isse nahi roka. Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne resham ya baariq pehnne se, aur sone aur chandi ke bartano mein peene se mana kiya. Unhone kaha: Doosre iss duniya mein inhein rakhte hain aur tumhein yeh Aakhirat mein milengi.

27.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنِي فُلَيْحٌ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ دَخَلَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَرَجُلٌ مِنْ أَصْحَابِهِ عَلَى رَجُلٍ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ وَهُوَ يُحَوِّلُ الْمَاءَ فِي حَائِطِهِ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِنْ كَانَ عِنْدَكَ مَاءٌ بَاتَ هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةَ فِي شَنٍّ وَإِلاَّ كَرَعْنَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ بَلْ عِنْدِي مَاءٌ بَاتَ فِي شَنٍّ ‏.‏
27.en: Jabir b. ‘abd Allah said:The Prophet (ﷺ) went to visit a man of the Ansar accompanied by one of his Companions who was watering his garden. The Messenger of Allah(ﷺ) said: If you have any water which has remained over night in a skin (we should like it), or shall sip (from a streamlet)
27.hi: Jabir bin Abdullah kehte hain: Nabi (ﷺ) Ansar ke ek aadmi se milne gaye, unke ek sahabi ke saath jo apne baagh ko paani de raha tha. Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne kaha: Agar tumhaare paas koi paani hai jo raat bhar khaal mein baaqi raha ho (humein woh pasand hoga), warna hum (kisi behte hue paani se) chuski le lenge.

27.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي الْمُخْتَارِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي أَوْفَى، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ سَاقِيَ الْقَوْمِ آخِرُهُمْ شُرْبًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
27.en: Narrated Abdullah ibn AbuAwfa: The Prophet (ﷺ) said: The supplier of the people is the last (man) to drink
27.hi: Hazrat Abdullah bin Abu Awfa bayaan karte hain: Nabi (ﷺ) ne kaha: Logon ko paani pilaane wala sabse aakhir mein peeta hai.

27.ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْقَعْنَبِيُّ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أُتِيَ بِلَبَنٍ قَدْ شِيبَ بِمَاءٍ وَعَنْ يَمِينِهِ أَعْرَابِيٌّ وَعَنْ يَسَارِهِ أَبُو بَكْرٍ فَشَرِبَ ثُمَّ أَعْطَى الأَعْرَابِيَّ وَقَالَ ‏ "‏ الأَيْمَنَ فَالأَيْمَنَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
27.en: Anas b. Malik said:The Prophet (ﷺ) was brought milk that was mixed with water. A nomad Arab was on his right and Abu Bakr was on his left. He himself drank and gave it to the nomad Arab, and said: He who is on the right , then he who is on his right then he who is on his right
27.hi: Anas bin Malik kehte hain: Nabi (ﷺ) ko doodh laaya gaya jo paani se milaaya gaya tha. Ek registaan wale Arab unki daayin taraf the aur Abu Bakr unki baayin taraf. Aapne khud piya aur registaan wale Arab ko diya, aur kaha: Woh jo daayin taraf hai, fir woh jo unki daayin taraf hai, fir woh jo unki daayin taraf hai.

27.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، عَنْ أَبِي عِصَامٍ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ إِذَا شَرِبَ تَنَفَّسَ ثَلاَثًا وَقَالَ ‏ "‏ هُوَ أَهْنَأُ وَأَمْرَأُ وَأَبْرَأُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
27.en: Anas b.Malik said :when the prophet (ﷺ) drank, he used to breathe three times in the course of a drink and say : It is more whole some ,thrist-quenching and healthier
27.hi: Anas bin Malik kehte hain: Jab Nabi (ﷺ) peete, aap peene ke dauraan teen martaba saans lete aur kehte: Yeh zyada bharpoor, pyaas bujhaane wala, aur sehatmand hai.

27.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ النُّفَيْلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْكَرِيمِ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ يُتَنَفَّسَ فِي الإِنَاءِ أَوْ يُنْفَخَ فِيهِ ‏.‏
27.en: Narrated Abdullah ibn Abbas: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) forbade blowing or breathing into a vessel
27.hi: Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas bayaan karte hain: Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne bartan mein phoonkne ya saans lene se mana kiya.

27.ar: حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ خُمَيْرٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ بُسْرٍ، - مِنْ بَنِي سُلَيْمٍ - قَالَ جَاءَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَى أَبِي فَنَزَلَ عَلَيْهِ فَقَدَّمَ إِلَيْهِ طَعَامًا فَذَكَرَ حَيْسًا أَتَاهُ بِهِ ثُمَّ أَتَاهُ بِشَرَابٍ فَشَرِبَ فَنَاوَلَ مَنْ عَلَى يَمِينِهِ وَأَكَلَ تَمْرًا فَجَعَلَ يُلْقِي النَّوَى عَلَى ظَهْرِ أُصْبَعَيْهِ السَّبَّابَةِ وَالْوُسْطَى فَلَمَّا قَامَ قَامَ أَبِي فَأَخَذَ بِلِجَامِ دَابَّتِهِ فَقَالَ ادْعُ اللَّهَ لِي ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَهُمْ فِيمَا رَزَقْتَهُمْ وَاغْفِرْ لَهُمْ وَارْحَمْهُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
27.en: ’Abd Allah b. Busr from Banu Sulaim said:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came to my father and he was a guest with him. He offered food to him and brought hais. He then brought a drink which he drank and he gave it to the one on his right. He ate dried dates and began to put the kernels on the back of his ring finger and middle finger. When he got up, my father also got up, and held the rein of his mount. He said : Pray to Allah for me. He said : O Allah, bless them in what you provided them, and have mercy on them
27.hi: Banu Sulaim ke Abdullah bin Busr kehte hain: Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) mere walid ke paas aaye aur woh unke saath mehmaan the. Unhone unhein khaana pesh kiya aur hais (ek meethi cheez khajoor, ghee, panir se) laaye. Fir woh ek mashroob laaye jo aapne piya aur apni daayin taraf wale ko de diya. Aapne sookhi khajoor khaayi aur unke beej apni anaamika aur beech ki ungli ke peechhe rakhne lage. Jab aap khade hue, mere walid bhi khade hue aur unki sawaari ki lagaam pakadi. Unhone kaha: Mere liye Allah se dua karein. Aapne kaha: Ae Allah, unhein jo tune inhein diya hai usme barkat de, aur inpar reham kar.

27.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ زَيْدٍ - ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ سَلَمَةَ - عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ حَرْمَلَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ كُنْتُ فِي بَيْتِ مَيْمُونَةَ فَدَخَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَمَعَهُ خَالِدُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ فَجَاءُوا بِضَبَّيْنِ مَشْوِيَّيْنِ عَلَى ثُمَامَتَيْنِ فَتَبَزَّقَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ خَالِدٌ إِخَالُكَ تَقْذُرُهُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَجَلْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ أُتِيَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِلَبَنٍ فَشَرِبَ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِذَا أَكَلَ أَحَدُكُمْ طَعَامًا فَلْيَقُلِ اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيهِ وَأَطْعِمْنَا خَيْرًا مِنْهُ ‏.‏ وَإِذَا سُقِيَ لَبَنًا فَلْيَقُلِ اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيهِ وَزِدْنَا مِنْهُ ‏.‏ فَإِنَّهُ لَيْسَ شَىْءٌ يُجْزِئُ مِنَ الطَّعَامِ وَالشَّرَابِ إِلاَّ اللَّبَنُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو دَاوُدَ هَذَا لَفْظُ مُسَدَّدٍ ‏.‏
27.en: Narrated Abdullah ibn Abbas: I was in the house of Maymunah. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) accompanied by Khalid ibn al-Walid entered. Two roasted long-tailed lizards (dabb) placed on the sticks were brought to him. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) spat. Khalid said: I think that you abominate it, Messenger of Allah. He said: Yes. Then the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was brought milk, and he drank (it). The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) then said: When one of you eats food, he should say: O Allah, bless us in it, and give us food (or nourishment) better than it. When he is given milk to drink he should say: O Allah! bless us in it and give us more of it, for no food or drink satisfies like milk. Abu Dawud said: This is the Musaddad's version
27.hi: Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas bayaan karte hain: Main Maymunah ke ghar mein tha. Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ), Khalid bin al-Walid ke saath, dakhil hue. Do bhuni hui lambi poonchh wali chhipkaliyon (dabb) ko lakdiyon par rakhkar unke paas laaya gaya. Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne thooka. Khalid ne kaha: Mujhe lagta hai aap isse na-pasand karte hain, Allah ke Rasool. Aapne kaha: Ji haan. Fir Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ko doodh laaya gaya, aur aapne (isse) piya. Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne fir kaha: Jab tum mein se koi khaana khaaye, use kehna chaahiye: Ae Allah, ismein humein barkat de, aur humein isse behtar khaana (ya rozi) de. Jab use doodh peene ke liye diya jaaye, use kehna chaahiye: Ae Allah, ismein humein barkat de, aur humein isse zyada de, kyunki koi bhi khaana ya mashroob doodh jaisa tasalli nahi deta. Abu Dawud kehte hain: Yeh Musaddad ka version hai.

27.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ حَنْبَلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَطَاءٌ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ أَغْلِقْ بَابَكَ وَاذْكُرِ اسْمَ اللَّهِ فَإِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ لاَ يَفْتَحُ بَابًا مُغْلَقًا وَأَطْفِ مِصْبَاحَكَ وَاذْكُرِ اسْمَ اللَّهِ وَخَمِّرْ إِنَاءَكَ وَلَوْ بِعُودٍ تَعْرُضُهُ عَلَيْهِ وَاذْكُرِ اسْمَ اللَّهِ وَأَوْكِ سِقَاءَكَ وَاذْكُرِ اسْمَ اللَّهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
27.en: Jabir reported the Prophet (ﷺ) as saying:Shut your door and make mention of Allah's name, for the devil does not open a door which has been shut; extinguish your lamp and make mention of Allah's name, cover up your vessel even by a piece of wood that you just put on it and make mention of Allah's name, and tie up your water-skin mentioning Allah's name
27.hi: Jabir ne Nabi (ﷺ) ko yeh kehte hue riwayat ki: Apna darwaza band karo aur Allah ka naam lo, kyunki shaytan koi band darwaza nahi kholta; apni chiraag bujhaao aur Allah ka naam lo, apne bartan ko dhaanko, chahe isse dhaankne ke liye ek lakdi ka tukda hi rakh do, aur Allah ka naam lo, aur apni paani ki khaal ko baandho, Allah ka naam lete hue.

27.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ الْقَعْنَبِيُّ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِهَذَا الْخَبَرِ وَلَيْسَ بِتَمَامِهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَإِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ لاَ يَفْتَحُ بَابًا غَلَقًا وَلاَ يَحُلُّ وِكَاءً وَلاَ يَكْشِفُ إِنَاءً وَإِنَّ الْفُوَيْسِقَةَ تُضْرِمُ عَلَى النَّاسِ بَيْتَهُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ أَوْ ‏"‏ بُيُوتَهُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
27.en: Jabir b.’Abd Allah reported the Prophet (ﷺ)as saying this version is not complete ‘’for the devil does not open a shut door, or loosen a water-skin, or uncover a vessel, for a mouse sets a house on fire over its inhabitants’’
27.hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne Nabi (ﷺ) ko yeh kehte hue riwayat ki - yeh version mukammal nahi hai - 'kyunki shaytan koi band darwaza nahi kholta, na koi paani ki khaal khol ta hai, na koi bartan dhaankne se khol ta hai, kyunki chuha ghar ko uske rehne walon par jala sakta hai.'

27.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، وَفُضَيْلُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْوَهَّابِ السُّكَّرِيُّ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، عَنْ كَثِيرِ بْنِ شِنْظِيرٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، رَفَعَهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَاكْفِتُوا صِبْيَانَكُمْ عِنْدَ الْعِشَاءِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ مُسَدَّدٌ ‏"‏ عِنْدَ الْمَسَاءِ ‏"‏ ‏"‏ فَإِنَّ لِلْجِنِّ انْتِشَارًا وَخَطْفَةً ‏"‏ ‏.‏
27.en: Jabir b.Abd Allah reported the Prophet (ﷺ) as saying:Gather your children when darkness spreads, or in the evening (according to Musaddad), for the jinn are abroad and seize them
27.hi: Jabir bin Abdullah ne Nabi (ﷺ) ko yeh kehte hue riwayat ki: Apne bacchon ko ekattha karo jab andhera phaile, ya shaam ko (jaisa Musaddad ke mutabiq), kyunki jinnaat baahar ghoomte hain aur unhein pakad lete hain.

27.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ كُنَّا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَاسْتَسْقَى فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الْقَوْمِ أَلاَ نَسْقِيكَ نَبِيذًا قَالَ ‏"‏ بَلَى ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَخَرَجَ الرَّجُلُ يَشْتَدُّ فَجَاءَ بِقَدَحٍ فِيهِ نَبِيذٌ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَلاَّ خَمَّرْتَهُ وَلَوْ أَنْ تَعْرِضَ عَلَيْهِ عُودًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو دَاوُدَ قَالَ الأَصْمَعِيُّ تَعْرُضُهُ عَلَيْهِ ‏.‏
27.en: Jabir said:We were with Prophet (ﷺ) and he asked for something to drink. A man from the company asked: Should we not give you nabidh (drink made from dates) to drink ? He replied : Yes . The man went quickly and bought a cup of nabidh. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Why did you not cover it up even by putting a piece of wood on it ? Abu Dawud said: Al-Asma'i's version has: "You put it on it
27.hi: Jabir kehte hain: Hum Nabi (ﷺ) ke saath the aur unhone kuch peene ke liye maanga. Giroh mein se ek aadmi ne poocha: Kya hum aapko nabidh (khajoor se banaaya mashroob) na piyein? Aapne jawaab diya: Ji haan. Aadmi jaldi gaya aur ek pyaala nabidh khareed laaya. Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne poocha: Tumne isse dhaanka kyun nahi, chahe iske liye lakdi ka tukda hi rakh diya hota? Abu Dawud kehte hain: Al-Asma'i ke version mein hai: 'Tumne isper rakh di.'

27.ar: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، وَعَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ النُّفَيْلِيُّ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، رضى الله عنها أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يُسْتَعْذَبُ لَهُ الْمَاءُ مِنْ بُيُوتِ السُّقْيَا ‏.‏ قَالَ قُتَيْبَةُ عَيْنٌ بَيْنَهَا وَبَيْنَ الْمَدِينَةِ يَوْمَانِ ‏.‏
27.en: Narrated Aisha, Ummul Mu'minin: The water from as-Suqya' was considered sweetest by the Prophet (ﷺ). Qutaybah said: it was a well on two days' journey from Medina
27.hi: Hazrat Aisha, Ummul-Momineen, bayaan karti hain: Nabi (ﷺ) as-Suqya ka paani sabse zyada meetha maante the. Qutaibah kehte hain: Yeh Madina se do din ke safar par ek kuan tha.

28.ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْقَعْنَبِيُّ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِذَا دُعِيَ أَحَدُكُمْ إِلَى الْوَلِيمَةِ فَلْيَأْتِهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
28.en: ‘Abd Allah b. ‘Umar reported the Prophet(ﷺ) as sayings:when one of you is invited for a wedding feast, he must attend it
28.hi: Abdullah bin Umar ne Nabi (ﷺ) ko yeh kehte hue riwayat ki: Jab tum mein se koi shaadi ki dawat par bulwaaya jaaye, use zaroor jaana chaahiye.

28.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مَخْلَدُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمَعْنَاهُ زَادَ ‏ "‏ فَإِنْ كَانَ مُفْطِرًا فَلْيَطْعَمْ وَإِنْ كَانَ صَائِمًا فَلْيَدْعُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
28.en: The tradition mentioned above has also been transmitted by Ibn ‘Umar to the same effect through a different chain of narrators. This version has the additional words:If he is not fasting, he should eat, and if he is fasting, he should leave it
28.hi: Upar zikr ki gayi riwayat bhi Ibn Umar se isi tarah ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai. Iss version mein izaafa hai: Agar woh roze mein nahi hai, use khaana chaahiye, aur agar woh roze mein hai, use isse chhod dena chaahiye.

28.ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِذَا دَعَا أَحَدُكُمْ أَخَاهُ فَلْيُجِبْ عُرْسًا كَانَ أَوْ نَحْوَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
28.en: Ibn ‘Umar reported the Messenger of Allah(ﷺ) as saying:if one of you invites his brother, he should accept(the invitation), whether it is a wedding feast or something of that nature
28.hi: Ibn Umar ne Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ko yeh kehte hue riwayat ki: Agar koi apne bhai ko bulwaaye, use qabool karna chaahiye, chahe yeh shaadi ki dawat ho ya isi jaisi koi cheez.

28.ar: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُصَفَّى، حَدَّثَنَا بَقِيَّةُ، حَدَّثَنَا الزُّبَيْدِيُّ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، بِإِسْنَادِ أَيُّوبَ وَمَعْنَاهُ ‏.‏
28.en: The tradition mentioned above has also been transmitted by Nafi’ to the same effect through the chain of narrators as mentioned in Ayyub
28.hi: Upar zikr ki gayi riwayat bhi Nafi' se isi tarah, Ayyub ki sanad ke zariye riwayat ki gayi hai.

28.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنْ دُعِيَ فَلْيُجِبْ فَإِنْ شَاءَ طَعِمَ وَإِنْ شَاءَ تَرَكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
28.en: Jabir reported the Messenger of Allah(ﷺ) as sayings:when one of you is invited to a meal, he must accept. If he wishes he may eat, but if he wishes(to leave), he may leave
28.hi: Jabir ne Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ko yeh kehte hue riwayat ki: Jab tum mein se koi khaane ki dawat par bulwaaya jaaye, use zaroor jaana chaahiye. Agar woh chaahe woh khaa sakta hai, lekin agar woh chaahe (jaana), woh jaa sakta hai.

28.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا دُرُسْتُ بْنُ زِيَادٍ، عَنْ أَبَانَ بْنِ طَارِقٍ، عَنْ طَارِقٍ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، قَالَ قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنْ دُعِيَ فَلَمْ يُجِبْ فَقَدْ عَصَى اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ وَمَنْ دَخَلَ عَلَى غَيْرِ دَعْوَةٍ دَخَلَ سَارِقًا وَخَرَجَ مُغِيرًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو دَاوُدَ أَبَانُ بْنُ طَارِقٍ مَجْهُولٌ ‏.‏
28.en: Narrated Abdullah ibn Umar: The Prophet (ﷺ) said: He who does not accept an invitation which he receives has disobeyed Allah and His Apostle, and he who enters without invitation enters as a thief and goes out as a raider. Abu Dawud said: Aban bin Tariq is unknown
28.hi: Hazrat Abdullah bin Umar bayaan karte hain: Nabi (ﷺ) ne kaha: Jo koi dawat qabool nahi karta jo unhein milti hai, usne Allah aur uske Rasool ki nafarmani ki hai, aur jo bagair dawat ke dakhil hota hai woh chor ki tarah dakhil hota hai aur luteroan ki tarah nikalta hai. Abu Dawud kehte hain: Aban bin Tariq maaruf nahi.

28.ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْقَعْنَبِيُّ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقُولُ شَرُّ الطَّعَامِ طَعَامُ الْوَلِيمَةِ يُدْعَى لَهَا الأَغْنِيَاءُ وَيُتْرَكُ الْمَسَاكِينُ وَمَنْ لَمْ يَأْتِ الدَّعْوَةَ فَقَدْ عَصَى اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ ‏.‏
28.en: Abu Hurairah said:The worst kind of food is that at a wedding feast to which the rich are invited and from which the poor are left out. If anyone does not attend the feast to which he was invited, he has disobeyed Allah and His Apostle (may peace upon him)
28.hi: Abu Hurairah kehte hain: Sabse bura khaana woh hai jo shaadi ki dawat mein diya jaata hai jismein ameeron ko bulwaaya jaata hai aur gareebon ko chhod diya jaata hai. Agar koi us dawat mein na jaaye jismein unhein bulwaaya gaya, unhone Allah aur uske Rasool ki nafarmani ki.
