40.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي ظَبْيَانَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ أُتِيَ عُمَرُ بِمَجْنُونَةٍ قَدْ زَنَتْ فَاسْتَشَارَ فِيهَا أُنَاسًا فَأَمَرَ بِهَا عُمَرُ أَنْ تُرْجَمَ فَمُرَّ بِهَا عَلَى عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ رِضْوَانُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالَ مَا شَأْنُ هَذِهِ قَالُوا مَجْنُونَةُ بَنِي فُلاَنٍ زَنَتْ فَأَمَرَ بِهَا عُمَرُ أَنْ تُرْجَمَ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَقَالَ ارْجِعُوا بِهَا ثُمَّ أَتَاهُ فَقَالَ يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ أَمَا عَلِمْتَ أَنَّ الْقَلَمَ قَدْ رُفِعَ عَنْ ثَلاَثَةٍ عَنِ الْمَجْنُونِ حَتَّى يَبْرَأَ وَعَنِ النَّائِمِ حَتَّى يَسْتَيْقِظَ وَعَنِ الصَّبِيِّ حَتَّى يَعْقِلَ قَالَ بَلَى ‏.‏ قَالَ فَمَا بَالُ هَذِهِ تُرْجَمُ قَالَ لاَ شَىْءَ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَأَرْسِلْهَا ‏.‏ قَالَ فَأَرْسَلَهَا ‏.‏ قَالَ فَجَعَلَ يُكَبِّرُ ‏.‏
40.en: Narrated Ali ibn AbuTalib: Ibn Abbas said: A lunatic woman who had committed adultery was brought to Umar. He consulted the people and ordered that she should be stoned. Ali ibn AbuTalib passed by and said: What is the matter with this (woman)? They said: This is a lunatic woman belonging to a certain family. She has committed adultery. Umar has given orders that she should be stoned. He said: Take her back. He then came to him and said: Commander of the Faithful, do you not know that there are three people whose actions are not recorded: a lunatic till he is restored to reason, a sleeper till he awakes, and a boy till he reaches puberty? He said: Yes. He then asked: Why is it that this woman is being stoned? He said: There is nothing. He then said: Let her go. He (Umar) let her go and began to utter: Allah is most great
40.hi: Hazrat Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) bayaan karte hain: Ibn Abbas kehte hain: Ek paagal aurat jinhone zina kiya tha Umar ke paas laayi gayi. Unhone logon se mashwara liya aur hukum diya ke unhein sangsaar kiya jaaye. Ali bin Abi Talib guzre aur poocha: Iss (aurat) ko kya hua? Unhone jawaab diya: Yeh ek paagal aurat hai jo fulan-fulan khaandaan se hai. Unhone zina kiya hai. Umar ne hukum diya hai ke unhein sangsaar kiya jaaye. Unhone kaha: Unhein wapas le jao. Fir woh unke (Umar ke) paas aaye aur kaha: Ameer-ul-Momineen, kya aapko nahi maloom ke teen log hain jinke amal likhe nahi jaate: paagal jab tak use hosh na aaye, sone wala jab tak woh jaage, aur ladka jab tak woh baaligh na ho? Unhone kaha: Ji haan. Fir unhone poocha: Fir yeh aurat kyun sangsaar ki jaa rahi hai? Unhone kaha: Kuch nahi. Fir unhone kaha: Unhein jaane do. Unhone (Umar ne) unhein jaane diya aur kehna shuru kiya: Allah sabse bada hai.

40.ar: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ بْنُ مُوسَى، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، نَحْوَهُ وَقَالَ أَيْضًا حَتَّى يَعْقِلَ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ وَعَنِ الْمَجْنُونِ حَتَّى يُفِيقَ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَجَعَلَ عُمَرُ يُكَبِّرُ ‏.‏
40.en: A similar tradition has also been transmitted by al-A’mash through a different chain of narrators. He also said :“... . Till he reaches puberty , and a lunatic till he is restored to consciousness.” ‘Umar then began to utter: Allah is most great
40.hi: Isi jaisi riwayat bhi al-A'mash se isi tarah ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai. Unhone bhi kaha: '...jab tak woh baaligh na ho, aur paagal jab tak use hosh na aaye.' Umar fir kehne lage: Allah sabse bada hai.

40.ar: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ السَّرْحِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي جَرِيرُ بْنُ حَازِمٍ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ مِهْرَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي ظَبْيَانَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ مُرَّ عَلَى عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ رضى الله عنه بِمَعْنَى عُثْمَانَ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَوَمَا تَذْكُرُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ رُفِعَ الْقَلَمُ عَنْ ثَلاَثَةٍ عَنِ الْمَجْنُونِ الْمَغْلُوبِ عَلَى عَقْلِهِ حَتَّى يُفِيقَ وَعَنِ النَّائِمِ حَتَّى يَسْتَيْقِظَ وَعَنِ الصَّبِيِّ حَتَّى يَحْتَلِمَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ صَدَقْتَ قَالَ فَخَلَّى عَنْهَا سَبِيلَهَا ‏.‏
40.en: Narrated Ali ibn AbuTalib: Ibn Abbas said: A lunatic woman passed by Ali ibn AbuTalib. He then mentioned the rest of the tradition to the same effect as Uthman mentioned. This version has: Do you not remember that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) has said: There are three whose actions are not recorded: a lunatic whose mind is deranged till he is restored to consciousness, a sleeper till he awakes, and a boy till he reaches puberty?
40.hi: Hazrat Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) bayaan karte hain: Ibn Abbas kehte hain: Ek paagal aurat Ali bin Abi Talib ke paas se guzri. Fir unhone baaqi riwayat isi tarah bayaan ki jaisa Uthman ne zikr ki. Iss version mein hai: Kya tumhein yaad nahi ke Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne kaha: Teen log hain jinke amal likhe nahi jaate: paagal jinki aqal bigadi hui ho jab tak use hosh na aaye, sone wala jab tak woh jaage, aur ladka jab tak woh baaligh na ho?

40.ar: حَدَّثَنَا هَنَّادٌ، عَنْ أَبِي الأَحْوَصِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، - الْمَعْنَى - عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ السَّائِبِ، عَنْ أَبِي ظَبْيَانَ، - قَالَ هَنَّادٌ - الْجَنْبِيِّ قَالَ أُتِيَ عُمَرُ بِامْرَأَةٍ قَدْ فَجَرَتْ فَأَمَرَ بِرَجْمِهَا فَمَرَّ عَلِيٌّ رضى الله عنه فَأَخَذَهَا فَخَلَّى سَبِيلَهَا فَأُخْبِرَ عُمَرُ قَالَ ادْعُوا لِي عَلِيًّا ‏.‏ فَجَاءَ عَلِيٌّ رضى الله عنه فَقَالَ يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ لَقَدْ عَلِمْتَ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ رُفِعَ الْقَلَمُ عَنْ ثَلاَثَةٍ عَنِ الصَّبِيِّ حَتَّى يَبْلُغَ وَعَنِ النَّائِمِ حَتَّى يَسْتَيْقِظَ وَعَنِ الْمَعْتُوهِ حَتَّى يَبْرَأَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَإِنَّ هَذِهِ مَعْتُوهَةُ بَنِي فُلاَنٍ لَعَلَّ الَّذِي أَتَاهَا أَتَاهَا وَهِيَ فِي بَلاَئِهَا ‏.‏ قَالَ فَقَالَ عُمَرُ لاَ أَدْرِي ‏.‏ فَقَالَ عَلِيٌّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ وَأَنَا لاَ أَدْرِي ‏.‏
40.en: Narrated Ali ibn AbuTalib: AbuZubyan said: A woman who had committed adultery was brought to Umar. He gave orders that she should be stoned. Ali passed by just then. He seized her and let her go. Umar was informed of it. He said: Ask Ali to come to me. Ali came to him and said: Commander of the Faithful, you know that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: There are three (people) whose actions are not recorded: A boy till he reaches puberty, a sleeper till he awakes, a lunatic till he is restored to reason. This is an idiot (mad) woman belonging to the family of so and so. Someone might have done this action with her when she suffered the fit of lunacy. Umar said: I do not know. Ali said: I do not know
40.hi: Hazrat Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) bayaan karte hain: Abu Zubyan kehte hain: Ek aurat jinhone zina kiya tha, Umar ke paas laayi gayi. Unhone hukum diya ke unhein sangsaar kiya jaaye. Ali usi waqt guzre. Unhone unhein pakda aur jaane diya. Umar ko iski khabar mili. Unhone kaha: Ali se kaho mere paas aayein. Ali unke paas aaye aur kaha: Ameer-ul-Momineen, aapko maloom hai ke Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne kaha: Teen (log) hain jinke amal likhe nahi jaate: ladka jab tak woh baaligh na ho, sone wala jab tak woh jaage, paagal jab tak use hosh na aaye. Yeh fulan-fulan khaandaan ki ek aqal se kamzor (paagal) aurat hai. Shaayad kisi ne yeh amal unke saath kiya ho jab woh paagalpan ke daure mein thi. Umar ne kaha: Mujhe nahi maloom. Ali ne kaha: Mujhe nahi maloom.

40.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ، عَنْ خَالِدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الضُّحَى، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ، عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ رُفِعَ الْقَلَمُ عَنْ ثَلاَثَةٍ عَنِ النَّائِمِ حَتَّى يَسْتَيْقِظَ وَعَنِ الصَّبِيِّ حَتَّى يَحْتَلِمَ وَعَنِ الْمَجْنُونِ حَتَّى يَعْقِلَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو دَاوُدَ رَوَاهُ ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنْ عَلِيٍّ رضى الله عنه عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم زَادَ فِيهِ ‏"‏ وَالْخَرِفِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
40.en: Narrated Ali ibn AbuTalib: The Prophet (ﷺ) said: There are three (persons) whose actions are not recorded: a sleeper till he awakes, a boy till he reaches puberty, and a lunatic till he comes to reason. Abu Dawud said: Ibn Juraij has transmitted it from Al-Qasim b. Yazid on the authority of 'Ali from the Prophet (ﷺ). This version adds: "and an old man who is feeble-minded
40.hi: Hazrat Ali bin Abi Talib (Alayhis Salam) bayaan karte hain: Nabi (ﷺ) ne kaha: Teen (log) hain jinke amal likhe nahi jaate: sone wala jab tak woh jaage, ladka jab tak woh baaligh na ho, aur paagal jab tak use hosh na aaye. Abu Dawud kehte hain: Ibn Juraij ne yeh al-Qasim bin Yazid se, Ali ke hawale se, Nabi (ﷺ) se riwayat ki hai. Iss version mein izaafa hai: 'aur ek boodha aadmi jinki aqal kamzor ho.'

40.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ عُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنِي عَطِيَّةُ الْقُرَظِيُّ، قَالَ كُنْتُ مِنْ سَبْىِ بَنِي قُرَيْظَةَ فَكَانُوا يَنْظُرُونَ فَمَنْ أَنْبَتَ الشَّعْرَ قُتِلَ وَمَنْ لَمْ يُنْبِتْ لَمْ يُقْتَلْ فَكُنْتُ فِيمَنْ لَمْ يُنْبِتْ ‏.‏
40.en: Narrated Atiyyah al-Qurazi: I was among the captives of Banu Qurayzah. They (the Companions) examined us, and those who had begun to grow hair (pubes) were killed, and those who had not were not killed. I was among those who had not grown hair
40.hi: Hazrat Atiyyah al-Qurazi bayaan karte hain: Main Banu Quraizah ke qaidiyon mein tha. Unhone (sahaba ne) humaari jaanch ki, aur jinke jism par baal ugna shuru ho chuke the unhein qatal kar diya gaya, aur jinke baal na ugne the unhein qatal nahi kiya gaya. Main un logon mein tha jinke baal nahi uge the.

40.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ، بِهَذَا الْحَدِيثِ قَالَ فَكَشَفُوا عَانَتِي فَوَجَدُوهَا لَمْ تَنْبُتْ فَجَعَلُونِي فِي السَّبْىِ ‏.‏
40.en: The tradition mentioned above has also been transmitted by ‘Abd al- Malik b. ‘Umar through a different chain of narrators. This version has:They uncovered my private parts, and when they found that the hair had not begun to grow they put me among the captives
40.hi: Upar zikr ki gayi riwayat bhi Abd al-Malik bin Umar se isi tarah ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai. Iss version mein hai: Unhone meri sharmgaah khol di, aur jab unhone paaya ke baal ugne shuru nahi hue the, unhone mujhe qaidiyon mein rakh diya.

40.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ حَنْبَلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي نَافِعٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عُرِضَهُ يَوْمَ أُحُدٍ وَهُوَ ابْنُ أَرْبَعَ عَشْرَةَ سَنَةً فَلَمْ يُجِزْهُ وَعُرِضَهُ يَوْمَ الْخَنْدَقِ وَهُوَ ابْنُ خَمْسَ عَشْرَةَ سَنَةً فَأَجَازَهُ ‏.‏
40.en: Ibn ‘Umar said:He was presented before the prophet (ﷺ) on the day of Uhd when he was fourteen years old, but he did not allow him (to participate in the battle). He was again presented before him on the day of Khandaq when he was fifteen years old, Then he allowed him
40.hi: Ibn Umar kehte hain: Unhein Nabi (ﷺ) ke saamne Uhud ke din pesh kiya gaya jab woh chaudah saal ke the, lekin unhone unhein (shirkat karne ki) ijazat nahi di. Unhein dobara aapke saamne Khandaq ke din pesh kiya gaya jab woh pandrah saal ke the. Fir aapne unhein ijazat di.

40.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ إِدْرِيسَ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ قَالَ نَافِعٌ حَدَّثْتُ بِهَذَا الْحَدِيثِ، عُمَرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ فَقَالَ إِنَّ هَذَا الْحَدُّ بَيْنَ الصَّغِيرِ وَالْكَبِيرِ ‏.‏
40.en: Nafi ‘said:When I mentioned this tradition to ‘Umar.b.’Abd al-Aziz he said : This prescribed punishment is between the minor and the major
40.hi: Nafi' kehte hain: Jab maine yeh riwayat Umar bin Abdul Aziz ko bataayi, unhone kaha: Yeh farz saza bachpan aur baaligh hone ke darmiyan hai.

40.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي حَيْوَةُ بْنُ شُرَيْحٍ، عَنْ عَيَّاشِ بْنِ عَبَّاسٍ الْقِتْبَانِيِّ، عَنْ شُيَيْمِ بْنِ بَيْتَانَ، وَيَزِيدَ بْنِ صُبْحٍ الأَصْبَحِيِّ، عَنْ جُنَادَةَ بْنِ أَبِي أُمَيَّةَ، قَالَ كُنَّا مَعَ بُسْرِ بْنِ أَرْطَاةَ فِي الْبَحْرِ فَأُتِيَ بِسَارِقٍ يُقَالُ لَهُ مِصْدَرٌ قَدْ سَرَقَ بُخْتِيَّةً فَقَالَ قَدْ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ لاَ تُقْطَعُ الأَيْدِي فِي السَّفَرِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَلَوْلاَ ذَلِكَ لَقَطَعْتُهُ ‏.‏
40.en: Narrated Busr ibn Artat: Junadah ibn AbuUmayyah said: We were with Busr ibn Artat on the sea (on an expedition). A thief called Misdar who had stolen a bukhti she-camel was brought. He said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say: Hands are not to be cut off during a warlike expedition. Had it not been so, I would have cut it off
40.hi: Hazrat Busr bin Artat bayaan karte hain: Junadah bin Abu Umayyah kehte hain: Hum Busr bin Artat ke saath samundar par the (ek muhim par). Ek chor jinhein Misdar kaha jaata tha jinhone ek bukhti oontni chura li thi, laaye gaye. Unhone kaha: Maine Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ko yeh kehte suna: Jung ki muhim ke daur mein haath nahi kaate jaate. Agar aisa na hota, main isse kaatta.

40.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي عِمْرَانَ، عَنِ الْمُشَعَّثِ بْنِ طَرِيفٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ، عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ، قَالَ قَالَ لِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ يَا أَبَا ذَرٍّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ لَبَّيْكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ وَسَعْدَيْكَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ كَيْفَ أَنْتَ إِذَا أَصَابَ النَّاسَ مَوْتٌ يَكُونُ الْبَيْتُ فِيهِ بِالْوَصِيفِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ يَعْنِي الْقَبْرَ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَعْلَمُ أَوْ مَا خَارَ اللَّهُ لِي وَرَسُولُهُ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ عَلَيْكَ بِالصَّبْرِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ أَوْ قَالَ ‏"‏ تَصْبِرُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو دَاوُدَ قَالَ حَمَّادُ بْنُ أَبِي سُلَيْمَانَ يُقْطَعُ النَّبَّاشُ لأَنَّهُ دَخَلَ عَلَى الْمَيِّتِ بَيْتَهُ ‏.‏
40.en: Narrated AbuDharr: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to me: O AbuDharr: I replied: At your service and at your pleasure, Messenger of Allah! He said: how will you do when death smites people, and a house, meaning a grave, will cost as much as a slave. I said: Allah and His Apostle know best, or he said: What Allah and His Apostle choose for me. He said: Show endurance, or he said: You may show endurance. Abu Dawud said: Hammad b. Abi Sulaiman said: The hand of one who rifles a grave should be cut off because he had entered the deceased's house
40.hi: Hazrat Abu Dharr bayaan karte hain: Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne mujhse kaha: Ae Abu Dharr: Maine jawaab diya: Aapki khidmat mein aur aapki khushi mein, Allah ke Rasool! Aapne kaha: Tum kya karoge jab logon ki maut aayegi, aur ek ghar, yaani qabar, ek ghulam jitni qeemat ka hoga. Maine kaha: Allah aur uske Rasool behtar jaante hain, ya unhone kaha: Jo Allah aur uske Rasool mere liye chunein. Aapne kaha: Sabr karo, ya unhone kaha: Tum sabr kar sakte ho. Abu Dawud kehte hain: Hammad bin Abi Sulaiman kehte hain: Us shakhs ka haath jo qabar loota hai kaata jaana chaahiye kyunki woh marne wale ke ghar mein dakhil hua.

40.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ عَقِيلٍ الْهِلاَلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا جَدِّي، عَنْ مُصْعَبِ بْنِ ثَابِتِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ جِيءَ بِسَارِقٍ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ اقْتُلُوهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّمَا سَرَقَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ اقْطَعُوهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَقُطِعَ ثُمَّ جِيءَ بِهِ الثَّانِيَةَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ اقْتُلُوهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّمَا سَرَقَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ اقْطَعُوهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَقُطِعَ ثُمَّ جِيءَ بِهِ الثَّالِثَةَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ اقْتُلُوهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّمَا سَرَقَ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ اقْطَعُوهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ أُتِيَ بِهِ الرَّابِعَةَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ اقْتُلُوهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّمَا سَرَقَ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ اقْطَعُوهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَأُتِيَ بِهِ الْخَامِسَةَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ اقْتُلُوهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ جَابِرٌ فَانْطَلَقْنَا بِهِ فَقَتَلْنَاهُ ثُمَّ اجْتَرَرْنَاهُ فَأَلْقَيْنَاهُ فِي بِئْرٍ وَرَمَيْنَا عَلَيْهِ الْحِجَارَةَ ‏.‏
40.en: Narrated Jabir ibn Abdullah: A thief was brought to the Prophet (ﷺ). He said: Kill him. The people said: He has committed theft, Messenger of Allah! Then he said: Cut off his hand. So his (right) hand was cut off. He was brought a second time and he said: Kill him. The people said: He has committed theft, Messenger of Allah! Then he said: Cut off his foot. So his (left) foot was cut off. He was brought a third time and he said: Kill him. The people said: He has committed theft, Messenger of Allah! So he said: Cut off his hand. (So his (left) hand was cut off.) He was brought a fourth time and he said: Kill him. The people said: He has committed theft, Messenger of Allah! So he said: Cut off his foot. So his (right) foot was cut off. He was brought a fifth time and he said: Kill him. So we took him away and killed him. We then dragged him and cast him into a well and threw stones over him
40.hi: Hazrat Jabir bin Abdullah bayaan karte hain: Ek chor Nabi (ﷺ) ke paas laaya gaya. Aapne kaha: Unhein qatal karo. Log ne kaha: Unhone chori ki hai, Allah ke Rasool! Fir aapne kaha: Unka haath kaato. So unka (daaya) haath kaata gaya. Woh doosri baar laaye gaye aur aapne kaha: Unhein qatal karo. Log ne kaha: Unhone chori ki hai, Allah ke Rasool! Fir aapne kaha: Unka paon kaato. So unka (baaya) paon kaata gaya. Woh teesri baar laaye gaye aur aapne kaha: Unhein qatal karo. Log ne kaha: Unhone chori ki hai, Allah ke Rasool! So aapne kaha: Unka haath kaato. (So unka baaya haath kaata gaya.) Woh chauthi baar laaye gaye aur aapne kaha: Unhein qatal karo. Log ne kaha: Unhone chori ki hai, Allah ke Rasool! So aapne kaha: Unka paon kaato. So unka (daaya) paon kaata gaya. Woh paanchvi baar laaye gaye aur aapne kaha: Unhein qatal karo. So hum unhein le gaye aur qatal kiya. Fir humne unhein ghaseeta aur ek kuen mein phenka aur unpar patthar phenke.

40.ar: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، حَدَّثَنَا الْحَجَّاجُ، عَنْ مَكْحُولٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ مُحَيْرِيزٍ، قَالَ سَأَلْنَا فَضَالَةَ بْنَ عُبَيْدٍ عَنْ تَعْلِيقِ الْيَدِ، فِي الْعُنُقِ لِلسَّارِقِ أَمِنَ السُّنَّةِ هُوَ قَالَ أُتِيَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِسَارِقٍ فَقُطِعَتْ يَدُهُ ثُمَّ أُمِرَ بِهَا فَعُلِّقَتْ فِي عُنُقِهِ ‏.‏
40.en: Abd al-Rahman b. Muhariz said: We asked Fadalah b. 'Ubaid about the hanging the (amputated) hand on the neck of a thief whether it was a sunnan. He said: A thief was brought to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and his hand was cut off. Thereafter he commanded for it, and it was hung on his neck
40.hi: Hazrat Abd al-Rahman bin Muhariz bayaan karte hain: Humne Fadalah bin Ubayd se poocha ke chor ke kaate hue haath ko unki gardan mein latkaana Sunnat hai ya nahi. Unhone kaha: Ek chor Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ke paas laaya gaya aur unka haath kaata gaya. Fir aapne isper hukum diya, aur isse unki gardan mein latkaaya gaya.

40.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ إِسْمَاعِيلَ - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِذَا سَرَقَ الْمَمْلُوكُ فَبِعْهُ وَلَوْ بِنَشٍّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
40.en: Narrated AbuHurayrah: The Prophet (ﷺ) as saying: When a slave steals, sell him, even though it be for half an uqiyah
40.hi: Hazrat Abu Hurairah bayaan karte hain: Nabi (ﷺ) ne yeh kehte suna: Jab ghulam chori kare, unhein bech do, chahe aadha uqiya ke liye hi kyun na ho.

40.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ الْمَرْوَزِيُّ، حَدَّثَنِي عَلِيُّ بْنُ الْحُسَيْنِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ النَّحْوِيِّ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ ‏{‏ وَاللاَّتِي يَأْتِينَ الْفَاحِشَةَ مِنْ نِسَائِكُمْ فَاسْتَشْهِدُوا عَلَيْهِنَّ أَرْبَعَةً مِنْكُمْ فَإِنْ شَهِدُوا فَأَمْسِكُوهُنَّ فِي الْبُيُوتِ حَتَّى يَتَوَفَّاهُنَّ الْمَوْتُ أَوْ يَجْعَلَ اللَّهُ لَهُنَّ سَبِيلاً ‏}‏ وَذَكَرَ الرَّجُلَ بَعْدَ الْمَرْأَةِ ثُمَّ جَمَعَهُمَا فَقَالَ ‏{‏ وَاللَّذَانِ يَأْتِيَانِهَا مِنْكُمْ فَآذُوهُمَا فَإِنْ تَابَا وَأَصْلَحَا فَأَعْرِضُوا عَنْهُمَا ‏}‏ فَنَسَخَ ذَلِكَ بِآيَةِ الْجَلْدِ فَقَالَ ‏{‏ الزَّانِيَةُ وَالزَّانِي فَاجْلِدُوا كُلَّ وَاحِدٍ مِنْهُمَا مِائَةَ جَلْدَةٍ ‏}‏ ‏.‏
40.en: Ibn ‘Abbas said:The Qur’anic verse goes: “If any of your woman are guilty of lewdness, take the evidence of four (reliable) witnesses from amongst you against them, and if they testify, Confine them to houses until death do chain them or Allah ordains for them some (other) way. Allah then mentioned man after woman and combined them in another verse : “If two men among you are guilty of lewdness, punish them both. If they repent and amend, leave them alone. This command was abrogated by the verse relating to flogging : “The woman and the man guilty of adultery or fornication – flog each of them with one hundred stripes
40.hi: Ibn Abbas kehte hain: Quraani aayat kehti hai: "Agar tumhaari koi aurat badkaari ki gunahgaar ho, unke khilaaf tum mein se chaar (bharosemand) gawaah lekar aao, aur agar woh gawaahi den, to unhein ghar mein qaid rakho jab tak maut unhein na le jaaye ya Allah unke liye koi (aur) raah muqarrar na kare." Fir Allah ne aurat ke baad mard ka zikr kiya aur unhein ek doosri aayat mein jama kiya: "Agar tum mein se do aadmi badkaari ki gunahgaar hon, unhein dono ko saza do. Agar woh tauba karein aur sudhrein, unhein akela chhod do." Yeh hukum kode maarne wali aayat ne mansookh kiya: "Zina karne wali aurat aur zina karne wala aadmi - har ek ko sau kode maaro."

40.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ مَسْعُودٍ - عَنْ شِبْلٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، قَالَ السَّبِيلُ الْحَدُّ قَالَ سُفْيَانُ ‏{‏ فَآذُوهُمَا ‏}‏ الْبِكْرَانِ ‏{‏ فَأَمْسِكُوهُنَّ فِي الْبُيُوتِ ‏}‏ الثَّيِّبَاتِ ‏.‏
40.en: Mujahid said:“Apponting a way in the verse (iv.15) means prescribed punishment. Sufiyan said: “Punish them “refers to unmarried, and “confine them to houses” refers to the women who are married
40.hi: Mujahid kehte hain: Aayat (4:15) mein 'koi raah muqarrar karna' ka matlab hai farz saza. Sufiyan kehte hain: 'Unhein saza do' ka ishara un-shaadi-shuda logon ki taraf hai, aur 'unhein ghar mein qaid rakho' ka ishara shaadi-shuda auraton ki taraf hai.

40.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي عَرُوبَةَ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، عَنْ حِطَّانَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الرَّقَاشِيِّ، عَنْ عُبَادَةَ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ خُذُوا عَنِّي خُذُوا عَنِّي قَدْ جَعَلَ اللَّهُ لَهُنَّ سَبِيلاً الثَّيِّبُ بِالثَّيِّبِ جَلْدُ مِائَةٍ وَرَمْىٌ بِالْحِجَارَةِ وَالْبِكْرُ بِالْبِكْرِ جَلْدُ مِائَةٍ وَنَفْىُ سَنَةٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
40.en: ‘Ubadah b. al-Samit reported the Messenger of Allah(ﷺ) as sayings:Receive my teachings, receive my teachings. Allah has appointed a way for those women. If the parties have been married, they shall receive a hundred lashes and stoned to death. If the parties are unmarried, they shall receive a hundred lashes and banished for a year
40.hi: Hazrat Ubadah bin as-Samit bayaan karte hain: Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne yeh kehte suna: Meri taleem qabool karo, meri taleem qabool karo. Allah ne un auraton ke liye ek raah muqarrar ki hai. Agar shaadi-shuda logon ne (zina kiya ho), unhein sau kode aur sangsaar milega. Agar log un-shaadi-shuda hon, unhein sau kode aur ek saal ke liye desh-nikaala milega.

40.ar: حَدَّثَنَا وَهْبُ بْنُ بَقِيَّةَ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الصَّبَّاحِ بْنِ سُفْيَانَ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، بِإِسْنَادِ يَحْيَى وَمَعْنَاهُ قَالاَ ‏ "‏ جَلْدُ مِائَةٍ وَالرَّجْمُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
40.en: A similar tradition has been transmitted by al-Hasan through a chain of Yahya and to the same effect. This version adds:They shall receive a hundred lashes and toned to death
40.hi: Isi jaisi riwayat bhi al-Hasan se Yahya ki sanad ke zariye isi tarah riwayat ki gayi hai. Iss version mein izaafa hai: Unhein sau kode aur sangsaar milega.

40.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَوْفٍ الطَّائِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا الرَّبِيعُ بْنُ رَوْحِ بْنِ خُلَيْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، - يَعْنِي الْوَهْبِيَّ - حَدَّثَنَا الْفَضْلُ بْنُ دَلْهَمٍ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، عَنْ سَلَمَةَ بْنِ الْمُحَبَّقِ، عَنْ عُبَادَةَ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِهَذَا الْحَدِيثِ فَقَالَ نَاسٌ لِسَعْدِ بْنِ عُبَادَةَ يَا أَبَا ثَابِتٍ قَدْ نَزَلَتِ الْحُدُودُ لَوْ أَنَّكَ وَجَدْتَ مَعَ امْرَأَتِكَ رَجُلاً كَيْفَ كُنْتَ صَانِعًا قَالَ كُنْتُ ضَارِبَهُمَا بِالسَّيْفِ حَتَّى يَسْكُتَا أَفَأَنَا أَذْهَبُ فَأَجْمَعُ أَرْبَعَةَ شُهَدَاءَ فَإِلَى ذَلِكَ قَدْ قَضَى الْحَاجَةَ ‏.‏ فَانْطَلَقُوا فَاجْتَمَعُوا عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى أَبِي ثَابِتٍ قَالَ كَذَا وَكَذَا فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ كَفَى بِالسَّيْفِ شَاهِدًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ لاَ أَخَافُ أَنْ يَتَتَايَعَ فِيهَا السَّكْرَانُ وَالْغَيْرَانُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو دَاوُدَ رَوَى وَكِيعٌ أَوَّلَ هَذَا الْحَدِيثِ عَنِ الْفَضْلِ بْنِ دَلْهَمٍ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ عَنْ قَبِيصَةَ بْنِ حُرَيْثٍ عَنْ سَلَمَةَ بْنِ الْمُحَبَّقِ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ وَإِنَّمَا هَذَا إِسْنَادُ حَدِيثِ ابْنِ الْمُحَبَّقِ أَنَّ رَجُلاً وَقَعَ عَلَى جَارِيَةِ امْرَأَتِهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو دَاوُدَ الْفَضْلُ بْنُ دَلْهَمٍ لَيْسَ بِالْحَافِظِ كَانَ قَصَّابًا بِوَاسِطَ ‏.‏
40.en: Narrated Ubadah ibn as-Samit: The tradition mentioned above (No. 4401) has also been transmitted by Ubadah ibn as-Samit through a different chain of narrators. This version has: The people said to Sa'd ibn Ubadah: AbuThabit, the prescribed punishments have been revealed: if you find a man with your wife, what will you do? He said: I shall strike them with a sword so much that they become silent (i.e. die). Should I go and gather four witnesses? Until that (time) the need would be fulfilled. So they went away and gathered with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and said: Messenger of Allah! did you not see AbuThabit. He said so-and-so. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: The sword is a sufficient witness. He then said: No, no, a furious and a jealous man may follow this course. Abu Dawud said: This tradition has been transmitted by Waki' from al-Fadl b. Dilham from al-Hasan, from Qabisah b. Huraith, from Salamah b. al-Muhabbaq, from the Prophet (ﷺ). And this is the chain of the tradition narrated by Ibn al-Muhabbaq to the effect that a man had sexual intercourse with a slave girl of his wife. Abu Dawud said: Al-Fadl b. Dilham was not the memoriser of traditions. He was a butcher in Wasit
40.hi: Hazrat Ubadah bin as-Samit bayaan karte hain: Upar zikr ki gayi riwayat (No. 4401) bhi Ubadah bin as-Samit se isi tarah ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai. Iss version mein hai: Logon ne Sa'd bin Ubadah se kaha: Abu Thabit, farz sazaen nazil ho chuki hain: agar aap apni biwi ke saath kisi aadmi ko paayein, aap kya karenge? Unhone kaha: Main unhein talwaar se maarunga yahan tak ke woh khamosh ho jaayein (yaani, mar jaayein). Kya mujhe jaakar chaar gawaah jama karne chaahiye? Us waqt tak zaroorat poori ho chuki hogi. So woh chale gaye aur Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ke paas jama hokar kaha: Allah ke Rasool! Kya aapne Abu Thabit ki baat nahi suni? Unhone fulan-fulan kaha. Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne kaha: Talwaar kaafi gawaahi hai. Fir aapne kaha: Nahi, nahi, ek gusse aur rashk mein bhare aadmi is raaste par chal sakte hain. Abu Dawud kehte hain: Yeh riwayat Waki' ne al-Fadl bin Dilham se, al-Hasan se, Qabisah bin Huraith se, Salamah bin al-Muhabbaq se, Nabi (ﷺ) se riwayat ki hai. Aur yeh Ibn al-Muhabbaq ki us riwayat ki sanad hai jismein ek aadmi ne apni biwi ki laundi se jinsi sohbat ki. Abu Dawud kehte hain: Al-Fadl bin Dilham riwaayaton ko yaad rakhne wale nahi the. Woh Wasit mein qassab the.

40.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ النُّفَيْلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، حَدَّثَنَا الزُّهْرِيُّ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ عُمَرَ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ الْخَطَّابِ - رضى الله عنه خَطَبَ فَقَالَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ بَعَثَ مُحَمَّدًا صلى الله عليه وسلم بِالْحَقِّ وَأَنْزَلَ عَلَيْهِ الْكِتَابَ فَكَانَ فِيمَا أَنْزَلَ عَلَيْهِ آيَةُ الرَّجْمِ فَقَرَأْنَاهَا وَوَعَيْنَاهَا وَرَجَمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَرَجَمْنَا مِنْ بَعْدِهِ وَإِنِّي خَشِيتُ - إِنْ طَالَ بِالنَّاسِ الزَّمَانُ - أَنْ يَقُولَ قَائِلٌ مَا نَجِدُ آيَةَ الرَّجْمِ فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ فَيَضِلُّوا بِتَرْكِ فَرِيضَةٍ أَنْزَلَهَا اللَّهُ تَعَالَى فَالرَّجْمُ حَقٌّ عَلَى مَنْ زَنَى مِنَ الرِّجَالِ وَالنِّسَاءِ إِذَا كَانَ مُحْصَنًا إِذَا قَامَتِ الْبَيِّنَةُ أَوْ كَانَ حَمْلٌ أَوِ اعْتِرَافٌ وَايْمُ اللَّهِ لَوْلاَ أَنْ يَقُولَ النَّاسُ زَادَ عُمَرُ فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ لَكَتَبْتُهَا ‏.‏
40.en: ‘Abd Allah b. ‘Abbas said:‘Umar b. al-Khattab gave an address saying: Allah sent Muhammad (ﷺ) with truth and sent down the Books of him, and the verse of stoning was included in what He sent down to him. We read it and memorized it. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had people stoned to death and we have done it also since his death. I am afraid the people might say with the passage of time: We do not find the verse of stoning in the Books of Allah, and thus they stray by abandoning a duty which Allah had received. Stoning is a duty laid down (by Allah) for married men and women who commit fornication when proof is established, or if there is pregnancy, or a confession. I swear by Allah, had it not been so that the people might say: ‘Umar made an addition to Allah’s Book, I would have written it (there)
40.hi: Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas bayaan karte hain: Umar bin Khattab ne khutba diya, kehte hue: Allah ne Muhammad (ﷺ) ko haq ke saath bheja aur usper Kitaab nazil ki, aur sangsaar ki aayat woh cheez thi jo Usne unhein nazil ki. Humne ise padha aur yaad rakha. Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne logon ko sangsaar karvaaya aur humne bhi unke baad aisa kiya. Mujhe dar hai ke waqt guzarne ke saath log kahenge: Humein Allah ki Kitaab mein sangsaar ki aayat nahi milti, aur isi wajah se woh ek farz chhodkar bhatak jaayein jo Allah ne nazil kiya tha. Sangsaar shaadi-shuda mardon aur auraton ke liye ek farz hai jo zina karein, jab saboot mile, ya haaml hon, ya iqraar karein. Main Allah ki qasam khaata hoon, agar aisa na hota ke log kehte: Umar ne Allah ki Kitaab mein izaafa kiya, main isse wahan likhta.

40.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ الأَنْبَارِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي يَزِيدُ بْنُ نُعَيْمِ بْنِ هَزَّالٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ كَانَ مَاعِزُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ يَتِيمًا فِي حِجْرِ أَبِي ‏.‏ فَأَصَابَ جَارِيَةً مِنَ الْحَىِّ فَقَالَ لَهُ أَبِي ائْتِ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَخْبِرْهُ بِمَا صَنَعْتَ لَعَلَّهُ يَسْتَغْفِرُ لَكَ وَإِنَّمَا يُرِيدُ بِذَلِكَ رَجَاءَ أَنْ يَكُونَ لَهُ مَخْرَجًا فَأَتَاهُ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي زَنَيْتُ فَأَقِمْ عَلَىَّ كِتَابَ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ فَأَعْرَضَ عَنْهُ فَعَادَ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي زَنَيْتُ فَأَقِمْ عَلَىَّ كِتَابَ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ حَتَّى قَالَهَا أَرْبَعَ مِرَارٍ ‏.‏ قَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنَّكَ قَدْ قُلْتَهَا أَرْبَعَ مَرَّاتٍ فَبِمَنْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ بِفُلاَنَةَ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ هَلْ ضَاجَعْتَهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ هَلْ بَاشَرْتَهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ هَلْ جَامَعْتَهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَأَمَرَ بِهِ أَنْ يُرْجَمَ فَأُخْرِجَ بِهِ إِلَى الْحَرَّةِ ‏.‏ فَلَمَّا رُجِمَ فَوَجَدَ مَسَّ الْحِجَارَةِ جَزِعَ فَخَرَجَ يَشْتَدُّ فَلَقِيَهُ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أُنَيْسٍ وَقَدْ عَجَزَ أَصْحَابُهُ فَنَزَعَ لَهُ بِوَظِيفِ بَعِيرٍ فَرَمَاهُ بِهِ فَقَتَلَهُ ثُمَّ أَتَى النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَذَكَرَ ذَلِكَ لَهُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ هَلاَّ تَرَكْتُمُوهُ لَعَلَّهُ أَنْ يَتُوبَ فَيَتُوبَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
40.en: Narrated Nu'aym ibn Huzzal: Yazid ibn Nu'aym ibn Huzzal, on his father's authority said: Ma'iz ibn Malik was an orphan under the protection of my father. He had illegal sexual intercourse with a slave-girl belonging to a clan. My father said to him: Go to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and inform him of what you have done, for he may perhaps ask Allah for your forgiveness. His purpose in that was simply a hope that it might be a way of escape for him. So he went to him and said: Messenger of Allah! I have committed fornication, so inflict on me the punishment ordained by Allah. He (the Prophet) turned away from him, so he came back and said: Messenger of Allah! I have committed fornication, so inflict on me the punishment ordained by Allah. He (again) turned away from him, so he came back and said: Messenger of Allah! I have committed fornication, so inflict on me the punishment ordained by Allah. When he uttered it four times, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: You have said it four times. With whom did you commit it? He replied: With so and so. He asked: Did you lie down with her? He replied: Yes. He asked: Had your skin been in contact with hers? He replied. Yes. He asked: Did you have intercourse with her? He said: Yes. So he (the Prophet) gave orders that he should be stoned to death. He was then taken out to the Harrah, and while he was being stoned he felt the effect of the stones and could not bear it and fled. But Abdullah ibn Unays encountered him when those who had been stoning him could not catch up with him. He threw the bone of a camel's foreleg at him, which hit him and killed him. They then went to the Prophet (ﷺ) and reported it to him. He said: Why did you not leave him alone. Perhaps he might have repented and been forgiven by Allah
40.hi: Hazrat Nu'aym bin Huzzal bayaan karte hain: Yazid bin Nu'aym bin Huzzal, apne walid ke hawale se, kehte hain: Ma'iz bin Malik mere walid ki sarparasti mein ek yateem the. Unhone kisi khaandaan ki ek laundi se naa-jaayez jinsi sohbat ki. Mere walid ne unse kaha: Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ke paas jao aur unhein bataao jo tumne kiya, kyunki shaayad woh Allah se tumhaari maafi maang sakein. Unka maqsad sirf yeh tha ke shaayad yeh unke liye chhutkaare ka koi raasta ho. So woh unke paas gaye aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool! Maine zina kiya hai, so mujhpar woh farz saza laagu karein jo Allah ne muqarrar ki hai. Aap (Nabi ﷺ) ne unse apna mudh phera, so woh wapas aaye aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool! Maine zina kiya hai, so mujhpar woh farz saza laagu karein jo Allah ne muqarrar ki hai. Aapne (fir) unse apna mudh phera, so woh wapas aaye aur kaha: Allah ke Rasool! Maine zina kiya hai, so mujhpar woh farz saza laagu karein jo Allah ne muqarrar ki hai. Jab unhone yeh chaar martaba kaha, Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne kaha: Tumne yeh chaar martaba kaha. Kiske saath tumne yeh kiya? Unhone jawaab diya: Fulan-fulan ke saath. Aapne poocha: Kya tum unke saath leta the? Unhone jawaab diya: Ji haan. Aapne poocha: Kya tumhaari khaal unki khaal se chhui? Unhone jawaab diya: Ji haan. Aapne poocha: Kya tumne unke saath sohbat ki? Unhone kaha: Ji haan. So aapne hukum diya ke unhein sangsaar kiya jaaye. Fir unhein Harrah le jaaya gaya, aur jabke unhein sangsaar kiya jaa raha tha, unhone patharon ka asar mehsoos kiya aur isse bardaasht na kar saken aur bhaag gaye. Lekin Abdullah bin Unays unse takraaye jabke jo unhein sangsaar kar rahe the woh unhein pakad na sake. Unhone oont ki agli taang ki haddi unpar phenki jo unhein lagi aur unhein qatal kar diya. Woh fir Nabi (ﷺ) ke paas gaye aur unhein iski khabar di. Aapne kaha: Tumne unhein akela kyun nahi chhod diya? Shaayad woh tauba karte aur Allah unhein maaf kar deta.

40.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ بْنِ مَيْسَرَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ، قَالَ ذَكَرْتُ لِعَاصِمِ بْنِ عُمَرَ بْنِ قَتَادَةَ قِصَّةَ مَاعِزِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ فَقَالَ لِي حَدَّثَنِي حَسَنُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي ذَلِكَ، مِنْ قَوْلِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ فَهَلاَّ تَرَكْتُمُوهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ مَنْ شِئْتُمْ مِنْ رِجَالِ أَسْلَمَ مِمَّنْ لاَ أَتَّهِمُ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَلَمْ أَعْرِفْ هَذَا الْحَدِيثَ قَالَ فَجِئْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ فَقُلْتُ إِنَّ رِجَالاً مِنْ أَسْلَمَ يُحَدِّثُونَ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ لَهُمْ حِينَ ذَكَرُوا لَهُ جَزَعَ مَاعِزٍ مِنَ الْحِجَارَةِ حِينَ أَصَابَتْهُ ‏"‏ أَلاَّ تَرَكْتُمُوهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَمَا أَعْرِفُ الْحَدِيثَ قَالَ يَا ابْنَ أَخِي أَنَا أَعْلَمُ النَّاسِ بِهَذَا الْحَدِيثِ كُنْتُ فِيمَنْ رَجَمَ الرَّجُلَ إِنَّا لَمَّا خَرَجْنَا بِهِ فَرَجَمْنَاهُ فَوَجَدَ مَسَّ الْحِجَارَةِ صَرَخَ بِنَا يَا قَوْمِ رُدُّونِي إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَإِنَّ قَوْمِي قَتَلُونِي وَغَرُّونِي مِنْ نَفْسِي وَأَخْبَرُونِي أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم غَيْرُ قَاتِلِي فَلَمْ نَنْزِعْ عَنْهُ حَتَّى قَتَلْنَاهُ فَلَمَّا رَجَعْنَا إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَخْبَرْنَاهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَهَلاَّ تَرَكْتُمُوهُ وَجِئْتُمُونِي بِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ لِيَسْتَثْبِتَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْهُ فَأَمَّا لِتَرْكِ حَدٍّ فَلاَ قَالَ فَعَرَفْتُ وَجْهَ الْحَدِيثِ ‏.‏
40.en: Narrated Jabir ibn Abdullah: Muhammad ibn Ishaq said: I mentioned the story of Ma'iz ibn Malik to Asim ibn Umar ibn Qatadah. He said to me: Hasan ibn Muhammad ibn Ali ibn AbuTalib said to me: Some men of the tribe of Aslam whom I do not blame and whom you like have transmitted to me the saying of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ): Why did you not leave him alone? He said: But I did not understand this tradition. So I went to Jabir ibn Abdullah and said (to him): Some men of the tribe of Aslam narrate that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said when they mentioned to him the anxiety of Ma'iz when the stones hurt him: "Why did you not leave him alone?' But I do not know this tradition. He said: My cousin, I know this tradition more than the people. I was one of those who had stoned the man. When we came out with him, stoned him and he felt the effect of the stones, he cried: O people! return me to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). My people killed me and deceived me; they told me that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) would not kill me. We did not keep away from him till we killed him. When we returned to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) we informed him of it. He said: Why did you not leave him alone and bring him to me? and he said this so that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) might ascertain it from him. But he did not say this to abandon the prescribed punishment. He said: I then understood the intent of the tradition
40.hi: Hazrat Jabir bin Abdullah bayaan karte hain: Muhammad bin Ishaq kehte hain: Maine Ma'iz bin Malik ki kahaani Asim bin Umar bin Qatadah ko zikr ki. Unhone mujhse kaha: Hasan bin Muhammad bin Ali bin Abi Talib ne mujhse kaha: Aslam qabeele ke kuch aadmi jinhein main dosh nahi deta aur jinhein tum pasand karte ho ne mujhe Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ka farmaan bataaya: Tumne unhein akela kyun nahi chhod diya? Unhone kaha: Lekin main iss riwayat ko samajh na saka. So main Jabir bin Abdullah ke paas gaya aur (unse) kaha: Aslam qabeele ke kuch aadmi riwayat karte hain ke Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne kaha jab unhone unhein Ma'iz ki bechaini ka zikr kiya jab patharon ne unhein takleef pahunchaayi: 'Tumne unhein akela kyun nahi chhod diya?' Lekin mujhe yeh riwayat nahi maloom. Unhone kaha: Mere chachaazaad bhai, mujhe yeh riwayat logon se zyada maloom hai. Main un logon mein se tha jinhone us aadmi ko sangsaar kiya. Jab hum unke saath baahar aaye, unhein sangsaar kiya, aur unhone patharon ka asar mehsoos kiya, woh cheeikhe: Ae logo! Mujhe Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ke paas wapas kar do. Mere logon ne mujhe qatal kiya aur mujhe dhoka diya; unhone mujhe bataaya ke Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) mujhe qatal nahi karenge. Humne unhein akela nahi chhoda jab tak humne unhein qatal nahi kiya. Jab hum Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ke paas wapas aaye, humne unhein iski khabar di. Aapne kaha: Tumne unhein akela kyun nahi chhoda aur mere paas kyun nahi laaye? Aur aapne yeh isliye kaha taake Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) yeh unse jaanch saken. Lekin aapne yeh farz saza chhodne ke liye nahi kaha. Unhone kaha: Fir maine iss riwayat ka matlab samjha.

40.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كَامِلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ، - يَعْنِي الْحَذَّاءَ - عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ مَاعِزَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، أَتَى النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ إِنَّهُ زَنَى ‏.‏ فَأَعْرَضَ عَنْهُ فَأَعَادَ عَلَيْهِ مِرَارًا فَأَعْرَضَ عَنْهُ فَسَأَلَ قَوْمَهُ ‏"‏ أَمَجْنُونٌ هُوَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا لَيْسَ بِهِ بَأْسٌ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَفَعَلْتَ بِهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ فَأَمَرَ بِهِ أَنْ يُرْجَمَ فَانْطُلِقَ بِهِ فَرُجِمَ وَلَمْ يُصَلِّ عَلَيْهِ ‏.‏
40.en: Narrated Abdullah ibn Abbas: Ma'iz ibn Malik came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said that he had committed fornication and he (the Prophet) turned away from him. He repeated it many times, but he (the Prophet) turned away from him. He asked his people: Is he mad? They replied: There is no defect in him. He asked: Have you done it with her? He replied: Yes. so he ordered that he should be stoned to death. He was taken out and stoned to death, and he (the Prophet) did not pray over him
40.hi: Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas bayaan karte hain: Ma'iz bin Malik Nabi (ﷺ) ke paas aaye aur kaha ke unhone zina kiya hai, aur aap (Nabi ﷺ) ne unse apna mudh phera. Unhone yeh kayi baar dohraaya, lekin aapne unse apna mudh phera. Aapne unke logon se poocha: Kya woh paagal hain? Unhone jawaab diya: Unme koi kami nahi. Aapne poocha: Kya tumne unke saath yeh kiya hai? Unhone jawaab diya: Ji haan. So aapne hukum diya ke unhein sangsaar kiya jaaye. Unhein baahar laaya gaya aur sangsaar kiya gaya, aur aapne (Nabi ne) unpar namaz nahi padhi.

40.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ سِمَاكٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ سَمُرَةَ، قَالَ رَأَيْتُ مَاعِزَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ حِينَ جِيءَ بِهِ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَجُلاً قَصِيرًا أَعْضَلَ لَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ رِدَاءٌ فَشَهِدَ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ أَرْبَعَ مَرَّاتٍ أَنَّهُ قَدْ زَنَى ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ فَلَعَلَّكَ قَبَّلْتَهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ لاَ وَاللَّهِ إِنَّهُ قَدْ زَنَى الآخِرُ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَرَجَمَهُ ثُمَّ خَطَبَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَلاَ كُلَّمَا نَفَرْنَا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ خَلَفَ أَحَدُهُمْ لَهُ نَبِيبٌ كَنَبِيبِ التَّيْسِ يَمْنَحُ إِحْدَاهُنَّ الْكُثْبَةَ أَمَا إِنَّ اللَّهَ إِنْ يُمَكِّنِّي مِنْ أَحَدٍ مِنْهُمْ إِلاَّ نَكَلْتُهُ عَنْهُنَّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
40.en: Jabir b. Samurah said:I saw Ma’iz b. Malik when he was brought to the Prophet (ﷺ). He was a small and muscular man. He did not wear the loose outer garment. He made confession about him four times that he committed fornication. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Perhaps you kissed her. He said that this most discarded man has committed fornication. He said: So he had him stoned to death and gave an address, saying: Beware, whenever we go out on an expedition in the path of Allah, one of them (I.e. the people) lags behind with a bleating sound like that of a he-goat, and gives modicum of his milk(i.e. sperm) to one of the women. If Allah gives control over any of them, I shall deter him from them (i.e. women) by punishing him severely
40.hi: Jabir bin Samurah kehte hain: Maine Ma'iz bin Malik ko dekha jab woh Nabi (ﷺ) ke paas laaye gaye. Woh chhota aur mazboot jism wale aadmi the. Unhone loose bahri kapda nahi pehna tha. Unhone chaar martaba iqraar kiya ke unhone zina kiya. Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne kaha: Shaayad tumne unhein sirf chooma ho. Unhone kaha ke iss badnaseeb aadmi ne zina kiya hai. Unhone kaha: So aapne unhein sangsaar karwaaya aur khutba diya, kehte hue: Khabardaar, jab bhi hum Allah ki raah mein kisi muhim par jaate hain, unmein se ek (yaani, log) piche reh jaata hai bakre jaisi awaaz ke saath, aur apni thodi si doodh (yaani, virya) kisi aurat ko de deta hai. Agar Allah mujhe unmein se kisi par ikhtiyaar de, main unhein saza dekar unse (yaani, auraton se) door rakhunga.

40.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ سِمَاكٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ سَمُرَةَ، بِهَذَا الْحَدِيثِ وَالأَوَّلُ أَتَمُّ قَالَ فَرَدَّهُ مَرَّتَيْنِ ‏.‏ قَالَ سِمَاكٌ فَحَدَّثْتُ بِهِ سَعِيدَ بْنَ جُبَيْرٍ فَقَالَ إِنَّهُ رَدَّهُ أَرْبَعَ مَرَّاتٍ ‏.‏
40.en: Simak said:I heard this tradition from Jabir b. Samurah. But the first version is more perfect. This version has: He repeated twice, Simak said: I narrated to Sa’id b. Jubair. He said: He repeated it four times
40.hi: Simak kehte hain: Maine yeh riwayat Jabir bin Samurah se suni. Lekin pehla version zyada mukammal hai. Iss version mein hai: Unhone do martaba dohraaya. Simak kehte hain: Maine yeh Sa'id bin Jubair ko riwayat ki. Unhone kaha: Unhone yeh chaar martaba dohraaya.

40.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْغَنِيِّ بْنُ أَبِي عَقِيلٍ الْمِصْرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ - قَالَ قَالَ شُعْبَةُ فَسَأَلْتُ سِمَاكًا عَنِ الْكُثْبَةِ فَقَالَ اللَّبَنُ الْقَلِيلُ ‏.‏
40.en: Shu’bah said:I asked Simak about the meaning of KUTHBAH. He said: A small quantity of milk
40.hi: Shu'bah kehte hain: Maine Simak se KUTHBAH ka matlab poocha. Unhone jawaab diya: Doodh ki thodi si miqdaar.

40.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُسَدَّدٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ سِمَاكِ بْنِ حَرْبٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِمَاعِزِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ‏"‏ أَحَقٌّ مَا بَلَغَنِي عَنْكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَمَا بَلَغَكَ عَنِّي قَالَ ‏"‏ بَلَغَنِي عَنْكَ أَنَّكَ وَقَعْتَ عَلَى جَارِيَةِ بَنِي فُلاَنٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ فَشَهِدَ أَرْبَعَ شَهَادَاتٍ فَأَمَرَ بِهِ فَرُجِمَ ‏.‏
40.en: Ibn ‘Abbas said:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) asked Ma’iz b. Malik : Is what I have heard about you is true? He said: What have you heard about me? He said: I have heard that you have had intercourse with a girl belonging to the family of so and so. He said: Yes. He then testified four times. He (The prophet) then gave order regarding him and he was stoned to death
40.hi: Ibn Abbas kehte hain: Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne Ma'iz bin Malik se poocha: Kya jo maine tumhaare baare mein suna hai woh sach hai? Unhone poocha: Aapne mere baare mein kya suna hai? Aapne kaha: Maine suna hai tumne fulan-fulan khaandaan ki ek ladki ke saath sohbat ki. Unhone jawaab diya: Ji haan. Fir unhone chaar martaba gawaahi di. Aapne (Nabi ne) fir unke baare mein hukum diya aur unhein sangsaar kiya gaya.

40.ar: حَدَّثَنَا نَصْرُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو أَحْمَدَ، أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْرَائِيلُ، عَنْ سِمَاكِ بْنِ حَرْبٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ جَاءَ مَاعِزُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَاعْتَرَفَ بِالزِّنَا مَرَّتَيْنِ فَطَرَدَهُ ثُمَّ جَاءَ فَاعْتَرَفَ بِالزِّنَا مَرَّتَيْنِ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ شَهِدْتَ عَلَى نَفْسِكَ أَرْبَعَ مَرَّاتٍ اذْهَبُوا بِهِ فَارْجُمُوهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
40.en: Narrated Abdullah ibn Abbas: Ma'iz ibn Malik came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and admitted fornication twice. But he drove him away. He then came and admitted fornication twice. But he drove him away. He then came and admitted fornication twice. He (the Prophet) said: You have testified to yourself four times. Take him away and stone him to death
40.hi: Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas bayaan karte hain: Ma'iz bin Malik Nabi (ﷺ) ke paas aaye aur do martaba zina ka iqraar kiya. Lekin aapne unhein hataaya. Fir woh aaye aur do martaba zina ka iqraar kiya. Lekin aapne unhein hataaya. Fir woh aaye aur do martaba zina ka iqraar kiya. Aapne (Nabi ne) kaha: Tumne apne khilaaf chaar martaba gawaahi di. Unhein le jaao aur sangsaar karo.

40.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، حَدَّثَنِي يَعْلَى، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ح وَحَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ وَعُقْبَةُ بْنُ مُكْرَمٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا وَهْبُ بْنُ جَرِيرٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي قَالَ سَمِعْتُ يَعْلَى بْنَ حَكِيمٍ يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ لِمَاعِزِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ‏"‏ لَعَلَّكَ قَبَّلْتَ أَوْ غَمَزْتَ أَوْ نَظَرْتَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ لاَ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَفَنِكْتَهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَعِنْدَ ذَلِكَ أَمَرَ بِرَجْمِهِ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ مُوسَى عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ وَهَذَا لَفْظُ وَهْبٍ ‏.‏
40.en: Narrated Abdullah ibn Abbas: The Prophet (ﷺ) said to Ma'iz ibn Malik: Perhaps you kissed, or squeezed, or looked. He said: No. He then said: Did you have intercourse with her? He said: Yes. On the (reply) he (the Prophet) gave order that he should be stoned to death. The narrator did not mention "on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas". This is Wahb's version
40.hi: Hazrat Abdullah bin Abbas bayaan karte hain: Nabi (ﷺ) ne Ma'iz bin Malik se kaha: Shaayad tumne unhein chooma, ya dabaaya, ya dekha. Unhone kaha: Nahi. Fir aapne kaha: Kya tumne unke saath sohbat ki? Unhone kaha: Ji haan. Iss jawaab par aapne (Nabi ne) hukum diya ke unhein sangsaar kiya jaaye. Raawi ne 'Ibn Abbas ke hawale se' ke alfaaz zikr nahi kiye. Yeh Wahb ka version hai.

40.ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ الصَّامِتِ ابْنَ عَمِّ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ، سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، يَقُولُ جَاءَ الأَسْلَمِيُّ إِلَى نَبِيِّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَشَهِدَ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ أَنَّهُ أَصَابَ امْرَأَةً حَرَامًا أَرْبَعَ مَرَّاتٍ كُلُّ ذَلِكَ يُعْرِضُ عَنْهُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَقْبَلَ فِي الْخَامِسَةِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَنِكْتَهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ حَتَّى غَابَ ذَلِكَ مِنْكَ فِي ذَلِكَ مِنْهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ كَمَا يَغِيبُ الْمِرْوَدُ فِي الْمُكْحُلَةِ وَالرِّشَاءُ فِي الْبِئْرِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَهَلْ تَدْرِي مَا الزِّنَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ نَعَمْ أَتَيْتُ مِنْهَا حَرَامًا مَا يَأْتِي الرَّجُلُ مِنِ امْرَأَتِهِ حَلاَلاً ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَمَا تُرِيدُ بِهَذَا الْقَوْلِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أُرِيدُ أَنْ تُطَهِّرَنِي ‏.‏ فَأَمَرَ بِهِ فَرُجِمَ فَسَمِعَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَجُلَيْنِ مِنْ أَصْحَابِهِ يَقُولُ أَحَدُهُمَا لِصَاحِبِهِ انْظُرْ إِلَى هَذَا الَّذِي سَتَرَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ فَلَمْ تَدَعْهُ نَفْسُهُ حَتَّى رُجِمَ رَجْمَ الْكَلْبِ ‏.‏ فَسَكَتَ عَنْهُمَا ثُمَّ سَارَ سَاعَةً حَتَّى مَرَّ بِجِيفَةِ حِمَارٍ شَائِلٍ بِرِجْلِهِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَيْنَ فُلاَنٌ وَفُلاَنٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالاَ نَحْنُ ذَانِ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ انْزِلاَ فَكُلاَ مِنْ جِيفَةِ هَذَا الْحِمَارِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالاَ يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ مَنْ يَأْكُلُ مِنْ هَذَا قَالَ ‏"‏ فَمَا نِلْتُمَا مِنْ عِرْضِ أَخِيكُمَا آنِفًا أَشَدُّ مِنْ أَكْلٍ مِنْهُ وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ إِنَّهُ الآنَ لَفِي أَنْهَارِ الْجَنَّةِ يَنْقَمِسُ فِيهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
40.en: Narrated AbuHurayrah: A man of the tribe of Aslam came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and testified four times against himself that he had had illicit intercourse with a woman, while all the time the Prophet (ﷺ) was turning away from him. Then when he confessed a fifth time, he turned round and asked: Did you have intercourse with her? He replied: Yes. He asked: Have you done it so that your sexual organ penetrated hers? He replied: Yes. He asked: Have you done it like a collyrium stick when enclosed in its case and a rope in a well? He replied: Yes. He asked: Do you know what fornication is? He replied: Yes. I have done with her unlawfully what a man may lawfully do with his wife. He then asked: What do you want from what you have said? He said: I want you to purify me. So he gave orders regarding him and he was stoned to death. Then the Prophet (ﷺ) heard one of his companions saying to another: Look at this man whose fault was concealed by Allah but who would not leave the matter alone, so that he was stoned like a dog. He said nothing to them but walked on for a time till he came to the corpse of an ass with its legs in the air. He asked: Where are so and so? They said: Here we are, Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)! He said: Go down and eat some of this ass's corpse. They replied: Messenger of Allah! Who can eat any of this? He said: The dishonour you have just shown to your brother is more serious than eating some of it. By Him in Whose hand my soul is, he is now among the rivers of Paradise and plunging into them
40.hi: Hazrat Abu Hurairah bayaan karte hain: Aslam qabeele ka ek aadmi Nabi (ﷺ) ke paas aaya aur apne khilaaf chaar martaba gawaahi di ke unhone kisi aurat se naa-jaayez sohbat ki, jabke poore waqt Nabi (ﷺ) unse apna mudh pherte rahe. Fir jab unhone paanchvi baar iqraar kiya, aap muDhe aur poocha: Kya tumne unke saath sohbat ki? Unhone jawaab diya: Ji haan. Aapne poocha: Kya tumne aisa kiya ke tumhaari sharmgaah unki sharmgaah mein dakhil hui? Unhone jawaab diya: Ji haan. Aapne poocha: Kya tumne aisa kiya jaise surmadaan ki taan uske dabbe mein aur rassi ek kuen mein hoti hai? Unhone jawaab diya: Ji haan. Aapne poocha: Kya tumhein maloom hai zina kya hota hai? Unhone jawaab diya: Ji haan. Maine unke saath woh naa-jaayez amal kiya jo koi aadmi apni biwi ke saath jaayez taur par kar sakta hai. Fir aapne poocha: Tum apni is baat se kya chaahte ho? Unhone kaha: Main chaahta hoon aap mujhe paak karein. So aapne unke baare mein hukum diya aur unhein sangsaar kiya gaya. Fir Nabi (ﷺ) ne apne sahaba mein se ek ko doosre se yeh kehte suna: Iss aadmi ko dekho jinki khaamiyaan Allah ne chhupaayi thi lekin jinhone iss maamle ko akela nahi chhoda, so unhein kutte ki tarah sangsaar kiya gaya. Aapne unhein kuch nahi kaha lekin thodi der chalte rahe yahan tak ke aap ek gadhe ki laash ke paas pahunche jiski taange upar thi. Aapne poocha: Fulan-fulan kahan hain? Unhone kaha: Hum yahan hain, Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ)! Aapne kaha: Utro aur is gadhe ki laash mein se kuch khao. Unhone jawaab diya: Allah ke Rasool! Ise koi kaise khaa sakta hai? Aapne kaha: Jo be-izzati tumne abhi apne bhai ko dikhaayi hai woh isme se kuch khaane se zyada sakht hai. Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, woh ab Jannat ki nadiyon mein hai aur unme dubki lagaa rahe hain.

40.ar: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَمِّ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، بِنَحْوِهِ زَادَ وَاخْتَلَفُوا فَقَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ رُبِطَ إِلَى شَجَرَةٍ وَقَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ وَقَفَ ‏.‏
40.en: A similar tradition has also been transmitted by Abu Hurrairah through a different chain of narrators. This version adds:The narrator Hasan b. “All said: The transmitters have differed in the wordings (of this tradition) reported to me. Some said: He (Ma’iz) was tied to a tree, and others said: He was made to stand
40.hi: Isi jaisi riwayat bhi Abu Hurairah se isi tarah ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai. Iss version mein izaafa hai: Raawi Hasan bin Ali kehte hain: Riwaayaton mein alfaaz ka ikhtilaaf hai jo mujhe bataayi gayi. Kuch ne kaha: (Ma'iz) ko ek darakht se baandha gaya, aur doosron ne kaha: Unhein khada kiya gaya.

40.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُتَوَكِّلِ الْعَسْقَلاَنِيُّ، وَالْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّ رَجُلاً، مِنْ أَسْلَمَ جَاءَ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَاعْتَرَفَ بِالزِّنَا فَأَعْرَضَ عَنْهُ ثُمَّ اعْتَرَفَ فَأَعْرَضَ عَنْهُ حَتَّى شَهِدَ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ أَرْبَعَ شَهَادَاتٍ فَقَالَ لَهُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَبِكَ جُنُونٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ لاَ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَحْصَنْتَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَأَمَرَ بِهِ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَرُجِمَ فِي الْمُصَلَّى فَلَمَّا أَذْلَقَتْهُ الْحِجَارَةُ فَرَّ فَأُدْرِكَ فَرُجِمَ حَتَّى مَاتَ فَقَالَ لَهُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَيْرًا وَلَمْ يُصَلِّ عَلَيْهِ ‏.‏
40.en: Jabir b. ‘Abd Allah said:A man of the tribe of Asalam came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and made confession of fornication. He (the prophet) turned away from him. When he testified against him four times, the Prophet (ﷺ) said: Are you mad? He said: No. he asked: Are you married? He replied: Yes. The Prophet (ﷺ) then commanded regarding him and he was stoned in the place of prayer. Then when the stones hurt him, he fled, but was overtaken and stoned to death. The Prophet (ﷺ) then spoke well of him and did not pray over him
40.hi: Jabir bin Abdullah kehte hain: Aslam qabeele ka ek aadmi Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ke paas aaya aur zina ka iqraar kiya. Aap (Nabi ne) unse apna mudh phera. Jab unhone chaar martaba apne khilaaf gawaahi di, Nabi (ﷺ) ne poocha: Kya tum paagal ho? Unhone kaha: Nahi. Aapne poocha: Kya tum shaadi-shuda ho? Unhone jawaab diya: Ji haan. Nabi (ﷺ) ne fir unke baare mein hukum diya aur unhein namaz padhne ki jagah par sangsaar kiya gaya. Fir jab patharon ne unhein takleef pahunchaayi, woh bhaage, lekin unhein pakad liya gaya aur sangsaar karke qatal kiya gaya. Nabi (ﷺ) ne fir unke baare mein achha bola aur unpar namaz nahi padhi.

40.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كَامِلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ زُرَيْعٍ - ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مَنِيعٍ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ زَكَرِيَّا، - وَهَذَا لَفْظُهُ - عَنْ دَاوُدَ، عَنْ أَبِي نَضْرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ لَمَّا أَمَرَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِرَجْمِ مَاعِزِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ خَرَجْنَا بِهِ إِلَى الْبَقِيعِ فَوَاللَّهِ مَا أَوْثَقْنَاهُ وَلاَ حَفَرْنَا لَهُ وَلَكِنَّهُ قَامَ لَنَا ‏.‏ - قَالَ أَبُو كَامِلٍ قَالَ - فَرَمَيْنَاهُ بِالْعِظَامِ وَالْمَدَرِ وَالْخَزَفِ فَاشْتَدَّ وَاشْتَدَدْنَا خَلْفَهُ حَتَّى أَتَى عُرْضَ الْحَرَّةِ فَانْتَصَبَ لَنَا فَرَمَيْنَاهُ بِجَلاَمِيدِ الْحَرَّةِ حَتَّى سَكَتَ - قَالَ - فَمَا اسْتَغْفَرَ لَهُ وَلاَ سَبَّهُ ‏.‏
40.en: Abu Sa’id said:When the Prophet (May peace e upon him) commanded to stone Ma’iz b. Malik, we took him out to Baql. I swear by Allah, we did not tie him, nor did we dig a pit for him. But he was standing before us. The narrator Abu Kamil said: So we threw at him bones, clods of mud and pieces of earthenware. He ran away and we ran after him till he came to a side of the Harrah. He stood there before us and we threw at him big stones of the Harrah until he died. He (the Prophet) did not ask forgiveness for him, nor did he speak ill of him
40.hi: Abu Sa'eed kehte hain: Jab Nabi (ﷺ) ne Ma'iz bin Malik ko sangsaar karne ka hukum diya, hum unhein Baql le gaye. Main Allah ki qasam khaata hoon, humne na unhein baandha, na unke liye koi gadhda khoda. Lekin woh humaare saamne khade the. Raawi Abu Kamil kehte hain: So humne unhein haddiyaan, mitti ke tukde, aur mitti ke bartano ke tukde phenke. Woh bhaage aur hum unke peeche daude yahan tak ke woh Harrah ke ek kinaare tak pahunche. Woh wahan humaare saamne khade hue aur humne unpar Harrah ke bade patthar phenke yahan tak ke woh mar gaye. Aapne (Nabi ne) na unke liye maafi maangi, na unke baare mein bura bola.

40.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُؤَمَّلُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، عَنِ الْجُرَيْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي نَضْرَةَ، قَالَ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَحْوَهُ وَلَيْسَ بِتَمَامِهِ قَالَ ذَهَبُوا يَسُبُّونَهُ فَنَهَاهُمْ قَالَ ذَهَبُوا يَسْتَغْفِرُونَ لَهُ فَنَهَاهُمْ قَالَ ‏ "‏ هُوَ رَجُلٌ أَصَابَ ذَنْبًا حَسِيبُهُ اللَّهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
40.en: Abu Nadrah said:A man came to Prophet (ﷺ). He then mentioned a similar tradition but not completely. This version has: People began to speak ill of him but he (the Prophet) forbade them. Then they began to ask forgiveness from him, but he forbade them by saying. He is a man who had committed a sin. Allah will call him to account himself
40.hi: Abu Nadrah kehte hain: Ek aadmi Nabi (ﷺ) ke paas aaya. Fir unhone isi jaisi riwayat bayaan ki lekin poori tarah nahi. Iss version mein hai: Log unke baare mein bura kehne lage lekin aapne (Nabi ne) unhein mana kiya. Fir woh unke liye maafi maangne lage, lekin aapne unhein yeh kehkar mana kiya: Woh ek aisa aadmi hai jinhone ek gunah kiya. Allah khud unse iska hisaab lega.

40.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَعْلَى بْنِ الْحَارِثِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ غَيْلاَنَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ بْنِ مَرْثَدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ بُرَيْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم اسْتَنْكَهَ مَاعِزًا ‏.‏
40.en: Buraidah said. :The Prophet (ﷺ) smelt the breath of Ma’iz
40.hi: Buraidah kehte hain: Nabi (ﷺ) ne Ma'iz ke munh se aane wali saans soongh li.

40.ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ الأَهْوَازِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أَحْمَدَ، حَدَّثَنَا بَشِيرُ بْنُ الْمُهَاجِرِ، حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ بُرَيْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ كُنَّا أَصْحَابَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ نَتَحَدَّثُ أَنَّ الْغَامِدِيَّةَ وَمَاعِزَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ لَوْ رَجَعَا بَعْدَ اعْتِرَافِهِمَا أَوْ قَالَ لَوْ لَمْ يَرْجِعَا بَعْدَ اعْتِرَافِهِمَا لَمْ يَطْلُبْهُمَا وَإِنَّمَا رَجَمَهُمَا عِنْدَ الرَّابِعَةِ ‏.‏
40.en: Narrated Buraydah ibn al-Hasib: We, the Companions of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), used to talk mutually: Would that al-Ghamidiyyah and Ma'iz ibn Malik had withdrawn after their confession; or he said: Had they not withdrawn after their confession, he would not have pursued them (for punishment). He had them stoned after the fourth (confession)
40.hi: Hazrat Buraydah bin al-Hasib bayaan karte hain: Hum, Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ke sahaba, aapas mein baaten karte the: Kaash al-Ghamidiyyah aur Ma'iz bin Malik ne apne iqraar ke baad apni baat wapas le li hoti; ya unhone kaha: Agar unhone apne iqraar ke baad apni baat wapas nahi li hoti, aap unhein saza dene ke liye peechha na karte. Unhein chauthi baar (iqraar) ke baad sangsaar kiya gaya.

40.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَةُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ دَاوُدَ بْنِ صُبَيْحٍ، قَالَ عَبْدَةُ أَخْبَرَنَا حَرَمِيُّ بْنُ حَفْصٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُلاَثَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ عُمَرَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ، أَنَّ خَالِدَ بْنَ اللَّجْلاَجِ، حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ اللَّجْلاَجَ أَبَاهُ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ، كَانَ قَاعِدًا يَعْتَمِلُ فِي السُّوقِ فَمَرَّتِ امْرَأَةٌ تَحْمِلُ صَبِيًّا فَثَارَ النَّاسُ مَعَهَا وَثُرْتُ فِيمَنْ ثَارَ فَانْتَهَيْتُ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُوَ يَقُولُ ‏"‏ مَنْ أَبُو هَذَا مَعَكِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَسَكَتَتْ فَقَالَ شَابٌّ حَذْوَهَا أَنَا أَبُوهُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ فَأَقْبَلَ عَلَيْهَا فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَنْ أَبُو هَذَا مَعَكِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ الْفَتَى أَنَا أَبُوهُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ فَنَظَرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَى بَعْضِ مَنْ حَوْلَهُ يَسْأَلُهُمْ عَنْهُ فَقَالُوا مَا عَلِمْنَا إِلاَّ خَيْرًا ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَهُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَحْصَنْتَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ فَأَمَرَ بِهِ فَرُجِمَ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَخَرَجْنَا بِهِ فَحَفَرْنَا لَهُ حَتَّى أَمْكَنَّا ثُمَّ رَمَيْنَاهُ بِالْحِجَارَةِ حَتَّى هَدَأَ فَجَاءَ رَجُلٌ يَسْأَلُ عَنِ الْمَرْجُومِ فَانْطَلَقْنَا بِهِ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقُلْنَا هَذَا جَاءَ يَسْأَلُ عَنِ الْخَبِيثِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لَهُوَ أَطْيَبُ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ مِنْ رِيحِ الْمِسْكِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَإِذَا هُوَ أَبُوهُ فَأَعَنَّاهُ عَلَى غُسْلِهِ وَتَكْفِينِهِ وَدَفْنِهِ وَمَا أَدْرِي قَالَ وَالصَّلاَةِ عَلَيْهِ أَمْ لاَ ‏.‏ وَهَذَا حَدِيثُ عَبْدَةَ وَهُوَ أَتَمُّ ‏.‏
40.en: Narrated Al-Lajlaj al-Amiri: I was working in the market. A woman passed carrying a child. The people rushed towards her, and I also rushed along with them. I then went to the Prophet (ﷺ) while he was asking: Who is the father of this (child) who is with you? She remained silent. A young man by her side said: I am his father, Messenger of Allah! He then turned towards her and asked: Who is the father of this child with you? The young man said: I am his father, Messenger of Allah! The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) then looked at some of those who were around him and asked them about him. They said: We only know good (about him). The Prophet (ﷺ) said to him: Are you married? He said: Yes. So he gave orders regarding him and he was stoned to death. He (the narrator) said: We took him out, dug a pit for him and put him in it. We then threw stones at him until he died. A man then came asking about the man who was stoned. We brought him to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said: This man has come asking about the wicked man. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: He is more agreeable than the fragrance of musk in the eyes of Allah. The man was his father. We then helped him in washing, shrouding and burying him. (The narrator said:) I do not know whether he said or did not say "in praying over him." This is the tradition of Abdah, and it is more accurate
40.hi: Hazrat Al-Lajlaj al-Amiri bayaan karte hain: Main bazaar mein kaam kar raha tha. Ek aurat ek bachche ko liye guzri. Log unki taraf daude, aur main bhi unke saath daudta. Fir main Nabi (ﷺ) ke paas gaya jab woh poochh rahe the: Kaun hai iska baap jo tumhaare saath hai? Woh khamosh rahi. Ek jawaan aadmi jo unke qareeb khade the, ne kaha: Main hoon iska baap, Allah ke Rasool! Aap fir unki taraf mude aur poocha: Kaun hai iska baap jo tumhaare saath hai? Jawaan aadmi ne kaha: Main hoon iska baap, Allah ke Rasool! Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne fir unke aas-paas ke kuch logon ki taraf dekha aur unke baare mein poocha. Unhone kaha: Humme unke baare mein sirf achhi baat hi maloom hai. Nabi (ﷺ) ne unse (jawaan aadmi se) poocha: Kya tum shaadi-shuda ho? Unhone kaha: Ji haan. So aapne unke baare mein hukum diya aur unhein sangsaar kiya gaya. Woh (raawi) kehte hain: Hum unhein le gaye, unke liye ek gadhda khoda, aur unhein isme rakh diya. Fir humne unpar patthar phenke yahan tak ke woh mar gaye. Ek aadmi fir aaya aur us aadmi ke baare mein poochne laga jise sangsaar kiya gaya tha. Hum unhein Nabi (ﷺ) ke paas laaye aur kaha: Yeh aadmi us bure aadmi ke baare mein poochne aaya hai. Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne kaha: Woh Allah ki nazron mein mushk ki khushbu se bhi zyada pasandeeda hai. Yeh aadmi unke baap the. Fir humne unhein dhoya, kafan diya, aur dafnaane mein madad ki. (Raawi kehte hain:) Mujhe nahi maloom unhone kaha ya nahi kaha 'unpar namaz padhne mein.' Yeh Abdah ki riwayat hai, aur yeh zyada sahi hai.

40.ar: حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا صَدَقَةُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا نَصْرُ بْنُ عَاصِمٍ الأَنْطَاكِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ، جَمِيعًا قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ، - قَالَ هِشَامٌ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الشُّعَيْثِيُّ - عَنْ مَسْلَمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْجُهَنِيِّ، عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ اللَّجْلاَجِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِبَعْضِ هَذَا الْحَدِيثِ ‏.‏
40.en: A part of tradition has also been transmitted by al-Lajlaj from the Prophet (ﷺ) through a different chain of narrators
40.hi: Riwayat ka ek hissa bhi al-Lajlaj se, Nabi (ﷺ) se, isi tarah ek doosri sanad se riwayat kiya gaya hai.

40.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا طَلْقُ بْنُ غَنَّامٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ السَّلاَمِ بْنُ حَفْصٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَازِمٍ، عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّ رَجُلاً أَتَاهُ فَأَقَرَّ عِنْدَهُ أَنَّهُ زَنَى بِامْرَأَةٍ سَمَّاهَا لَهُ فَبَعَثَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَى الْمَرْأَةِ فَسَأَلَهَا عَنْ ذَلِكَ فَأَنْكَرَتْ أَنْ تَكُونَ زَنَتْ فَجَلَدَهُ الْحَدَّ وَتَرَكَهَا ‏.‏
40.en: Narrated Sahl ibn Sa'd: A man came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and confessed before him that he had committed fornication with a woman whom he named. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) sent for the woman and asked her about it. But she denied that she had committed fornication. So he inflicted the prescribed punishment of flogging on him, and let her go
40.hi: Hazrat Sahl bin Sa'd bayaan karte hain: Ek aadmi Nabi (ﷺ) ke paas aaya aur unke saamne iqraar kiya ke unhone ek aurat se zina kiya, jinka naam unhone liya. Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne aurat ko bulwaaya aur unse (iske baare mein) poocha. Lekin unhone zina karne se inkaar kiya. So aapne un (aadmi) par farz kode maarne ki saza laagu ki, aur unhein (aurat ko) jaane diya.

40.ar: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا ح، وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ السَّرْحِ، - الْمَعْنَى - قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، أَنَّ رَجُلاً، زَنَى بِامْرَأَةٍ فَأَمَرَ بِهِ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَجُلِدَ الْحَدَّ ثُمَّ أُخْبِرَ أَنَّهُ مُحْصَنٌ فَأَمَرَ بِهِ فَرُجِمَ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو دَاوُدَ رَوَى هَذَا الْحَدِيثَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَكْرٍ الْبُرْسَانِيُّ عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ مَوْقُوفًا عَلَى جَابِرٍ ‏.‏ وَرَوَاهُ أَبُو عَاصِمٍ عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ بِنَحْوِ ابْنِ وَهْبٍ لَمْ يَذْكُرِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ إِنَّ رَجُلاً زَنَى فَلَمْ يَعْلَمْ بِإِحْصَانِهِ فَجُلِدَ ثُمَّ عَلِمَ بِإِحْصَانِهِ فَرُجِمَ ‏.‏
40.en: Narrated Jabir ibn Abdullah: A man committed fornication with a woman. So the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) ordered regarding him and the prescribed punishment of flogging was inflicted on him. He was then informed that he was married. So he commanded regarding him and he was stoned to death. Abu Dawud said: This tradition has been transmitted by Muhammad b. Bakr al-Barsani from Ibn Juraij as a statement of Jabir, and Abu 'Asim has transmitted it from Ibn Juraid similar to that of Ibn Wahb. He did not mention the Prophet (ﷺ). But he said: A man committed fornication, but did not know that he was married ; so he was flogged. It was then known that he was married, so he was stoned to death
40.hi: Hazrat Jabir bin Abdullah bayaan karte hain: Ek aadmi ne ek aurat se zina kiya. So Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne unke baare mein hukum diya aur unpar farz kode maarne ki saza laagu ki gayi. Fir unhein bataaya gaya ke woh shaadi-shuda hain. So aapne unke baare mein hukum diya aur unhein sangsaar kiya gaya. Abu Dawud kehte hain: Yeh riwayat Muhammad bin Bakr al-Barsani ne Ibn Juraij se, Jabir ke apne bayaan ke tor par riwayat ki hai, aur Abu Asim ne isse Ibn Juraij se, Ibn Wahb jaisi riwayat ki hai. Unhone Nabi (ﷺ) ka zikr nahi kiya. Lekin unhone kaha: Ek aadmi ne zina kiya, lekin unhein nahi maloom tha ke woh shaadi-shuda hain; so unhein kode maare gaye. Fir maloom hua ke woh shaadi-shuda hain, so unhein sangsaar kiya gaya.

40.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحِيمِ أَبُو يَحْيَى الْبَزَّازُ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، أَنَّ رَجُلاً، زَنَى بِامْرَأَةٍ فَلَمْ يَعْلَمْ بِإِحْصَانِهِ فَجُلِدَ ثُمَّ عَلِمَ بِإِحْصَانِهِ فَرُجِمَ ‏.‏
40.en: Jabir said:A man committed fornication with a woman. It was not known that he was married. So he was flogged. It was then known that he was married, so he was stoned to death
40.hi: Jabir kehte hain: Ek aadmi ne ek aurat se zina kiya. Unhein nahi maloom tha ke woh shaadi-shuda hain. So unhein kode maare gaye. Fir maloom hua ke woh shaadi-shuda hain, so unhein sangsaar kiya gaya.

40.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُسْلِمُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَنَّ هِشَامًا الدَّسْتَوَائِيَّ، وَأَبَانَ بْنَ يَزِيدَ، حَدَّثَاهُمُ - الْمَعْنَى، - عَنْ يَحْيَى، عَنْ أَبِي قِلاَبَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الْمُهَلَّبِ، عَنْ عِمْرَانَ بْنِ حُصَيْنٍ، أَنَّ امْرَأَةً، - قَالَ فِي حَدِيثِ أَبَانَ مِنْ جُهَيْنَةَ - أَتَتِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَتْ إِنَّهَا زَنَتْ وَهِيَ حُبْلَى ‏.‏ فَدَعَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَلِيًّا لَهَا فَقَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَحْسِنْ إِلَيْهَا فَإِذَا وَضَعَتْ فَجِئْ بِهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَلَمَّا أَنْ وَضَعَتْ جَاءَ بِهَا فَأَمَرَ بِهَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَشُكَّتْ عَلَيْهَا ثِيَابُهَا ثُمَّ أَمَرَ بِهَا فَرُجِمَتْ ثُمَّ أَمَرَهُمْ فَصَلَّوْا عَلَيْهَا فَقَالَ عُمَرُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ تُصَلِّي عَلَيْهَا وَقَدْ زَنَتْ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ لَقَدْ تَابَتْ تَوْبَةً لَوْ قُسِّمَتْ بَيْنَ سَبْعِينَ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْمَدِينَةِ لَوَسِعَتْهُمْ وَهَلْ وَجَدْتَ أَفْضَلَ مِنْ أَنْ جَادَتْ بِنَفْسِهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ لَمْ يَقُلْ عَنْ أَبَانَ فَشُكَّتْ عَلَيْهَا ثِيَابُهَا ‏.‏
40.en: Narrated Imran ibn Husayn: A woman belonging to the tribe of Juhaynah (according to the version of Aban) came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said that she had committed fornication and that she was pregnant. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) called her guardian. Then the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to him: Be good to her, and when she bears a child, bring her (to me). When she gave birth to the child, he brought her (to him). The Prophet (ﷺ) gave orders regarding her, and her clothes were tied to her. He then commanded regarding her and she was stoned to death. He commanded the people (to pray) and they prayed over her. Thereupon Umar said: Are you praying over her, Messenger of Allah, when she has committed fornication? He said: By Him in Whose hand my soul is, she has repented to such an extent that if it were divided among the seventy people of Medina, it would have been enough for them all. And what do you find better than the fact that she gave her life. Aban did not say in his version: Then her clothes were tied to her
40.hi: Hazrat Imran bin Husayn bayaan karte hain: Juhaynah qabeele ki ek aurat (Aban ke version ke mutabiq) Nabi (ﷺ) ke paas aayi aur kaha ke unhone zina kiya hai aur woh haaml hain. Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne unke sarparast ko bulwaaya. Fir Allah ke Rasool (ﷺ) ne unse kaha: Unke saath achha suluk karo, aur jab woh bachcha janme, unhein (mere paas) laao. Jab unhone bachcha janma, woh unhein (Nabi ke paas) laaye. Nabi (ﷺ) ne unke baare mein hukum diya, aur unke kapde unse baandhe gaye. Fir aapne unke baare mein hukum diya aur unhein sangsaar kiya gaya. Aapne logon ko (namaz ke liye) hukum diya aur unhone unpar namaz padhi. Isper Umar ne kaha: Kya aap unpar namaz padh rahe hain, Allah ke Rasool, jabke unhone zina kiya hai? Aapne kaha: Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, unhone itni tauba ki hai ke agar yeh Madina ke sattar logon mein taqseem ki jaaye, yeh unke liye kaafi hoti. Aur tumhein isse behtar kya lagega ke unhone apni jaan de di. Aban ne apne version mein 'fir unke kapde unse baandhe gaye' ke alfaaz zikr nahi kiye.

40.ar: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْوَزِيرِ الدِّمَشْقِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ، عَنِ الأَوْزَاعِيِّ، قَالَ فَشُكَّتْ عَلَيْهَا ثِيَابُهَا ‏.‏ يَعْنِي فَشُدَّتْ ‏.‏
40.en: Al-Auza’i said:The word shukkta means tied, meaning her clothes were tied on her
40.hi: Al-Auza'i kehte hain: Lafz 'shukkta' ka matlab hai baandhna, yaani, unke kapde unpar baandhe gaye.

40.ar: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُوسَى الرَّازِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ يُونُسَ، عَنْ بَشِيرِ بْنِ الْمُهَاجِرِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ بُرَيْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ امْرَأَةً، - يَعْنِي مِنْ غَامِدَ - أَتَتِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَتْ إِنِّي قَدْ فَجَرْتُ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ ارْجِعِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَرَجَعَتْ فَلَمَّا كَانَ الْغَدُ أَتَتْهُ فَقَالَتْ لَعَلَّكَ أَنْ تَرُدَّنِي كَمَا رَدَدْتَ مَاعِزَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ فَوَاللَّهِ إِنِّي لَحُبْلَى ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَهَا ‏"‏ ارْجِعِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَرَجَعَتْ فَلَمَّا كَانَ الْغَدُ أَتَتْهُ فَقَالَ لَهَا ‏"‏ ارْجِعِي حَتَّى تَلِدِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَرَجَعَتْ فَلَمَّا وَلَدَتْ أَتَتْهُ بِالصَّبِيِّ فَقَالَتْ هَذَا قَدْ وَلَدْتُهُ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَهَا ‏"‏ ارْجِعِي فَأَرْضِعِيهِ حَتَّى تَفْطِمِيهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَجَاءَتْ بِهِ وَقَدْ فَطَمَتْهُ وَفِي يَدِهِ شَىْءٌ يَأْكُلُهُ فَأَمَرَ بِالصَّبِيِّ فَدُفِعَ إِلَى رَجُلٍ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ وَأَمَرَ بِهَا فَحُفِرَ لَهَا وَأَمَرَ بِهَا فَرُجِمَتْ وَكَانَ خَالِدٌ فِيمَنْ يَرْجُمُهَا فَرَجَمَهَا بِحَجَرٍ فَوَقَعَتْ قَطْرَةٌ مِنْ دَمِهَا عَلَى وَجْنَتِهِ فَسَبَّهَا فَقَالَ لَهُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَهْلاً يَا خَالِدُ فَوَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ لَقَدْ تَابَتْ تَوْبَةً لَوْ تَابَهَا صَاحِبُ مَكْسٍ لَغُفِرَ لَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَأَمَرَ بِهَا فَصُلِّيَ عَلَيْهَا فَدُفِنَتْ ‏.‏
40.en: Buraidah said:A woman of Ghamid came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said: I have committed fornication. He said: Go back. She returned, and on the next day she came to him again, and said: Perhaps you want to send me back as you did to Ma’iz b. Malik. I swear by Allah, I am pregnant. He said to her: Go back. She then returned and came to him the next day. He said to her: Go back until you give birth to a child. She then returned. When she gave birth to a child, she brought the child to him, and said: Here it is! I have given birth to it. He said: Go back, and suckle him until you wean him. When she had weaned him, she brought him (the boy) to him with something in his hand which he was eating. The boy was then given to a certain man of the Muslims and he (the Prophet) commanded regarding her. So a pit was dug for her, and he gave orders about her and she was stoned to death. Khalid was one of those who were throwing stones at her. He threw a stone at her. When a drop blood fell on his cheeks, he abused her. The Prophet (ﷺ) said to him: Gently, Khalid. By Him in whose hand my soul is, she has reported to such an extent that if one who wrongfully takes extra tax were to repent to a like extent, he would be forgiven. Then giving command regarding her, prayed over her and she was buried
40.hi: Buraidah kehte hain: Ghamid ki ek aurat Nabi (ﷺ) ke paas aayi aur kaha: Maine zina kiya hai. Aapne kaha: Wapas jao. Woh wapas gayi, aur agle din woh unke paas dobara aayi, aur kaha: Shaayad aap mujhe wapas bhejna chaahte hain jaisa aapne Ma'iz bin Malik ke saath kiya. Main Allah ki qasam khaati hoon, main haaml hoon. Aapne unse kaha: Wapas jao. Fir woh wapas gayi aur agle din unke paas aayi. Aapne unse kaha: Wapas jao jab tak tum bachcha janm na do. Fir woh wapas gayi. Jab unhone bachcha janma, woh bachcha unke paas laayi, aur kaha: Yeh raha! Maine ise janm diya hai. Aapne kaha: Wapas jao, aur ise doodh pilaao jab tak tum ise doodh chhudwaao. Jab unhone ise doodh chhudwaaya, woh usse (ladke ko) unke paas kuch cheez haath mein liye laayi jo woh khaa rahe the. Ladka fir Musalmanon mein se ek aadmi ko diya gaya aur aapne unke baare mein hukum diya. So unke liye ek gadhda khoda gaya, aur aapne unke baare mein hukum diya aur unhein sangsaar kiya gaya. Khalid un logon mein se the jo unpar patthar phenk rahe the. Unhone unpar ek patthar phenka. Jab ek boond khoon unke galon par gira, unhone (unhein) gaali di. Nabi (ﷺ) ne unse kaha: Aaraam se, Khalid. Us Zaat ki qasam jiske haath mein meri jaan hai, unhone itni tauba ki hai ke agar koi zulm se izaafi tax lene wala isi tarah tauba karta, use maaf kar diya jaata. Fir unke baare mein hukum dete hue, aapne unpar namaz padhi aur unhein dafnaaya gaya.

40.ar: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعُ بْنُ الْجَرَّاحِ، عَنْ زَكَرِيَّا أَبِي عِمْرَانَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ شَيْخًا، يُحَدِّثُ عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي بَكْرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَجَمَ امْرَأَةً فَحُفِرَ لَهَا إِلَى الثَّنْدُوَةِ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو دَاوُدَ أَفْهَمَنِي رَجُلٌ عَنْ عُثْمَانَ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو دَاوُدَ قَالَ الْغَسَّانِيُّ جُهَيْنَةُ وَغَامِدٌ وَبَارِقٌ وَاحِدٌ ‏.‏
40.en: Narrated Zakariya Abi 'Imran: I heard an old man who transmitted from Abu Bakrah on this father's authority that the Prophet (ﷺ) had a woman stoned and a pit was dug up to her breasts. Abu Dawud said: A man made me understand it from 'Uthman (b. Abi Shaibah) Abu Dawud said: Al-Ghassani said: Juhainah, Ghamid and Bariq as the same
40.hi: Hazrat Zakariya Abi Imran bayaan karte hain: Maine ek budhe aadmi ko suna jinhone Abu Bakrah se, unke walid ke hawale se riwayat ki ke Nabi (ﷺ) ne ek aurat ko sangsaar karvaaya aur ek gadhda unke seene tak khoda gaya. Abu Dawud kehte hain: Ek aadmi ne mujhe iske baare mein Uthman (bin Abi Shaibah) se samjhaya. Abu Dawud kehte hain: Al-Ghassani kehte hain: Juhaynah, Ghamid, aur Bariq ek hi hain.

40.ar: قَالَ أَبُو دَاوُدَ حُدِّثْتُ عَنْ عَبْدِ الصَّمَدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْوَارِثِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّا بْنُ سُلَيْمٍ، بِإِسْنَادِهِ نَحْوَهُ زَادَ ثُمَّ رَمَاهَا بِحَصَاةٍ مِثْلَ الْحُمُّصَةِ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏ "‏ ارْمُوا وَاتَّقُوا الْوَجْهَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَلَمَّا طَفِئَتْ أَخْرَجَهَا فَصَلَّى عَلَيْهَا وَقَالَ فِي التَّوْبَةِ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ بُرَيْدَةَ ‏.‏
40.en: Abu Dawud said:A similar tradition has been transmitted by Zakariya b. Salim through a different chain of narrators. This version adds: He (the Prophet) then threw a pebble like a gram at her. He then said: Throw at her and avoid her face. When se died, he took her out and prayed over her. About repentance he said similar to the tradition on Buraidah
40.hi: Abu Dawud kehte hain: Isi jaisi riwayat bhi Zakariya bin Salim se isi tarah ek doosri sanad se riwayat ki gayi hai. Iss version mein izaafa hai: Aapne (Nabi ne) fir unpar ek chana jaisa patthar phenka. Fir aapne kaha: Unpar phenko aur unke chehre se bacho. Jab woh mar gayi, aap unhein le gaye aur unpar namaz padhi. Tauba ke baare mein aapne isi jaisi baat kahi jaisi Buraidah ki riwayat mein hai.
